import { type InputHTMLAttributes, type ReactNode, useEffect, useRef, useState } from "react";
import { createPortal } from "react-dom";
import { App as AntApp } from "antd";
import { Eye, EyeOff, KeyRound, LoaderCircle, LockKeyhole, Mail, Ticket, X } from "lucide-react";
import { useTranslation } from "react-i18next";
import { useLocation, useNavigate } from "react-router-dom";

import { BrandName, BrandWordmark } from "@/components/brand/brand-wordmark";
import { changeAppLocale, listLocales, type AppLocale } from "@/i18n";
import { useAuthStore } from "@/stores/use-auth-store";
import { useAuthDialogStore, type AuthMode } from "@/stores/use-auth-dialog-store";
import "./auth-dialog.css";

const EMAIL_RE = /^[^\s@]+@[^\s@]+\.[^\s@]+$/;
const AUTH_ROUTES = ["/login", "/register", "/forgot-password"];

/**
 * 即梦式登录弹窗：浮在当前页面之上，遮罩 + 居中卡片，不跳路由。
 * 登录 / 注册 / 重置三种模式共用一套外壳，切换在弹窗内完成。
 */
export function AuthDialog() {
    const { message } = AntApp.useApp();
    const { i18n, t } = useTranslation();
    const navigate = useNavigate();
    const location = useLocation();

    const mode = useAuthDialogStore((state) => state.mode);
    const redirect = useAuthDialogStore((state) => state.redirect);
    const presetInvite = useAuthDialogStore((state) => state.invite);
    const setMode = useAuthDialogStore((state) => state.setMode);
    const close = useAuthDialogStore((state) => state.close);

    const login = useAuthStore((state) => state.login);
    const register = useAuthStore((state) => state.register);
    const resetPassword = useAuthStore((state) => state.resetPassword);
    const sendCode = useAuthStore((state) => state.sendCode);

    const [email, setEmail] = useState("");
    const [password, setPassword] = useState("");
    const [confirm, setConfirm] = useState("");
    const [code, setCode] = useState("");
    const [inviteCode, setInviteCode] = useState("");
    const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false);
    const [sending, setSending] = useState(false);
    const [cooldown, setCooldown] = useState(0);
    const [passwordVisible, setPasswordVisible] = useState(false);
    const [confirmVisible, setConfirmVisible] = useState(false);

    const cardRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
    const open = mode !== null;

    // 打开时预填邀请码；切换模式保留已输入的邮箱，避免重复输入。
    useEffect(() => {
        if (!open) return;
        if (presetInvite) setInviteCode(presetInvite);
    }, [open, presetInvite]);

    useEffect(() => {
        if (cooldown <= 0) return;
        const timer = window.setTimeout(() => setCooldown((value) => value - 1), 1000);
        return () => window.clearTimeout(timer);
    }, [cooldown]);

    // 关闭入口要清掉验证码与密码，邮箱留着方便再打开
    function closeDialog() {
        close();
        setPassword("");
        setConfirm("");
        setCode("");
        setCooldown(0);
        setPasswordVisible(false);
        setConfirmVisible(false);
        // 通过 /login 等地址进来的，关闭后回首页（保留来源页更自然）
        if (AUTH_ROUTES.includes(location.pathname)) {
            navigate("/", { replace: true });
        }
    }

    useEffect(() => {
        if (!open) return;
        const previousFocused = document.activeElement instanceof HTMLElement ? document.activeElement : null;
        const focusables = () =>
            Array.from(
                cardRef.current?.querySelectorAll<HTMLElement>(
                    'button:not(:disabled), input:not(:disabled), select:not(:disabled), textarea:not(:disabled), a[href], [tabindex]:not([tabindex="-1"])',
                ) ?? [],
            ).filter((element) => element.offsetParent !== null);
        const onKeyDown = (event: KeyboardEvent) => {
            if (event.key === "Escape") {
                closeDialog();
                return;
            }
            if (event.key !== "Tab") return;
            const list = focusables();
            if (!list.length) return;
            const first = list[0];
            const last = list[list.length - 1];
            const active = document.activeElement;
            if (event.shiftKey) {
                if (active === first || !cardRef.current?.contains(active)) {
                    event.preventDefault();
                    last.focus();
                }
            } else if (active === last || !cardRef.current?.contains(active)) {
                event.preventDefault();
                first.focus();
            }
        };
        const previousOverflow = document.body.style.overflow;
        document.body.style.overflow = "hidden";
        document.addEventListener("keydown", onKeyDown);
        // 打开时把焦点交给第一个输入框，键盘用户不用先摸到卡片
        const timer = window.setTimeout(() => {
            cardRef.current?.querySelector<HTMLInputElement>("input")?.focus();
        }, 60);
        return () => {
            document.body.style.overflow = previousOverflow;
            document.removeEventListener("keydown", onKeyDown);
            window.clearTimeout(timer);
            if (previousFocused?.isConnected) previousFocused.focus();
        };
        // eslint-disable-next-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps
    }, [open]);

    if (!open) return null;

    const currentMode: AuthMode = mode;
    const needsCode = currentMode !== "login";
    const locale = i18n.resolvedLanguage as AppLocale;
    const authLocales = listLocales();
    const localeIndex = Math.max(0, authLocales.findIndex((item) => item.code === locale));
    const nextLocaleItem = authLocales[(localeIndex + 1) % authLocales.length];

    const copy =
        currentMode === "login"
            ? { title: t("auth.welcomeBack"), subtitle: t("auth.loginSubtitle"), action: t("auth.login") }
            : currentMode === "register"
              ? { title: t("auth.createWorkspace"), subtitle: t("auth.registerSubtitle"), action: t("auth.register") }
              : { title: t("auth.resetAccess"), subtitle: t("auth.resetSubtitle"), action: t("auth.reset") };

    async function handleSendCode() {
        if (!EMAIL_RE.test(email)) {
            message.error(t("auth.invalidEmail"));
            return;
        }
        setSending(true);
        try {
            await sendCode(email, currentMode === "register" ? "register" : "reset");
            message.success(t("auth.codeSent"));
            setCooldown(60);
        } catch (error) {
            message.error(error instanceof Error ? error.message : String(error));
        } finally {
            setSending(false);
        }
    }

    async function handleSubmit() {
        if (!EMAIL_RE.test(email)) {
            message.error(t("auth.invalidEmail"));
            return;
        }
        if (password.length < 8) {
            message.error(t("auth.passwordTooShort"));
            return;
        }
        if (currentMode !== "login" && password !== confirm) {
            message.error(t("auth.passwordMismatch"));
            return;
        }
        if (needsCode && !code.trim()) {
            message.error(t("auth.codeRequired"));
            return;
        }

        setLoading(true);
        try {
            if (currentMode === "login") {
                await login(email, password);
                message.success(t("auth.loginSuccess"));
                close();
                navigate(redirect || "/", { replace: true });
            } else if (currentMode === "register") {
                await register(email, code.trim(), password, inviteCode.trim().toUpperCase());
                message.success(t("auth.registerSuccess"));
                close();
                navigate(redirect || "/", { replace: true });
            } else {
                await resetPassword(email, code.trim(), password);
                message.success(t("auth.resetSuccess"));
                setPassword("");
                setConfirm("");
                setCode("");
                setMode("login");
            }
        } catch (error) {
            message.error(error instanceof Error ? error.message : String(error));
        } finally {
            setLoading(false);
        }
    }

    return createPortal(
        <div className="auth-modal">
            <div className="auth-modal-mask" onClick={closeDialog} />
            <div className="auth-modal-card" role="dialog" aria-modal="true" aria-labelledby="auth-modal-title" ref={cardRef}>
                <header className="auth-modal-head">
                    <span className="auth-modal-brand">
                        <img className="auth-modal-symbol" src="/brand/sundas-symbol.svg" alt="" />
                        <BrandWordmark height={13} decorative />
                    </span>
                    <div className="auth-modal-head-actions">
                        <button
                            type="button"
                            className="auth-modal-locale"
                            onClick={() => void changeAppLocale(nextLocaleItem.code)}
                            aria-label={t("topNav.switchLanguage", { language: nextLocaleItem.label })}
                        >
                            {nextLocaleItem.short}
                        </button>
                        <button type="button" className="auth-modal-close" onClick={closeDialog} aria-label={t("auth.backHome")}>
                            <X />
                        </button>
                    </div>
                </header>

                <div className="auth-modal-heading">
                    <h2 id="auth-modal-title" className="auth-modal-title">
                        <BrandName text={copy.title} imageHeight="0.78em" />
                    </h2>
                    <p className="auth-modal-subtitle">{copy.subtitle}</p>
                </div>

                <form
                    className="auth-modal-fields"
                    onSubmit={(event) => {
                        event.preventDefault();
                        void handleSubmit();
                    }}
                >
                    <AuthField
                        label={t("auth.email")}
                        icon={<Mail />}
                        type="email"
                        name="email"
                        placeholder={t("auth.emailPlaceholder")}
                        value={email}
                        autoComplete="email"
                        onChange={(event) => setEmail(event.target.value)}
                    />
                    <AuthField
                        label={t("auth.password")}
                        icon={<LockKeyhole />}
                        type={passwordVisible ? "text" : "password"}
                        name="password"
                        placeholder={t("auth.passwordPlaceholder")}
                        value={password}
                        autoComplete={currentMode === "login" ? "current-password" : "new-password"}
                        onChange={(event) => setPassword(event.target.value)}
                        action={
                            <button type="button" className="auth-modal-eye" onClick={() => setPasswordVisible((value) => !value)} aria-label={passwordVisible ? t("auth.hidePassword") : t("auth.showPassword")}>
                                {passwordVisible ? <EyeOff /> : <Eye />}
                            </button>
                        }
                    />
                    {currentMode !== "login" ? (
                        <AuthField
                            label={t("auth.confirmPassword")}
                            icon={<LockKeyhole />}
                            type={confirmVisible ? "text" : "password"}
                            name="confirmPassword"
                            placeholder={t("auth.confirmPassword")}
                            value={confirm}
                            autoComplete="new-password"
                            onChange={(event) => setConfirm(event.target.value)}
                            action={
                                <button type="button" className="auth-modal-eye" onClick={() => setConfirmVisible((value) => !value)} aria-label={confirmVisible ? t("auth.hidePassword") : t("auth.showPassword")}>
                                    {confirmVisible ? <EyeOff /> : <Eye />}
                                </button>
                            }
                        />
                    ) : null}
                    {needsCode ? (
                        <label className="auth-modal-field">
                            <span className="auth-modal-label">{t("auth.code")}</span>
                            <span className="auth-modal-code-row">
                                <span className="auth-modal-shell">
                                    <KeyRound className="auth-modal-icon" />
                                    <input
                                        className="auth-modal-input"
                                        name="code"
                                        inputMode="numeric"
                                        maxLength={6}
                                        placeholder={t("auth.codePlaceholder")}
                                        value={code}
                                        autoComplete="one-time-code"
                                        onChange={(event) => setCode(event.target.value.replace(/\D/g, ""))}
                                    />
                                </span>
                                <button type="button" className="auth-modal-code-btn" disabled={sending || cooldown > 0} onClick={() => void handleSendCode()}>
                                    {cooldown > 0 ? t("auth.resendIn", { seconds: cooldown }) : t("auth.sendCode")}
                                </button>
                            </span>
                        </label>
                    ) : null}
                    {currentMode === "register" ? (
                        <label className="auth-modal-field">
                            <span className="auth-modal-label">
                                {t("auth.inviteCode")}
                                <span className="auth-modal-optional">{t("auth.optional")}</span>
                            </span>
                            <span className="auth-modal-shell">
                                <Ticket className="auth-modal-icon" />
                                <input
                                    className="auth-modal-input"
                                    name="inviteCode"
                                    maxLength={16}
                                    placeholder={t("auth.inviteCodePlaceholder")}
                                    value={inviteCode}
                                    onChange={(event) => setInviteCode(event.target.value.toUpperCase())}
                                />
                            </span>
                        </label>
                    ) : null}

                    <button type="submit" className="auth-modal-submit" disabled={loading}>
                        {loading ? <LoaderCircle className="auth-modal-spin" size={17} /> : copy.action}
                    </button>
                </form>

                <div className="auth-modal-alt">
                    {currentMode === "login" ? (
                        <>
                            <button type="button" className="auth-modal-link" onClick={() => setMode("register")}>
                                {t("auth.noAccount")}
                                <span className="auth-modal-link-strong">{t("auth.toRegister")}</span>
                            </button>
                            <button type="button" className="auth-modal-link" onClick={() => setMode("reset")}>
                                {t("auth.forgot")}
                            </button>
                        </>
                    ) : currentMode === "register" ? (
                        <button type="button" className="auth-modal-link" onClick={() => setMode("login")}>
                            {t("auth.hasAccount")}
                            <span className="auth-modal-link-strong">{t("auth.toLogin")}</span>
                        </button>
                    ) : (
                        <button type="button" className="auth-modal-link" onClick={() => setMode("login")}>
                            {t("auth.backToLogin")}
                        </button>
                    )}
                </div>

                <p className="auth-modal-foot">{t("auth.formFootnote")}</p>
            </div>
        </div>,
        document.body,
    );
}

function AuthField({
    label,
    icon,
    action,
    ...props
}: InputHTMLAttributes<HTMLInputElement> & { label: string; icon: ReactNode; action?: ReactNode }) {
    return (
        <label className="auth-modal-field">
            <span className="auth-modal-label">{label}</span>
            <span className="auth-modal-shell">
                <span className="auth-modal-icon">{icon}</span>
                <input className="auth-modal-input" {...props} />
                {action}
            </span>
        </label>
    );
}

import { useEffect, useRef } from "react";

import "./dot-field.css";

/**
 * 点阵底纹（参照 liblib.tv 的页面背景）。
 *
 * 效果：一整片均匀的暗点，光标移上去时附近的点被「点亮」并微微放大，
 * 以光标为圆心柔和衰减，移开后回落到原亮度；光点带缓动拖尾，所以移动时是流动的而不是硬贴。
 *
 * 实现拆成两层 canvas：
 *   底层整片点阵只在尺寸变化时画一次（几千个点合成一条 Path，一次 fill）；
 *   上层每帧只重画光标半径内的点，并按亮度分桶批量 fill，
 *   所以逐帧开销只跟「光斑内的点数」有关，与页面大小无关。
 */

/* 网格间距：参照图实测 18px，点径约 2px */
const SPACING = 19;
const BASE_RADIUS = 1;
const PEAK_RADIUS = 1.85;
const BASE_ALPHA = 0.12;
const PEAK_ALPHA = 0.46;
/* 光斑半径：超过这个距离的点保持基础亮度 */
const FALLOFF = 200;
/* 光标周围的柔光，让点亮区域像一小片被打亮的面而不是孤立亮点 */
const HALO = 0.02;
const TAU = Math.PI * 2;
/* 亮度分档：把光斑内的点按衰减值分桶，每桶一次 fill */
const BUCKETS = 14;

export function DotField({ className = "" }: { className?: string }) {
    const hostRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
    const baseRef = useRef<HTMLCanvasElement>(null);
    const glowRef = useRef<HTMLCanvasElement>(null);

    useEffect(() => {
        const host = hostRef.current;
        const baseCanvas = baseRef.current;
        const glowCanvas = glowRef.current;
        if (!host || !baseCanvas || !glowCanvas) return;
        const baseCtx = baseCanvas.getContext("2d");
        const glowCtx = glowCanvas.getContext("2d");
        if (!baseCtx || !glowCtx) return;

        const motion = window.matchMedia("(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)");
        let width = 0;
        let height = 0;
        let dpr = 1;
        let frame = 0;

        /* x/y 是缓动后的光斑中心，tx/ty 是真实光标；strength 控制整体亮灭 */
        const pointer = { x: -9999, y: -9999, tx: -9999, ty: -9999, strength: 0, target: 0 };

        const paintBase = () => {
            baseCtx.setTransform(1, 0, 0, 1, 0, 0);
            baseCtx.clearRect(0, 0, baseCanvas.width, baseCanvas.height);
            if (!width || !height) return;
            baseCtx.setTransform(dpr, 0, 0, dpr, 0, 0);
            baseCtx.fillStyle = `rgba(255, 255, 255, ${BASE_ALPHA})`;
            baseCtx.beginPath();
            for (let y = SPACING / 2; y < height; y += SPACING) {
                for (let x = SPACING / 2; x < width; x += SPACING) {
                    baseCtx.moveTo(x + BASE_RADIUS, y);
                    baseCtx.arc(x, y, BASE_RADIUS, 0, TAU);
                }
            }
            baseCtx.fill();
        };

        const paintGlow = () => {
            glowCtx.setTransform(1, 0, 0, 1, 0, 0);
            glowCtx.clearRect(0, 0, glowCanvas.width, glowCanvas.height);
            const strength = pointer.strength;
            if (!width || !height || strength <= 0.004) return;
            glowCtx.setTransform(dpr, 0, 0, dpr, 0, 0);

            const cx = pointer.x;
            const cy = pointer.y;

            /* 柔光：被点亮的那一小片面 */
            const halo = glowCtx.createRadialGradient(cx, cy, 0, cx, cy, FALLOFF);
            halo.addColorStop(0, `rgba(255, 255, 255, ${HALO * strength})`);
            halo.addColorStop(0.5, `rgba(255, 255, 255, ${HALO * 0.38 * strength})`);
            halo.addColorStop(1, "rgba(255, 255, 255, 0)");
            glowCtx.fillStyle = halo;
            glowCtx.fillRect(cx - FALLOFF, cy - FALLOFF, FALLOFF * 2, FALLOFF * 2);

            /* 逐点算衰减，按档位归桶；smoothstep 让中心是一片接近满亮的区域，边缘才快速淡出 */
            const paths = Array.from({ length: BUCKETS }, () => new Path2D());
            const firstCol = Math.floor((cx - FALLOFF) / SPACING);
            const lastCol = Math.ceil((cx + FALLOFF) / SPACING);
            const firstRow = Math.floor((cy - FALLOFF) / SPACING);
            const lastRow = Math.ceil((cy + FALLOFF) / SPACING);
            const spans: boolean[] = new Array(BUCKETS).fill(false);

            for (let row = firstRow; row <= lastRow; row += 1) {
                const y = SPACING / 2 + row * SPACING;
                if (y < 0 || y > height) continue;
                for (let col = firstCol; col <= lastCol; col += 1) {
                    const x = SPACING / 2 + col * SPACING;
                    if (x < 0 || x > width) continue;
                    const distance = Math.hypot(x - cx, y - cy);
                    if (distance >= FALLOFF) continue;
                    const energy = 1 - distance / FALLOFF;
                    const eased = energy * energy * (3 - 2 * energy);
                    const slot = Math.min(BUCKETS - 1, Math.round(eased * (BUCKETS - 1)));
                    const radius = BASE_RADIUS + (PEAK_RADIUS - BASE_RADIUS) * eased * strength;
                    const path = paths[slot];
                    path.moveTo(x + radius, y);
                    path.arc(x, y, radius, 0, TAU);
                    spans[slot] = true;
                }
            }

            /* 由暗到亮依次铺，亮的覆盖在暗的上面 */
            for (let slot = 0; slot < BUCKETS; slot += 1) {
                if (!spans[slot]) continue;
                const eased = slot / (BUCKETS - 1);
                const alpha = BASE_ALPHA + (PEAK_ALPHA - BASE_ALPHA) * eased * strength;
                glowCtx.fillStyle = `rgba(255, 255, 255, ${alpha.toFixed(4)})`;
                glowCtx.fill(paths[slot]);
            }
        };

        const tick = () => {
            frame = 0;
            const snap = motion.matches;
            const follow = snap ? 1 : 0.18;
            const rise = snap ? 1 : 0.1;
            pointer.x += (pointer.tx - pointer.x) * follow;
            pointer.y += (pointer.ty - pointer.y) * follow;
            pointer.strength += (pointer.target - pointer.strength) * rise;
            paintGlow();
            const following = Math.abs(pointer.tx - pointer.x) > 0.4 || Math.abs(pointer.ty - pointer.y) > 0.4;
            const changing = Math.abs(pointer.target - pointer.strength) > 0.003;
            if (following || changing) frame = requestAnimationFrame(tick);
        };

        const wake = () => {
            if (!frame) frame = requestAnimationFrame(tick);
        };

        const onMove = (event: PointerEvent) => {
            if (event.pointerType === "touch") return;
            const rect = host.getBoundingClientRect();
            const x = event.clientX - rect.left;
            const y = event.clientY - rect.top;
            if (x < 0 || y < 0 || x > rect.width || y > rect.height) {
                if (pointer.target !== 0) {
                    pointer.target = 0;
                    wake();
                }
                return;
            }
            /* 熄着进来的话直接落位，不要从上一个位置飞过来 */
            if (pointer.strength < 0.05) {
                pointer.x = x;
                pointer.y = y;
            }
            pointer.tx = x;
            pointer.ty = y;
            pointer.target = 1;
            wake();
        };

        const onLeave = () => {
            if (pointer.target === 0) return;
            pointer.target = 0;
            wake();
        };

        const resize = () => {
            const rect = host.getBoundingClientRect();
            width = Math.round(rect.width);
            height = Math.round(rect.height);
            dpr = Math.min(window.devicePixelRatio || 1, 2);
            for (const canvas of [baseCanvas, glowCanvas]) {
                canvas.width = Math.round(width * dpr);
                canvas.height = Math.round(height * dpr);
            }
            paintBase();
            glowCtx.setTransform(1, 0, 0, 1, 0, 0);
            glowCtx.clearRect(0, 0, glowCanvas.width, glowCanvas.height);
        };

        const observer = new ResizeObserver(resize);
        observer.observe(host);
        resize();

        window.addEventListener("pointermove", onMove, { passive: true });
        window.addEventListener("blur", onLeave);
        document.addEventListener("pointerleave", onLeave);
        motion.addEventListener("change", wake);

        return () => {
            if (frame) cancelAnimationFrame(frame);
            observer.disconnect();
            window.removeEventListener("pointermove", onMove);
            window.removeEventListener("blur", onLeave);
            document.removeEventListener("pointerleave", onLeave);
            motion.removeEventListener("change", wake);
        };
    }, []);

    return (
        <div ref={hostRef} aria-hidden="true" className={`jm-dot-field ${className}`.trim()}>
            <canvas ref={baseRef} />
            <canvas ref={glowRef} />
        </div>
    );
}

import { cn } from "@/lib/utils";

/** 全站唯一的文字 logo 资源（管理后台同款），矢量、可任意缩放 */
const WORDMARK_SRC = "/brand/sundas-wordmark.svg";

/**
 * 品牌文字 logo。
 * 资产已收到墨迹边界，height 即字母实际高度（含 d 的升部），宽度按约 6.05 : 1 自适应。
 */
export function BrandWordmark({ height = 16, className, decorative = false }: { height?: number; className?: string; decorative?: boolean }) {
    return (
        <img
            src={WORDMARK_SRC}
            alt={decorative ? "" : "sundas"}
            draggable={false}
            className={cn("block w-auto shrink-0 select-none", className)}
            style={{ height }}
        />
    );
}

/**
 * 行内品牌名：把文案里的 sundas 片段换成文字 logo，其余文字保持原样参与排版流。
 * 用于「登录 sundas」「© 2026 sundas Inc.」「SUNDAS MEMBERSHIP」这类句子/标签。
 */
export function BrandName({ text, imageClassName, imageHeight = "0.82em" }: { text: string; imageClassName?: string; imageHeight?: string }) {
    return (
        <>
            {text.split(/(sundas)/gi).map((part, index) =>
                part.toLowerCase() === "sundas" ? (
                    <img
                        key={index}
                        src={WORDMARK_SRC}
                        alt="sundas"
                        draggable={false}
                        className={cn("inline-block w-auto select-none align-baseline", imageClassName)}
                        style={{ height: imageHeight }}
                    />
                ) : (
                    <span key={index}>{part}</span>
                ),
            )}
        </>
    );
}

import { MediaThumbnail } from "@/components/media-thumbnail";
import { useEffect, useMemo, useState, useSyncExternalStore } from "react";
import { Empty, Input, Modal, Pagination, Tag } from "antd";
import { Search } from "lucide-react";
import { useTranslation } from "react-i18next";

import { cn } from "@/lib/utils";
import { getImagePreviewRevision, subscribeImagePreviews } from "@/services/image-storage";
import { assetCoverUrl, isAssetAccountActive, useAssetStore, type Asset } from "@/stores/use-asset-store";
import { useAuthStore } from "@/stores/use-auth-store";

export type InsertAssetPayload = { kind: "text"; content: string; title: string } | { kind: "image"; dataUrl: string; title: string; storageKey?: string } | ({ kind: "video" } | { kind: "audio" }) & { url: string; title: string; storageKey?: string; width?: number; height?: number };

type Props = {
    open: boolean;
    defaultTab?: string;
    onInsert: (payload: InsertAssetPayload) => void;
    onClose: () => void;
};

export function AssetPickerModal({ open, onInsert, onClose }: Props) {
    const { t } = useTranslation();
    return (
        <Modal title={t("canvas.assetPicker.title")} open={open} onCancel={onClose} footer={null} width={860} destroyOnHidden styles={{ body: { padding: "0 24px 24px", minHeight: 480 } }}>
            <MyAssetsTab onInsert={onInsert} />
        </Modal>
    );
}

const PAGE_SIZE = 8;

const kindOptions = ["all", "text", "image", "video", "audio"];

function PickerCard({ title, kind, cover, video, onClick }: { title: string; kind: string; cover: string; video?:boolean; onClick: () => void }) {
    const { t } = useTranslation();
    return (
        <button
            type="button"
            className="group relative cursor-pointer overflow-hidden rounded-lg border border-border bg-white text-left transition hover:border-muted-foreground/50 hover:shadow-md dark:border-border dark:bg-muted dark:hover:border-muted-foreground/60"
            onClick={onClick}
        >
            {cover ? (
                <MediaThumbnail source={cover} kind={video?"video":"image"} alt={title} className="grid aspect-[4/3] w-full place-items-center" fallback={<span className="text-xs opacity-60">{title}</span>} />
            ) : (
                <div className="flex aspect-[4/3] items-center justify-center bg-muted p-3 text-center text-xs leading-5 text-muted-foreground dark:bg-muted dark:text-muted-foreground">{title}</div>
            )}
            <div className="p-2.5">
                <div className="flex items-center justify-between gap-2">
                    <span className="line-clamp-1 text-xs font-medium text-foreground dark:text-foreground">{title}</span>
                    <Tag className="m-0 shrink-0 text-[10px]">{t(`assets.kinds.${kind}`)}</Tag>
                </div>
            </div>
            <div className="pointer-events-none absolute inset-0 flex items-center justify-center bg-black/0 text-sm font-medium text-white opacity-0 transition group-hover:bg-black/55 group-hover:opacity-100">{t("canvas.assetPicker.insert")}</div>
        </button>
    );
}

function MyAssetsTab({ onInsert }: { onInsert: (payload: InsertAssetPayload) => void }) {
    const { t } = useTranslation();
    useSyncExternalStore(subscribeImagePreviews, getImagePreviewRevision);
    const assets = useAssetStore((state) => state.assets);
    const hydrated = useAssetStore((state) => state.hydrated);
    const userId = useAuthStore((state) => state.user?.id ?? null);
    const authReady = useAuthStore((state) => state.ready);
    const [keyword, setKeyword] = useState("");
    const [kindFilter, setKindFilter] = useState("all");
    const [page, setPage] = useState(1);

    const filtered = useMemo(() => {
        const query = keyword.trim().toLowerCase();
        return assets
            .filter((a) => a.kind === "text" || a.kind === "image" || a.kind === "video" || a.kind === "audio")
            .filter((a) => kindFilter === "all" || a.kind === kindFilter)
            .filter((a) => !query || [a.title, ...(a.tags || [])].join(" ").toLowerCase().includes(query));
    }, [assets, keyword, kindFilter]);

    const visible = useMemo(() => filtered.slice((page - 1) * PAGE_SIZE, page * PAGE_SIZE), [filtered, page]);

    useEffect(() => {
        const maxPage = Math.max(1, Math.ceil(filtered.length / PAGE_SIZE));
        setPage((v) => Math.min(v, maxPage));
    }, [filtered.length]);

    const handleInsert = (asset: Asset) => {
        const auth = useAuthStore.getState();
        if (!userId || !auth.ready || !useAssetStore.getState().hydrated || auth.user?.id !== userId || !isAssetAccountActive(userId)) return;
        // 3D 模型只服务于导演台，不能作为画布资源插入。
        if (asset.kind === "model") return;
        if (asset.kind === "text") {
            onInsert({ kind: "text", content: asset.data.content, title: asset.title });
        } else if (asset.kind === "video" || asset.kind === "audio") {
            onInsert({ kind: asset.kind, url: asset.data.url, storageKey: asset.data.storageKey, title: asset.title, width: asset.data.width, height: asset.data.height });
        } else {
            onInsert({ kind: "image", dataUrl: asset.data.dataUrl, storageKey: asset.data.storageKey, title: asset.title });
        }
    };

    if (!authReady || !hydrated || !isAssetAccountActive(userId)) return <div className="py-8 text-center text-sm text-stone-500">{t("canvas.loading")}</div>;

    return (
        <div className="space-y-4">
            <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-3">
                <Input
                    className="w-full min-w-0 sm:w-56"
                    size="small"
                    prefix={<Search className="size-3.5 text-muted-foreground" />}
                    placeholder={t("canvas.assetPicker.search")}
                    value={keyword}
                    allowClear
                    onChange={(e) => {
                        setPage(1);
                        setKeyword(e.target.value);
                    }}
                />
                <div className="flex gap-1.5">
                    {kindOptions.map((option) => (
                        <Tag.CheckableTag
                            key={option}
                            checked={kindFilter === option}
                            className={cn("prompt-filter-tag", kindFilter === option && "is-active")}
                            onChange={() => {
                                setPage(1);
                                setKindFilter(option);
                            }}
                        >
                            {option === "all" ? t("common.all") : t(`assets.kinds.${option}`)}
                        </Tag.CheckableTag>
                    ))}
                </div>
            </div>

            {visible.length ? (
                <div className="grid grid-cols-3 gap-3 min-[480px]:grid-cols-4">
                    {visible.map((asset) => (
                        <PickerCard key={asset.id} title={asset.title} kind={asset.kind} video={asset.kind === "video" && !assetCoverUrl(asset)} cover={assetCoverUrl(asset) || (asset.kind === "video" ? asset.data.url : "")} onClick={() => handleInsert(asset)} />
                    ))}
                </div>
            ) : (
                <Empty image={Empty.PRESENTED_IMAGE_SIMPLE} description={t("canvas.assetPicker.empty")} className="py-12" />
            )}

            {filtered.length > PAGE_SIZE && (
                <div className="flex justify-center">
                    <Pagination size="small" current={page} pageSize={PAGE_SIZE} total={filtered.length} onChange={setPage} showSizeChanger={false} />
                </div>
            )}
        </div>
    );
}

function sourceKey(value: string) {
    try {
        const url = new URL(value, window.location.origin);
        return url.origin === window.location.origin && url.pathname.startsWith('/media/') ? decodeURIComponent(url.pathname.slice(7)) : null;
    } catch { return null; }
}

type PanelProps = { projectId: string; sourceNode?: CanvasNodeData | null; sourceNodes?: CanvasNodeData[]; instructions?: string; open: boolean; onClose: () => void; onResult?: (run: UpscaleRun) => void };
type SourceActions = { quote: () => Promise<void>; submit: () => Promise<void> };

export function CanvasAiUpscalePanel({ sourceNode, sourceNodes, instructions, ...props }: PanelProps) {
    const nodes = upscaleSources(sourceNode, sourceNodes);
    const identity = nodes.map(node => node.id + ':' + node.metadata?.content).join('|');
    const userId = useAuthStore(state => state.ready ? state.user?.id : undefined);
    const epoch = useAuthStore(state => state.sessionEpoch);
    const [batchBusy, setBatchBusy] = useState(false);
    const [quotes, setQuotes] = useState<Record<string, UpscaleQuote>>({});
    const actions = useRef(new Map<string, SourceActions>());
    const context = [props.projectId, identity, userId, epoch, props.open].join('|');
    const batchSession = useRef({ context });
    if (batchSession.current.context !== context) batchSession.current = { context };
    const batchLock = useRef(false);
    const onQuoteChange = useCallback((id: string, quote: UpscaleQuote | null) => setQuotes(previous => {
        if (previous[id] === quote || (!previous[id] && !quote)) return previous;
        const next = { ...previous }; if (quote) next[id] = quote; else delete next[id]; return next;
    }), []);
    useEffect(() => { setBatchBusy(false); batchLock.current = false; }, [context]);
    async function batch(action: keyof SourceActions) {
        if (batchLock.current) return;
        batchLock.current = true; setBatchBusy(true);
        const session = batchSession.current;
        try {
            for (const node of nodes) {
                if (batchSession.current !== session || !props.open) break;
                await actions.current.get(node.id)?.[action]();
            }
        } finally {
            if (batchSession.current === session) { setBatchBusy(false); batchLock.current = false; }
        }
    }
    const total = Object.values(quotes).reduce((sum, quote) => sum + quote.credits, 0);
    return <Modal title={nodes.length > 1 ? '批量 AI 超分 · ' + nodes.length + ' 项' : 'AI 超分'} open={props.open && nodes.length > 0} onCancel={props.onClose} footer={null} width={760} centered destroyOnHidden>
        {nodes.length > 1 && <div className="mb-4 space-y-2">
            <p className="text-sm">逐项选择模型和规格；每项独立报价、提交和保留结果。关闭面板会停止尚未发送的项目，已发送任务继续处理。</p>
            <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-2"><Button loading={batchBusy} onClick={() => void batch('quote')}>预估全部费用</Button>
                <Button type="primary" disabled={batchBusy || !Object.keys(quotes).length} onClick={() => void batch('submit')}>确认已报价 {Object.keys(quotes).length} 项 · {total} 积分</Button></div>
        </div>}
        {instructions?.trim() && <Alert className="mb-4" type="info" showIcon message="助手处理建议" description={instructions} />}
        <div className="max-h-[72vh] space-y-8 overflow-y-auto">
            {nodes.map(node => <UpscaleSourcePanel key={props.projectId + ':' + userId + ':' + epoch + ':' + node.id + ':' + node.metadata?.content} {...props} sourceNode={node} batchBusy={batchBusy} onQuoteChange={onQuoteChange}
                ref={value => { if (value) actions.current.set(node.id, value); else actions.current.delete(node.id); }} />)}
        </div>
    </Modal>;
}

const UpscaleSourcePanel = forwardRef<SourceActions, Omit<PanelProps, 'sourceNodes' | 'sourceNode'> & { sourceNode: CanvasNodeData; batchBusy: boolean; onQuoteChange: (id: string, quote: UpscaleQuote | null) => void }>(function UpscaleSourcePanel({ projectId, sourceNode, open, onResult, batchBusy, onQuoteChange }, ref) {
    const theme = canvasThemes[useThemeStore(state => state.theme)];
    const userId = useAuthStore(state => state.ready ? state.user?.id : undefined);
    const epoch = useAuthStore(state => state.sessionEpoch);
    const [capabilities, setCapabilities] = useState<UpscaleCapabilities | null>(null);
    const [runs, setRuns] = useState<UpscaleRun[]>([]);
    const [modelId, setModelId] = useState<string>();
    const [targetId, setTargetId] = useState<string>();
    const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false);
    const [saving, setSaving] = useState(false);
    const [error, setError] = useState('');
    const [notice, setNotice] = useState('');
    const [quote, setQuote] = useState<UpscaleQuote | null>(null);
    const [reload, setReload] = useState(0);
    const controller = useRef<AbortController | null>(null);
    const draftId = useRef<string | null>(null);
    const operating = useRef(false);
    const pendingSubmission = useRef(false);
    const busy = saving || batchBusy;
    const content = sourceNode?.metadata?.content ?? '';
    const objectKey = sourceKey(content);
    const kind = sourceNode?.type === 'video' ? 'video' : 'image';
    const selectedModel = capabilities?.models.find(model => model.id === modelId);
    const currentRuns = runs.filter(run => run.source.objectKey === objectKey);
    const current = (signal: AbortSignal) => !signal.aborted && useAuthStore.getState().user?.id === userId && useAuthStore.getState().sessionEpoch === epoch;

    useEffect(() => {
        setCapabilities(null); setRuns([]); setError(''); setNotice(''); setSaving(false);
        if (!open || !sourceNode || !userId) return;
        const request = new AbortController();
        controller.current = request;
        const session = { userId, signal: request.signal };
        setLoading(true);
        void Promise.allSettled([getUpscaleCapabilities(kind, session), getUpscaleRuns(projectId, sourceNode.id, session)]).then(([catalog, history]) => {
            if (!current(request.signal)) return;
            if (catalog.status === 'fulfilled') setCapabilities(catalog.value);
            if (history.status === 'fulfilled') {
                setRuns(history.value.runs);
                if (history.value.runs.some(run => run.id === draftId.current && run.taskId)) { pendingSubmission.current = false; setQuote(null); }
            }
            const failure = catalog.status === 'rejected' ? catalog.reason : history.status === 'rejected' ? history.reason : null;
            if (failure) setError(failure instanceof Error ? failure.message : '读取超分配置失败');
            setLoading(false);
        });
        return () => { request.abort(); if (controller.current === request) controller.current = null; };
    }, [open, projectId, sourceNode?.id, content, kind, userId, epoch, reload]);

    async function save(estimate = false) {
        const request = controller.current;
        if (!request || !current(request.signal) || !objectKey || !sourceNode || !userId || operating.current) return;
        if (pendingSubmission.current) { setError('上次提交结果尚未确认，请先刷新记录并查询原任务。'); return; }
        if (estimate && (!selectedModel?.available || !targetId)) { setError('请选择当前素材可用的超分模型与规格'); return; }
        if (draftId.current && runs.some(run => run.id === draftId.current && run.taskId)) { setError('此记录已经提交，请查看原任务；选择新参数后才能另建任务。'); return; }
        if (!draftId.current) draftId.current = crypto.randomUUID();
        operating.current = true;
        setSaving(true); setError(''); setNotice('');
        if (estimate) setQuote(null);
        try {
            const { run } = await saveUpscaleDraft(projectId, {
                id: draftId.current, sourceNodeId: sourceNode.id, sourceObjectKey: objectKey, mediaKind: kind,
                ...(modelId ? { modelId, targetId } : {}),
            }, { userId, signal: request.signal });
            if (!current(request.signal)) return;
            setRuns(items => [run, ...items.filter(item => item.id !== run.id)]);
            if (estimate) {
                const cost = await quoteUpscaleRun(projectId, run.id, { userId, signal: request.signal });
                if (!current(request.signal)) return;
                setQuote(cost); setNotice('已核验原始媒体，确认后将提交超分任务并冻结对应积分。');
            } else setNotice('准备记录已保存到此画布；尚未提交模型任务，也未扣费。');
        } catch (cause) {
            if (current(request.signal)) setError(cause instanceof Error ? cause.message : '保存失败，请重试');
        } finally { operating.current = false; if (current(request.signal)) setSaving(false); }
    }

    async function submit() {
        const request = controller.current;
        if (!request || !current(request.signal) || !draftId.current || !quote || !userId || operating.current) return;
        operating.current = true; pendingSubmission.current = true;
        setSaving(true); setError('');
        try {
            const { run } = await submitUpscaleRun(projectId, draftId.current, quote, { userId, signal: request.signal });
            if (!current(request.signal)) return;
            pendingSubmission.current = false;
            setRuns(items => [run, ...items.filter(item => item.id !== run.id)]); setQuote(null);
            setNotice('任务已提交。关闭面板后服务端继续处理，可刷新记录查看进度。');
        } catch (cause) {
            if (current(request.signal)) {
                // An explicit input/quote rejection may be corrected. Network loss and
                // server errors retain the same request ID until the original is known.
                if (cause instanceof ApiError && cause.status >= 400 && cause.status < 500 && cause.status !== 408) {
                    pendingSubmission.current = false; setQuote(null);
                }
                setError(cause instanceof Error ? cause.message : '提交结果未确认，请刷新记录查看原任务');
            }
        }
        finally { operating.current = false; if (current(request.signal)) setSaving(false); }
    }

    async function resume(run: UpscaleRun) {
        const request = controller.current;
        if (!request || !current(request.signal) || !userId || operating.current) return;
        operating.current = true;
        setSaving(true); setError('');
        try {
            const result = await resumeUpscaleRun(projectId, run.id, { userId, signal: request.signal });
            if (!current(request.signal)) return;
            setRuns(items => items.map(item => item.id === run.id ? result.run : item)); setNotice('已恢复查询或保存原任务，不会重新调用模型。');
        } catch (cause) { if (current(request.signal)) setError(cause instanceof Error ? cause.message : '恢复失败'); }
        finally { operating.current = false; if (current(request.signal)) setSaving(false); }
    }

    useImperativeHandle(ref, () => ({ quote: () => save(true), submit }), [quote, modelId, targetId, runs, saving, capabilities]);
    useEffect(() => { onQuoteChange(sourceNode.id, quote); return () => onQuoteChange(sourceNode.id, null); }, [sourceNode.id, quote, onQuoteChange]);
    return (
        <div className="space-y-5" style={{ color: theme.node.text }}>
            <p className="text-sm" style={{ color: theme.node.muted }}>保留原素材，超分完成后生成独立结果。模型、输出规格与费用由可用渠道提供。</p>
            <div className="grid gap-5 sm:grid-cols-2">
                <div className="min-w-0 space-y-2">
                    <div className="flex min-h-40 items-center justify-center overflow-hidden rounded-lg" style={{ background: theme.canvas.background }}>
                        {open && content ? kind === 'video'
                            ? <video key={content} src={content} controls playsInline preload="metadata" className="max-h-64 max-w-full" aria-label="原视频预览" />
                            : <img src={content} alt={sourceNode?.title || '原图预览'} className="max-h-64 max-w-full object-contain" /> : <span>节点暂无媒体</span>}
                    </div>
                    <p className="truncate text-sm">{sourceNode?.title || '原素材'}</p>
                    {objectKey && <a className="text-sm" href={content} download>下载原始素材</a>}
                    {sourceNode?.metadata?.naturalWidth && sourceNode.metadata.naturalHeight ? <p className="text-xs" style={{ color: theme.node.muted }}>{sourceNode.metadata.naturalWidth} × {sourceNode.metadata.naturalHeight} 像素</p> : null}
                    {!objectKey && <p className="text-sm" style={{ color: theme.node.muted }}>请先将素材上传并保存到当前画布，再保存超分准备记录。</p>}
                </div>
                <div className="min-w-0 space-y-4">
                    <div><label htmlFor={"canvas-upscale-model-" + sourceNode.id} className="mb-2 block text-sm">超分模型</label><Select id={"canvas-upscale-model-" + sourceNode.id} className="w-full" value={modelId} loading={loading} disabled={busy || pendingSubmission.current || !capabilities?.models.length}
                        placeholder="暂无已接入的超分模型" options={capabilities?.models.map(model => ({ value: model.id, label: model.name, disabled: !model.available }))}
                        onChange={value => { setModelId(value); setTargetId(undefined); draftId.current = null; pendingSubmission.current = false; setQuote(null); }} /></div>
                    <div><label htmlFor={"canvas-upscale-target-" + sourceNode.id} className="mb-2 block text-sm">输出规格</label><Select id={"canvas-upscale-target-" + sourceNode.id} className="w-full" value={targetId} disabled={busy || pendingSubmission.current || !selectedModel?.available}
                        placeholder="由所选模型提供" options={selectedModel?.targets.map(target => ({ value: target.id, label: target.label }))}
                        onChange={value => { setTargetId(value); draftId.current = null; pendingSubmission.current = false; setQuote(null); }} /></div>
                    <p className="text-sm" style={{ color: theme.node.muted }}>预计费用：{quote ? `${quote.credits} 积分` : selectedModel?.available ? '选择规格后预估' : '暂无可用报价'}</p>
                    {quote && <p className="text-sm">预计输出 {quote.target.width} × {quote.target.height} 像素</p>}
                    <p className="text-xs" style={{ color: theme.node.muted }}>{kind === 'image' ? '输入不超过 5 MB，至少 32×32；长边≤1920、短边≤1080。超出时拒绝提交。' : '输入不超过 1 GB，两边均>360；长边<1920、短边<1080。输出固定 2 倍。'}</p>
                    <p className="text-xs" style={{ color: theme.node.muted }}>成品文件沿用平台归档限制：{kind === 'image' ? '50 MiB' : '200 MiB'}。保存失败时保留任务与冻结积分供核对，不会重复调用模型。</p>
                    {!loading && capabilities && !capabilities.available && <Alert type="info" showIcon title="暂不可生成" description={capabilities.reason} />}
                </div>
            </div>
            {loading && <div className="flex items-center gap-2 text-sm" role="status"><Spin size="small" />正在读取配置与记录</div>}
            {error && <Alert type="error" showIcon title={error} />}
            {notice && <p role="status" className="text-sm">{notice}</p>}
            <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center justify-end gap-2">
                <Button type="text" icon={<RefreshCw size={16} />} disabled={loading || busy} onClick={() => setReload(value => value + 1)}>刷新配置与记录</Button>
                <Button disabled={!objectKey || !userId || loading || busy || Boolean(modelId && !targetId)} loading={saving} onClick={() => void save()}>保存准备记录</Button>
                <Button disabled={!objectKey || !selectedModel?.available || !targetId || loading || busy} onClick={() => void save(true)}>预估费用</Button>
                <Button type="primary" disabled={!quote || busy || loading} loading={saving && Boolean(quote)} icon={<WandSparkles size={16} />} onClick={() => void submit()}>{pendingSubmission.current ? "核对原提交" : "确认超分"}{quote ? ` · ${quote.credits} 积分` : ''}</Button>
            </div>
            {currentRuns.length > 0 && <section aria-label="此素材的超分记录" className="space-y-2 border-t pt-4" style={{ borderColor: theme.toolbar.border }}>
                <h3 className="text-sm font-medium">此素材的处理记录</h3>
                {currentRuns.map(run => <div key={run.id} className="flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-2 py-2 text-sm">
                    <div><p>{run.modelName || '待配置模型'}{run.parameters.target ? ` · ${run.parameters.target.label}` : ''}</p><p style={{ color: theme.node.muted }}>{statusLabels[run.status]} · {new Date(run.createdAt).toLocaleString()}</p></div>
                    {run.error && <p className="w-full text-xs" role="status">{run.error}</p>}
                    {run.resultUrl && <a href={run.resultUrl} target="_blank" rel="noreferrer">查看结果</a>}
                    {run.resultUrl && <a href={run.resultUrl} download>下载结果</a>}
                    {run.status === 'succeeded' && run.resultUrl && run.result && onResult && <Button type="text" onClick={() => onResult(run)}>添加到画布</Button>}
                    {run.status === 'review' && <Button type="text" disabled={busy} onClick={() => void resume(run)}>查询 / 保存原任务</Button>}
                    {run.result && <span>{run.result.width} × {run.result.height}{run.result.duration ? ` · ${run.result.duration.toFixed(2)} 秒` : ''}</span>}
                    {run.creditsCharged !== null && <span>已扣 {run.creditsCharged} 积分</span>}
                </div>)}
            </section>}
        </div>
    );
});

import { useEffect, useRef, useState, type CSSProperties, type RefObject } from "react";
import { createPortal } from "react-dom";
import { SlidersHorizontal } from "lucide-react";
import { Button } from "antd";

import { AudioSettingsPanel } from "@/components/audio-settings-panel";
import { audioFormatLabel, audioSpeedLabel, audioVoiceLabel } from "@/lib/audio-generation";
import { canvasThemes } from "@/lib/canvas-theme";
import { useThemeStore } from "@/stores/use-theme-store";
import type { AiConfig } from "@/stores/use-config-store";

export type CanvasAudioSettingKey = "audioVoice" | "audioFormat" | "audioSpeed" | "audioInstructions";

type CanvasAudioSettingsPopoverProps = {
    config: AiConfig;
    onConfigChange: (key: CanvasAudioSettingKey, value: string) => void;
    buttonClassName?: string;
    buttonStyle?: CSSProperties;
    placement?: "topLeft" | "top" | "topRight" | "bottomLeft" | "bottom" | "bottomRight";
};

export function CanvasAudioSettingsPopover({ config, onConfigChange, buttonClassName, buttonStyle, placement = "topLeft" }: CanvasAudioSettingsPopoverProps) {
    const theme = canvasThemes[useThemeStore((state) => state.theme)];
    const buttonRef = useRef<HTMLSpanElement>(null);
    const panelRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
    const [open, setOpen] = useState(false);
    const [buttonRect, setButtonRect] = useState<DOMRect | null>(null);

    useEffect(() => {
        if (!open) return;
        const syncPosition = () => setButtonRect(buttonRef.current?.getBoundingClientRect() || null);
        const closeOnOutsidePointer = (event: PointerEvent) => {
            const target = event.target;
            if (!(target instanceof Node)) return;
            if (buttonRef.current?.contains(target) || panelRef.current?.contains(target)) return;
            setOpen(false);
        };

        syncPosition();
        window.addEventListener("resize", syncPosition);
        window.addEventListener("scroll", syncPosition, true);
        window.addEventListener("pointerdown", closeOnOutsidePointer, true);
        return () => {
            window.removeEventListener("resize", syncPosition);
            window.removeEventListener("scroll", syncPosition, true);
            window.removeEventListener("pointerdown", closeOnOutsidePointer, true);
        };
    }, [open]);

    const panel = open && buttonRect ? <AudioSettingsPortal buttonRect={buttonRect} panelRef={panelRef} placement={placement} theme={theme} config={config} onConfigChange={onConfigChange} /> : null;

    return (
        <>
            <span ref={buttonRef} className="inline-flex min-w-0">
                <Button size="small" type="text" className={buttonClassName || "!h-8 !max-w-[170px] !justify-start !rounded-full !px-2.5"} style={{ background: theme.node.fill, color: theme.node.text, ...buttonStyle }} icon={<SlidersHorizontal className="size-3.5" />} onClick={() => setOpen((current) => !current)}>
                    <span className="truncate">
                        {audioVoiceLabel(config.audioVoice)} · {audioFormatLabel(config.audioFormat)} · {audioSpeedLabel(config.audioSpeed)}
                    </span>
                </Button>
            </span>
            {panel}
        </>
    );
}

function AudioSettingsPortal({
    buttonRect,
    panelRef,
    placement,
    theme,
    config,
    onConfigChange,
}: {
    buttonRect: DOMRect;
    panelRef: RefObject<HTMLDivElement | null>;
    placement: CanvasAudioSettingsPopoverProps["placement"];
    theme: (typeof canvasThemes)[keyof typeof canvasThemes];
    config: AiConfig;
    onConfigChange: (key: CanvasAudioSettingKey, value: string) => void;
}) {
    const width = 356;
    const gap = 8;
    const margin = 12;
    const alignRight = placement?.endsWith("Right");
    const alignCenter = placement === "top" || placement === "bottom";
    const left = alignCenter ? buttonRect.left + buttonRect.width / 2 - width / 2 : alignRight ? buttonRect.right - width : buttonRect.left;
    const topPlacement = placement?.startsWith("top");
    const style = {
        position: "fixed",
        zIndex: 1200,
        width,
        left: Math.max(margin, Math.min(window.innerWidth - width - margin, left)),
        ...(topPlacement ? { bottom: window.innerHeight - buttonRect.top + gap, maxHeight: Math.max(260, buttonRect.top - margin * 2) } : { top: buttonRect.bottom + gap, maxHeight: Math.max(260, window.innerHeight - buttonRect.bottom - margin * 2) }),
        background: theme.toolbar.panel,
        borderRadius: 16,
        border: `1px solid ${theme.menu.border}`,
        boxShadow: theme.menu.shadow,
        padding: 18,
        overflowY: "auto",
        color: theme.node.text,
    } as const;

    return createPortal(
        <div
            ref={panelRef}
            className="canvas-image-settings-popover"
            style={style}
            onPointerDown={(event) => event.stopPropagation()}
            onMouseDown={(event) => event.stopPropagation()}
            onClick={(event) => event.stopPropagation()}
        >
            <AudioSettingsPanel config={config} onConfigChange={(key, value) => onConfigChange(key, value)} theme={theme} className="space-y-4" />
        </div>,
        document.body,
    );
}

import { useEffect } from "react";
import type { ReactNode } from "react";
import { CircleDot, ClipboardPaste, Eraser, Grid2x2, Maximize2, Scan, Square, SquareDashedMousePointer, Upload } from "lucide-react";
import { useTranslation } from "react-i18next";

import { canvasThemes, type CanvasBackgroundMode } from "@/lib/canvas-theme";
import { useThemeStore } from "@/stores/use-theme-store";

/**
 * 画布空白处右键菜单。迁移自 BeefTV：以前 sundas 在空白处右键只会被
 * preventDefault 掉、什么都不弹，视口与画布级操作只能去 Dock 里找。
 */
export function CanvasBlankContextMenu({
    x,
    y,
    backgroundMode,
    hasNodes,
    onClose,
    onPaste,
    onSelectAll,
    onFitAll,
    onResetZoom,
    onBackgroundModeChange,
    onUpload,
    onClear,
}: {
    x: number;
    y: number;
    backgroundMode: CanvasBackgroundMode;
    hasNodes: boolean;
    onClose: () => void;
    onPaste: () => void;
    onSelectAll: () => void;
    onFitAll: () => void;
    onResetZoom: () => void;
    onBackgroundModeChange: (mode: CanvasBackgroundMode) => void;
    onUpload: () => void;
    onClear: () => void;
}) {
    const { t } = useTranslation();
    const theme = canvasThemes[useThemeStore((state) => state.theme)];

    useEffect(() => {
        const close = (event: PointerEvent) => {
            const target = event.target;
            if (target instanceof Element && target.closest(".ant-popover")) return;
            onClose();
        };
        window.addEventListener("pointerdown", close);
        return () => window.removeEventListener("pointerdown", close);
    }, [onClose]);

    const maxLeft = Math.max(0, window.innerWidth - 220);
    const maxTop = Math.max(0, window.innerHeight - 340);

    return (
        <div
            className="fixed z-[80] w-[212px] overflow-hidden rounded-xl border py-1 shadow-2xl backdrop-blur-2xl"
            style={{ left: Math.min(x, maxLeft), top: Math.min(y, maxTop), background: theme.toolbar.panel, borderColor: theme.toolbar.border, color: theme.node.text }}
            onPointerDown={(event) => event.stopPropagation()}
            onContextMenu={(event) => event.preventDefault()}
        >
            <MenuRow icon={<ClipboardPaste className="size-3.5" />} label={t("canvas.blankMenu.paste")} shortcut="⌘V" onClick={() => { onClose(); onPaste(); }} />
            <MenuRow icon={<SquareDashedMousePointer className="size-3.5" />} label={t("canvas.blankMenu.selectAll")} shortcut="⌘A" onClick={() => { onClose(); onSelectAll(); }} />
            <Divider theme={theme} />
            <MenuRow icon={<Scan className="size-3.5" />} label={t("canvas.blankMenu.fitAll")} shortcut="⌘0" disabled={!hasNodes} onClick={() => { onClose(); onFitAll(); }} />
            <MenuRow icon={<Maximize2 className="size-3.5" />} label={t("canvas.blankMenu.actualSize")} shortcut="⌘1" onClick={() => { onClose(); onResetZoom(); }} />
            <Divider theme={theme} />
            <div className="px-3 pb-1 pt-1.5 text-[10px] font-medium opacity-40">{t("canvas.blankMenu.background")}</div>
            <div className="mx-2 mb-1 flex items-center gap-1">
                <ModeChip icon={<CircleDot className="size-3.5" />} label={t("canvas.toolbar.dots")} active={backgroundMode === "dots"} onClick={() => { onBackgroundModeChange("dots"); onClose(); }} />
                <ModeChip icon={<Grid2x2 className="size-3.5" />} label={t("canvas.toolbar.lines")} active={backgroundMode === "lines"} onClick={() => { onBackgroundModeChange("lines"); onClose(); }} />
                <ModeChip icon={<Square className="size-3.5" />} label={t("canvas.toolbar.blank")} active={backgroundMode === "blank"} onClick={() => { onBackgroundModeChange("blank"); onClose(); }} />
            </div>
            <Divider theme={theme} />
            <MenuRow icon={<Upload className="size-3.5" />} label={t("canvas.toolbar.upload")} onClick={() => { onClose(); onUpload(); }} />
            <Divider theme={theme} />
            <MenuRow icon={<Eraser className="size-3.5" />} label={t("canvas.blankMenu.clear")} danger onClick={() => { onClose(); onClear(); }} />
        </div>
    );
}

function MenuRow({ icon, label, shortcut, danger = false, disabled = false, onClick }: { icon: ReactNode; label: string; shortcut?: string; danger?: boolean; disabled?: boolean; onClick?: () => void }) {
    const theme = canvasThemes[useThemeStore((state) => state.theme)];
    return (
        <button
            type="button"
            disabled={disabled}
            className="flex h-8 w-full items-center gap-2 px-3 text-left text-[11.5px] transition-colors hover:bg-white/[0.06] disabled:cursor-not-allowed disabled:opacity-35"
            style={{ color: danger ? "#f87171" : theme.node.text }}
            onClick={onClick}
        >
            <span className="grid size-4 place-items-center opacity-70">{icon}</span>
            <span className="min-w-0 flex-1 truncate">{label}</span>
            {shortcut ? <span className="text-[10px] opacity-35">{shortcut}</span> : null}
        </button>
    );
}

function ModeChip({ icon, label, active, onClick }: { icon: ReactNode; label: string; active: boolean; onClick: () => void }) {
    const theme = canvasThemes[useThemeStore((state) => state.theme)];
    return (
        <button
            type="button"
            className="inline-flex h-7 flex-1 items-center justify-center gap-1 rounded-md text-[10.5px] font-medium transition-colors"
            style={{ background: active ? theme.toolbar.activeBg : "transparent", color: active ? theme.toolbar.activeText : theme.node.muted }}
            onClick={onClick}
        >
            {icon}
            <span className="truncate">{label}</span>
        </button>
    );
}

function Divider({ theme }: { theme: (typeof canvasThemes)[keyof typeof canvasThemes] }) {
    return <div className="my-1 h-px" style={{ background: theme.toolbar.border }} />;
}

import { useEffect, useRef, useState } from "react";
import { Alert, Button, Drawer, Form, Input, InputNumber, Select, Space, Switch, Tag } from "antd";
import { characterRequest, type CharacterMedia, type CharacterRun, type CharacterStepName } from "@/services/api/character-workflow";
import { getMediaBlob, uploadMediaFile } from "@/services/file-storage";
import { imageToDataUrl } from "@/services/image-storage";
import { useAuthStore } from "@/stores/use-auth-store";
import { modelOptionName, useConfigStore, useEffectiveConfig } from "@/stores/use-config-store";
import { useCreditEstimate } from "@/hooks/use-credit-estimate";
import { CanvasNodeType, type CanvasNodeData } from "@/types/canvas";

const stepNames: Record<CharacterStepName, string> = { prepare: "准备镜头", image: "生成替换参考帧", video: "生成替换视频", assemble: "回插并输出成片" };
const stateNames = { queued: "等待处理", running: "处理中", succeeded: "已完成", failed: "失败", review: "待核对" };

async function cloudKey(node: CanvasNodeData, owner: string) {
    const content = node.metadata?.content || "";
    const localKey = node.metadata?.storageKey;
    const direct = mediaKey(content);
    if (direct) return direct;
    const input = node.type === CanvasNodeType.Image
        ? await imageToDataUrl({ dataUrl: content, storageKey: localKey })
        : localKey ? await getMediaBlob(localKey) : content;
    if (!input) throw new Error("素材内容不可用，请重新上传");
    const uploaded = await uploadMediaFile(input, node.type, { expectedOwner: owner });
    const key = mediaKey(uploaded.url);
    if (!key) throw new Error("素材尚未同步到服务端，请检查网络后重试");
    return key;
}

function mediaKey(value: string) {
    try { const url = new URL(value, window.location.origin); return url.origin === window.location.origin && url.pathname.startsWith("/media/private/") ? decodeURIComponent(url.pathname.slice(7)) : ""; }
    catch { return ""; }
}

export function CanvasCharacterPanel({ projectId, nodes, initialSourceId, initialReferenceId, initialInstructions, prepareCanvas, onAddMedia, onClose }: {
    projectId: string; nodes: CanvasNodeData[]; initialSourceId?: string | null; initialReferenceId?: string; initialInstructions?: string;
    prepareCanvas: () => Promise<unknown>;
    onAddMedia: (run: CharacterRun, media: CharacterMedia[]) => void;
    onClose: () => void;
}) {
    const config = useEffectiveConfig();
    const models = useConfigStore(state => state.serverModels);
    const owner = useAuthStore(state => state.user?.id || "");
    const sessionEpoch = useAuthStore(state => state.sessionEpoch);
    const [sourceId, setSourceId] = useState(initialSourceId || "");
    const [characterId, setCharacterId] = useState(initialReferenceId || "");
    const [target, setTarget] = useState("");
    const [instructions, setInstructions] = useState(initialInstructions || "");
    const [imageModel, setImageModel] = useState(modelOptionName(config.imageModel));
    const [videoModel, setVideoModel] = useState(modelOptionName(config.videoModel));
    const [start, setStart] = useState(0);
    const [end, setEnd] = useState<number | null>(null);
    const [keepAudio, setKeepAudio] = useState(true);
    const [resolution, setResolution] = useState(config.vquality.replace(/p$/i, "") || "720");
    const [ratio, setRatio] = useState("16:9");
    const [runs, setRuns] = useState<CharacterRun[]>([]);
    const [run, setRun] = useState<CharacterRun | null>(null);
    const [busy, setBusy] = useState(false);
    const performing = useRef(false);
    const [error, setError] = useState("");
    const identity = `${owner}:${sessionEpoch}:${projectId}`;
    const current = useRef(identity); current.current = identity;
    const alive = useRef(true);
    useEffect(() => { alive.current = true; return () => { alive.current = false; }; }, []);
    const active = (captured: string) => alive.current && current.current === captured;
    const selectedSource = nodes.find(node => node.id === sourceId);
    const duration = run?.steps?.find(step => step.name === "prepare" && step.status === "succeeded")?.output.range?.duration
        ?? (end !== null ? end - start : (selectedSource?.metadata?.durationMs || 0) / 1000 - start);
    const imageEstimate = useCreditEstimate(run?.input.imageModel || imageModel, "image", 0, "", identity);
    const videoEstimate = useCreditEstimate(run?.input.videoModel || videoModel, "video", duration, run?.input.resolution || resolution, identity);
    const estimateText = (estimate: typeof imageEstimate) => estimate.data ? `预计 ${estimate.data.minCredits === estimate.data.maxCredits ? estimate.data.minCredits : `${estimate.data.minCredits}–${estimate.data.maxCredits}`} 积分` : estimate.loading ? "费用计算中" : "暂时无法预估费用";
    const refresh = async (id = run?.id) => {
        if (!id) return;
        const captured = identity;
        const result = await characterRequest<{ run: CharacterRun }>(`/${id}`);
        if (active(captured)) setRun(result.run);
    };
    useEffect(() => {
        setRun(null); setRuns([]); setError(""); setBusy(false);
        const controller = new AbortController();
        void characterRequest<{ runs: CharacterRun[] }>(`?projectId=${encodeURIComponent(projectId)}`, { signal: controller.signal })
            .then(result => { if (!controller.signal.aborted && active(identity)) setRuns(result.runs); })
            .catch(cause => { if (!controller.signal.aborted && active(identity)) setError(cause instanceof Error ? cause.message : "记录读取失败"); });
        return () => controller.abort();
    }, [identity, projectId]);
    useEffect(() => {
        if (!run || !run.steps?.some(step => ["queued", "running"].includes(step.status))) return;
        const controller = new AbortController();
        // Same cadence as existing image/video task queries; no resubmission.
        const timer = setTimeout(() => {
            void characterRequest<{ run: CharacterRun }>(`/${run.id}`, { signal: controller.signal })
                .then(result => { if (!controller.signal.aborted && active(identity)) setRun(result.run); })
                .catch(cause => { if (!controller.signal.aborted && active(identity)) setError(cause instanceof Error ? cause.message : "查询失败，请刷新原任务"); });
        }, 5000);
        return () => { clearTimeout(timer); controller.abort(); };
    }, [run, identity]);
    const perform = async (action: () => Promise<void>) => {
        if (performing.current) return;
        performing.current = true;
        const captured = identity; setBusy(true); setError("");
        try { await action(); }
        catch (cause) { if (active(captured)) setError(cause instanceof Error ? cause.message : "操作失败"); }
        finally { performing.current = false; if (active(captured)) setBusy(false); }
    };
    const create = () => perform(async () => {
        const source = nodes.find(node => node.id === sourceId), character = nodes.find(node => node.id === characterId);
        if (!source || !character || !target.trim()) throw new Error("请选择原视频、人物参考图并说明替换对象");
        const captured = identity;
        await prepareCanvas();
        const [sourceKey, characterKey] = await Promise.all([cloudKey(source, owner), cloudKey(character, owner)]);
        if (!active(captured)) return;
        const result = await characterRequest<{ run: CharacterRun }>("", { method: "POST", json: { id: crypto.randomUUID(), projectId, input: { sourceKey, characterKey, target, instructions, imageModel, videoModel, resolution, ratio, start, end, keepAudio } } });
        if (active(captured)) { setRun(result.run); setRuns(items => [result.run, ...items]); }
    });
    const execute = (name: CharacterStepName) => perform(async () => {
        if (!run) return;
        const captured = identity;
        const result = await characterRequest<{ run: CharacterRun }>(`/${run.id}/steps/${name}`, { method: "POST", json: {} });
        if (active(captured)) setRun(result.run);
    });
    const patch = (body: { selectedKey?: string; paused?: boolean }) => perform(async () => {
        if (!run) return;
        const captured = identity;
        const result = await characterRequest<{ run: CharacterRun }>(`/${run.id}`, { method: "PATCH", json: body });
        if (active(captured)) setRun(result.run);
    });
    const lastSteps = Object.values(Object.fromEntries((run?.steps || []).map(step => [step.name, step])));
    const preparation = lastSteps.find(step => step.name === 'prepare' && step.status === 'succeeded')?.output;
    return <Drawer open title="人物替换工作流" onClose={onClose} width={560}>
        <div className="flex flex-col gap-4">
            <Alert type="info" showIcon message="原视频和每一步结果都会保留" description="先确认替换参考帧，再生成视频。效果取决于模型；回插时不会自动改变片段速度。关闭面板后可从运行记录继续。" />
            <Select aria-label="运行记录" placeholder="选择已有运行记录" value={run?.id} disabled={busy} options={runs.map(item => ({ value: item.id, label: `${item.input.target} · ${new Date(item.createdAt).toLocaleString()}` }))} onChange={id => void perform(() => refresh(id))} />
            {error && <Alert type="error" showIcon message={error} />}
            {!run ? <Form layout="vertical">
                <Form.Item label="原视频"><Select value={sourceId || undefined} onChange={setSourceId} options={nodes.filter(node => node.type === CanvasNodeType.Video && node.metadata?.content).map(node => ({ value: node.id, label: node.title }))} /></Form.Item>
                <Form.Item label="目标人物参考图"><Select value={characterId || undefined} onChange={setCharacterId} options={nodes.filter(node => node.type === CanvasNodeType.Image && node.metadata?.content).map(node => ({ value: node.id, label: node.title }))} /></Form.Item>
                <Form.Item label="替换谁"><Input value={target} onChange={event => setTarget(event.target.value)} placeholder="例如：画面左侧穿蓝衣的人物" /></Form.Item>
                <Form.Item label="补充要求"><Input.TextArea value={instructions} onChange={event => setInstructions(event.target.value)} autoSize={{ minRows: 2 }} /></Form.Item>
                <Form.Item label="替换区间（秒，结束留空表示原片结尾）"><Space wrap><InputNumber aria-label="开始秒数" value={start} onChange={value => setStart(value ?? 0)} min={0} /><InputNumber aria-label="结束秒数" value={end} onChange={value => setEnd(value)} min={0} /></Space></Form.Item>
                <Form.Item label="参考帧编辑模型"><Select value={imageModel || undefined} onChange={setImageModel} options={models.filter(model => model.capability === "image").map(model => ({ value: model.id, label: model.name }))} /><div className="mt-1 text-xs opacity-70">{estimateText(imageEstimate)}</div></Form.Item>
                <Form.Item label="视频编辑模型"><Select value={videoModel || undefined} onChange={setVideoModel} options={models.filter(model => model.capability === "video" && Number((model.metadata?.referenceLimits as { videos?: number })?.videos) > 0).map(model => ({ value: model.id, label: model.name }))} /><div className="mt-1 text-xs opacity-70">{estimateText(videoEstimate)}，实际费用按各次任务结算</div></Form.Item>
                <Form.Item label="输出规格"><Space wrap><Input aria-label="清晰度" value={resolution} onChange={event => setResolution(event.target.value)} placeholder="模型支持的清晰度" /><Input aria-label="画面比例" value={ratio} onChange={event => setRatio(event.target.value)} placeholder="16:9" /></Space></Form.Item>
                <Form.Item label="成片保留原声"><Switch checked={keepAudio} onChange={setKeepAudio} /> <span className="text-xs opacity-70">关闭后成片静音，生成片段仍单独保留</span></Form.Item>
                <Button type="primary" loading={busy} disabled={!imageModel || !videoModel} onClick={() => void create()}>创建工作流</Button>
            </Form> : <>
                <div><strong>{run.input.target}</strong><div className="mt-1 text-sm opacity-70">区间 {run.input.start} 秒至 {run.input.end ?? "原片结尾"} · {run.input.keepAudio ? "保留原声" : "成片静音"}</div></div>
                <Space wrap><Button loading={busy} onClick={() => void perform(() => refresh())}>刷新进度</Button><Button disabled={busy} onClick={() => void patch({ paused: !run.paused })}>{run.paused ? "恢复后续步骤" : "暂停后续步骤"}</Button><Button disabled={busy} onClick={() => setRun(null)}>新建运行</Button></Space>
                {run.paused && <Alert type="warning" message="后续步骤已暂停；已提交的模型任务仍会完成并计费。" />}
                {(Object.keys(stepNames) as CharacterStepName[]).map(name => {
                    const step = lastSteps.find(item => item.name === name);
                    const comparison: CharacterMedia | undefined = name === 'image' ? preparation?.frame : name === 'video' ? preparation?.clip : name === 'assemble' ? { key: run.input.sourceKey, kind: 'video' } : undefined;
                    const ready = name === "prepare" || (name === "image" && lastSteps.some(item => item.name === "prepare" && item.status === "succeeded")) || (name === "video" && Boolean(run.selectedKey)) || (name === "assemble" && lastSteps.some(item => item.name === "video" && item.status === "succeeded"));
                    return <section key={name} className="border-b border-current/10 pb-4">
                        <div className="mb-2 flex items-center justify-between gap-2"><strong>{stepNames[name]}</strong>{step && <Tag>{stateNames[step.status]} · 第 {step.attempt} 次</Tag>}</div>
                        {step?.error && <p role="alert" className="mb-2 text-sm">{step.error}</p>}
                        {name === "image" && <p className="mb-2 text-xs opacity-70">{estimateText(imageEstimate)}</p>}
                        {name === "video" && <p className="mb-2 text-xs opacity-70">{estimateText(videoEstimate)}</p>}
                        {(!step || step.status === "failed") && <Button disabled={busy || run.paused || !ready} onClick={() => void execute(name)}>{step ? "重试此步骤" : "开始此步骤"}</Button>}
                        {(step?.output.media || []).map(media => <div key={media.key} className="mt-3">
                            <div className={comparison ? 'grid gap-3 sm:grid-cols-2' : ''}>
                                {comparison && <div><p className="mb-1 text-xs opacity-70">{name === 'assemble' ? '完整原片' : name === 'video' ? '原始片段' : '原始参考帧'}</p>
                                    {comparison.kind === 'image' ? <img src={comparison.url || `/media/${comparison.key}`} alt="原始参考帧" loading="lazy" className="max-h-64 max-w-full object-contain" /> : <video src={comparison.url || `/media/${comparison.key}`} aria-label={name === 'assemble' ? '完整原片' : '原始片段'} controls playsInline preload="none" className="max-h-64 max-w-full" />}
                                    <Button type="text" size="small" href={comparison.url || `/media/${comparison.key}`} download>下载原始素材</Button>
                                </div>}
                                <div>{comparison && <p className="mb-1 text-xs opacity-70">{name === 'assemble' ? '回插成片' : '替换结果'}</p>}
                                    {media.kind === "image" ? <img src={media.url || `/media/${media.key}`} alt="替换参考帧" loading="lazy" className="max-h-64 max-w-full object-contain" /> : <video src={media.url || `/media/${media.key}`} aria-label={name === 'assemble' ? '回插成片' : '替换结果'} controls playsInline preload="none" className="max-h-64 max-w-full" />}
                                    <Button type="text" size="small" href={media.url || `/media/${media.key}`} download>下载结果</Button>
                                </div>
                            </div>
                            <Space wrap className="mt-2">
                                {name === "image" && <Button disabled={busy || lastSteps.some(item => item.name === "video")} type={run.selectedKey === media.key ? "primary" : "default"} onClick={() => void patch({ selectedKey: media.key })}>{run.selectedKey === media.key ? "已确认此帧" : "确认此帧用于视频"}</Button>}
                                <Button onClick={() => onAddMedia(run, [media])}>放入画布</Button>
                            </Space>
                        </div>)}
                    </section>;
                })}
                <p className="text-xs opacity-70">已完成步骤保留结果。参考帧确认后再开始视频；需要修改输入或更换已提交的参考帧时，创建新的运行。</p>
            </>}
        </div>
    </Drawer>;
}
