import type { ReactNode } from "react";
import { useEffect, useRef, useState } from "react";
import { CircleDot, Clapperboard, Grid2x2, ListVideo, Hand, Image as ImageIcon, Keyboard, MousePointer2, Palette, Plus, Puzzle, Square, Trash2, Undo2, Redo2 } from "lucide-react";
import { Segmented, Switch } from "antd";
import { useTranslation } from "react-i18next";

import { CanvasCreatePanel } from "@/components/canvas/canvas-create-panel";
import { CanvasShortcutsPopover } from "@/components/canvas/canvas-shortcuts-popover";
import { canvasThemes, type CanvasBackgroundMode, type CanvasTheme } from "@/lib/canvas-theme";
import { useThemeStore } from "@/stores/use-theme-store";
import type { CanvasNodeTypeId } from "@/types/canvas";

type TipState = { id: string; label: string; shortcut?: string; x: number } | null;

/**
 * 画布底部 Dock。迁移自 BeefTV 的 LibTV 浮动工具栏：
 * 常态只留 5～7 个核心入口（添加节点 / 抓手 / 外观 / 资产 / 快捷键），
 * 其余能力收进「添加节点」面板与右键菜单，避免一排 14 个图标挤成一堵墙。
 */
export function CanvasToolbar({
    selectedCount,
    canvasTool,
    canUndo,
    canRedo,
    backgroundMode,
    showImageInfo,
    onAddImage,
    onAddVideo,
    onAddAudio,
    onAddText,
    onAddConfig,
    onAddGroup,
    onAddExtensionNode,
    onUndo,
    onRedo,
    onUpload,
    onOpenAssets,
    onOpenDirector,
    onOpenStoryboard,
    onDelete,
    onClear,
    onCanvasToolChange,
    onBackgroundModeChange,
    onShowImageInfoChange,
    onFocusSelected,
}: {
    selectedCount: number;
    canvasTool: "select" | "pan";
    canUndo: boolean;
    canRedo: boolean;
    backgroundMode: CanvasBackgroundMode;
    showImageInfo: boolean;
    onAddImage: () => void;
    onAddVideo: () => void;
    onAddAudio: () => void;
    onAddText: () => void;
    onAddConfig: () => void;
    onAddGroup: () => void;
    onAddExtensionNode: (type: string) => void;
    onUndo: () => void;
    onRedo: () => void;
    onUpload: () => void;
    onOpenAssets?: () => void;
    onOpenDirector?: () => void;
    onOpenStoryboard?: () => void;
    onDelete: () => void;
    onClear: () => void;
    onCanvasToolChange: (tool: "select" | "pan") => void;
    onBackgroundModeChange: (mode: CanvasBackgroundMode) => void;
    onShowImageInfoChange: (show: boolean) => void;
    onFocusSelected: () => void;
}) {
    const { t } = useTranslation();
    const colorTheme = useThemeStore((state) => state.theme);
    const theme = canvasThemes[colorTheme];
    const rootRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
    const dockRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
    const [tip, setTip] = useState<TipState>(null);
    const [createOpen, setCreateOpen] = useState(false);
    const [appearanceOpen, setAppearanceOpen] = useState(false);
    const [shortcutsOpen, setShortcutsOpen] = useState(false);

    const closePanels = () => {
        setCreateOpen(false);
        setAppearanceOpen(false);
        setShortcutsOpen(false);
    };

    // 浮层只允许同时存在一个；点击 Dock 之外一律收起。
    useEffect(() => {
        if (!createOpen && !appearanceOpen && !shortcutsOpen) return;
        const handlePointerDown = (event: PointerEvent) => {
            if (rootRef.current && !rootRef.current.contains(event.target as Node)) closePanels();
        };
        document.addEventListener("pointerdown", handlePointerDown, true);
        return () => document.removeEventListener("pointerdown", handlePointerDown, true);
    }, [createOpen, appearanceOpen, shortcutsOpen]);

    const showTip = (event: { currentTarget: HTMLElement }, id: string, label: string, shortcut?: string) => {
        // 提示条挂在整条底部容器上（不是 Dock 本身），所以基准要取 rootRef 的盒子，
        // 否则 Dock 居中后提示会整体左移半个 Dock 宽度。
        const root = rootRef.current;
        if (!root) return;
        const rootBox = root.getBoundingClientRect();
        const box = event.currentTarget.getBoundingClientRect();
        setTip({ id, label, shortcut, x: box.left - rootBox.left + box.width / 2 });
    };

    const handleCreate = (type: CanvasNodeTypeId) => {
        if (type === "text") onAddText();
        else if (type === "image") onAddImage();
        else if (type === "video") onAddVideo();
        else if (type === "audio") onAddAudio();
        else if (type === "config") onAddConfig();
        else if (type === "group") onAddGroup();
        else onAddExtensionNode(type);
        closePanels();
    };

    return (
        <div ref={rootRef} className="pointer-events-none absolute bottom-4 z-50 flex justify-center max-lg:bottom-3" style={{ left: 16, right: 16 }} data-canvas-bottom-toolbar>
            {tip ? <DockTip label={tip.label} shortcut={tip.shortcut} x={tip.x} theme={theme} /> : null}

            <div
                ref={dockRef}
                className="pointer-events-auto flex h-11 items-center gap-[3px] rounded-2xl border px-1.5 backdrop-blur-md"
                style={{ background: theme.toolbar.panel, borderColor: theme.toolbar.border, color: theme.toolbar.item, boxShadow: "0 18px 44px rgba(0,0,0,.46)" }}
            >
                <DockButton
                    id="dock-add"
                    label={t("canvas.dock.add")}
                    prominent
                    active={createOpen}
                    tip={tip}
                    onTip={(event) => showTip(event, "dock-add", t("canvas.dock.add"))}
                    onTipEnd={() => setTip(null)}
                    onClick={() => {
                        const next = !createOpen;
                        closePanels();
                        setCreateOpen(next);
                    }}
                >
                    <Plus className="size-[18px]" />
                </DockButton>

                <DockDivider theme={theme} />

                <DockButton
                    id={`dock-tool-${canvasTool}`}
                    label={canvasTool === "select" ? t("canvas.dock.selectTool") : t("canvas.dock.handTool")}
                    shortcut={canvasTool === "select" ? "V" : "H"}
                    tip={tip}
                    onTip={(event) => showTip(event, `dock-tool-${canvasTool}`, canvasTool === "select" ? t("canvas.dock.selectTool") : t("canvas.dock.handTool"), canvasTool === "select" ? "V" : "H")}
                    onTipEnd={() => setTip(null)}
                    onClick={() => onCanvasToolChange(canvasTool === "select" ? "pan" : "select")}
                >
                    {canvasTool === "select" ? <MousePointer2 className="size-[18px]" /> : <Hand className="size-[18px]" />}
                </DockButton>
                <DockButton
                    id="dock-undo"
                    label={t("canvas.undo")}
                    shortcut="⌘Z"
                    disabled={!canUndo}
                    tip={tip}
                    onTip={(event) => showTip(event, "dock-undo", t("canvas.undo"), "⌘Z")}
                    onTipEnd={() => setTip(null)}
                    onClick={onUndo}
                >
                    <Undo2 className="size-[18px]" />
                </DockButton>
                <DockButton
                    id="dock-redo"
                    label={t("canvas.redo")}
                    shortcut="⌘⇧Z"
                    disabled={!canRedo}
                    tip={tip}
                    onTip={(event) => showTip(event, "dock-redo", t("canvas.redo"), "⌘⇧Z")}
                    onTipEnd={() => setTip(null)}
                    onClick={onRedo}
                >
                    <Redo2 className="size-[18px]" />
                </DockButton>

                <DockDivider theme={theme} />

                <DockButton
                    id="dock-appearance"
                    label={t("canvas.toolbar.appearance")}
                    active={appearanceOpen}
                    tip={tip}
                    onTip={(event) => showTip(event, "dock-appearance", t("canvas.toolbar.appearance"))}
                    onTipEnd={() => setTip(null)}
                    onClick={() => {
                        const next = !appearanceOpen;
                        closePanels();
                        setAppearanceOpen(next);
                    }}
                >
                    <Palette className="size-[18px]" />
                </DockButton>
                {onOpenStoryboard ? (
                    <DockButton
                        id="dock-storyboard"
                        label={t("canvas.dock.storyboard")}
                        tip={tip}
                        onTip={(event) => showTip(event, "dock-storyboard", t("canvas.dock.storyboard"))}
                        onTipEnd={() => setTip(null)}
                        onClick={() => {
                            closePanels();
                            onOpenStoryboard();
                        }}
                    >
                        <ListVideo className="size-[18px]" />
                    </DockButton>
                ) : null}
                {onOpenDirector ? (
                    <DockButton
                        id="dock-director"
                        label={t("canvas.dock.director")}
                        tip={tip}
                        onTip={(event) => showTip(event, "dock-director", t("canvas.dock.director"))}
                        onTipEnd={() => setTip(null)}
                        onClick={() => {
                            closePanels();
                            onOpenDirector();
                        }}
                    >
                        <Clapperboard className="size-[18px]" />
                    </DockButton>
                ) : null}
                <DockButton
                    id="dock-assets"
                    label={t("canvas.dock.assets")}
                    tip={tip}
                    onTip={(event) => showTip(event, "dock-assets", t("canvas.dock.assets"))}
                    onTipEnd={() => setTip(null)}
                    onClick={() => {
                        closePanels();
                        if (onOpenAssets) onOpenAssets();
                        else onUpload();
                    }}
                >
                    <Puzzle className="size-[18px]" />
                </DockButton>
                <DockButton
                    id="dock-shortcuts"
                    label={t("canvas.dock.shortcuts")}
                    active={shortcutsOpen}
                    tip={tip}
                    onTip={(event) => showTip(event, "dock-shortcuts", t("canvas.dock.shortcuts"))}
                    onTipEnd={() => setTip(null)}
                    onClick={() => {
                        const next = !shortcutsOpen;
                        closePanels();
                        setShortcutsOpen(next);
                    }}
                >
                    <Keyboard className="size-[18px]" />
                </DockButton>

                {selectedCount ? (
                    <>
                        <DockDivider theme={theme} />
                        <DockButton
                            id="dock-focus"
                            label={t("canvas.toolbar.focus")}
                            tip={tip}
                            onTip={(event) => showTip(event, "dock-focus", t("canvas.toolbar.focus"))}
                            onTipEnd={() => setTip(null)}
                            onClick={onFocusSelected}
                        >
                            <Square className="size-[18px]" />
                        </DockButton>
                        <DockButton
                            id="dock-delete"
                            label={t("canvas.deleteSelected")}
                            danger
                            tip={tip}
                            onTip={(event) => showTip(event, "dock-delete", t("canvas.deleteSelected"))}
                            onTipEnd={() => setTip(null)}

function DockButton({
    id,
    label,
    shortcut,
    active = false,
    disabled = false,
    danger = false,
    prominent = false,
    tip,
    onTip,
    onTipEnd,
    onClick,
    children,
}: {
    id: string;
    label: string;
    shortcut?: string;
    active?: boolean;
    disabled?: boolean;
    danger?: boolean;
    prominent?: boolean;
    tip: TipState;
    onTip: (event: { currentTarget: HTMLButtonElement }) => void;
    onTipEnd: () => void;
    onClick?: () => void;
    children: ReactNode;
}) {
    const theme = canvasThemes[useThemeStore((state) => state.theme)];
    const isActive = active || tip?.id === id;
    const background = prominent ? (isActive ? "rgba(255,255,255,.16)" : "rgba(255,255,255,.1)") : isActive ? theme.toolbar.itemHover : "transparent";
    const color = disabled ? theme.toolbar.item : danger ? "#f87171" : isActive ? theme.toolbar.activeText : theme.toolbar.item;

    return (
        <button
            type="button"
            aria-label={label}
            aria-pressed={active || undefined}
            disabled={disabled}
            className="grid size-8 shrink-0 place-items-center rounded-[10px] transition-[background-color,color,transform] duration-150 active:scale-[0.94] disabled:cursor-not-allowed disabled:opacity-35"
            style={{ background, color }}
            onMouseEnter={onTip}
            onMouseLeave={onTipEnd}
            onFocus={onTip}
            onBlur={onTipEnd}
            onClick={onClick}
        >
            {children}
        </button>
    );
}

function DockDivider({ theme }: { theme: CanvasTheme }) {
    return <div className="mx-1 h-4 w-px shrink-0" style={{ background: theme.toolbar.border }} />;
}

function DockTip({ label, shortcut, x, theme }: { label: string; shortcut?: string; x: number; theme: CanvasTheme }) {
    return (
        <span
            className="pointer-events-none absolute bottom-[calc(100%-2px)] z-50 flex h-6 -translate-x-1/2 items-center gap-1.5 whitespace-nowrap rounded-md px-2 text-[11px] shadow-xl"
            style={{ left: x, background: theme.node.text, color: theme.node.panel }}
        >
            {label}
            {shortcut ? <kbd className="rounded-[3px] px-1 text-[9.5px] opacity-60" style={{ background: "rgba(0,0,0,.14)" }}>{shortcut}</kbd> : null}
        </span>
    );
}

import { useEffect, useRef, useState, type CSSProperties, type RefObject } from "react";
import { createPortal } from "react-dom";
import { SlidersHorizontal } from "lucide-react";
import { Button } from "antd";

import { VideoSettingsPanel, videoModeLabel, videoResolutionLabel, videoSecondsLabel, videoSizeLabel } from "@/components/video-settings-panel";
import { canvasThemes } from "@/lib/canvas-theme";
import { useThemeStore } from "@/stores/use-theme-store";
import type { AiConfig } from "@/stores/use-config-store";

type CanvasVideoSettingsPopoverProps = {
    config: AiConfig;
    model?: string;
    onConfigChange: (key: keyof AiConfig, value: string) => void;
    buttonClassName?: string;
    buttonStyle?: CSSProperties;
    placement?: "topLeft" | "top" | "topRight" | "bottomLeft" | "bottom" | "bottomRight";
};

export function CanvasVideoSettingsPopover({ config, model, onConfigChange, buttonClassName, buttonStyle, placement = "topLeft" }: CanvasVideoSettingsPopoverProps) {
    const theme = canvasThemes[useThemeStore((state) => state.theme)];
    const buttonRef = useRef<HTMLSpanElement>(null);
    const panelRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
    const [open, setOpen] = useState(false);
    const [buttonRect, setButtonRect] = useState<DOMRect | null>(null);

    useEffect(() => {
        if (!open) return;
        const syncPosition = () => setButtonRect(buttonRef.current?.getBoundingClientRect() || null);
        const closeOnOutsidePointer = (event: PointerEvent) => {
            const target = event.target;
            if (!(target instanceof Node)) return;
            if (buttonRef.current?.contains(target) || panelRef.current?.contains(target)) return;
            setOpen(false);
        };

        syncPosition();
        window.addEventListener("resize", syncPosition);
        window.addEventListener("scroll", syncPosition, true);
        window.addEventListener("pointerdown", closeOnOutsidePointer, true);
        return () => {
            window.removeEventListener("resize", syncPosition);
            window.removeEventListener("scroll", syncPosition, true);
            window.removeEventListener("pointerdown", closeOnOutsidePointer, true);
        };
    }, [open]);

    const panel = open && buttonRect ? <VideoSettingsPortal buttonRect={buttonRect} panelRef={panelRef} placement={placement} theme={theme} config={config} model={model} onConfigChange={onConfigChange} /> : null;

    return (
        <>
            <span ref={buttonRef} className="inline-flex min-w-0">
                <Button size="small" type="text" className={buttonClassName || "!h-8 !max-w-[220px] !justify-start !rounded-full !px-2.5"} style={{ background: theme.node.fill, color: theme.node.text, ...buttonStyle }} icon={<SlidersHorizontal className="size-3.5" />} onClick={() => setOpen((current) => !current)}>
                    <span className="truncate">
                        {videoResolutionLabel(config.vquality)} · {videoSizeLabel(config.size)} · {videoSecondsLabel(config.videoSeconds)} · {videoModeLabel(config.videoMode)}
                    </span>
                </Button>
            </span>
            {panel}
        </>
    );
}

function VideoSettingsPortal({
    buttonRect,
    panelRef,
    placement,
    theme,
    config,
    model,
    onConfigChange,
}: {
    buttonRect: DOMRect;
    panelRef: RefObject<HTMLDivElement | null>;
    placement: CanvasVideoSettingsPopoverProps["placement"];
    theme: (typeof canvasThemes)[keyof typeof canvasThemes];
    config: AiConfig;
    model?: string;
    onConfigChange: (key: keyof AiConfig, value: string) => void;
}) {
    const width = 356;
    const gap = 8;
    const margin = 12;
    const alignRight = placement?.endsWith("Right");
    const alignCenter = placement === "top" || placement === "bottom";
    const left = alignCenter ? buttonRect.left + buttonRect.width / 2 - width / 2 : alignRight ? buttonRect.right - width : buttonRect.left;
    const topPlacement = placement?.startsWith("top");
    const style = {
        position: "fixed",
        zIndex: 1200,
        width,
        left: Math.max(margin, Math.min(window.innerWidth - width - margin, left)),
        ...(topPlacement ? { bottom: window.innerHeight - buttonRect.top + gap, maxHeight: Math.max(260, buttonRect.top - margin * 2) } : { top: buttonRect.bottom + gap, maxHeight: Math.max(260, window.innerHeight - buttonRect.bottom - margin * 2) }),
        background: theme.toolbar.panel,
        borderRadius: 16,
        border: `1px solid ${theme.menu.border}`,
        boxShadow: theme.menu.shadow,
        padding: 18,
        overflowY: "auto",
        color: theme.node.text,
    } as const;

    return createPortal(
        <div
            ref={panelRef}
            className="canvas-image-settings-popover"
            style={style}
            onPointerDown={(event) => event.stopPropagation()}
            onMouseDown={(event) => event.stopPropagation()}
            onClick={(event) => event.stopPropagation()}
        >
            <VideoSettingsPanel config={config} model={model} onConfigChange={(key, value) => onConfigChange(key, value)} theme={theme} className="space-y-4" />
        </div>,
        document.body,
    );
}

export function CanvasZoomControls({ scale, onScaleChange, onReset, isMiniMapOpen, onToggleMiniMap }: CanvasZoomControlsProps) {

    const colorTheme = useThemeStore((state) => state.theme);

                <Tooltip title={isMiniMapOpen ? t("canvas.miniMapClose") : t("canvas.miniMapOpen")}>
                    <Button
                        type="text"
                        className="!h-8 !w-8 !min-w-8 !p-0"
                        style={isMiniMapOpen ? activeStyle : { color: theme.toolbar.item }}
                        icon={<Compass className="size-3.5" />}
                        onClick={onToggleMiniMap}
                        aria-label={isMiniMapOpen ? t("canvas.miniMapClose") : t("canvas.miniMapOpen")}
                    />
                </Tooltip>
                <Tooltip title={t("canvas.resetView")}>
                    <Button type="text" className="!h-8 !w-8 !min-w-8 !p-0" style={{ color: theme.toolbar.item }} icon={<Focus className="size-3.5" />} onClick={onReset} aria-label={t("canvas.resetView")} />
                </Tooltip>
                <Tooltip title={t("canvas.zoom")}>
                    <input
                        type="range"
                        min="5"
                        max="500"
                        step="1"
                        value={Math.round(scale * 100)}
                        className="w-20 accent-white"
                        style={{ accentColor: theme.node.activeStroke }}
                        onChange={(event) => onScaleChange(Number(event.target.value) / 100)}
                        aria-label={t("canvas.zoom")}
                    />
                </Tooltip>
                <span className="w-10 pr-1 text-right text-[11px] tabular-nums" style={{ color: theme.node.muted }}>
                    {Math.round(scale * 100)}%
                </span>
                <Tooltip title={t("canvas.shortcuts")}>
                    <Button type="text" className="!h-8 !w-8 !min-w-8 !p-0" style={shortcutsOpen ? activeStyle : { color: theme.toolbar.item }} icon={<HelpCircle className="size-3.5" />} onClick={() => setShortcutsOpen(true)} aria-label={t("canvas.shortcuts")} />
                </Tooltip>
            </div>
            <Modal title={t("canvas.shortcuts")} open={shortcutsOpen} onCancel={() => setShortcutsOpen(false)} footer={null} centered>
                <div className="space-y-3 border-t pt-4 text-sm" style={{ borderColor: theme.node.stroke }}>
                    <Shortcut label={`Ctrl / Space + ${t("canvas.shortcut.drag")}`} value={t("canvas.shortcut.toggleTool")} />
                    <Shortcut label={t("canvas.shortcut.wheel")} value={t("canvas.shortcut.zoom")} />
                    <Shortcut label={t("canvas.shortcut.drag")} value={t("canvas.shortcut.boxSelect")} />
                    <Shortcut label={`Shift / Cmd + ${t("canvas.shortcut.click")}`} value={t("canvas.shortcut.addSelection")} />
                    <Shortcut label="Ctrl / Cmd + C / V" value={t("canvas.shortcut.copyPasteNodes")} />
                    <Shortcut label="Ctrl / Cmd + G" value={t("canvas.shortcut.group")} />
                    <Shortcut label="Ctrl / Cmd + Shift + G" value={t("canvas.shortcut.ungroup")} />
                    <Shortcut label="Delete / Backspace" value={t("canvas.shortcut.delete")} />
                </div>
            </Modal>
        </div>
    );
}

function Shortcut({ label, value }: { label: ReactNode; value: string }) {
    return (
        <div className="flex items-center justify-between gap-4">
            <span className="text-base font-medium">{label}</span>
            <span className="opacity-60">{value}</span>
        </div>
    );
}


========================================================================

import { useEffect, useRef, useState } from 'react';
import { Button, Input, Select, Tabs, Tag, theme as antdTheme } from 'antd';
import { ArrowUp, BookOpen, ChevronDown, MessageSquare, Sparkles, Pause, Play, Plus, RefreshCw, Settings2, X, AlertCircle, CheckCircle2, Clock, Loader2 } from 'lucide-react';
import { creativeAgentApi, type AgentItem, type AgentProject, type AgentState, type AgentTurn, type AgentTurnInput, type CreativeAgentOperation, type CreativeToolHandoff } from '@/services/api/creative-agent';
import { useCreativeAgentStore } from '@/stores/use-creative-agent-store';
import { useAuthStore } from '@/stores/use-auth-store';
import { useCanvasStore } from '@/stores/canvas/use-canvas-store';
import { validateCreativeToolHandoff } from '@/lib/canvas/creative-tool-handoff';
import { describeAgentChanges } from '@/lib/canvas/creative-agent-changes';
import { CreativeSkillsPanel } from './creative-skills-panel';
import { canvasThemes } from '@/lib/canvas-theme';
import { useThemeStore } from '@/stores/use-theme-store';

export type CreativeAgentPanelProps = {
    projectId: string;
    selectedNodeIds: string[];
    prepareCanvas: () => Promise<AgentProject>;
    applyProject: (project: AgentProject) => void | Promise<void>;
    onClose?: () => void;
    onOpenProductionExport?: () => void;
    onOpenDirector?: () => void;
    onToolHandoff?: (handoff: CreativeToolHandoff) => void;
};
const statuses: Record<string, string> = { planning: '正在规划', ready: '等待确认', executing: '执行中', submitted: '已提交，等待任务结果', pending: '待执行', paused: '已暂停后续步骤', completed: '本轮完成', succeeded: '已完成', failed: '失败', review: '待核对' };
const modes: Record<string, string> = { text: '文字', image: '图片', video: '视频', audio: '配音' };

export function describeAgentOperation(operation: CreativeAgentOperation, state?: AgentState | null) {
    const title = (id: string) => {
        const existing = state?.project.content.nodes.find(node => node.id === id);
        const planned = state?.items.find(item => item.content.operation?.type === 'add_node' && item.content.operation.id === id)?.content.operation;
        return existing?.title || (planned?.type === 'add_node' ? planned.title : id);
    };
    switch (operation.type) {
        case 'media_inspect': return '检查真实参考帧';
        case 'production_capture': return '抽取成片预览参考帧';
        case 'production_edit': return `调整成片编排 · ${operation.commands.length} 项操作`;
        case 'director_capture': return operation.parameters.kind === 'video' ? '录制导演序列参考视频' : '抽取导演参考帧';
        case 'director_command': return `调整导演场景 · ${operation.commands.length} 项操作`;
        case 'add_node': return `新建${modes[operation.nodeType] || '分组'}节点：${operation.title}`;
        case 'move_node': return `移动「${title(operation.nodeId)}」至 ${operation.position.x}, ${operation.position.y}`;
        case 'update_prompt': return `更新「${title(operation.nodeId)}」的提示词`;
        case 'connect_nodes': return `连接「${title(operation.fromNodeId)}」→「${title(operation.toNodeId)}」`;
        case 'generate': return `为「${title(operation.nodeId)}」生成${modes[operation.mode]}${operation.seconds ? ` · ${operation.seconds}秒` : ''}`;
        case 'creative_tool': return `${operation.tool === 'upscale' ? 'AI 超分' : '人物替换'}：「${title(operation.nodeId)}」`;
        case 'production_tool': return `${({ preview: '生成服务端预览', script: '整理剧本草稿', images: '生成分镜图片', narration: '生成旁白', check: '检查制作稿' })[operation.action]}${operation.shotIds?.length ? ` · ${operation.shotIds.length} 个镜头` : ''}${operation.narrationIds?.length ? ` · ${operation.narrationIds.length} 段旁白` : ''}`;
    }
}

function quoteText(item: AgentItem) {
    const value = item.content.quote;
    if (!value || value.maxCredits === null) return '费用需进一步确认';
    if (!value.maxCredits) return '无需模型积分';
    return value.minCredits === value.maxCredits ? `预计 ${value.maxCredits} 积分` : `预计 ${value.minCredits}–${value.maxCredits} 积分`;
}

function operationDetails(operation: CreativeAgentOperation, modelName: (id: string) => string) {
    if (operation.type === 'production_capture') return `来源预览：${operation.runId}\n帧号：${operation.frames.join('、')}\n保留原尺寸，保存到素材库，占用现有存储配额，不调用生成模型。`;
    if (operation.type === 'media_inspect') return `模型：${modelName(operation.modelId)}\n帧号：${operation.frames.join('、')}\n检查要求：${operation.instructions}\n仅检查选定真实画面，结果是建议。`;
    if (operation.type === 'director_capture') return `帧范围 ${operation.parameters.startFrame}–${operation.parameters.endFrame}（结束帧不包含），${operation.parameters.frames?.join('、') || '整段视频'}。需在导演台领取执行，真实产物验收后完成。`;
    if (operation.type === 'generate') return [`模型：${modelName(operation.modelId)}`, `参考素材：${operation.referenceNodeIds.length} 项`, operation.size ? `尺寸：${operation.size}` : '', operation.resolution ? `清晰度：${operation.resolution}` : '', operation.voice ? `音色：${operation.voice}` : '', `提示词：\n${operation.prompt}`].filter(Boolean).join('\n');
    if (operation.type === 'creative_tool') return operation.instructions;
    if (operation.type === 'production_tool') return [operation.modelId ? `模型：${modelName(operation.modelId)}` : '', operation.voice ? `音色：${operation.voice}` : '', operation.prompt || '', '产物进入制作生产记录，采用前可审核。'].filter(Boolean).join('\n');
    if (operation.type === 'add_node') return [operation.text || '', operation.prompt || ''].filter(Boolean).join('\n') || '创建空节点，供后续编辑';
    if (operation.type === 'update_prompt') return operation.prompt;
    return '';
}

function StatusIcon({ status }: { status: string }) {
    if (status === 'succeeded' || status === 'completed') return <CheckCircle2 className="size-3 shrink-0 text-green-500" />;
    if (status === 'failed') return <AlertCircle className="size-3 shrink-0 text-red-400" />;
    if (status === 'executing' || status === 'submitted') return <Loader2 className="size-3 shrink-0 animate-spin opacity-60" />;
    return <Clock className="size-3 shrink-0 opacity-40" />;
}

export function CreativeAgentPanel({ projectId, selectedNodeIds, prepareCanvas, applyProject, onClose, onToolHandoff, onOpenProductionExport, onOpenDirector }: CreativeAgentPanelProps) {
    const { token } = antdTheme.useToken();
    const theme = canvasThemes[useThemeStore(s => s.theme)];
    const [settingsOpen, setSettingsOpen] = useState(false);
    const scrollRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
    const state = useCreativeAgentStore();
    const owner = useAuthStore(value => value.user?.id);
    const epoch = useAuthStore(value => value.sessionEpoch);
    const [prompt, setPrompt] = useState('');
    const [model, setModel] = useState('');
    const [selectedSkills, setSelectedSkills] = useState<string[]>([]);
    const scope = `${owner || ''}:${epoch}:${projectId}`;
    const scopeRef = useRef(scope); scopeRef.current = scope;
    const controller = useRef(new AbortController());
    const running = useRef(false);
    const pauseRequested = useRef(false);
    const pendingPlan = useRef<{ fingerprint: string; input: AgentTurnInput } | null>(null);

    useEffect(() => {
        const active = new AbortController(); controller.current = active; running.current = false; pauseRequested.current = true; pendingPlan.current = null;
        setPrompt(''); setSelectedSkills([]); setModel('');
        useCreativeAgentStore.getState().patch({ projectId, snapshot: null, threads: [], skills: [], catalog: null, busy: true, error: '' });
        const client = creativeAgentApi(active.signal);
        const valid = () => !active.signal.aborted && scopeRef.current === scope;
        void Promise.all([client.catalog(), client.skills(), client.threads(projectId)]).then(async ([catalog, skills, threads]) => {
            if (!valid()) return;
            useCreativeAgentStore.getState().patch({ catalog, skills: skills.skills, threads: threads.threads });
            setModel(catalog.models[0]?.id || '');
            if (threads.threads[0]) { const snapshot = await client.thread(threads.threads[0].id); if (valid()) useCreativeAgentStore.getState().patch({ snapshot }); }
        }).catch(error => { if (valid()) useCreativeAgentStore.getState().patch({ error: error instanceof Error ? error.message : '助手加载失败' }); })
            .finally(() => { if (valid()) useCreativeAgentStore.getState().patch({ busy: false }); });
        return () => { active.abort(); pauseRequested.current = true; };
    }, [projectId, owner, epoch]);

    async function work(action: (client: ReturnType<typeof creativeAgentApi>, valid: () => boolean) => Promise<void>) {
        if (running.current) return;
        running.current = true;
        const active = controller.current; const expected = scope;
        const valid = () => !active.signal.aborted && scopeRef.current === expected;
        const client = creativeAgentApi(active.signal);
        state.patch({ busy: true, error: '' });
        try { await action(client, valid); }
        catch (error) { if (valid()) state.patch({ error: error instanceof Error ? error.message : '助手操作失败' }); }
        finally { if (valid()) { running.current = false; state.patch({ busy: false }); } }
    }
    async function accept(snapshot: AgentState, valid: () => boolean, apply = false) {
        if (!valid() || snapshot.thread.projectId !== projectId) return;
        state.patch({ snapshot });
        if (apply) await applyProject(snapshot.project);
    }
    async function newThread() {
        await work(async (client, valid) => {
            const project = await prepareCanvas(); if (!valid() || project.id !== projectId) return;
            const snapshot = await client.createThread(projectId, '新的创作对话');
            await accept(snapshot, valid);
            const list = await client.threads(projectId); if (valid()) state.patch({ threads: list.threads });
        });
    }
    async function plan() {
        if (!prompt.trim()) return;
        const selectedModel = state.catalog?.models.find(item => item.id === model);
        if (!selectedModel) { state.patch({ error: '请先选择可用文本模型' }); return; }
        await work(async (client, valid) => {
            const project = await prepareCanvas(); if (!valid() || project.id !== projectId) return;
            let snapshot = useCreativeAgentStore.getState().snapshot;
            if (!snapshot) snapshot = await client.createThread(projectId, prompt.trim());
            if (!valid()) return;
            state.patch({ snapshot });
            const payload = { modelId: model, expectedVersion: project.version, prompt: prompt.trim(), selectedNodeIds, skills: state.skills.filter(skill => skill.enabled && selectedSkills.includes(skill.id)).map(skill => ({ id: skill.id, version: skill.version })), acceptedPlanningCredits: selectedModel.credits };
            const fingerprint = JSON.stringify({ threadId: snapshot.thread.id, ...payload });
            if (!pendingPlan.current || pendingPlan.current.fingerprint !== fingerprint) pendingPlan.current = { fingerprint, input: { ...payload, clientRequestId: crypto.randomUUID() } };
            const result = await client.plan(snapshot.thread.id, pendingPlan.current.input);
            if (!valid()) return;
            pendingPlan.current = null; setPrompt('');
            await accept(result, valid);
            const threads = await client.threads(projectId); if (valid()) state.patch({ threads: threads.threads });
        });
    }
    async function execute(turn: AgentTurn) {
        await work(async (client, valid) => {
            pauseRequested.current = false;
            const project = await prepareCanvas(); if (!valid() || project.id !== projectId) return;
            let snapshot = await client.confirm(turn.id, project.version); await accept(snapshot, valid);
            while (valid() && !pauseRequested.current) {
                const liveTurn = snapshot.turns.find(item => item.id === turn.id);
                if (liveTurn?.status !== 'executing') break;
                const items = snapshot.items.filter(item => item.turnId === turn.id && item.role === 'tool').sort((a, b) => a.position - b.position);
                const next = items.find(item => item.status !== 'succeeded');
                if (!next || next.status !== 'pending') break;
                snapshot = await client.step(turn.id, next.itemId, snapshot.project.version);
                await accept(snapshot, valid, true);
                if (!valid()) break;
            }
        });
    }
    async function pause(turn: AgentTurn) {
        pauseRequested.current = true;
        const expected = scope; const active = controller.current;
        try { const snapshot = await creativeAgentApi(active.signal).pause(turn.id); if (!active.signal.aborted && scopeRef.current === expected) state.patch({ snapshot }); }
        catch (error) { if (!active.signal.aborted && scopeRef.current === expected) state.patch({ error: error instanceof Error ? error.message : '暂停未完成' }); }
    }
    async function refresh(turn: AgentTurn) {
        await work(async (client, valid) => {
            const project = await prepareCanvas(); if (!valid() || project.id !== projectId) return;
            const snapshot = await client.refresh(turn.id); await accept(snapshot, valid, snapshot.project.version !== project.version);
        });
    }
    function openTool(handoff: CreativeToolHandoff) {
        const auth = useAuthStore.getState();
        if (controller.current.signal.aborted || scopeRef.current !== scope || auth.user?.id !== owner || auth.sessionEpoch !== epoch) return;
        try {
            validateCreativeToolHandoff(handoff, useCanvasStore.getState().projects.find(project => project.id === projectId), window.location.origin);
            onToolHandoff?.(handoff);
        } catch (error) { state.patch({ error: error instanceof Error ? error.message : '工具准备记录已变化' }); }
    }
    useEffect(() => {
        const el = scrollRef.current;
        if (el) el.scrollTop = el.scrollHeight;
    }, [state.snapshot, state.busy, state.tab]);
    const last = state.snapshot?.turns.at(-1);
    const planningModel = state.catalog?.models.find(item => item.id === model);
    const disabledSend = state.busy || !prompt.trim() || !planningModel || last?.status === 'planning' || last?.status === 'executing';

    // 把所有 turns + items 展平为时间线消息
    const messages = state.snapshot?.turns.flatMap(turn => {
        const items = state.snapshot!.items
            .filter(item => item.threadId === state.snapshot!.thread.id && item.turnId === turn.id)
            .sort((a, b) => a.position - b.position);
        return items;
    }) ?? [];

    return (
        <aside
            className="canvas-redesigned flex h-full min-h-0 w-[400px] max-w-[90vw] flex-col border-l"
            style={{ background: theme.toolbar.panel, color: theme.toolbar.item, borderColor: theme.toolbar.border }}
            aria-label="创作助手"
        >
            {/* 顶栏 */}
            <div className="flex h-12 shrink-0 items-center justify-between border-b px-3" style={{ borderColor: theme.toolbar.border }}>
                <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                    {/* 对话切换 */}
                    <Select
                        className="agent-select"
                        style={{ width: 160 }}
                        size="small"
                        bordered={false}
                        placeholder="选择对话"
                        suffixIcon={<ChevronDown className="size-3 opacity-50" />}
                        value={state.snapshot?.thread.id}
                        disabled={state.busy}
                        options={state.threads.map(t => ({ value: t.id, label: t.title }))}
                        onChange={id => void work(async (client, valid) => accept(await client.thread(id), valid))}
                    />
                    <button
                        type="button"
                        className="grid size-7 place-items-center rounded-full transition hover:opacity-90"
                        style={{ background: theme.composer.chip, color: theme.composer.muted }}
                        aria-label="新建对话"
                        disabled={state.busy}
                        title="新建对话"
                        onClick={() => void newThread()}
                    >
                        <Plus className="size-3.5" />
                    </button>
                </div>
                <div className="flex items-center gap-1">
                    <button
                        type="button"
                        className="grid size-8 place-items-center rounded-full transition hover:opacity-90"
                        style={{ background: settingsOpen ? theme.composer.chipHover : 'transparent', color: theme.composer.muted }}
                        aria-label="设置"
                        aria-expanded={settingsOpen}
                        onClick={() => setSettingsOpen(!settingsOpen)}
                        title="设置"
                    >
                        <Settings2 className="size-3.5" />
                    </button>
                    <button
                        type="button"
                        className="grid size-8 place-items-center rounded-full transition hover:opacity-90"
                        style={{ color: theme.composer.muted }}
                        aria-label="关闭"
                        onClick={onClose}
                        title="关闭"
                    >
                        <X className="size-3.5" />
                    </button>
                </div>
            </div>

            {/* 折叠设置 */}
            {settingsOpen && (
                <div className="shrink-0 space-y-1.5 border-b px-3 py-2.5" style={{ borderColor: theme.toolbar.border, background: theme.toolbar.itemHover }}>
                    <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                        <span className="w-14 shrink-0 text-[11px] opacity-50">模型</span>
                        <Select
                            className="agent-select flex-1"
                            size="small"
                            bordered={false}
                            placeholder="选择模型"
                            value={model || undefined}
                            disabled={state.busy}
                            options={state.catalog?.models.map(item => ({ value: item.id, label: `${item.name} · ${item.credits}积分` })) || []}
                            onChange={setModel}
                        />
                    </div>
                    <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                        <span className="w-14 shrink-0 text-[11px] opacity-50">技能</span>
                        <Select
                            mode="multiple"
                            className="agent-select flex-1"
                            size="small"
                            bordered={false}
                            placeholder="选择技能（可选）"
                            value={selectedSkills}
                            disabled={state.busy}
                            options={state.skills.filter(s => s.enabled).map(s => ({ value: s.id, label: `${s.name} v${s.version}` }))}
                            onChange={setSelectedSkills}
                        />
                    </div>
                    <p className="text-[10px] opacity-40">已选 {selectedNodeIds.length} 个节点 · 读取文字与结构，不读取媒体画面</p>
                </div>
            )}

            {/* 标签页 */}
            <Tabs
                className="agent-tabs shrink-0 px-3"
                size="small"
                activeKey={state.tab}
                onChange={key => state.patch({ tab: key as 'chat' | 'skills' })}
                items={[
                    { key: 'chat', label: <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-1 text-[11px]"><MessageSquare className="size-3" />对话</span> },
                    { key: 'skills', label: <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-1 text-[11px]"><BookOpen className="size-3" />技能</span> },
                ]}
            />

            {state.tab === 'skills' ? <CreativeSkillsPanel /> : (
                <>
                    {/* 对话消息区 */}
                    <div ref={scrollRef} className="thin-scrollbar min-h-0 flex-1 space-y-1 overflow-y-auto px-3 py-3">
                        {/* 空状态 */}
                        {!messages.length && !state.busy && (
                            <div className="flex flex-col items-center justify-center gap-3 px-6 py-16 text-center">
                                <div className="grid size-12 place-items-center rounded-2xl" style={{ background: theme.composer.chip, color: theme.node.text }}>
                                    <Sparkles className="size-5" />
                                </div>
                                <p className="text-sm font-medium" style={{ color: theme.node.text }}>有什么想创作的？</p>
                                <p className="max-w-[240px] text-xs leading-relaxed" style={{ color: theme.composer.muted }}>描述你的创作目标，助手会先列出方案，确认后才修改画布</p>
                            </div>
                        )}

                        {/* 加载中 */}
                        {state.busy && !messages.length && (
                            <div className="flex items-center gap-2 py-4 text-[11px] opacity-45">
                                <Loader2 className="size-3.5 animate-spin" />
                                加载中…
                            </div>
                        )}

                        {/* 消息列表 */}
                        {state.snapshot?.turns.map(turn => {
                            const items = state.snapshot!.items
                                .filter(item => item.threadId === state.snapshot!.thread.id && item.turnId === turn.id)
                                .sort((a, b) => a.position - b.position);
                            const ops = items.filter(i => i.role === 'tool');
                            const known = ops.reduce((s, i) => s + (i.content.quote?.maxCredits || 0), 0);
                            const hasUnknown = ops.some(i => i.content.quote?.maxCredits === null);

                            return (
                                <div key={`${turn.threadId}:${turn.id}`} className="space-y-1">
                                    <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-1 text-xs opacity-70"><span>{statuses[turn.status]} · 规划 {Number(turn.planningCredits)} 积分</span>{turn.skillSnapshots.map(skill => <Tag key={skill.id}>{skill.name} v{skill.version}</Tag>)}</div>
                                    {items.map(item => (
                                        <div key={`${item.threadId}:${item.turnId}:${item.itemId}`}>
                                            {/* 用户消息 */}
                                            {item.role === 'user' && (
                                                <div className="flex justify-end pb-1">
                                                    <div
                                                        className="whitespace-pre-wrap break-words max-w-[86%] rounded-[18px] rounded-br-md px-3.5 py-2 text-[13px] leading-relaxed"
                                                        style={{ background: theme.composer.chipHover, color: theme.node.text }}
                                                    >
                                                        {item.content.text}
                                                    </div>
                                                </div>
                                            )}

                                            {/* 助手方案文字 */}
                                            {item.role === 'assistant' && (

                                                    <StatusIcon status={item.status} />

                                {operationDetails(item.content.operation!, id => state.catalog?.generationModels.find(model => model.id === id)?.name || '已下线模型') && <details className="text-xs"><summary className="cursor-pointer" style={{ color: token.colorTextSecondary }}>查看具体参数</summary><p className="mt-2 whitespace-pre-wrap break-words">{operationDetails(item.content.operation!, id => state.catalog?.generationModels.find(model => model.id === id)?.name || '已下线模型')}</p></details>}
                                {['director_command','production_edit'].includes(item.content.operation?.type || '') && item.status === 'succeeded' && <Button type="text" size="small" disabled={state.busy} onClick={() => void work(async (client, valid) => { const project = await prepareCanvas(); if (!valid()) return; const result = await client.undoDirector(projectId, item.itemId, project.version); if (!valid()) return; await applyProject(result.project); const snapshot = await client.thread(item.threadId); await accept(snapshot, valid); })}>撤销本次修改</Button>}
                                {item.receipt?.message && <p className="text-xs leading-relaxed" style={{ color: item.status === 'review' || item.status === 'failed' ? token.colorWarning : token.colorTextSecondary }}>{item.receipt.message}</p>}
                                {typeof item.receipt?.report === 'string' && <div className="whitespace-pre-wrap text-sm">{item.receipt.report}</div>}
                                {item.receipt?.inspectedFrames?.map(frame => <a key={frame.frame} href={frame.url} target="_blank" rel="noreferrer" className="inline-block mr-2 text-xs underline">查看检查依据：第 {frame.frame} 帧</a>)}
                                {item.content.operation?.type === 'director_capture' && <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2">
                                    {onOpenDirector && <Button type="text" size="small" disabled={state.busy} onClick={onOpenDirector}>{item.status === 'succeeded' ? '打开导演台查看与采用' : '打开导演台执行渲染'}</Button>}
                                    {item.receipt?.renderReceipt?.outputs?.map(output => <a key={output.objectKey} href={`/media/${output.objectKey}`} target="_blank" rel="noreferrer" className="text-xs underline">{output.frame === undefined ? '查看参考视频' : `查看第 ${output.frame} 帧`}</a>)}
                                </div>}
                                {item.content.operation?.type === 'production_capture' && item.receipt?.outputs?.map((output, index) => output.url && <a key={output.id} href={output.url} target="_blank" rel="noreferrer" className="inline-block mr-2 text-xs underline">查看第 {output.frame ?? index + 1} 帧{output.timeSeconds === undefined ? "" : ` · ${output.timeSeconds.toFixed(3)} 秒`}</a>)}
                                {item.content.operation?.type === 'production_tool' && item.content.operation.action === 'preview' && item.receipt?.outputs?.map(output => output.url && <a key={output.id} href={output.url} target="_blank" rel="noreferrer" className="text-xs underline">查看成片预览</a>)}
                                {item.receipt?.toolHandoff?.projectId === projectId && onToolHandoff && <div className="space-y-1"><Button type="text" size="small" disabled={state.busy} onClick={() => openTool(item.receipt!.toolHandoff!)}>打开{item.receipt.toolHandoff.tool === 'upscale' ? '超分' : '人物替换'}设置</Button><p className="text-xs" style={{ color: token.colorTextSecondary }}>打开后仍需检查参数并单独确认费用；此回执只完成工具准备。</p></div>}
                                {item.taskIds.length > 0 && <details className="text-xs"><summary className="cursor-pointer" style={{ color: token.colorTextSecondary }}>任务回执</summary>{item.taskIds.map(id => <div key={id} className="break-all">{id}</div>)}{item.receipt?.creditsCharged !== undefined && <div>本次扣除 {item.receipt.creditsCharged} 积分</div>}</details>}
                                                    </div>
                                                </div>
                                            )}
                                        </div>
                                    ))}

                                    {/* 轮次操作按钮 */}
                                    {turn.status !== 'completed' && (
                                        <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-1.5 pb-2 pl-2">
                                            {ops.length > 0 && (
                                                <span className="text-[10px] opacity-40">
                                                    最多 {known} 积分{hasUnknown ? ' + 待确认' : ''}
                                                </span>
                                            )}
                                            <div className="ml-auto flex gap-1">
                                                {['ready', 'paused', 'executing'].includes(turn.status) && !ops.some(i => ['failed', 'review'].includes(i.status)) && (
                                                    <button
                                                        type="button"
                                                        className="inline-flex h-7 items-center gap-1 rounded-full px-3 text-xs font-medium transition disabled:opacity-40"
                                                        style={{ background: theme.accent.primary, color: theme.accent.onPrimary }}
                                                        disabled={state.busy || ops.some(i => ['executing', 'submitted'].includes(i.status))}
                                                        onClick={() => void execute(turn)}
                                                    >
                                                        <Play className="size-2.5" />
                                                        {turn.status === 'ready' ? '执行' : '继续'}
                                                    </button>
                                                )}
                                                {turn.status === 'executing' && (
                                                    <button
                                                        type="button"
                                                        className="inline-flex h-7 items-center gap-1 rounded-full px-3 text-xs opacity-70 transition hover:opacity-100"
                                                        style={{ background: theme.toolbar.activeBg }}
                                                        onClick={() => void pause(turn)}
                                                    >
                                                        <Pause className="size-2.5" />暂停
                                                    </button>
                                                )}
                                                {(
                                                    <button
                                                        type="button"
                                                        className="inline-flex h-7 items-center gap-1 rounded-full px-3 text-xs opacity-60 transition hover:opacity-100"
                                                        style={{ background: theme.toolbar.activeBg }}
                                                        disabled={state.busy}
                                                        onClick={() => void refresh(turn)}
                                                    >
                                                        <RefreshCw className="size-2.5" />刷新
                                                    </button>
                                                )}
                                            </div>
                                        </div>
                                    )}
                                    {turn.status === "paused" && <p className="text-xs opacity-60">暂停只停止后续步骤，已提交的供应商任务仍会继续处理。</p>}
                                    {turn.error && (
                                        <div className="ml-2 flex items-start gap-1.5 text-[10px] text-red-400 pb-1">
                                            <AlertCircle className="size-3 shrink-0 mt-px" />{turn.error}
                                        </div>
                                    )}
                                </div>
                            );
                        })}

                        {/* 助手正在思考 */}
                        {state.busy && messages.length > 0 && (
                            <div className="flex items-center gap-2 py-1 pl-1 text-[11px] opacity-40">
                                <Loader2 className="size-3 animate-spin" />思考中…
                            </div>

                            <AlertCircle className="size-3 shrink-0 mt-px" />{state.error}

                            <button
                                type="button"
                                className="flex h-7 w-full items-center justify-center gap-1.5 rounded-lg border text-[11px] opacity-70 transition hover:opacity-100"
                                style={{ borderColor: theme.toolbar.border, background: theme.toolbar.itemHover }}
                                disabled={state.busy}
                                onClick={onOpenProductionExport}
                            >
                                打开制作面板
                            </button>
                        </div>
                    )}

                    {/* 输入区 */}
                    <div className="shrink-0 px-3 pb-3 pt-2">
                        <div
                            className="flex flex-col gap-1 rounded-[18px] border px-3 pb-2.5 pt-2.5 transition-[border-color] duration-150 [border-color:var(--agent-border)] focus-within:[border-color:var(--agent-border-focus)]"
                            style={{ background: theme.composer.chip, ['--agent-border' as string]: theme.composer.border, ['--agent-border-focus' as string]: theme.composer.borderFocus }}
                        >
                            <Input.TextArea
                                className="agent-input"
                                aria-label="创作目标"
                                placeholder="描述创作目标，Enter 发送，Shift + Enter 换行"
                                bordered={false}
                                autoSize={{ minRows: 2, maxRows: 6 }}
                                value={prompt}
                                disabled={state.busy}
                                style={{ padding: 0, fontSize: 13, lineHeight: 1.6, background: 'transparent' }}
                                onChange={e => setPrompt(e.target.value)}
                                onPressEnter={e => {
                                    if (!e.nativeEvent.isComposing && !e.shiftKey && !disabledSend) { e.preventDefault(); void plan(); }

                                    <button
                                        type="button"

                                        style={{ background: theme.composer.chip, color: theme.composer.chipText, fontSize: 12 }}
                                        title="切换规划模型"
                                        onClick={() => setSettingsOpen(true)}
                                    >
                                        <span className="truncate text-xs">{planningModel ? `${planningModel.name} · ${planningModel.credits} 积分` : '未选模型'}</span>
                                        <ChevronDown className="size-3 shrink-0 opacity-60" />
                                    </button>
                                    <span className="shrink-0 text-[11px]" style={{ color: theme.composer.muted }} title="本轮读取文字与结构，不读取媒体画面">已选 {selectedNodeIds.length} 个节点</span>
                                </div>
                                <button
                                    type="button"
                                    className="grid size-8 shrink-0 place-items-center rounded-full transition-[transform,background-color] duration-150 enabled:hover:scale-105 enabled:active:scale-95 disabled:cursor-not-allowed focus-visible:outline-2 focus-visible:outline-offset-2"
                                    style={disabledSend ? { background: theme.composer.sendDisabledBg, color: theme.composer.sendDisabledText } : { background: theme.accent.primary, color: theme.accent.onPrimary }}
                                    disabled={disabledSend}

                </>
            )}
        </aside>

import { useEffect, useRef, useState } from 'react';
import { Button, Input, Modal, Select, Switch, Tag, theme } from 'antd';
import { Copy, Download, History, Plus, Upload } from 'lucide-react';
import { creativeAgentApi, type CreativeSkill, type SkillDraft, type SkillVersion } from '@/services/api/creative-agent';
import { useCreativeAgentStore } from '@/stores/use-creative-agent-store';
import { useAuthStore } from '@/stores/use-auth-store';

const empty: SkillDraft = { name: '', description: '', content: '', requirements: ['text'] };
const capabilityNames: Record<string, string> = { text: '文字', vision: '视觉理解', image: '图片生成', video: '视频生成', audio: '音频生成' };

export function CreativeSkillsPanel() {
    const { token } = theme.useToken();
    const skills = useCreativeAgentStore(state => state.skills);
    const [editing, setEditing] = useState<CreativeSkill | 'new' | null>(null);
    const [draft, setDraft] = useState<SkillDraft>(empty);
    const [history, setHistory] = useState<{ skill: CreativeSkill; versions: SkillVersion[] } | null>(null);
    const [busy, setBusy] = useState(false);
    const [error, setError] = useState('');
    const uploadRef = useRef<HTMLInputElement>(null);
    const controller = useRef(new AbortController());
    const owner = useAuthStore(state => state.user?.id);
    const epoch = useAuthStore(state => state.sessionEpoch);
    useEffect(() => { const active = new AbortController(); controller.current = active; setEditing(null); setHistory(null); setDraft(empty); setError(''); setBusy(false); return () => active.abort(); }, [owner, epoch]);
    const reload = async (client: ReturnType<typeof creativeAgentApi>) => { const result = await client.skills(); useCreativeAgentStore.getState().patch({ skills: result.skills }); };
    async function act(action: (client: ReturnType<typeof creativeAgentApi>, valid: () => boolean) => Promise<void>) {
        if (busy) return;
        const active = controller.current;
        const valid = () => !active.signal.aborted && controller.current === active;
        setBusy(true); setError('');
        try { await action(creativeAgentApi(active.signal), valid); } catch (error) { if (valid()) setError(error instanceof Error ? error.message : '技能操作失败'); }
        finally { if (valid()) setBusy(false); }
    }
    function edit(skill: CreativeSkill | 'new') { setEditing(skill); setDraft(skill === 'new' ? empty : { name: skill.name, description: skill.description, content: skill.content, requirements: skill.requirements }); }
    function exportSkill(skill: CreativeSkill) {
        const blob = new Blob([JSON.stringify({ format: 'sundas-creative-skill', version: 1, skill: { name: skill.name, description: skill.description, content: skill.content, requirements: skill.requirements } }, null, 2)], { type: 'application/json;charset=utf-8' });
        const url = URL.createObjectURL(blob); const anchor = document.createElement('a');
        anchor.href = url; anchor.download = `${skill.name.replace(/[\\/:*?"<>|]/g, '_')}.json`; anchor.click(); URL.revokeObjectURL(url);
    }
    async function importFile(file: File, client: ReturnType<typeof creativeAgentApi>) {
        const text = await file.text();
        let value: SkillDraft;
        if (file.name.toLowerCase().endsWith('.json')) {
            const parsed = JSON.parse(text);
            if (parsed.format !== 'sundas-creative-skill' || parsed.version !== 1 || !parsed.skill) throw new Error('不是支持的文本技能文件');
            value = parsed.skill;
        } else value = { name: file.name.replace(/\.(md|txt)$/i, ''), description: '从文本文件导入', content: text, requirements: ['text'] };
        await client.createSkill(value); await reload(client);
    }
    return <div className="flex min-h-0 flex-1 flex-col gap-3 overflow-auto p-4">
        <p className="text-xs leading-relaxed" style={{ color: token.colorTextSecondary }}>技能是提示词与创作方法。每轮固定技能版本；文本导入不会运行脚本。本轮助手仅读取文字和画布结构，视觉核验仍需实际画面检查。</p>
        <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-1">
            <Button type="text" icon={<Plus size={15} />} onClick={() => edit('new')}>新建</Button>
            <Button type="text" icon={<Upload size={15} />} disabled={busy} onClick={() => uploadRef.current?.click()}>导入文本</Button>
            <input ref={uploadRef} type="file" accept=".md,.txt,.json" className="hidden" onChange={event => { const file = event.target.files?.[0]; event.target.value = ''; if (file) void act(client => importFile(file, client)); }} />
        </div>
        {error && <p role="alert" className="text-xs" style={{ color: token.colorError }}>{error}</p>}
        {skills.map(skill => <div key={skill.id} className="space-y-2 border-b py-3" style={{ borderColor: token.colorBorderSecondary }}>
            <div className="flex items-center justify-between gap-2"><button type="button" className="text-left text-sm font-medium" onClick={() => edit(skill)}>{skill.name}</button><Switch size="small" checked={skill.enabled} disabled={busy} onChange={enabled => void act(async client => { await client.enableSkill(skill.id, enabled); await reload(client); })} aria-label={`启用${skill.name}`} /></div>
            <p className="text-xs" style={{ color: token.colorTextSecondary }}>{skill.description}</p>
            <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-1 text-xs"><Tag>{skill.source === 'builtin' ? '内置' : '个人'} · v{skill.version}</Tag>{skill.requirements.map(capability => <span key={capability} style={{ color: token.colorTextSecondary }}>{capabilityNames[capability] || capability}</span>)}</div>
            <div className="flex flex-wrap">
                <Button size="small" type="text" icon={<Copy size={13} />} disabled={busy} onClick={() => void act(async client => { await client.copySkill(skill.id, skill.version); await reload(client); })}>复制</Button>
                <Button size="small" type="text" icon={<Download size={13} />} onClick={() => exportSkill(skill)}>导出</Button>
                <Button size="small" type="text" icon={<History size={13} />} disabled={busy} onClick={() => void act(async (client, valid) => { const result = await client.versions(skill.id); if (valid()) setHistory({ skill, versions: result.versions }); })}>版本</Button>
            </div>
        </div>)}
        <Modal open={editing !== null} title={editing === 'new' ? '新建个人技能' : editing?.source === 'builtin' ? '内置技能' : '编辑个人技能'} onCancel={() => setEditing(null)} destroyOnHidden footer={editing && editing !== 'new' && editing.source === 'builtin' ? <Button onClick={() => setEditing(null)}>关闭</Button> : <Button type="primary" loading={busy} disabled={!draft.name.trim() || !draft.content.trim()} onClick={() => void act(async (client, valid) => { if (editing === 'new') await client.createSkill(draft); else if (editing) await client.editSkill(editing.id, draft, editing.version); await reload(client); if (valid()) setEditing(null); })}>保存新版本</Button>}>
            <div className="space-y-3">
                <Input aria-label="技能名称" placeholder="技能名称" value={draft.name} disabled={editing !== 'new' && editing?.source === 'builtin'} onChange={event => setDraft({ ...draft, name: event.target.value })} />
                <Input aria-label="技能用途" placeholder="用途与触发场景" value={draft.description} disabled={editing !== 'new' && editing?.source === 'builtin'} onChange={event => setDraft({ ...draft, description: event.target.value })} />
                <Select mode="multiple" className="w-full" aria-label="所需能力" value={draft.requirements} options={Object.entries(capabilityNames).map(([value, label]) => ({ value, label }))} disabled={editing !== 'new' && editing?.source === 'builtin'} onChange={requirements => setDraft({ ...draft, requirements })} />
                <Input.TextArea aria-label="技能内容" rows={12} value={draft.content} readOnly={editing !== 'new' && editing?.source === 'builtin'} onChange={event => setDraft({ ...draft, content: event.target.value })} />
            </div>
        </Modal>
        <Modal open={Boolean(history)} title="技能版本记录" onCancel={() => setHistory(null)} footer={null} destroyOnHidden>
            <div className="max-h-[60vh] space-y-3 overflow-auto">{history?.versions.map(version => <details key={version.version} className="border-b pb-3" style={{ borderColor: token.colorBorderSecondary }}><summary className="cursor-pointer text-sm">v{version.version} · {version.name}</summary><pre className="mt-2 whitespace-pre-wrap text-xs">{version.content}</pre>{history.skill.source === 'personal' && version.version !== history.skill.version && <Button type="text" size="small" disabled={busy} onClick={() => void act(async (client, valid) => { await client.restoreSkill(history.skill.id, version.version, history.skill.version); await reload(client); if (valid()) setHistory(null); })}>恢复为新版本</Button>}</details>)}</div>
        </Modal>
    </div>;
}

import { useEffect, useState } from "react";
import { Clapperboard, Move3d } from "lucide-react";

import { canvasThemes, type CanvasTheme } from "@/lib/canvas-theme";
import { resolveDirectorActiveShot, resolveDirectorPreviewSource, type DirectorNodeContentReader } from "@/lib/canvas/director/director-preview";
import { resolveImageUrl } from "@/services/image-storage";
import { useActiveTheme } from "@/stores/canvas/use-canvas-theme-store";
import type { CanvasNodeData } from "@/types/canvas";
import type { DirectorScene } from "@/types/director";

export function CanvasDirectorNodePanel({ node, scene, readNodeContent, readNodeStorageKey, onOpen, professional = true }: { node: CanvasNodeData; scene: DirectorScene | null; readNodeContent: DirectorNodeContentReader; readNodeStorageKey?: DirectorNodeContentReader; onOpen: () => void; professional?: boolean }) {
    const theme = canvasThemes[useActiveTheme()];
    const shot = resolveDirectorActiveShot(scene, node.metadata?.directorShotId);
    // 记录「失败的那个 URL」而非布尔量：同一个坏 URL 不再反复渲染，换成另一个 URL 时自动重试。
    const [failedUrl, setFailedUrl] = useState<string | null>(null);
    const coverStorageKey = node.metadata?.directorCoverStorageKey || (!node.metadata?.directorCoverUrl ? readNodeStorageKey?.(node.metadata?.directorPreviewNodeId) || readNodeStorageKey?.(shot?.previewNodeId) : undefined);
    const [resolvedCover, setResolvedCover] = useState<{ key: string; url: string } | null>(null);
    useEffect(() => {
        if (!coverStorageKey) return;
        let live = true;
        void resolveImageUrl(coverStorageKey, node.metadata?.directorCoverUrl || "", { cacheMiss: true })
            .then((url) => { if (live && url) setResolvedCover({ key: coverStorageKey, url }); })
            .catch(() => { /* 旧预览或空态仍可使用。 */ });
        return () => { live = false; };
    }, [coverStorageKey, node.metadata?.directorCoverUrl]);
    const coverUrl = resolvedCover && resolvedCover.key === coverStorageKey ? resolvedCover.url : node.metadata?.directorCoverUrl;
    const preview = resolveDirectorPreviewSource({ scene, shot, coverUrl, failedUrl, previewNodeId: node.metadata?.directorPreviewNodeId, readNodeContent });

    return (
        <div
            className="relative h-full w-full min-h-0 overflow-hidden rounded-[inherit]"
            style={{ color: theme.node.text, background: theme.node.fill }}
            data-director-open={preview.kind === "image" ? "preview" : "empty"}
        >
            {preview.kind === "image"
                ? <img src={preview.url} alt={`${node.title} 导演台场景封面`} className="block h-full w-full object-cover" draggable={false} onError={() => setFailedUrl(preview.url)} />
                : <DirectorPreviewState kind={preview.kind} theme={theme} />}
            <button
                type="button"
                data-canvas-no-zoom
                className="absolute left-1/2 top-1/2 z-10 flex -translate-x-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 items-center gap-2 whitespace-nowrap rounded-xl px-6 py-4 text-base font-semibold shadow-lg transition hover:brightness-110 focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 disabled:cursor-default disabled:opacity-60"
                style={{ background: theme.accent.primary, color: theme.accent.onPrimary, border: `1px solid ${theme.toolbar.border}` }}
                aria-label={professional ? "打开导演台" : "切换到专业模式后编辑导演台"}
                disabled={!professional}
                onMouseDown={(event) => event.stopPropagation()}
                onPointerDown={(event) => event.stopPropagation()}
                onClick={(event) => { event.stopPropagation(); onOpen(); }}
            >
                <Clapperboard className="size-8" aria-hidden />
