import { useEffect, useRef, useState } from 'react';
import { Button } from 'antd';
import { Play } from 'lucide-react';
import { resolveImageUrl } from '@/services/image-storage';
import { resolveMediaUrl, uploadMediaFile } from '@/services/file-storage';
import { uploadImage } from '@/services/image-storage';
import { useAuthStore } from '@/stores/use-auth-store';
import { useMediaPreview } from '@/hooks/use-media-preview';
import type { ProductionMedia } from '../../../../shared/production';
import { useProduction } from './production-context';

export function ProductionMediaPreview({ media, onDuration, seek }: { media?: ProductionMedia; onDuration?: (durationMs: number) => void; seek?: { timeMs: number; nonce: number } }) {
    const [url, setUrl] = useState(''), [active, setActive] = useState(false);
    const [visible, setVisible] = useState(false), container = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
    const player = useRef<HTMLMediaElement | null>(null);
    const owner = useAuthStore(state => state.user?.id), epoch = useAuthStore(state => state.sessionEpoch);
    const thumbnail = useMediaPreview(visible && media?.kind !== 'audio' ? media?.url : undefined);
    useEffect(() => { const element = container.current; if (!element) return; if (typeof IntersectionObserver === 'undefined') { setVisible(true); return; } const observer = new IntersectionObserver(entries => setVisible(entries.some(entry => entry.isIntersecting))); observer.observe(element); return () => observer.disconnect(); }, []);
    useEffect(() => { setUrl(''); setActive(false); }, [media?.url, media?.storageKey, media?.kind, owner, epoch]);
    useEffect(() => {
        let mounted = true;
        if (media && (visible || active)) void (media.kind === 'image' ? resolveImageUrl(media.storageKey, media.url) : resolveMediaUrl(media.storageKey, media.url)).then(value => { if (mounted) setUrl(value); }).catch(() => {});
        return () => { mounted = false; };
    }, [media?.url, media?.storageKey, media?.kind, owner, epoch, visible, active]);
    useEffect(() => { const element = player.current; return () => { if (element) { element.pause(); element.removeAttribute('src'); element.load(); } }; }, [active, url]);
    useEffect(() => { if (!seek) return; setActive(true); const element = player.current; if (element && element.readyState > 0) { element.currentTime = seek.timeMs / 1000; void element.play().catch(() => {}); } }, [seek?.nonce]);
    if (!media) return <div ref={container} />;
    const metadata = (element: HTMLMediaElement) => { if (seek) element.currentTime = seek.timeMs / 1000; if (Number.isFinite(element.duration) && element.duration > 0 && !media.durationMs) onDuration?.(Math.round(element.duration * 1000)); };
    return <div ref={container} className="min-h-8">{media.kind === 'image' ? (visible && (thumbnail.url || (!thumbnail.cloud && url)) ? <img src={thumbnail.url || url} alt="画面预览" className="max-h-44 w-full rounded object-contain" loading="lazy" decoding="async" /> : thumbnail.error ? <Button type="text" size="small" onClick={thumbnail.retry}>重新加载缩略图</Button> : <span className="text-xs">画面预览</span>) : !active ? <div>{visible && thumbnail.url && <img src={thumbnail.url} alt="视频封面" className="max-h-40 w-full object-contain" loading="lazy" />}<Button type="text" icon={<Play size={14} />} disabled={!url} onClick={() => setActive(true)}>播放{media.kind === 'audio' ? '音频' : '视频'}{media.durationMs ? ` · ${(media.durationMs / 1000).toFixed(2)} 秒` : ''}</Button></div> : media.kind === 'audio' ? <audio ref={element => { player.current = element; }} src={url} controls autoPlay preload="none" className="w-full" onLoadedMetadata={event => metadata(event.currentTarget)} /> : <video ref={element => { player.current = element; }} src={url} controls autoPlay preload="none" className="max-h-56 w-full" onLoadedMetadata={event => metadata(event.currentTarget)} />}</div>;
}

export function ProductionMediaUpload({ kind, onMedia }: { kind: ProductionMedia['kind']; onMedia: (media: ProductionMedia) => void }) {
    const { error } = useProduction();
    const input = useRef<HTMLInputElement>(null), [busy, setBusy] = useState(false);
    const callback = useRef(onMedia); callback.current = onMedia;
    const scope = useRef(0);
    useEffect(() => () => { scope.current++; }, []);
    return <><input ref={input} className="hidden" type="file" accept={`${kind}/*`} onChange={async event => {
        const file = event.target.files?.[0]; event.target.value = ''; if (!file) return;
        const token = scope.current, auth = useAuthStore.getState(), owner = auth.user?.id, epoch = auth.sessionEpoch;
        const current = () => token === scope.current && useAuthStore.getState().user?.id === owner && useAuthStore.getState().sessionEpoch === epoch;
        setBusy(true);
        try {
            const result = kind === 'image' ? await uploadImage(file, { expectedOwner: owner }) : await uploadMediaFile(file, kind, { expectedOwner: owner });
            if (current()) callback.current({ kind, ...(result.storageKey ? { storageKey: result.storageKey } : { url: result.url }), ...('durationMs' in result && result.durationMs ? { durationMs: result.durationMs } : {}) });
        } catch (e) { if (current()) error(e instanceof Error ? e.message : '素材上传失败'); }
        finally { if (current()) setBusy(false); }
    }} /><Button type="text" size="small" loading={busy} onClick={() => input.current?.click()}>上传{kind === 'image' ? '图片' : kind === 'audio' ? '音频' : '视频'}</Button></>;
}

FILE: web/src/components/canvas/use-image-editor-viewport.ts

import { useCallback, useEffect, useLayoutEffect, useRef, useState, type CSSProperties, type MouseEvent as ReactMouseEvent, type PointerEvent as ReactPointerEvent } from "react";

type ImageSize = { width: number; height: number };

const minZoom = 1;
const maxZoom = 4;
const zoomStep = 1.2;
const viewportPadding = 16;

export function useImageEditorViewport(image: ImageSize | null, open: boolean) {
    const viewportNodeRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
    const stageRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
    const panRef = useRef<{ pointerId: number; x: number; y: number; scrollLeft: number; scrollTop: number } | null>(null);
    const zoomAnchorRef = useRef<{ zoom: number; ratioX: number; ratioY: number; viewportX: number; viewportY: number } | null>(null);
    const [viewportElement, setViewportElement] = useState<HTMLDivElement | null>(null);
    const [viewportSize, setViewportSize] = useState<ImageSize>({ width: 0, height: 0 });
    const [zoom, setZoom] = useState(minZoom);
    const [isPanning, setIsPanning] = useState(false);
    const [spacePressed, setSpacePressed] = useState(false);
    const spacePressedRef = useRef(false);
    const viewportRef = useCallback((node: HTMLDivElement | null) => {
        viewportNodeRef.current = node;
        setViewportElement(node);
    }, []);

    useEffect(() => {
        if (!open) return;
        zoomAnchorRef.current = null;
        setZoom(minZoom);
    }, [open, image?.width, image?.height]);

    useEffect(() => {
        if (!open) return;
        const releaseSpace = () => {
            spacePressedRef.current = false;
            setSpacePressed(false);
        };
        const handleKeyDown = (event: KeyboardEvent) => {
            if (event.code !== "Space" || event.repeat) return;
            const target = event.target instanceof Element ? event.target : null;
            if (target?.closest("input,textarea,[contenteditable='true']")) return;
            event.preventDefault();
            event.stopPropagation();
            event.stopImmediatePropagation();
            if (document.activeElement instanceof HTMLElement && document.activeElement.matches("button,a,[role='button']")) document.activeElement.blur();
            spacePressedRef.current = true;
            setSpacePressed(true);
        };
        const handleKeyUp = (event: KeyboardEvent) => {
            if (event.code !== "Space" || !spacePressedRef.current) return;
            event.preventDefault();
            event.stopPropagation();
            event.stopImmediatePropagation();
            releaseSpace();
        };
        window.addEventListener("keydown", handleKeyDown, true);
        window.addEventListener("keyup", handleKeyUp, true);
        window.addEventListener("blur", releaseSpace);
        return () => {
            window.removeEventListener("keydown", handleKeyDown, true);
            window.removeEventListener("keyup", handleKeyUp, true);
            window.removeEventListener("blur", releaseSpace);
            spacePressedRef.current = false;
        };
    }, [open]);

    useEffect(() => {
        if (!open || !viewportElement) return;
        const updateSize = () => {
            const width = viewportElement.clientWidth;
            const height = viewportElement.clientHeight;
            setViewportSize((current) => (current.width === width && current.height === height ? current : { width, height }));
        };
        updateSize();
        const observer = new ResizeObserver(updateSize);
        observer.observe(viewportElement);
        return () => observer.disconnect();
    }, [open, viewportElement]);

    const baseSize = fitImage(image, viewportSize);
    const stageSize = { width: baseSize.width * zoom, height: baseSize.height * zoom };
    const contentSize = {
        width: Math.max(viewportSize.width, stageSize.width),
        height: Math.max(viewportSize.height, stageSize.height),
    };
    const stageOffset = {
        left: Math.max(0, Math.round((contentSize.width - stageSize.width) / 2)),
        top: Math.max(0, Math.round((contentSize.height - stageSize.height) / 2)),
    };

    useLayoutEffect(() => {
        const viewport = viewportNodeRef.current;
        const anchor = zoomAnchorRef.current;
        if (!viewport || !anchor || Math.abs(anchor.zoom - zoom) > 0.001) return;
        const nextWidth = baseSize.width * zoom;
        const nextHeight = baseSize.height * zoom;
        const nextLeft = Math.max(0, (Math.max(viewport.clientWidth, nextWidth) - nextWidth) / 2);
        const nextTop = Math.max(0, (Math.max(viewport.clientHeight, nextHeight) - nextHeight) / 2);
        viewport.scrollLeft = nextLeft + anchor.ratioX * nextWidth - anchor.viewportX;
        viewport.scrollTop = nextTop + anchor.ratioY * nextHeight - anchor.viewportY;
        zoomAnchorRef.current = null;
    }, [baseSize.height, baseSize.width, zoom]);

    const setZoomAround = useCallback(
        (nextZoom: number, clientX?: number, clientY?: number) => {
            const viewport = viewportNodeRef.current;
            const stage = stageRef.current;
            if (!viewport || !stage || !baseSize.width || !baseSize.height) return;

            const boundedZoom = clamp(nextZoom, minZoom, maxZoom);
            if (Math.abs(boundedZoom - zoom) < 0.001) return;

            const viewportRect = viewport.getBoundingClientRect();
            const stageRect = stage.getBoundingClientRect();
            const pointerX = clientX ?? viewportRect.left + viewportRect.width / 2;
            const pointerY = clientY ?? viewportRect.top + viewportRect.height / 2;
            const ratioX = clamp((pointerX - stageRect.left) / Math.max(1, stageRect.width), 0, 1);
            const ratioY = clamp((pointerY - stageRect.top) / Math.max(1, stageRect.height), 0, 1);
            const viewportX = pointerX - viewportRect.left;
            const viewportY = pointerY - viewportRect.top;

            zoomAnchorRef.current = { zoom: boundedZoom, ratioX, ratioY, viewportX, viewportY };
            setZoom(boundedZoom);
        },
        [baseSize.height, baseSize.width, zoom],
    );

    useEffect(() => {
        if (!open || !viewportElement) return;
        const handleWheel = (event: WheelEvent) => {
            event.preventDefault();
            event.stopPropagation();
            setZoomAround(event.deltaY < 0 ? zoom * zoomStep : zoom / zoomStep, event.clientX, event.clientY);
        };
        viewportElement.addEventListener("wheel", handleWheel, { passive: false });
        return () => viewportElement.removeEventListener("wheel", handleWheel);
    }, [open, setZoomAround, viewportElement, zoom]);

    const startPan = useCallback((event: ReactPointerEvent<HTMLDivElement>) => {
        if (event.button !== 1 && !(event.button === 0 && spacePressedRef.current)) return;
        event.preventDefault();
        event.stopPropagation();
        const viewport = event.currentTarget;
        panRef.current = { pointerId: event.pointerId, x: event.clientX, y: event.clientY, scrollLeft: viewport.scrollLeft, scrollTop: viewport.scrollTop };
        viewport.setPointerCapture(event.pointerId);
        setIsPanning(true);
    }, []);
    const movePan = useCallback((event: ReactPointerEvent<HTMLDivElement>) => {
        const pan = panRef.current;
        if (!pan || event.pointerId !== pan.pointerId) return;
        event.preventDefault();
        event.stopPropagation();
        event.currentTarget.scrollLeft = pan.scrollLeft - (event.clientX - pan.x);
        event.currentTarget.scrollTop = pan.scrollTop - (event.clientY - pan.y);
    }, []);
    const stopPan = useCallback((event: ReactPointerEvent<HTMLDivElement>) => {
        const pan = panRef.current;
        if (!pan || event.pointerId !== pan.pointerId) return;
        event.preventDefault();
        event.stopPropagation();
        if (event.currentTarget.hasPointerCapture(event.pointerId)) event.currentTarget.releasePointerCapture(event.pointerId);
        panRef.current = null;
        setIsPanning(false);
    }, []);
    const preventAuxClick = useCallback((event: ReactMouseEvent<HTMLDivElement>) => {
        if (event.button !== 1) return;
        event.preventDefault();
        event.stopPropagation();
    }, []);

    return {
        viewportRef,
        stageRef,
        zoom,
        isPanning,
        spacePressed,
        scrollClassName: zoom > minZoom + 0.001 ? "overflow-scroll" : "overflow-hidden",
        panHandlers: {
            onPointerDownCapture: startPan,
            onPointerMoveCapture: movePan,
            onPointerUpCapture: stopPan,
            onPointerCancelCapture: stopPan,
            onAuxClick: preventAuxClick,
        },
        canZoomIn: zoom < maxZoom,
        canZoomOut: zoom > minZoom,
        imageScale: image ? stageSize.width / image.width : 0,
        zoomIn: () => setZoomAround(zoom * zoomStep),
        zoomOut: () => setZoomAround(zoom / zoomStep),
        resetZoom: () => setZoomAround(minZoom),
        contentStyle: { width: contentSize.width, height: contentSize.height } satisfies CSSProperties,
        stageStyle: {
            left: stageOffset.left,
            top: stageOffset.top,
            width: stageSize.width,
            height: stageSize.height,
        } satisfies CSSProperties,
        mediaStyle: {
            width: baseSize.width,
            height: baseSize.height,
            transform: `translateZ(0) scale(${zoom})`,
            transformOrigin: "top left",
        } satisfies CSSProperties,
    };
}

function fitImage(image: ImageSize | null, viewport: ImageSize): ImageSize {
    if (!image || !viewport.width || !viewport.height) return { width: 0, height: 0 };
    const availableWidth = Math.max(1, viewport.width - viewportPadding * 2);
    const availableHeight = Math.max(1, viewport.height - viewportPadding * 2);
    const scale = Math.min(availableWidth / image.width, availableHeight / image.height, 1);
    return { width: Math.max(1, Math.floor(image.width * scale)), height: Math.max(1, Math.floor(image.height * scale)) };
}

function clamp(value: number, min: number, max: number) {
    return Math.min(max, Math.max(min, value));
}

import { useState } from "react";
import type { Continuation } from "./creation-drafts";

const separator = "\n\n本次修改要求：\n";
export function continuationPrompt(prompt: string, continuation?: Continuation) {
    const instruction = prompt.trim();
    return instruction && continuation ? `原创作描述：\n${continuation.prompt}${separator}${instruction}\n请根据以上修改要求生成新版本，保留未要求改变的内容。` : instruction;
}

export function CreationRequest({ prompt }: { prompt: string }) {
    const [expanded, setExpanded] = useState(false);
    const instruction = prompt.includes(separator) ? prompt.slice(prompt.lastIndexOf(separator) + separator.length).replace(/\n请根据以上修改要求生成新版本，保留未要求改变的内容。$/, "") : prompt;
    const expandable = instruction.length > 240 || instruction.split("\n").length > 6;
    return <div className="mb-5 flex justify-end"><div className="max-w-[85%] whitespace-pre-wrap break-words rounded-2xl rounded-br-sm bg-muted px-4 py-3 text-sm leading-6" aria-label="你的创作要求"><p className={expandable && !expanded ? "line-clamp-6" : ""}>{instruction}</p>{expandable && <button type="button" className="mt-2 text-xs text-muted-foreground hover:text-foreground" aria-expanded={expanded} onClick={() => setExpanded(value => !value)}>{expanded ? "收起描述" : "展开完整描述"}</button>}</div></div>;
}

export function ContinuationNotice({ value, mode, onCancel }: { value?: Continuation; mode: "image" | "video"; onCancel: () => void }) {
    if (!value) return null;
    return <div className="mb-2 flex items-center gap-3 rounded-lg border border-border px-3 py-2 text-xs"><div className="min-w-0 flex-1"><p className="truncate font-medium">{mode === "image" ? "继续改图" : "调整后重新生成"} · {value.title}</p><p className="mt-1 text-muted-foreground">{mode === "image" ? "已引用选中图片，请输入修改要求" : "沿用原描述与参数，输入修改要求后生成新视频"}</p></div><button type="button" onClick={onCancel} className="shrink-0 text-muted-foreground hover:text-foreground">结束修改</button></div>;
}

import type { ReferenceImage } from "@/types/image";
import type { ReferenceAudio, ReferenceVideo } from "@/types/media";

export type Continuation = { title: string; prompt: string };

type Draft = { continuation?: Continuation; prompt: string; references: ReferenceImage[]; videos: ReferenceVideo[]; audios: ReferenceAudio[] };
let session = "";
const drafts: Partial<Record<"image" | "video", Draft>> = {};

function forSession(owner: string, epoch: number) {
    const current = `${owner}:${epoch}`;
    if (session !== current) {
        session = current;
        delete drafts.image;
        delete drafts.video;
    }
}

export function readCreationDraft(mode: "image" | "video", owner: string, epoch: number) {
    forSession(owner, epoch);
    return drafts[mode];
}

export function saveCreationDraft(mode: "image" | "video", owner: string, epoch: number, draft: Draft) {
    forSession(owner, epoch);
    drafts[mode] = draft;
}

export function clearCreationDrafts() { delete drafts.image; delete drafts.video; }

    video: RecentCreation[];

};

    session: "", image: [], video: [],
    update: (session, mode, items) => set((state) => ({

    })),
}));

import { useEffect, useState, type ReactNode } from "react";
import { ChevronsLeft, ChevronsRight, History } from "lucide-react";
import { useTranslation } from "react-i18next";

import "./creation-records-rail.css";

/** 窄屏仍旧用底部抽屉，宽屏才把面板停靠到右侧 */
export function useNarrowRecords() {
    const [narrow, setNarrow] = useState(() => typeof window !== "undefined" && window.matchMedia("(max-width: 1023px)").matches);
    useEffect(() => {
        const query = window.matchMedia("(max-width: 1023px)");
        const onChange = () => setNarrow(query.matches);
        onChange();
        query.addEventListener("change", onChange);
        return () => query.removeEventListener("change", onChange);
    }, []);
    return narrow;
}

/**
 * 「生成记录」停靠面板（参考即梦工作台右侧记录栏）：
 * 收起是一条 92px 的竖向栏，只留「« 生成记录」；展开 372px，内容由调用方塞进来。
 * 面板本身不覆盖合成器，创作区和记录区各滚各的。
 */
export function CreationRecordsRail({ open, count, onToggle, children }: {
    open: boolean;
    count: number;
    onToggle: () => void;
    children: ReactNode;
}) {
    const { t } = useTranslation();
    const label = t("workbench.logs");
    return (
        <aside className={`creation-records-rail${open ? " is-open" : ""}`} aria-label={label}>
            <header className="crec-head">
                <button type="button" className="crec-toggle" onClick={onToggle} aria-expanded={open} title={label}>
                    {open ? <ChevronsRight className="size-4 shrink-0" aria-hidden /> : <ChevronsLeft className="size-4 shrink-0" aria-hidden />}
                    <span className="crec-title">{label}</span>
                </button>
                {open ? <span className="crec-count">{count}</span> : null}
            </header>
            {open ? <div className="crec-body thin-scrollbar">{children}</div> : (
                /* 收起态没有顶栏按钮兜底，整条竖栏就是展开入口 */
                <button type="button" className="crec-stub" onClick={onToggle} aria-expanded={false} aria-label={label} title={label}>
                    <History className="size-4" aria-hidden />
                </button>
            )}
        </aside>
    );
}

import { ChatLayout, ChatMessageList } from "@astryxdesign/core/Chat";
import { InternationalizationProvider } from "@astryxdesign/core/i18n";
import zhCN from "@astryxdesign/core/locales/zh-CN.generated.js";
import { useEffect, useRef, useState, type ReactNode } from "react";
import { useTranslation } from "react-i18next";

import { useThemeStore } from "@/stores/use-theme-store";

export function CreationStream({ children, composer, onScrollTop, tasks = [] }: { children: ReactNode; composer: ReactNode; onScrollTop?: () => void; tasks?: { id: string; status: string }[] }) {
    const theme = useThemeStore((state) => state.theme);
    const layout = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
    const previousTasks = useRef(new Map<string, string>());
    const [hasFinishedTasks, setHasFinishedTasks] = useState(false);
    useEffect(() => {
        const finished = tasks.some(task => previousTasks.current.get(task.id) === "pending" && task.status !== "pending");
        previousTasks.current = new Map(tasks.map(task => [task.id, task.status]));
        const element = layout.current;
        if (finished && element && element.scrollHeight - element.scrollTop - element.clientHeight > 100) setHasFinishedTasks(true);
    }, [tasks]);
    const previousScrollTop = useRef(0);
    const upwardIntent = useRef(false);
    const touchY = useRef<number | null>(null);
    const { i18n } = useTranslation();
    return (
        <InternationalizationProvider locale={i18n.resolvedLanguage === "en" ? "en" : "zh-CN"} messages={{ "zh-CN": zhCN }}>
            <div className="creation-stream flex min-h-0 flex-1 flex-col" data-astryx-theme="neutral" style={{ colorScheme: theme }}>
                <ChatLayout ref={layout} density="spacious" composer={<>{hasFinishedTasks && <div className="mb-2 text-center"><button type="button" className="rounded-full border border-border bg-card px-4 py-2 text-sm text-foreground" onClick={() => { setHasFinishedTasks(false); layout.current?.scrollTo({ top: layout.current.scrollHeight, behavior: "smooth" }); }}>有新结果 · 查看</button></div>}{composer}</>} onWheel={(event) => {
                    upwardIntent.current = event.deltaY < 0;
                    if (upwardIntent.current && event.currentTarget.scrollTop <= 24) {
                        upwardIntent.current = false;
                        onScrollTop?.();
                    }
                }} onTouchStart={(event) => { touchY.current = event.touches[0]?.clientY ?? null; }} onTouchMove={(event) => {
                    const nextY = event.touches[0]?.clientY;
                    if (nextY != null && touchY.current != null) upwardIntent.current = nextY > touchY.current;
                    touchY.current = nextY ?? null;
                }} onKeyDown={(event) => {
                    if (["ArrowUp", "PageUp", "Home"].includes(event.key)) upwardIntent.current = true;
                }} onScroll={(event) => {
                    const top = event.currentTarget.scrollTop;
                    if (event.currentTarget.scrollHeight - top - event.currentTarget.clientHeight < 30) setHasFinishedTasks(false);
                    if (upwardIntent.current && top <= 24 && top < previousScrollTop.current) {
                        upwardIntent.current = false;
                        onScrollTop?.();
                    }
                    previousScrollTop.current = top;
                }}><ChatMessageList align="top" gap={0} aria-label="创作记录">{children}</ChatMessageList></ChatLayout>
            </div>
        </InternationalizationProvider>
    );
}

import { Button } from "@astryxdesign/core/Button";
import { App, Dropdown } from "antd";
import { FolderOpen, ImagePlus, Video, MessageSquare, Plus, SlidersHorizontal, BookOpen, Paperclip, type LucideIcon } from "lucide-react";
import { useNavigate } from "react-router-dom";
import { useCallback, useEffect, useLayoutEffect, useRef, useState, type KeyboardEvent, type ReactNode } from "react";
import { useAuthStore } from "@/stores/use-auth-store";
import { useCreationChat } from "@/pages/chat/chat-store";

export function CreationToolbar({ mode, busy, referencesOpen, onSettings, onUpload, onReferences, onPrompts, onAssets, modelPicker, onChat }: {
    mode: "image" | "video"; busy: boolean; referencesOpen: boolean;
    onSettings: () => void; onUpload: () => void; onReferences: () => void; onPrompts: () => void; onAssets: () => void;
    modelPicker?: ReactNode; onChat?: () => Promise<string | undefined>;
}) {
    return <div className="flex min-w-0 flex-wrap items-center gap-2" role="group" aria-label="创作工具">
        <CreationModeSwitch mode={mode} busy={busy} onChat={onChat} />
        {modelPicker}
        <Button label="创作设置" size="sm" variant="ghost" icon={<SlidersHorizontal className="size-3.5" />} onClick={onSettings} />
        <Dropdown trigger={["click"]} menu={{ items: [
            { key: "upload", label: "上传参考素材", icon: <Plus className="size-4" />, onClick: onUpload, disabled: busy },
            { key: "assets", label: "从素材库选择", icon: <FolderOpen className="size-4" />, onClick: onAssets, disabled: busy },
            { type: "divider" },
            { key: "prompts", label: "提示词库", icon: <BookOpen className="size-4" />, onClick: onPrompts },
        ] }}><button type="button" className="creation-tool-button" aria-label="添加素材或提示词"><Plus className="size-4" />添加</button></Dropdown>
        <button type="button" className="creation-tool-button" aria-pressed={referencesOpen} onClick={onReferences}><Paperclip className="size-3.5" />参考素材</button>
    </div>;
}

export type CreationModeOption = { value: string; label: string; icon?: LucideIcon };

export const CREATION_MODES: readonly CreationModeOption[] = [
    { value: "image", label: "图片", icon: ImagePlus },
    { value: "video", label: "视频", icon: Video },
    { value: "chat", label: "对话", icon: MessageSquare },
];

type CreationMode = "image" | "video" | "chat";

/**
 * 图片/视频/对话各自是独立页面（/create?mode=…），切换会重新挂载整页。
 * 这里记住上一页的选中项与轨道横坐标，新页面挂载时先画在旧位置再滑到新位置，
 * 视觉上就是一个框里的滑块在移动，而不是整块控件跳一下。
 */
let lastSwitchMemory: { mode: string; left: number } | null = null;

/** 一整条描边轨道，选中项是轨道内的一块滑块；只暴露 value / onChange，交互与图标都在内部。 */
export function CreationModeTrack({ value, options, onChange, disabled = false, busy = false, handoff = false }: {
    value: string; options: readonly CreationModeOption[]; onChange: (value: string) => void;
    disabled?: boolean; busy?: boolean; handoff?: boolean;
}) {
    const trackRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement | null>(null);
    const [bar, setBar] = useState<{ left: number; width: number } | null>(null);
    // 跨页面接力动画还在等第一帧时，不要被 ResizeObserver 直接拉到终点
    const handoffPendingRef = useRef(false);

    useLayoutEffect(() => {
        const track = trackRef.current;
        if (!track) return;
        const current = track.querySelector<HTMLButtonElement>('[role="radio"][aria-checked="true"]');
        if (!current) return;
        const trackRect = track.getBoundingClientRect();
        const rect = current.getBoundingClientRect();
        const target = { left: rect.left - trackRect.left - track.clientLeft, width: rect.width };
        const previous = lastSwitchMemory;
        lastSwitchMemory = { mode: value, left: trackRect.left };
        const previousButton = handoff && previous && previous.mode !== value
            ? track.querySelector<HTMLButtonElement>(`[role="radio"][data-mode-value="${previous.mode}"]`)
            : null;
        // 只有轨道位置基本一致时才做跨页面接力，否则（例如对话页输入框更窄）直接从目标位置开始。
        if (previousButton && Math.abs(previous!.left - trackRect.left) < 24) {
            const from = previousButton.getBoundingClientRect();
            setBar({ left: from.left - trackRect.left - track.clientLeft, width: from.width });
            handoffPendingRef.current = true;
            const timer = window.setTimeout(() => {
                handoffPendingRef.current = false;
                setBar(target);
            }, 30);
            return () => {
                window.clearTimeout(timer);
                handoffPendingRef.current = false;
            };
        }
        setBar(target);
    }, [handoff, value]);

    // 容器尺寸变化时重新量一次，避免滑块和文字错位
    useEffect(() => {
        const track = trackRef.current;
        if (!track) return;
        const observer = new ResizeObserver(() => {
            if (handoffPendingRef.current) return;
            const current = track.querySelector<HTMLButtonElement>('[role="radio"][aria-checked="true"]');
            if (!current) return;
            const trackRect = track.getBoundingClientRect();
            const rect = current.getBoundingClientRect();
            setBar({ left: rect.left - trackRect.left - track.clientLeft, width: rect.width });
        });
        observer.observe(track);
        return () => observer.disconnect();
    }, []);

    function handleKeyDown(event: KeyboardEvent<HTMLDivElement>) {
        const index = options.findIndex(item => item.value === value);
        if (index < 0) return;
        let next = index;
        if (event.key === "ArrowLeft" || event.key === "ArrowUp") next = (index - 1 + options.length) % options.length;
        else if (event.key === "ArrowRight" || event.key === "ArrowDown") next = (index + 1) % options.length;
        else if (event.key === "Home") next = 0;
        else if (event.key === "End") next = options.length - 1;
        else return;
        event.preventDefault();
        if (next === index) return;
        trackRef.current?.querySelector<HTMLButtonElement>(`[data-mode-value="${options[next].value}"]`)?.focus();
        onChange(options[next].value);
    }

    return (
        <div
            ref={trackRef}
            className="creation-mode-switch"
            role="radiogroup"
            aria-label="生成类型"
            aria-busy={busy || disabled || undefined}
            data-busy={busy || undefined}
            data-count={options.length}
            onKeyDown={handleKeyDown}
        >
            <span className="creation-mode-switch-bar" aria-hidden="true" style={bar ? { left: bar.left, width: bar.width } : { opacity: 0 }} />
            {options.map(item => {
                const active = item.value === value;
                const Icon = item.icon;
                return (
                    <button
                        key={item.value}
                        type="button"
                        role="radio"
                        aria-checked={active}
                        data-mode-value={item.value}
                        tabIndex={active ? 0 : -1}
                        disabled={disabled}
                        title={disabled && !busy ? "处理中，请稍候" : undefined}
                        className="creation-mode-switch-item"
                        onClick={() => { if (!active) onChange(item.value); }}
                    >
                        {Icon ? <Icon className="size-3.5" aria-hidden="true" /> : null}
                        <span>{item.label}</span>
                    </button>
                );
            })}
        </div>
    );
}

export function CreationModeSwitch({ mode, busy = false, onChat }: { mode: CreationMode; busy?: boolean; onChat?: () => Promise<string | undefined> }) {
    const navigate = useNavigate();
    const { message } = App.useApp();
    const [switching, setSwitching] = useState(false);

    const switchMode = useCallback(async (value: string) => {
        if (value === mode || switching) return;
        setSwitching(true);
        try {
            const id = value === "chat" ? await onChat?.() : undefined;
            const store = useCreationChat.getState();
            const threadId = id || (store.owner === useAuthStore.getState().user?.id ? store.activeId : "");
            navigate(`/create?mode=${value}${threadId ? `&thread=${encodeURIComponent(threadId)}` : ""}`);
        } catch (error) { message.error(error instanceof Error ? error.message : String(error)); }
        finally { setSwitching(false); }
    }, [message, mode, navigate, onChat, switching]);

    return <CreationModeTrack value={mode} options={CREATION_MODES} onChange={value => void switchMode(value)} disabled={busy || switching} busy={busy} handoff />;
}

import { useCreditEstimate } from "@/hooks/use-credit-estimate";
import { inferMediaScale, parseVideoResolution } from "@/lib/media-size";
import { useAuthStore } from "@/stores/use-auth-store";
import { modelOptionName, useEffectiveConfig } from "@/stores/use-config-store";

export function CreditEstimate({ mode }: { mode: "image" | "video" }) {
    const config = useEffectiveConfig();
    const user = useAuthStore((state) => state.user);
    const epoch = useAuthStore((state) => state.sessionEpoch);
    const model = mode === "image" ? config.imageModel || config.model : config.videoModel || config.model;
    const count = mode === "image" ? Math.max(1, Math.min(10, Number(config.count) || 1)) : 1;
    const estimate = useCreditEstimate(modelOptionName(model), mode, mode === "video" ? Number(config.videoSeconds) : 1, mode === "video" ? parseVideoResolution(config.vquality) : inferMediaScale(config.size), `${user?.id ?? "guest"}:${epoch}`, 0, mode === "video" ? config.videoRouteId : "");
    const min = (estimate.data?.minCredits ?? 0) * count;
    const max = (estimate.data?.maxCredits ?? 0) * count;
    const text = !estimate.hasModel ? "请选择模型" : estimate.loading ? "正在计算积分" : estimate.error || !estimate.data ? "暂无法估算积分" : `预计 ${min === max ? min : `${min}–${max}`} 积分`;
    return <span role="status" className="text-xs text-muted-foreground" title="实际费用以服务端结算为准">{text}</span>;
}

import { App, Button, Drawer } from "antd";

import { saveAs } from "file-saver";

import { imageLogStorage } from "@/lib/image-log-storage";
import { videoLogStorage } from "@/lib/video-log-storage";
import { resolveImageUrl } from "@/services/image-storage";
import { resolveMediaUrl } from "@/services/file-storage";
import { useAssetStore } from "@/stores/use-asset-store";

async function mergedHistory(owner: string, mode: "image" | "video", cloud: ReturnType<GenerationHistoryPager["snapshot"]>) {
    const store = mode === "image" ? imageLogStorage : videoLogStorage;
    const local = await store.list<RestoredLog>(owner).catch(() => [] as RestoredLog[]);
    const resolved = await Promise.all(local.map(async log => ({
        ...log,
        images: await Promise.all((log.images || []).map(async image => ({ ...image, dataUrl: await resolveImageUrl(image.storageKey, image.dataUrl) }))),
        video: log.video ? { ...log.video, url: await resolveMediaUrl(log.video.storageKey, log.video.url) } : undefined,
    })));
    return mergeGenerationHistory(resolved, cloud.logs, cloud.hiddenTaskIds);
}

// The active page keeps its original submission engine and result actions.
// The other media type is read-only until the user chooses to work with it.
export function useOtherCreationHistory(owner: string | undefined, epoch: number, mode: "image" | "video") {
    const [state, setState] = useState<{ owner?: string; epoch: number; logs: RestoredLog[]; more: boolean; error: string }>({ epoch, logs: [], more: false, error: "" });
    const [pager, setPager] = useState<GenerationHistoryPager>();
    const currentPager = useRef<GenerationHistoryPager | undefined>(undefined);
    useEffect(() => {
        if (!owner) return;
        const next = new GenerationHistoryPager(owner, mode);
        currentPager.current = next;
        setPager(next);
        setState({ owner, epoch, logs: [], more: false, error: "" });
        let active = true;
        let timer: ReturnType<typeof setTimeout> | undefined;
        const refresh = () => {
            let error = "";
            void next.refresh().catch(() => { error = "云端记录暂未加载，显示本地记录"; return next.snapshot(); }).then(async result => {
            const logs = await mergedHistory(owner, mode, result);
            if (active) {
                setState({ owner, epoch, logs, more: result.hasMore, error });
                clearTimeout(timer);
                if (result.logs.some(log => log.status === "pending")) timer = setTimeout(refresh, 5000);
            }
        }).catch(() => { if (active) setState(current => ({ ...current, owner, epoch, error: "另一种创作记录暂未加载" })); }); };
        refresh();
        window.addEventListener("focus", refresh);
        return () => { active = false; currentPager.current = undefined; clearTimeout(timer); window.removeEventListener("focus", refresh); };
    }, [owner, epoch, mode]);
    const current = state.owner === owner && state.epoch === epoch;
    const loadMore = async () => {
        if (!pager || !owner) return;
        try {
            const result = await pager.loadMore();
            const logs = await mergedHistory(owner, mode, result);
            if (currentPager.current !== pager) return;
            setState({ owner, epoch, logs, more: result.hasMore, error: "" });
        } catch (error) {
            if (currentPager.current === pager) setState(value => ({ ...value, error: "加载更早记录失败，请重试" }));
            throw error;
        }
    };
    return { logs: current ? state.logs : [], more: current && state.more, error: current ? state.error : "", loadMore };
}

import { useEffect, useState } from "react";
import { estimatePromptOptimization } from "@/services/api/prompt-optimizer";
import { useEffectiveConfig } from "@/stores/use-config-store";
import { useAuthStore } from "@/stores/use-auth-store";

export function PromptOptimizationEstimate({ mode }: { mode: "image" | "video" }) {
    const config = useEffectiveConfig();
    const user = useAuthStore(state => state.user);
    const epoch = useAuthStore(state => state.sessionEpoch);
    const model = (mode === "image" ? config.imageModel : config.videoModel) || config.model;
    const key = JSON.stringify([user?.id, epoch, mode, model]);
    const [quote, setQuote] = useState<{ key: string; credits?: number; error?: string }>();
    useEffect(() => {
        if (!user || !model) return;
        const controller = new AbortController();
        void estimatePromptOptimization(model, mode, controller.signal)
            .then(result => { if (!controller.signal.aborted) setQuote({ key, credits: result.credits }); })
            .catch(error => { if (!controller.signal.aborted) setQuote({ key, error: error instanceof Error ? error.message : "报价暂不可用" }); });
        return () => controller.abort();
    }, [key, model, mode]);
    const current = quote?.key === key ? quote : undefined;
    return <span className="text-xs text-muted-foreground" title={current?.error || "优化提示词单独计费，最终以提交时的价格为准"}>{!user || !model ? "提示词优化单独计费" : !current ? "正在查询优化费用" : current.credits == null ? "优化报价暂不可用" : `优化预计 ${current.credits} 积分/次`}</span>;
}

import { App } from "antd";
import { useEffect, useState } from "react";
import { useBlocker } from "react-router-dom";

// Keep the workbench mounted until selected media has finished uploading.
export function useReferenceTransfer() {
    const { message } = App.useApp();
    const [pending, setPending] = useState(0);
    const blocker = useBlocker(({ currentLocation, nextLocation }) => pending > 0 && currentLocation.pathname !== nextLocation.pathname);
    useEffect(() => {
        if (blocker.state !== "blocked") return;
        message.warning("参考素材正在处理，请等待完成后再切换页面");
        blocker.reset();
    }, [blocker, message]);

    const run = async <T,>(work: () => Promise<T>): Promise<T> => {
        setPending((value) => value + 1);
        try { return await work(); }
        finally { setPending((value) => value - 1); }
    };
    return { run, isTransferring: pending > 0 };
}

import { useEffect, useState } from "react";

const PAGE_SIZE = 30;

// Render recent records first so long histories do not mount every media item.
export function useVisibleRecords<T extends { id: string }>(logs: T[], owner: string | undefined, recordId: string | null) {
    const [limit, setLimit] = useState(PAGE_SIZE);
    useEffect(() => { setLimit(PAGE_SIZE); }, [owner]);
    useEffect(() => {
        if (!recordId) return;
        const index = logs.findIndex((item) => item.id === recordId);
        if (index >= 0) setLimit((current) => Math.max(current, index + 1));
    }, [logs, recordId]);

    const showEarlier = () => {
        const anchor = logs[Math.min(limit, logs.length) - 1]?.id;
        const element = anchor ? document.getElementById(`creation-record-${anchor}`) : null;
        const top = element?.getBoundingClientRect().top;
        let scroller = element?.parentElement ?? null;
        while (scroller && !/(auto|scroll)/.test(getComputedStyle(scroller).overflowY)) scroller = scroller.parentElement;
        setLimit((current) => current + PAGE_SIZE);
        if (element && scroller && top != null) requestAnimationFrame(() => requestAnimationFrame(() => {
            if (element.isConnected) scroller.scrollTop += element.getBoundingClientRect().top - top;
        }));
    };
    return { records: logs.slice(0, limit).reverse(), hasEarlier: logs.length > limit, showEarlier };
}

/**
 * 首页「创作工具」四个入口的自绘图标。
 *
 * 不用 lucide 的通用线性图标：这里每个入口需要一眼分辨的「专属比喻」，
 * 同时统一 24 网格 / 1.5 描边 / 白→品牌色的渐变描边语言，
 * 保证四张卡片摆在一起像一套，而不是四个搜来的图标。
 *
 * 渐变必须用 userSpaceOnUse：横向直线（如一行文字）的包围盒高度为 0，
 * 用默认的 objectBoundingBox 会让渐变退化，Chrome 直接不画这条线。
 *
 * 渐变 id 唯一且每个图标只渲染一次，不需要 useId。
 */

type IconProps = { className?: string };

const gradient = (id: string, to: string) => (
    <defs>
        <linearGradient id={id} gradientUnits="userSpaceOnUse" x1="2" y1="1.5" x2="22" y2="22.5">
            <stop offset="0" stopColor="#FFFFFF" stopOpacity="0.96" />
            <stop offset="1" stopColor={to} stopOpacity="0.92" />
        </linearGradient>
    </defs>
);

import { useEffect, useState } from "react";
import { LoaderCircle } from "lucide-react";
import { useTranslation } from "react-i18next";

import { formatDuration } from "@/lib/image-utils";
import { cn } from "@/lib/utils";

export function ImageGenerationPending({ className, label, compact = false }: { className?: string; label?: string; compact?: boolean }) {
    const { t } = useTranslation();
    const [tick, setTick] = useState(0);
    const pendingMessages = t("generation.pending", { returnObjects: true }) as string[];

    useEffect(() => {
        const timer = window.setInterval(() => setTick((value) => value + 1), 1000);
        return () => window.clearInterval(timer);
    }, []);

    const index = Math.floor(tick / 2) % pendingMessages.length;
    const progress = Math.min(98, 10 + (1 - Math.exp(-tick / 28)) * 88);

    return (
        <div className={cn("relative overflow-hidden bg-muted dark:bg-white/10", compact ? "min-h-24" : "aspect-[4/3]", className)}>
            <div
                className="absolute inset-0 opacity-60"
                style={{
                    backgroundImage: "radial-gradient(circle, rgba(120,113,108,0.35) 1.4px, transparent 1.6px)",
                    backgroundSize: "16px 16px",
                    maskImage: "radial-gradient(ellipse at 38% 68%, black 0%, black 28%, transparent 60%)",
                }}
            />
            <div className="absolute left-4 top-4 flex items-center gap-2 text-[15px] font-medium text-muted-foreground dark:text-foreground/80">
                <LoaderCircle className="size-4 animate-spin" />
                <span>{label || pendingMessages[index]}</span>
            </div>
            <div className="absolute bottom-4 left-4 right-4">
                <div className="mb-2 flex items-center justify-between text-xs text-muted-foreground">
                    <span>{formatDuration(tick * 1000)}</span>
                    <span>{Math.floor(progress)}%</span>
                </div>
                <div className="h-1.5 rounded-full bg-muted dark:bg-white/12">
                    <div className="h-full rounded-full bg-foreground dark:bg-muted" style={{ width: `${progress}%` }} />
                </div>
            </div>
        </div>
    );
}

import { type ReactNode, useState } from "react";
import { ConfigProvider, Switch } from "antd";
import { useTranslation } from "react-i18next";

import i18n from "@/i18n";
import { type CanvasTheme } from "@/lib/canvas-theme";
import { computeMediaSize, inferMediaRatio, inferMediaScale, mediaRatioOptions, mediaScaleOptions, readMediaDimensions } from "@/lib/media-size";
import { modelOptionName, useConfigStore, type AiConfig } from "@/stores/use-config-store";

const qualityOptions = [
    { value: "auto", labelKey: "auto" },
    { value: "low", labelKey: "low" },
    { value: "medium", labelKey: "medium" },
    { value: "high", labelKey: "high" },
    { value: "xhigh", labelKey: "xhigh" },
    { value: "max", labelKey: "max" },
];
const DIMENSION_STEP = 16;

export const imageQualityOptions = qualityOptions.map((item) => ({ value: item.value, get label() { return i18n.t(`settingsPanels.common.${item.labelKey}`); } }));
export const imageAspectOptions = mediaRatioOptions.map((item) => ({ value: item.value, label: item.value === "auto" ? i18n.t("settingsPanels.common.auto") : item.value }));
export const imageScaleOptions = mediaScaleOptions.map((value) => ({ value, label: value === "auto" ? i18n.t("settingsPanels.common.auto") : value }));

type ImageSettingsPanelProps = {
    config: AiConfig;
    onConfigChange: (key: "quality" | "size" | "count" | "background", value: string) => void;
    theme: CanvasTheme;
    showTitle?: boolean;
    className?: string;
    maxCount?: number;
    quickCount?: number;
};

export function ImageSettingsPanel({ config, onConfigChange, theme, showTitle = true, className = "w-[320px] space-y-4 rounded-2xl px-1 py-0.5", maxCount = 15, quickCount = 10 }: ImageSettingsPanelProps) {
    const { t } = useTranslation();
    const [snapDimensionToStep, setSnapDimensionToStep] = useState(true);
    const quality = config.quality || "auto";
    const count = Math.max(1, Math.min(maxCount, Math.floor(Math.abs(Number(config.count)) || 1)));
    const activeSize = config.size || "auto";
    const transparentBackground = config.background === "transparent";
    const selectedScale = inferMediaScale(activeSize);
    const selectedRatio = inferMediaRatio(activeSize);
    const model = useConfigStore((state) => state.serverModels.find((item) => item.id === modelOptionName(config.model || config.imageModel)));
    const allowedScales = (model?.metadata?.imageCapabilities as { resolutions?: string[] } | undefined)?.resolutions?.map((value) => value.toLowerCase());
    const dimensions = readMediaDimensions(activeSize, selectedScale, selectedRatio);
    const applySize = (scale: string, ratio: string) => onConfigChange("size", computeMediaSize(scale, ratio));
    const selectScale = (scale: string) => applySize(scale, selectedRatio === "auto" ? "1:1" : selectedRatio);
    const selectRatio = (ratio: string) => applySize(selectedScale, ratio);
    const updateDimension = (key: "width" | "height", value: number | null) => {
        const next = Math.max(1, Math.floor(value || dimensions[key] || 1024));
        const width = key === "width" ? next : dimensions.width;
        const height = key === "height" ? next : dimensions.height;
        onConfigChange("size", `${alignDimension(width, snapDimensionToStep)}x${alignDimension(height, snapDimensionToStep)}`);
    };

    return (
        <ImageSettingsTheme theme={theme}>
            <div
                className={className}
                style={{ color: theme.node.text }}
                onMouseDown={(event) => {
                    event.stopPropagation();
                    if (event.target instanceof HTMLInputElement) return;
                    if (document.activeElement instanceof HTMLInputElement && event.currentTarget.contains(document.activeElement)) document.activeElement.blur();
                }}
            >
                {showTitle ? <div className="text-lg font-semibold">{t("settingsPanels.image.title")}</div> : null}
                <div className="space-y-2.5">
                    <SettingTitle color={theme.node.muted}>{t("settingsPanels.image.quality")}</SettingTitle>
                    <div className="grid grid-cols-3 gap-2.5">
                        {qualityOptions.map((item) => (
                            <OptionPill key={item.value} selected={quality === item.value} theme={theme} onClick={() => onConfigChange("quality", item.value)}>
                                {t(`settingsPanels.common.${item.labelKey}`)}
                            </OptionPill>
                        ))}
                    </div>
                </div>
                <div className="space-y-2.5">
                    <div className="flex items-center justify-between gap-3">
                        <SettingTitle color={theme.node.muted}>{t("settingsPanels.image.size")}</SettingTitle>
                        <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                            <span className="text-xs font-medium" style={{ color: theme.node.muted }}>
                                {t("settingsPanels.image.align16")}
                            </span>
                            <span title={t("settingsPanels.image.align16Hint")} onMouseDown={(event) => event.stopPropagation()}>
                                <Switch size="small" checked={snapDimensionToStep} onChange={setSnapDimensionToStep} />
                            </span>
                        </div>
                    </div>
                    <div className="grid grid-cols-[1fr_auto_1fr] items-center gap-2.5">
                        <DimensionInput prefix="W" value={dimensions.width} disabled={selectedRatio === "auto"} theme={theme} alignToStep={snapDimensionToStep} onChange={(value) => updateDimension("width", value)} />
                        <span className="text-lg opacity-45">↔</span>
                        <DimensionInput prefix="H" value={dimensions.height} disabled={selectedRatio === "auto"} theme={theme} alignToStep={snapDimensionToStep} onChange={(value) => updateDimension("height", value)} />
                    </div>
                </div>
                <div className="space-y-2.5">
                    <SettingTitle color={theme.node.muted}>{t("settingsPanels.image.resolution")}</SettingTitle>
                    <div className="grid grid-cols-4 gap-2.5">
                        {mediaScaleOptions.filter((value) => value === 'auto' || !allowedScales?.length || allowedScales.includes(value)).map((value) => (
                            <OptionPill key={value} selected={selectedScale === value} theme={theme} onClick={() => selectScale(value)}>
                                {value === "auto" ? t("settingsPanels.common.auto") : value}
                            </OptionPill>
                        ))}
                    </div>
                </div>
                <div className="space-y-2.5">
                    <SettingTitle color={theme.node.muted}>{t("settingsPanels.image.aspectRatio")}</SettingTitle>
                    <div className="grid grid-cols-4 gap-2.5">
                        {mediaRatioOptions.map((item) => (
                            <button
                                key={item.value}
                                type="button"
                                className="flex h-[72px] cursor-pointer flex-col items-center justify-center gap-1.5 rounded-xl border bg-transparent text-sm transition hover:opacity-80"
                                style={{ borderColor: selectedRatio === item.value ? theme.node.text : theme.node.stroke, background: "transparent", color: theme.node.text }}
                                onMouseDown={(event) => event.stopPropagation()}
                                onClick={() => selectRatio(item.value)}
                            >
                                <AspectIcon width={item.width} height={item.height} color={theme.node.text} />
                                <span>{item.value === "auto" ? t("settingsPanels.common.auto") : item.value}</span>
                            </button>
                        ))}
                    </div>
                </div>
                <div className="flex items-center justify-between gap-3">
                    <div className="space-y-0.5">
                        <SettingTitle color={theme.node.muted}>{t("settingsPanels.image.transparent")}</SettingTitle>
                        <div className="text-xs" style={{ color: theme.node.muted, opacity: 0.75 }}>
                            {t("settingsPanels.image.transparentHint")}
                        </div>
                    </div>
                    <span onMouseDown={(event) => event.stopPropagation()}>
                        <Switch size="small" checked={transparentBackground} onChange={(checked) => onConfigChange("background", checked ? "transparent" : "")} />
                    </span>
                </div>
                <div className="space-y-2.5">
                    <SettingTitle color={theme.node.muted}>{t("settingsPanels.image.count")}</SettingTitle>
                    <div className="grid grid-cols-4 gap-2.5">
                        {Array.from({ length: quickCount }, (_, index) => index + 1).map((value) => (
                            <OptionPill key={value} selected={count === value} theme={theme} onClick={() => onConfigChange("count", String(value))}>
                                {t("settingsPanels.image.images", { count: value })}
                            </OptionPill>
                        ))}
                        <CountInput value={count} max={maxCount} theme={theme} onChange={(value) => onConfigChange("count", String(value || 1))} />
                    </div>
                </div>
            </div>
        </ImageSettingsTheme>
    );
}

export function ImageSettingsTheme({ theme, children }: { theme: CanvasTheme; children: ReactNode }) {
    return (
        <ConfigProvider
            theme={{
                token: { colorBgContainer: theme.toolbar.panel, colorBgElevated: theme.toolbar.panel, colorBorder: theme.node.stroke, colorPrimary: theme.node.activeStroke, colorText: theme.node.text, colorTextLightSolid: theme.node.panel },
                components: {
                    Button: { defaultBg: theme.toolbar.panel, defaultBorderColor: theme.node.stroke, defaultColor: theme.node.text },
                    Slider: { railBg: theme.node.stroke, railHoverBg: theme.node.stroke, trackBg: theme.node.activeStroke, handleColor: theme.node.text, handleActiveColor: theme.node.text },
                },
            }}
        >
            {children}
        </ConfigProvider>
    );
}

export function imageQualityLabel(value: string) {
    return qualityOptions.some((item) => item.value === value) ? i18n.t(`settingsPanels.common.${value}`) : value;
}

export function imageSizeLabel(size: string) {
    const scale = inferMediaScale(size);
    const ratio = inferMediaRatio(size);
    if (ratio === "auto" || size === "auto") return i18n.t("settingsPanels.common.auto");
    if (scale === "auto") return ratio;
    return `${scale} · ${ratio}`;
}

function OptionPill({ selected, theme, onClick, children }: { selected: boolean; theme: CanvasTheme; onClick: () => void; children: ReactNode }) {
    return (
        <button
            type="button"
            className="h-9 cursor-pointer rounded-full border px-2 text-sm transition hover:opacity-80"
            style={{ background: "transparent", borderColor: selected ? theme.node.text : theme.node.stroke, color: theme.node.text }}
            onMouseDown={(event) => event.stopPropagation()}
            onClick={onClick}
        >
            {children}
        </button>
    );
}

function DimensionInput({ prefix, value, disabled, theme, alignToStep, onChange }: { prefix: string; value: number; disabled: boolean; theme: CanvasTheme; alignToStep: boolean; onChange: (value: number | null) => void }) {
    const commit = (input: HTMLInputElement) => {
        const next = alignDimension(Math.max(1, Math.floor(Number(input.value) || value || 1024)), alignToStep);
        input.value = String(next);
        onChange(next);
    };

    return (
        <label className="flex h-9 overflow-hidden rounded-xl text-sm" style={{ background: theme.node.fill, color: theme.node.text, opacity: disabled ? 0.55 : 1 }}>
            <span className="grid w-9 place-items-center" style={{ color: theme.node.muted }}>
                {prefix}
            </span>
            <input
                type="number"
                min={1}
                disabled={disabled}
                className="min-w-0 flex-1 bg-transparent px-2 outline-none [appearance:textfield] [&::-webkit-inner-spin-button]:appearance-none [&::-webkit-outer-spin-button]:appearance-none"
                defaultValue={value || ""}
                key={`${prefix}-${value}`}
                onBlur={(event) => commit(event.currentTarget)}
                onKeyDown={(event) => {
                    if (event.key === "Enter") event.currentTarget.blur();
                }}
                onMouseDown={(event) => event.stopPropagation()}
            />
        </label>
    );
}

function CountInput({ value, max, theme, onChange }: { value: number; max: number; theme: CanvasTheme; onChange: (value: number | null) => void }) {
    return (
        <label className="col-span-2 flex h-9 overflow-hidden rounded-full border text-sm" style={{ borderColor: theme.node.stroke, color: theme.node.text }}>
            <input
                type="number"
                min={1}
                max={max}
                className="min-w-0 flex-1 bg-transparent px-3 text-center outline-none [appearance:textfield] [&::-webkit-inner-spin-button]:appearance-none [&::-webkit-outer-spin-button]:appearance-none"
                style={{ color: theme.node.text, WebkitTextFillColor: theme.node.text }}
                value={value || ""}
                onChange={(event) => onChange(Number(event.target.value) || null)}
                onMouseDown={(event) => event.stopPropagation()}
            />
        </label>
    );
}

function AspectIcon({ width, height, color }: { width: number; height: number; color: string }) {
    if (!width || !height) return null;
    const ratio = width / height;
    const boxWidth = ratio >= 1 ? 24 : Math.max(10, 24 * ratio);
    const boxHeight = ratio >= 1 ? Math.max(10, 24 / ratio) : 24;
    return (
        <span className="grid h-7 w-9 place-items-center">
            <span className="border-2" style={{ width: boxWidth, height: boxHeight, borderColor: color }} />
        </span>
    );
}

function SettingTitle({ children, color }: { children: string; color: string }) {
    return (
        <div className="text-xs font-medium" style={{ color }}>
            {children}
        </div>
    );
}

function alignDimension(value: number, enabled: boolean) {
    return enabled ? Math.ceil(value / DIMENSION_STEP) * DIMENSION_STEP : value;
}

import { useEffect, useRef, useState } from "react";
import { App, Avatar } from "antd";
import dayjs from "dayjs";
import { ChevronDown, CreditCard, Crown, HardDrive, Languages, LogOut, ReceiptText, Settings2, UserRound, Wallet } from "lucide-react";
import { useTranslation } from "react-i18next";
import { Link, useNavigate } from "react-router-dom";

import { changeAppLocale, listLocales, type AppLocale } from "@/i18n";
import { UserStatusActions } from "@/components/layout/user-status-actions";
import { cn } from "@/lib/utils";
import { useAuthStore } from "@/stores/use-auth-store";
import { formatGenerationDiscount } from "@/lib/membership";
import { useConfigStore } from "@/stores/use-config-store";
import { useAuthDialogStore } from "@/stores/use-auth-dialog-store";

function formatStorage(bytes: number) {
    if (bytes >= 1024 ** 3) return `${(bytes / 1024 ** 3).toFixed(bytes % (1024 ** 3) === 0 ? 0 : 1)} GB`;
    if (bytes >= 1024 ** 2) return `${Math.round(bytes / 1024 ** 2)} MB`;
    return `${Math.round(bytes / 1024)} KB`;
}

export function UserAccountMenu() {
    const { t, i18n } = useTranslation();
    const { message, notification } = App.useApp();
    const navigate = useNavigate();
    const user = useAuthStore((state) => state.user);
    const wallet = useAuthStore((state) => state.wallet);
    const refreshWallet = useAuthStore((state) => state.refreshWallet);
    const logout = useAuthStore((state) => state.logout);
    const openConfigDialog = useConfigStore((state) => state.openConfigDialog);
    const openAuthDialog = useAuthDialogStore((state) => state.open);
    const wrapperRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
    const [open, setOpen] = useState(false);
    const warnedOwner = useRef<string | null>(null);

    useEffect(() => {
        const storage = wallet?.storage;
        if (!user || !storage?.limitBytes || storage.usedBytes / storage.limitBytes < 0.9) {
            warnedOwner.current = null;
            notification.destroy("storage-low");
            return;
        }
        if (warnedOwner.current === user.id) return;
        warnedOwner.current = user.id;
        notification.warning({
            key: "storage-low",
            message: t("account.storageNearlyFull"),
            // 通知浮层挂在 antd App 子树（RouterProvider 之外），不能用 Link，否则 NavigationContext 为 null 导致整页崩溃。
            description: <div>{t("account.storageNearlyFullDescription")} <a href="/assets?tab=history" onClick={() => notification.destroy("storage-low")} className="text-primary underline">{t("account.cleanStorage")}</a></div>,
            duration: 0,
        });
    }, [notification, t, user?.id, wallet?.storage?.usedBytes, wallet?.storage?.limitBytes]);

    useEffect(() => {
        if (!open) return;
        void refreshWallet().catch(() => undefined);
        const closeOutside = (event: PointerEvent) => {
            if (!wrapperRef.current?.contains(event.target as Node)) setOpen(false);
        };
        const closeEscape = (event: KeyboardEvent) => {
            if (event.key === "Escape") setOpen(false);
        };
        document.addEventListener("pointerdown", closeOutside);
        document.addEventListener("keydown", closeEscape);
        return () => {
            document.removeEventListener("pointerdown", closeOutside);
            document.removeEventListener("keydown", closeEscape);
        };
    }, [open, refreshWallet]);

    if (!user) {
        return (
            <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                <UserStatusActions showConfig={false} />
                {/* 登录按钮：品牌青柠胶囊 + 深墨字，点击浮出登录弹窗 */}
                <button
                    type="button"
                    onClick={() => openAuthDialog("login", { redirect: "/" })}
                    className="inline-flex h-8 shrink-0 items-center gap-2 whitespace-nowrap rounded-[8px] !bg-[var(--brand)] px-3 text-[13px] font-medium !text-[var(--brand-ink)] transition-colors hover:!bg-[var(--accent-hover)]"
                    aria-label={t("auth.login")}
                >
                    {t("auth.login")}
                </button>
            </div>
        );
    }

    const planName = wallet?.member ? wallet.tierName || wallet.planName || t("account.member") : t("account.freePlan");
    const memberUntil = wallet?.memberUntil ? dayjs(wallet.memberUntil).format("YYYY.MM.DD") : null;
    const usedBytes = wallet?.storage?.usedBytes ?? 0;
    const limitBytes = wallet?.storage?.limitBytes ?? 0;
    const storagePercent = limitBytes ? Math.min(100, (usedBytes / limitBytes) * 100) : 0;
    const locale = i18n.resolvedLanguage as AppLocale;
    const menuLocales = listLocales();
    const localeIndex = Math.max(0, menuLocales.findIndex((item) => item.code === locale));
    const currentLocale = menuLocales[localeIndex];
    const nextLocale = menuLocales[(localeIndex + 1) % menuLocales.length];
    const close = () => setOpen(false);

    return (
        <div ref={wrapperRef} className="relative flex items-center gap-2">
            <Link to="/account?tab=membership" title={wallet?.member ? `${planName} · 生成${formatGenerationDiscount(wallet.generationDiscount)}` : "查看会员权益"}
                className={cn("inline-flex h-8 max-w-[76px] shrink-0 items-center gap-1.5 rounded-full border px-2.5 text-xs transition hover:bg-accent sm:max-w-[144px]", wallet?.member ? "border-primary/30 bg-brand-soft !text-foreground" : "border-border !text-muted-foreground")}>
                <Crown className="hidden size-3.5 shrink-0 sm:block" />
                <span className="truncate">{wallet?.member && wallet.tierLevel ? `LV.${wallet.tierLevel} ` : ""}{wallet ? planName : "加载中"}</span>
            </Link>
            <Link to="/account" className="hidden h-8 shrink-0 items-center gap-1.5 whitespace-nowrap rounded-full border border-border px-3 text-xs !text-foreground transition hover:bg-muted sm:inline-flex">
                <Wallet className="size-3.5 shrink-0 text-muted-foreground" />
                <span className="font-semibold tabular-nums">{wallet?.availableCredits ?? wallet?.balance ?? 0}</span>
                <span className="whitespace-nowrap text-muted-foreground">{t("account.credits")}</span>
            </Link>
            <button type="button" className="inline-flex shrink-0 items-center gap-1 rounded-full p-0.5 transition hover:bg-muted" onClick={() => setOpen((value) => !value)} aria-expanded={open} aria-label={t("account.title")}>
                <Avatar size={30} className="!bg-foreground text-xs !text-white dark:!bg-muted dark:!text-foreground">
                    {(user.displayName || user.email).slice(0, 1).toUpperCase()}
                </Avatar>
                <ChevronDown className={cn("size-3.5 text-muted-foreground transition-transform", open && "rotate-180")} />
            </button>

            {open ? (
                <div className="absolute right-0 top-full z-[80] mt-2 w-[344px] max-w-[calc(100vw-24px)] overflow-hidden rounded-xl border border-border bg-popover text-popover-foreground shadow-2xl">
                    <div className="flex items-start gap-3 border-b border-border px-4 py-4">
                        <Avatar size={38} className="!bg-foreground text-sm !text-white dark:!bg-muted dark:!text-foreground">
                            {(user.displayName || user.email).slice(0, 1).toUpperCase()}
                        </Avatar>
                        <div className="min-w-0 flex-1">
                            <div className="truncate text-sm font-semibold text-foreground">{user.displayName || user.email}</div>
                            <div className="mt-0.5 truncate text-[11px] text-muted-foreground">{user.email}</div>
                        </div>
                        <span className="rounded-full border border-border px-2 py-1 text-[10px] text-muted-foreground">{planName}</span>
                    </div>

                    <div className="space-y-2 p-3">
                        <div className="rounded-lg border border-border bg-muted/40 p-3">
                            <div className="flex items-center justify-between gap-3 text-[11px]">
                                <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 text-muted-foreground"><CreditCard className="size-3.5" />{t("account.currentSubscription")}</span>
                                <span className="font-medium text-foreground">{planName}</span>
                            </div>
                            <div className="mt-1.5 text-[10px] text-muted-foreground">
                                {wallet?.member && memberUntil ? t("account.memberUntil", { date: memberUntil }) : t("account.freePlanHint")}
                            </div>
                            {wallet?.member && <div className="mt-1.5 text-xs text-foreground">生成积分 · {formatGenerationDiscount(wallet.generationDiscount)}</div>}
                            <div className="mt-3 flex gap-2">
                                <Link to="/account?tab=membership" onClick={close} className="inline-flex h-7 flex-1 items-center justify-center rounded-md bg-foreground text-[11px] font-medium text-background transition hover:opacity-85">
                                    查看会员权益
                                </Link>
                                <Link to="/account?tab=orders" onClick={close} className="inline-flex h-7 flex-1 items-center justify-center rounded-md border border-border text-[11px] text-foreground transition hover:bg-muted">
                                    {t("account.orders")}
                                </Link>
                            </div>
                        </div>

                        <div className="rounded-lg border border-border px-3 py-2.5">
                            <div className="flex items-center justify-between gap-3 text-[11px]">
                                <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 text-muted-foreground"><HardDrive className="size-3.5" />{t("account.storageSpace")}</span>
                                <span className="tabular-nums text-muted-foreground">{formatStorage(usedBytes)} / {formatStorage(limitBytes)}</span>
                            </div>
                            <div className="mt-2 h-1 overflow-hidden rounded-full bg-muted">
                                <span className="block h-full rounded-full bg-brand transition-[width]" style={{ width: `${storagePercent}%` }} />
                            </div>
                            {storagePercent >= 90 ? <p className="mt-2 text-xs text-amber-500">{t("account.storageNearlyFull")}</p> : null}
                            <div className="mt-2 flex items-center justify-between gap-2">
                                <Link to="/assets" onClick={close} className="inline-flex items-center gap-1 text-[10px] text-muted-foreground transition hover:text-foreground">
                                    {t("account.manageAssets")} <ChevronDown className="size-3 -rotate-90" />
                                </Link>
                                <Link to="/assets?tab=history" onClick={close} className="inline-flex items-center gap-1 text-[10px] text-muted-foreground transition hover:text-foreground">
                                    {t("assets.tabHistory")} <ChevronDown className="size-3 -rotate-90" />
                                </Link>
                            </div>
                        </div>

                        <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-1">
                            <Link to="/account" onClick={close} className="flex items-center gap-2 rounded-md px-2.5 py-2 text-[11px] text-foreground transition hover:bg-muted">
                                <UserRound className="size-3.5 text-muted-foreground" />{t("account.title")}
                            </Link>
                            <Link to="/account?tab=ledger" onClick={close} className="flex items-center gap-2 rounded-md px-2.5 py-2 text-[11px] text-foreground transition hover:bg-muted">
                                <ReceiptText className="size-3.5 text-muted-foreground" />{t("account.ledger")}
                            </Link>
                        </div>

                        <div className="border-t border-border pt-1">
                            <button type="button" onClick={() => void changeAppLocale(nextLocale.code)} className="flex w-full items-center gap-2 rounded-md px-2.5 py-2 text-left text-[11px] text-muted-foreground transition hover:bg-muted hover:text-foreground">
                                <Languages className="size-3.5" />
                                <span>{t("account.interfaceLanguage")}</span>
                                <span className="ml-auto text-foreground">{currentLocale?.label ?? locale}</span>
                            </button>
                            <button type="button" onClick={() => { close(); openConfigDialog(false); }} className="flex w-full items-center gap-2 rounded-md px-2.5 py-2 text-left text-[11px] text-muted-foreground transition hover:bg-muted hover:text-foreground">
                                <Settings2 className="size-3.5" />
                                <span>{t("account.preferences")}</span>
                            </button>
                        </div>

                        <button type="button" onClick={() => { close(); void logout().then(() => navigate("/")).catch((error) => message.error(error instanceof Error ? error.message : "退出失败，请重试")); }} className="flex w-full items-center gap-2 rounded-md px-2.5 py-2 text-left text-[11px] text-red-500 transition hover:bg-red-500/10">
                            <LogOut className="size-3.5" />
                            <span>{t("auth.logout")}</span>
                        </button>
                    </div>
                </div>
            ) : null}
        </div>
    );
}

import { useEffect } from "react";
import { useLocation } from "react-router-dom";

import { trackPageview } from "@/lib/analytics";

// Observe SPA route changes and report page views; trackPageview is a no-op when analytics is not configured.
export function AnalyticsTracker() {
    const location = useLocation();

    useEffect(() => {
        trackPageview(`${location.pathname}${location.search}`);
    }, [location.pathname, location.search]);

    return null;
}
