import { App, Button, Form, Input, Modal, Radio, Select, Switch } from "antd";
import { useTranslation } from "react-i18next";

import { ModelPicker } from "@/components/model-picker";
import { audioFormatOptions, audioVoiceOptions, normalizeAudioSpeedValue } from "@/lib/audio-generation";
import { computeMediaSize, computeVideoSize, inferMediaRatio, inferMediaScale, inferVideoRatio, mediaScaleOptions, parseVideoResolution, videoResolutionOptionsFromMap } from "@/lib/media-size";
import { modelOptionName, useConfigStore, type ModelCapability } from "@/stores/use-config-store";

type ModelGroup = {
    capability: ModelCapability;
    modelKey: "imageModel" | "videoModel" | "textModel" | "audioModel";
    labelKey: string;
};

const modelGroups: ModelGroup[] = [
    { capability: "image", modelKey: "imageModel", labelKey: "config.preferences.defaultImageModel" },
    { capability: "video", modelKey: "videoModel", labelKey: "config.preferences.defaultVideoModel" },
    { capability: "text", modelKey: "textModel", labelKey: "config.preferences.defaultTextModel" },
    { capability: "audio", modelKey: "audioModel", labelKey: "config.preferences.defaultAudioModel" },
];

export function AppConfigPanel({ showDoneButton = false }: { showDoneButton?: boolean }) {
    const { message } = App.useApp();
    const { t } = useTranslation();
    const config = useConfigStore((state) => state.config);
    const serverModels = useConfigStore((state) => state.serverModels);
    const updateConfig = useConfigStore((state) => state.updateConfig);
    const shouldPromptContinue = useConfigStore((state) => state.shouldPromptContinue);
    const setConfigDialogOpen = useConfigStore((state) => state.setConfigDialogOpen);
    const clearPromptContinue = useConfigStore((state) => state.clearPromptContinue);
    const imageResolutionOptions = mediaScaleOptions.map((value) => ({ value, label: value === "auto" ? t("settingsPanels.common.auto") : value.toUpperCase() }));
    const selectedVideoModel = serverModels.find((model) => model.id === modelOptionName(config.videoModel) && model.capability === "video");
    const videoResolutionOptions = videoResolutionOptionsFromMap(selectedVideoModel?.resolutionMultipliers);

    const finishConfig = () => {
        setConfigDialogOpen(false);
        message.success(t(shouldPromptContinue ? "config.savedContinue" : "config.saved"));
        clearPromptContinue();
    };

    return (
        <>
            <Form layout="vertical" requiredMark={false}>
                <div className="mb-2 text-sm font-semibold">{t("config.preferences.defaultModels")}</div>
                <div className="mb-4 grid gap-4 md:grid-cols-2 xl:grid-cols-4">
                    {modelGroups.map((group) => (
                        <Form.Item key={group.modelKey} label={t(group.labelKey)} className="mb-0">
                            <ModelPicker config={config} value={config[group.modelKey]} onChange={(model) => updateConfig(group.modelKey, model)} capability={group.capability} fullWidth />
                        </Form.Item>
                    ))}
                </div>
                <div className="mb-2 text-sm font-semibold">{t("config.preferences.generation")}</div>
                <div className="grid gap-4 md:grid-cols-4">
                    <Form.Item label={t("config.preferences.canvasImageCount")} extra={t("config.preferences.canvasImageCountDescription")} className="mb-4">
                        <Input
                            type="number"
                            min={1}
                            max={15}
                            value={config.canvasImageCount}
                            onChange={(event) => updateConfig("canvasImageCount", event.target.value)}
                            onBlur={(event) => updateConfig("canvasImageCount", normalizeImageCount(event.target.value))}
                        />
                    </Form.Item>
                    <Form.Item label={t("config.preferences.imageResolution")} className="mb-4">
                        <Select value={inferMediaScale(config.size)} options={imageResolutionOptions} onChange={(scale) => updateConfig("size", computeMediaSize(scale, inferMediaRatio(config.size)))} />
                    </Form.Item>
                    <Form.Item label={t("config.preferences.videoResolution")} className="mb-4">
                        <Select
                            value={parseVideoResolution(config.vquality)}
                            options={videoResolutionOptions}
                            onChange={(value) => {
                                updateConfig("vquality", value);
                                const ratio = inferVideoRatio(config.size);
                                if (ratio !== "auto") updateConfig("size", computeVideoSize(value, ratio));
                            }}
                        />
                    </Form.Item>
                    <Form.Item label={t("config.preferences.audioVoice")} className="mb-4">
                        <Select value={config.audioVoice} options={audioVoiceOptions} onChange={(value) => updateConfig("audioVoice", value)} />
                    </Form.Item>
                    <Form.Item label={t("config.preferences.audioFormat")} className="mb-4">
                        <Select value={config.audioFormat} options={audioFormatOptions} onChange={(value) => updateConfig("audioFormat", value)} />
                    </Form.Item>
                    <Form.Item label={t("config.preferences.audioSpeed")} className="mb-4">
                        <Input
                            type="number"
                            min={0.25}
                            max={4}
                            step={0.05}
                            value={config.audioSpeed}
                            onChange={(event) => updateConfig("audioSpeed", event.target.value)}
                            onBlur={(event) => updateConfig("audioSpeed", normalizeAudioSpeedValue(event.target.value))}
                        />
                    </Form.Item>
                </div>
                <Form.Item label={t("config.preferences.regenerateBehavior")} className="mb-4">
                    <Radio.Group value={config.nodeRegenerateBehavior} onChange={(event) => updateConfig("nodeRegenerateBehavior", event.target.value)} className="flex flex-col gap-2">
                        <Radio value="overwrite">
                            <span className="block text-sm font-medium">{t("config.preferences.regenerateBehaviorOverwrite")}</span>
                            <span className="mt-0.5 block text-xs opacity-60">{t("config.preferences.regenerateBehaviorOverwriteDescription")}</span>
                        </Radio>
                        <Radio value="new-node">
                            <span className="block text-sm font-medium">{t("config.preferences.regenerateBehaviorNewNode")}</span>
                            <span className="mt-0.5 block text-xs opacity-60">{t("config.preferences.regenerateBehaviorNewNodeDescription")}</span>
                        </Radio>
                    </Radio.Group>
                </Form.Item>
                <Form.Item className="mb-4">
                    <div className="flex items-center justify-between gap-3">
                        <span className="text-sm">{t("config.preferences.autoFocusOnSelect")}</span>
                        <Switch checked={config.autoFocusOnSelect} onChange={(checked) => updateConfig("autoFocusOnSelect", checked)} />
                    </div>
                </Form.Item>
                <Form.Item label={t("config.preferences.audioInstructions")} className="mb-4">
                    <Input.TextArea rows={2} value={config.audioInstructions} placeholder={t("config.preferences.audioInstructionsPlaceholder")} onChange={(event) => updateConfig("audioInstructions", event.target.value)} />
                </Form.Item>
                <Form.Item label={t("config.preferences.systemPrompt")} className="mb-0">
                    <Input.TextArea rows={4} value={config.systemPrompt} placeholder={t("config.preferences.systemPromptPlaceholder")} onChange={(event) => updateConfig("systemPrompt", event.target.value)} />
                </Form.Item>
            </Form>
            {showDoneButton ? (
                <div className="mt-4 flex justify-end">
                    <Button type="primary" onClick={finishConfig}>
                        {t("common.done")}
                    </Button>
                </div>
            ) : null}
        </>
    );
}

export function AppConfigModal() {
    const { t } = useTranslation();
    const isConfigOpen = useConfigStore((state) => state.isConfigOpen);
    const setConfigDialogOpen = useConfigStore((state) => state.setConfigDialogOpen);
    return (
        <Modal
            title={
                <div>
                    <div className="text-lg font-semibold">{t("config.title")}</div>
                    <div className="mt-1 text-xs font-normal text-muted-foreground">{t("config.modalDescription")}</div>
                </div>

            open={isConfigOpen}
            width={980}
            centered
            onCancel={() => setConfigDialogOpen(false)}

            footer={null}
        >

        </Modal>

}

function normalizeImageCount(value: string) {
    return String(Math.max(1, Math.min(15, Math.floor(Math.abs(Number(value)) || 3))));
}

import type { ReactNode } from "react";
import { useEffect } from "react";
import { QueryClient, QueryClientProvider } from "@tanstack/react-query";
import { App, ConfigProvider } from "antd";
import enUS from "antd/es/locale/en_US";
import zhCN from "antd/es/locale/zh_CN";
import dayjs from "dayjs";
import "dayjs/locale/zh-cn";
import { useTranslation } from "react-i18next";

import { ClientRootInit } from "@/components/layout/client-root-init";
import { useGlobalScrollbar } from "@/hooks/use-global-scrollbar";
import type { AppLocale } from "@/i18n";
import { getAntThemeConfig } from "@/lib/app-theme";
import { useThemeStore } from "@/stores/use-theme-store";

const queryClient = new QueryClient({
    defaultOptions: {
        queries: {
            staleTime: 30_000,
            retry: false,
            refetchOnWindowFocus: false,
        },
    },
});

export function AppProviders({ children }: { children: ReactNode }) {
    const { i18n, t } = useTranslation();
    useGlobalScrollbar();
    const theme = useThemeStore((state) => state.theme);
    const dark = theme === "dark";
    const locale = i18n.resolvedLanguage as AppLocale;

    useEffect(() => {
        document.documentElement.classList.toggle("dark", dark);
        document.documentElement.style.colorScheme = theme;
    }, [dark, theme]);

    useEffect(() => {
        document.documentElement.lang = locale;
        document.title = t("meta.title");
        document.querySelector('meta[name="description"]')?.setAttribute("content", t("meta.description"));
        dayjs.locale(locale === "zh-CN" ? "zh-cn" : "en");
    }, [locale, t]);

    return (
        <ConfigProvider locale={locale === "zh-CN" ? zhCN : enUS} theme={getAntThemeConfig(dark)}>
            <App>
                <QueryClientProvider client={queryClient}>
                    <ClientRootInit>{children}</ClientRootInit>
                </QueryClientProvider>
            </App>
        </ConfigProvider>
    );
}

import { useEffect, useState } from "react";

import { UserAccountMenu } from "@/components/layout/account-menu";
import { NavAdminIcon, NavAssetsIcon, NavCanvasIcon, NavCreateIcon, NavExploreIcon, NavHomeIcon, NavPromptsIcon } from "@/components/layout/nav-icons";
import { useAuthStore } from "@/stores/use-auth-store";
import { AppConfigModalHost } from "@/components/layout/lazy-overlays";
import { cn } from "@/lib/utils";
import { prefetchRoute } from "@/lib/route-prefetch";
import { loadSiteInfo } from "@/services/api/site";
import "./app-top-nav.css";

export function useApiIntegrationUrl() {
    const [url, setUrl] = useState("");
    useEffect(() => {
        let active = true;
        void loadSiteInfo().then(({ site }) => {
            const value = site.apiIntegrationUrl?.trim();
            if (active && value && /^https?:\/\//i.test(value)) setUrl(value);
        }).catch(() => undefined);
        return () => { active = false; };
    }, []);
    return url;
}

type NavIcon = ComponentType<{ className?: string }>;
type NavItem = { to: string; labelKey: string; icon: NavIcon; match: (pathname: string) => boolean };

const creationNav: NavItem[] = [
    { to: "/", labelKey: "navigation.home", icon: NavHomeIcon, match: path => path === "/" },
    { to: "/canvas", labelKey: "navigation.canvas", icon: NavCanvasIcon, match: path => path === "/canvas" },
    { to: "/create", labelKey: "navigation.create", icon: NavCreateIcon, match: path => ["/create", "/image", "/video"].includes(path) },
    { to: "/explore", labelKey: "navigation.explore", icon: NavExploreIcon, match: path => path === "/explore" },
];
const resourceNav: NavItem[] = [
    { to: "/assets", labelKey: "navigation.assets", icon: NavAssetsIcon, match: path => path === "/assets" },
    { to: "/prompts", labelKey: "navigation.prompts", icon: NavPromptsIcon, match: path => path === "/prompts" },
];

function useNavItems(): NavItem[] {
    const user = useAuthStore((state) => state.user);
    return user?.role === "admin"
        ? [...creationNav, ...resourceNav, { to: "/admin", labelKey: "navigation.admin", icon: NavAdminIcon, match: (path: string) => path === "/admin" }]
        : [...creationNav, ...resourceNav];
}

                {/* 头部通栏：布局保留（logo 贴左、导航居中、账户区贴右），视觉按即梦规范 */}
                <div className="flex h-[64px] w-full items-center gap-5 px-5 md:px-6 xl:px-8">
                    <Link to="/" className="flex shrink-0 items-center gap-2.5 !text-foreground transition hover:opacity-80">

                        <div className="mx-auto flex w-max items-center gap-1">
                            {apiUrl && <a href={apiUrl} target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" className="flex h-9 shrink-0 items-center gap-2 whitespace-nowrap rounded-[8px] px-2.5 text-[13px] font-medium !text-muted-foreground transition-colors hover:text-foreground"><Code2 className="size-4" />API 对接</a>}

                        {/* 右侧动作区：不套背景容器，会员/积分/头像三枚胶囊直接贴在顶栏上 */}

import { useEffect } from "react";
import type { ReactNode } from "react";
import { App } from "antd";

import { useCloudSync } from "@/hooks/use-cloud-sync";
import { applyServerModels, type ServerModel } from "@/lib/server-models";
import { apiRequest } from "@/services/api/client";
import { useAuthStore } from "@/stores/use-auth-store";
import { subscribeSessionChanges } from "@/lib/session-broadcast";

export function ClientRootInit({ children }: { children: ReactNode }) {
    const { message } = App.useApp();
    useCloudSync();

    useEffect(() => {
        void useAuthStore.getState().hydrate().catch((error) => message.error(error instanceof Error ? error.message : "无法确认登录状态"));
        return subscribeSessionChanges(() => { void useAuthStore.getState().externalSessionChanged().catch((error) => message.error(error instanceof Error ? error.message : "无法确认登录状态")); });
    }, []);

    useEffect(() => {
        const refresh = () => { if (document.visibilityState === "visible") void useAuthStore.getState().refreshWallet().catch(() => undefined); };
        document.addEventListener("visibilitychange", refresh);
        window.addEventListener("online", refresh);
        return () => { document.removeEventListener("visibilitychange", refresh); window.removeEventListener("online", refresh); };
    }, []);

    useEffect(() => {
        let cancelled = false;
        apiRequest<{ models: ServerModel[] }>("/api/models")
            .then((data) => {
                if (!cancelled && data.models.length) applyServerModels(data.models);
            })
            .catch(() => {
                // 模型列表拉取失败时保留本地缓存，登录后还会再拉一次。
            });
        return () => {
            cancelled = true;
        };
    }, []);

    return <>{children}</>;
}

import { loadCreationChats, useCreationChat } from "@/pages/chat/chat-store";
import { Drawer } from "antd";
import { ImagePlus, LayoutGrid, Menu, Video, X, MessageSquare } from "lucide-react";
import { useEffect, useState } from "react";
import { Link, useLocation } from "react-router-dom";

import { useAuthStore } from "@/stores/use-auth-store";
import { isCanvasAccountActive, useCanvasStore } from "@/stores/canvas/use-canvas-store";
import { useCreationHistory } from "@/components/creation/creation-history";
import { fetchRecentGenerationHistory } from "@/services/api/generation-history";

export function CreationSidebar() {
    const [open, setOpen] = useState(false);
    const { pathname, search } = useLocation();
    const user = useAuthStore((state) => state.user);
    const ready = useAuthStore((state) => state.ready);
    const epoch = useAuthStore((state) => state.sessionEpoch);
    const history = useCreationHistory();
    const chats = useCreationChat();
    useEffect(() => { if (ready && user) void loadCreationChats(user.id); }, [ready, user?.id]);
    const threads = chats.owner === user?.id ? chats.threads : [];
    useEffect(() => { setOpen(false); }, [pathname, search]);
    useEffect(() => {
        if (!ready || !user) return;
        const owner = user.id;
        const session = `${owner}:${epoch}`;
        const videoMode = pathname === "/video" || (pathname === "/create" && new URLSearchParams(search).get("mode") === "video");
        const modes: ("image" | "video")[] = videoMode ? ["image"] : pathname === "/image" || pathname === "/create" ? ["video"] : ["image", "video"];
        let active = true;
        for (const mode of modes) {
            const current = useCreationHistory.getState();
            if (current.session === session && current[mode].length) continue;
            void fetchRecentGenerationHistory(owner, mode).then((items) => {
                const auth = useAuthStore.getState();
                const currentState = useCreationHistory.getState();
                if (active && auth.ready && auth.user?.id === owner && auth.sessionEpoch === epoch && (currentState.session !== session || !currentState[mode].length)) currentState.update(session, mode, items);
            }).catch(() => undefined);
        }
        return () => { active = false; };
    }, [ready, user?.id, epoch, pathname, search]);
    const projects = useCanvasStore((state) => state.projects);
    const hydrated = useCanvasStore((state) => state.hydrated);
    const recent = ready && hydrated && user && isCanvasAccountActive(user.id)
        ? [...projects].sort((a, b) => b.updatedAt.localeCompare(a.updatedAt)).slice(0, 4)
        : [];

    const recentGenerations = ready && user && history.session === `${user.id}:${epoch}`
        ? [...history.image, ...history.video].sort((a, b) => b.createdAt - a.createdAt).slice(0, 5)
        : [];
    const recentWorks = [
        ...threads.filter(t => t.messages.length || t.records.length || t.draft).map(t => ({ key: `chat:${t.id}`, title: t.title, time: t.updatedAt, to: `/create?mode=chat&thread=${t.id}`, icon: MessageSquare, type: "对话" })),
        ...recentGenerations.map(item => ({ key: `${item.mode}:${item.id}`, title: item.title, time: item.createdAt, to: threads.some(t => t.records.some(r => r.id === item.id)) ? `/create?mode=chat&thread=${threads.find(t => t.records.some(r => r.id === item.id))!.id}` : `/create?mode=${item.mode}&record=${encodeURIComponent(item.id)}`, icon: item.mode === "image" ? ImagePlus : Video, type: item.mode === "image" ? "图片" : "视频" })),
        ...recent.map(project => ({ key: `canvas:${project.id}`, title: project.title, time: new Date(project.updatedAt).getTime(), to: `/canvas/${project.id}`, icon: LayoutGrid, type: "画布" })),
    ].sort((a, b) => b.time - a.time);

    const sidebar = (
        <aside className="creation-sidebar flex h-full w-[220px] lg:w-[240px] shrink-0 flex-col border-r border-border text-foreground">
            <div className="flex h-16 items-center justify-between px-5">
                <h2 className="text-sm font-semibold">最近作品</h2>
                <button type="button" onClick={() => setOpen(false)} className="text-muted-foreground lg:hidden" aria-label="关闭最近作品"><X className="size-5" /></button>
            </div>
            <nav className="thin-scrollbar min-h-0 flex-1 overflow-y-auto px-2 pb-4" aria-label="最近作品">
                {user && <div>
                    {recentWorks.map(({ key, title, to, icon: Icon, type }) => <Link key={key} to={to} aria-current={`${pathname}${search}` === to ? "page" : undefined} title={`${type} · ${title}`} onClick={() => setOpen(false)} className="flex h-9 items-center gap-2 rounded-lg px-3 text-sm !text-muted-foreground hover:bg-muted hover:!text-foreground"><Icon className="size-3.5 shrink-0" /><span className="min-w-0 flex-1 truncate">{title}</span><span className="shrink-0 text-xs">{type}</span></Link>)}
                    {recentWorks.length === 0 && <p className="px-3 py-2 text-xs text-muted-foreground">暂无最近作品</p>}
                    <div className="mt-2 flex gap-3 px-3 text-xs"><Link to="/create" onClick={() => setOpen(false)} className="!text-muted-foreground hover:!text-foreground">生成历史</Link><Link to="/canvas" onClick={() => setOpen(false)} className="!text-muted-foreground hover:!text-foreground">全部画布</Link></div>
                </div>}
            </nav>

        </aside>
    );
    // 未登录访客没有「最近作品」，不占侧栏宽度
    if (!user) return null;
    return <>
        <div className="hidden h-full lg:block">{sidebar}</div>
        <button type="button" onClick={() => setOpen(true)} className="m-2 flex shrink-0 items-center gap-2 self-start rounded-lg px-3 py-2 text-xs text-muted-foreground hover:bg-muted lg:hidden" aria-label="打开最近作品" aria-expanded={open} aria-controls="creation-mobile-navigation"><Menu className="size-4" />最近作品</button>
        <Drawer open={open} onClose={() => setOpen(false)} placement="left" size={220} closable={false} styles={{ body: { padding: 0 } }} rootClassName="creation-mobile-drawer" destroyOnHidden><div id="creation-mobile-navigation" className="creation-shell h-full">{sidebar}</div></Drawer>
    </>;
}

import { Suspense, lazy, useEffect, useState } from "react";

import { useAuthDialogStore } from "@/stores/use-auth-dialog-store";
import { useConfigStore } from "@/stores/use-config-store";

/**
 * 全局浮层（登录弹窗 / 偏好设置弹窗）按需加载：
 * 这两块只在用户主动触发时才出现，但会静态带进 antd 的 Form / Modal / Select / Radio / Switch，
 * 是首屏包最大的一块业务开销。默认不挂载 → chunk 不下载；
 * 首次打开后保持挂载，关闭动画与内部状态与原来一致。
 */
const AuthDialog = lazy(() => import("@/components/auth/auth-dialog").then((module) => ({ default: module.AuthDialog })));
const AppConfigModal = lazy(() => import("@/components/layout/app-config-modal").then((module) => ({ default: module.AppConfigModal })));

function useKeepMountedWhen(open: boolean) {
    const [mounted, setMounted] = useState(open);
    useEffect(() => {
        if (open) setMounted(true);
    }, [open]);
    return mounted;
}

export function AuthDialogHost() {
    const open = useAuthDialogStore((state) => state.mode !== null);
    const mounted = useKeepMountedWhen(open);
    if (!mounted) return null;
    return (
        <Suspense fallback={null}>
            <AuthDialog />
        </Suspense>
    );
}

export function AppConfigModalHost() {
    const open = useConfigStore((state) => state.isConfigOpen);
    const mounted = useKeepMountedWhen(open);
    if (!mounted) return null;
    return (
        <Suspense fallback={null}>
            <AppConfigModal />
        </Suspense>
    );
}

import { App, Button, Checkbox, Input, Modal, Tabs } from "antd";
import { RefreshCw, Search } from "lucide-react";
import { useEffect, useMemo, useState } from "react";
import { useTranslation } from "react-i18next";

import { fetchChannelModels } from "@/services/api/image";
import type { ModelChannel } from "@/stores/use-config-store";

// Channel model selector: fetch upstream models or add them manually, then include checked models in the channel list.
export function ModelSelectModal({ open, channel, selectedNames, onConfirm, onClose }: { open: boolean; channel: ModelChannel | null; selectedNames: string[]; onConfirm: (names: string[]) => void; onClose: () => void }) {
    const { message } = App.useApp();
    const { t } = useTranslation();
    const [existing, setExisting] = useState<string[]>([]);
    const [fetched, setFetched] = useState<string[]>([]);
    const [selected, setSelected] = useState<Set<string>>(new Set());
    const [activeTab, setActiveTab] = useState("new");
    const [search, setSearch] = useState("");
    const [manual, setManual] = useState("");
    const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false);

    useEffect(() => {
        if (!open) return;
        setExisting(selectedNames);
        setFetched([]);
        setSelected(new Set(selectedNames));
        setActiveTab(selectedNames.length ? "existing" : "new");
        setSearch("");
        setManual("");
    }, [open, selectedNames]);

    const currentList = activeTab === "new" ? fetched : existing;
    const visibleList = useMemo(() => {
        const keyword = search.trim().toLowerCase();
        return keyword ? currentList.filter((name) => name.toLowerCase().includes(keyword)) : currentList;
    }, [currentList, search]);
    const visibleSelectedCount = visibleList.filter((name) => selected.has(name)).length;

    const toggle = (name: string, checked: boolean) =>
        setSelected((current) => {
            const next = new Set(current);
            if (checked) next.add(name);
            else next.delete(name);
            return next;
        });

    const selectVisible = (checked: boolean) =>
        setSelected((current) => {
            const next = new Set(current);
            visibleList.forEach((name) => (checked ? next.add(name) : next.delete(name)));
            return next;
        });

    const addManual = () => {
        const name = manual.trim();
        if (!name) return;
        if (!fetched.includes(name) && !existing.includes(name)) setFetched((current) => [name, ...current]);
        setSelected((current) => new Set(current).add(name));
        setManual("");
        setActiveTab("new");
    };

    const fetchModels = async () => {
        if (!channel) return;
        if (!channel.baseUrl.trim() || !channel.apiKey.trim()) {
            message.error(t("config.modelSelect.missingConfig"));
            return;
        }
        setLoading(true);
        try {
            const models = await fetchChannelModels(channel);
            setFetched(models);
            setActiveTab("new");
            message.success(t("config.modelSelect.fetched", { count: models.length }));
        } catch (error) {
            message.error(error instanceof Error ? error.message : t("config.modelSelect.fetchFailed"));
        } finally {
            setLoading(false);
        }
    };

    const confirm = () => {
        const ordered = [...existing, ...fetched].filter((name, index, list) => list.indexOf(name) === index).filter((name) => selected.has(name));
        onConfirm(ordered);
        onClose();
    };

    return (
        <Modal
            open={open}
            width={880}
            centered
            onCancel={onClose}
            title={
                <span>
                    {t("config.modelSelect.title")} <span className="ml-2 text-xs font-normal text-muted-foreground">{t("config.modelSelect.selected", { selected: selected.size, total: new Set([...existing, ...fetched]).size })}</span>
                </span>
            }
            styles={{ body: { maxHeight: "62vh", overflowY: "auto" } }}
            footer={[
                <Button key="cancel" onClick={onClose}>
                    {t("common.cancel")}
                </Button>,
                <Button key="confirm" type="primary" onClick={confirm}>
                    {t("config.modelSelect.confirm")}
                </Button>,
            ]}
        >
            <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-3">
                <Input className="min-w-[200px] flex-1" value={search} onChange={(event) => setSearch(event.target.value)} placeholder={t("config.modelSelect.search")} prefix={<Search className="size-4 text-muted-foreground" />} allowClear />
                <Input className="min-w-[180px] flex-1" value={manual} onChange={(event) => setManual(event.target.value)} onPressEnter={addManual} placeholder={t("config.modelSelect.modelName")} />
                <Button onClick={addManual}>{t("config.modelSelect.add")}</Button>
                <Button icon={<RefreshCw className="size-4" />} loading={loading} onClick={() => void fetchModels()}>
                    {t("config.modelSelect.fetch")}
                </Button>
            </div>
            <div className="mt-2 text-xs text-muted-foreground">{t("config.modelSelect.description")}</div>

            <Tabs
                className="mt-3"
                activeKey={activeTab}
                onChange={setActiveTab}
                items={[
                    { key: "new", label: t("config.modelSelect.fetchedTab", { count: fetched.length }) },
                    { key: "existing", label: t("config.modelSelect.existingTab", { count: existing.length }) },
                ]}
            />

            <div className="mb-3 flex items-center justify-between gap-2">
                <span className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">{t("config.modelSelect.visibleSelected", { selected: visibleSelectedCount, total: visibleList.length })}</span>
                <div className="flex gap-2">
                    <Button size="small" disabled={!visibleList.length} onClick={() => selectVisible(true)}>
                        {t("config.modelSelect.selectVisible")}
                    </Button>
                    <Button size="small" disabled={!visibleSelectedCount} onClick={() => selectVisible(false)}>
                        {t("config.modelSelect.clearVisible")}
                    </Button>
                </div>
            </div>

            {visibleList.length ? (
                <div className="grid grid-cols-1 gap-x-8 gap-y-3 md:grid-cols-2">
                    {visibleList.map((name) => (
                        <Checkbox key={name} checked={selected.has(name)} onChange={(event) => toggle(name, event.target.checked)}>
                            <span className="truncate" title={name}>
                                {name}
                            </span>
                        </Checkbox>
                    ))}
                </div>
            ) : (
                <div className="py-8 text-center text-sm text-muted-foreground">{t(activeTab === "new" ? "config.modelSelect.fetchedEmpty" : "config.modelSelect.existingEmpty")}</div>
            )}
        </Modal>
    );
}

FILE: web/src/components/layout/page-transition.tsx

import { useEffect, useLayoutEffect, useRef, type ReactNode } from "react";
import { useLocation } from "react-router-dom";

export function PageTransition({ children, disabled = false, className = "h-full min-h-0" }: { children: ReactNode; disabled?: boolean; className?: string }) {
    const { pathname, search } = useLocation();
    const frame = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);

    useLayoutEffect(() => {
        const preference = window.matchMedia("(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)");
        if (disabled || preference.matches || !frame.current?.animate) return;
        const animation = frame.current.animate(
            [{ opacity: 0.55, translate: "0 6px" }, { opacity: 1, translate: "0 0" }],
            { duration: 200, easing: "cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1)" },
        );
        const stop = () => { if (preference.matches) animation.cancel(); };
        preference.addEventListener("change", stop);
        return () => { animation.cancel(); preference.removeEventListener("change", stop); };
    }, [disabled, pathname, search]);

    useEffect(() => {
        if (disabled) return;
        const preference = window.matchMedia("(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)");
        let pressed: Animation | undefined;
        const stop = () => pressed?.cancel();
        const click = (event: MouseEvent) => {
            if (preference.matches || !(event.target instanceof Element)) return;
            const control = event.target.closest<HTMLElement>("button, a[href], [role='button'], [role='tab'], [role='menuitem'], .ant-segmented-item, .ant-tag-checkable");
            if (!control?.animate || control.closest(":disabled, [aria-disabled='true'], .ant-btn-loading, .ant-tabs-tab-disabled, .ant-segmented-item-disabled")) return;
            stop();
            pressed = control.animate([{ scale: "1" }, { scale: "0.97", offset: 0.35 }, { scale: "1" }], { duration: 160, easing: "ease-out" });
        };
        // 捕获阶段覆盖导航、普通按钮及弹窗内的按钮，不改变原有点击行为。
        document.addEventListener("click", click, true);
        preference.addEventListener("change", stop);
        return () => { stop(); document.removeEventListener("click", click, true); preference.removeEventListener("change", stop); };
    }, [disabled]);

    return <div ref={frame} className={className}>{children}</div>;
}

import type { ReactNode } from "react";
import { Spin } from "antd";
import { Navigate } from "react-router-dom";

import { useAuthStore } from "@/stores/use-auth-store";

export function RequireAdmin({ children }: { children: ReactNode }) {
    const user = useAuthStore((state) => state.user);
    const ready = useAuthStore((state) => state.ready);

    if (!ready) {
        return (
            <div className="flex h-dvh items-center justify-center">
                <Spin />
            </div>
        );
    }
    if (!user || user.role !== "admin") return <Navigate to="/" replace />;
    return <>{children}</>;
}

import type { ReactNode } from "react";
import { Spin } from "antd";
import { Navigate, useLocation } from "react-router-dom";

import { useAuthStore } from "@/stores/use-auth-store";

export function RequireAuth({ children }: { children: ReactNode }) {
    const user = useAuthStore((state) => state.user);
    const ready = useAuthStore((state) => state.ready);
    const location = useLocation();

    if (!ready) {
        return (
            <div className="flex h-full items-center justify-center">
                <Spin />
            </div>
        );
    }
    if (!user) {
        return <Navigate to={`/login?redirect=${encodeURIComponent(`${location.pathname}${location.search}`)}`} replace />;
    }
    return <>{children}</>;
}

import { isRouteErrorResponse, useRouteError } from "react-router-dom";

export function RouteErrorPage() {
    const error = useRouteError();
    const message = isRouteErrorResponse(error)
        ? `${error.status} ${error.statusText}`
        : error instanceof Error ? error.message : String(error ?? "");
    const chunkError = /Failed to fetch dynamically imported module|Importing a module script failed|error loading dynamically imported module|ChunkLoadError/i.test(message);
    return (
        <main className="grid min-h-dvh place-items-center bg-background px-6 text-foreground">
            <div className="w-full max-w-md text-center">
                <h1 className="text-[26px] font-semibold leading-9 tracking-[-0.01em]">{chunkError ? "页面资源已更新" : "页面加载失败"}</h1>
                <p className="mt-3 text-[13px] leading-6 text-muted-foreground">
                    {chunkError ? "检测到新版本资源，刷新页面即可继续使用。" : "页面遇到了一点问题，请刷新后重试。"}
                </p>
                <div className="mt-7 flex justify-center gap-2">
                    <button type="button" className="jm-btn jm-btn-primary" onClick={() => window.location.reload()}>
                        刷新页面
                    </button>
                    <a className="jm-btn jm-btn-secondary" href="/">返回首页</a>
                </div>
            </div>
        </main>
    );
}

import type { CSSProperties } from "react";
import { Dropdown } from "antd";
import { ChevronDown, Keyboard, Settings2 } from "lucide-react";
import { useTranslation } from "react-i18next";

import { changeAppLocale, listLocales, type LocaleCode } from "@/i18n";
import { canvasThemes } from "@/lib/canvas-theme";
import { useConfigStore } from "@/stores/use-config-store";
import { useThemeStore } from "@/stores/use-theme-store";

type UserStatusActionsProps = {
    showConfig?: boolean;
    variant?: "default" | "canvas";
    onOpenShortcuts?: () => void;
};

/** 语言切换下拉：自动列出 i18n 注册表内全部语言，登录/未登录均可复用 */
export function LanguageMenu({ buttonClassName, iconStyle }: { buttonClassName?: string; iconStyle?: CSSProperties }) {
    const { i18n, t } = useTranslation();
    const locale = i18n.resolvedLanguage as LocaleCode;
    const locales = listLocales();
    const currentLocale = locales.find((item) => item.code === locale);
    const languageLabel = t("topNav.switchLanguage", { language: currentLocale ? currentLocale.label : locale });

    return (
        <Dropdown
            trigger={["click"]}
            placement="bottom"
            menu={{
                items: locales.map((item) => ({ key: item.code, label: item.label })),
                selectable: true,
                selectedKeys: [locale],
                onClick: ({ key }) => {
                    if (key !== locale) void changeAppLocale(key as LocaleCode);
                },
            }}
        >
            <button type="button" className={buttonClassName} style={iconStyle} aria-label={languageLabel} aria-haspopup="menu">
                {currentLocale?.short ?? "中"}
                <ChevronDown className="size-3 opacity-60" />
            </button>
        </Dropdown>
    );
}

export function UserStatusActions({ showConfig = true, variant = "default", onOpenShortcuts }: UserStatusActionsProps) {
    const { t } = useTranslation();
    const openConfigDialog = useConfigStore((state) => state.openConfigDialog);
    const theme = useThemeStore((state) => state.theme);
    const canvasTheme = canvasThemes[theme];
    const naturalIconClass = "inline-flex size-7 shrink-0 cursor-pointer items-center justify-center rounded-md text-muted-foreground transition-colors hover:bg-black/5 hover:text-foreground dark:hover:bg-white/10 dark:hover:text-white [&_svg]:size-4";
    const iconStyle: CSSProperties | undefined = variant === "canvas" ? { color: canvasTheme.node.text } : undefined;

    return (
        <div className="inline-flex shrink-0 items-center gap-1">
            {showConfig ? (
                <button type="button" className={naturalIconClass} style={iconStyle} onClick={() => openConfigDialog(false)} aria-label={t("navigation.config")} title={t("navigation.config")}>
                    <Settings2 className="size-4" />
                </button>
            ) : null}
            <LanguageMenu
                buttonClassName={`${naturalIconClass} gap-0.5 px-1.5 text-[11px] font-semibold tracking-tight`}
                iconStyle={iconStyle}
            />
            {onOpenShortcuts ? (
                <button type="button" className={naturalIconClass} style={iconStyle} onClick={onOpenShortcuts} aria-label={t("topNav.shortcuts")} title={t("topNav.shortcuts")}>
                    <Keyboard className="size-4" />
                </button>
            ) : null}
        </div>
    );
}

/**
 * 页面加载骨架屏
 * 提供比简单文本更好的加载体验，减少感知加载时间
 */
export const PageSkeleton = ({ embedded = false }: { embedded?: boolean }) => {
    return (
        <div className={`flex ${embedded ? "h-full" : "h-screen"} w-full flex-col bg-background p-6`}>
            {!embedded && (
                /* 顶部导航栏骨架 */
                <div className="mb-8 flex items-center justify-between">
                    <div className="h-8 w-32 animate-pulse rounded-lg bg-muted" />
                    <div className="flex gap-4">
                        <div className="h-10 w-20 animate-pulse rounded-lg bg-muted" />
                        <div className="h-10 w-24 animate-pulse rounded-lg bg-muted" />
                    </div>
                </div>
            )}

            {/* 主内容区域骨架 */}
            <div className="flex-1 space-y-6">
                {/* 标题 */}
                <div className="h-10 w-64 animate-pulse rounded-lg bg-muted" />

                {/* 内容卡片 */}
                <div className="grid gap-6 md:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3">
                    {[1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6].map((i) => (
                        <div key={i} className="space-y-3 rounded-xl border border-border bg-card p-4">
                            <div className="aspect-video animate-pulse rounded-lg bg-muted" />
                            <div className="h-4 w-3/4 animate-pulse rounded bg-muted" />
                            <div className="h-4 w-1/2 animate-pulse rounded bg-muted" />
                        </div>
                    ))}
                </div>
            </div>

            {!embedded && (
                /* 品牌化加载指示器（可选） */
                <div className="fixed bottom-8 left-1/2 -translate-x-1/2">
                    <div className="flex items-center gap-2 rounded-full bg-card/80 px-4 py-2 shadow-lg backdrop-blur">
                        <div className="h-2 w-2 animate-pulse rounded-full bg-brand" />
                        <span className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">加载中...</span>
                    </div>
                </div>
            )}
        </div>
    );
};

 */
export const CompactSkeleton = () => {
    return (

            <div className="space-y-4 w-full max-w-md">
                <div className="h-8 w-3/4 animate-pulse rounded-lg bg-muted" />
                <div className="h-4 w-full animate-pulse rounded bg-muted" />
                <div className="h-4 w-5/6 animate-pulse rounded bg-muted" />
            </div>
        </div>
    );
};

import { useEffect, useState, type ReactNode } from 'react';
import { useMediaPreview } from '@/hooks/use-media-preview';

// Small cards never fetch a cloud original to stand in for its derivative.
export function MediaThumbnail({source,kind='image',alt='',className='grid size-full place-items-center overflow-hidden',imageClassName='size-full object-cover',fallback}: {
    source?:string;kind?:'image'|'video';alt?:string;className?:string;imageClassName?:string;fallback?:ReactNode;
}) {
    const [element,setElement]=useState<HTMLElement|null>(null),[visible,setVisible]=useState(false);
    useEffect(()=>{
        if (!element) return;
        if (typeof IntersectionObserver==='undefined') {setVisible(true);return;}
        const observer=new IntersectionObserver(entries=>setVisible(entries.some(entry=>entry.isIntersecting)));
        observer.observe(element);return()=>observer.disconnect();
    },[element]);
    const preview=useMediaPreview(visible?source:undefined);
    const url=visible?(preview.cloud?preview.url:source):undefined;
    return <span ref={setElement} className={className} title={preview.error?`${preview.error}，点击可重试缩略图`:undefined} onClick={()=>{if(preview.error)preview.retry();}}>
        {url?(kind==='video'&&!preview.cloud?<video src={url} muted preload="metadata" className={imageClassName}/>:<img src={url} alt={alt} loading="lazy" decoding="async" className={imageClassName}/>):fallback}
    </span>;
}

FILE: web/src/components/model-picker.tsx

import { useEffect, useId, useMemo, useState, type CSSProperties } from "react";
import { Cpu } from "lucide-react";
import { useTranslation } from "react-i18next";

import i18n from "@/i18n";
import { Select, SelectContent, SelectGroup, SelectItem, SelectLabel, SelectTrigger } from "@/components/ui/select";
import { cn } from "@/lib/utils";
import { parseVideoResolution, videoResolutionOptionsFromMap } from "@/lib/media-size";
import { modelOptionLabel, modelOptionName, selectableModelsByCapability, useConfigStore, type AiConfig, type ModelCapability, type ServerModelInfo } from "@/stores/use-config-store";

type ModelPickerProps = {
    config: AiConfig;
    value?: string;
    onChange: (model: string) => void;
    capability?: ModelCapability;
    className?: string;
    fullWidth?: boolean;
    placeholder?: string;
    onMissingConfig?: () => void;
    onRouteSelect?: (model: string, routeId: string) => void;
    triggerStyle?: CSSProperties;
};

type ModelGroup = { key: string; label: string; hint: string; models: string[] };

export function ModelPicker({ config, value, onChange, capability, className, fullWidth = false, placeholder, onMissingConfig, onRouteSelect, triggerStyle }: ModelPickerProps) {
    const { t } = useTranslation();
    const pickerId = useId();
    const [open, setOpen] = useState(false);
    const serverModels = useConfigStore((state) => state.serverModels);
    const options = useMemo(() => {
        const candidates = [...(config.channelMode === "local" && !capability ? [value] : []), ...selectableModelsByCapability(config, capability)];
        return Array.from(new Set(candidates.filter((model): model is string => !!model && (!model.startsWith("server::") || serverModels.some(item => item.id === modelOptionName(model))))));
    }, [capability, config, value, serverModels]);
    const current = value && options.includes(value) ? value : "";
    const pickerPlaceholder = placeholder || t("settingsPanels.model.select");
    const serverInfo = useMemo(() => {
        const map = new Map(serverModels.map((model) => [model.id, model]));
        return (model: string) => map.get(modelOptionName(model));
    }, [serverModels]);
    const groups = useMemo(() => groupModels(config, options, serverInfo), [config, options, serverInfo]);
    const selected = serverInfo(current);
    const selectedRoute = capability === 'video' && onRouteSelect && config.videoRouteId ? selected?.routes.find((route) => route.id === config.videoRouteId) : undefined;
    const routeLabel = selectedRoute ? displayRouteName(selectedRoute.channelName) : (capability === 'video' && onRouteSelect && config.videoRouteId ? '所选线路已不可用，请重新选择' : capability === 'video' && onRouteSelect && selected?.routes.length ? '自动选择' : '');
    const routeValue = (model: string, routeId: string) => `__video_route__${encodeURIComponent(model)}|${routeId}`;
    const selectVideoRoute = (model: string, routeId: string) => {
        const info = serverInfo(model);
        const capabilities = routeId ? info?.routes.find(route => route.id === routeId)?.resolutionMultipliers : info?.resolutionMultipliers;
        const resolutions = videoResolutionOptionsFromMap(capabilities);
        if (!resolutions.some(option => option.value === parseVideoResolution(config.vquality))) {
            useConfigStore.getState().updateConfig("vquality", resolutions.find(option => option.value === "720")?.value ?? resolutions[0].value);
        }
        onRouteSelect?.(model, routeId);
    };

    useEffect(() => {
        const closeOtherPicker = (event: Event) => {
            if ((event as CustomEvent<string>).detail !== pickerId) setOpen(false);
        };
        window.addEventListener("model-picker-open", closeOtherPicker);
        return () => window.removeEventListener("model-picker-open", closeOtherPicker);
    }, [pickerId]);

    return (
        <Select
            open={open}
            value={selectedRoute ? routeValue(current, selectedRoute.id) : current}
            onOpenChange={(nextOpen) => {
                if (nextOpen && !options.length && config.channelMode === "local") onMissingConfig?.();
                if (nextOpen) window.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent("model-picker-open", { detail: pickerId }));
                setOpen(nextOpen);
            }}
            onValueChange={(next) => {
                if (next.startsWith('__video_route__') && onRouteSelect) {
                    const [encoded, routeId] = next.slice('__video_route__'.length).split('|');
                    selectVideoRoute(decodeURIComponent(encoded), routeId);
                } else if (capability === 'video' && onRouteSelect) selectVideoRoute(next, '');
                else onChange(next);
            }}
        >
            <SelectTrigger
                className={cn(
                    "canvas-composer-model-picker h-8 w-fit max-w-full gap-2 rounded-full border border-input bg-transparent px-3 text-sm font-normal shadow-sm transition-colors",
                    fullWidth ? "w-full min-w-0 justify-start" : "min-w-[9rem] justify-start",
                    "data-[state=open]:border-ring data-[state=open]:ring-2 data-[state=open]:ring-ring/20",
                    className,
                )}
                style={triggerStyle}
                onMouseDown={(event) => event.stopPropagation()}
                onPointerDown={(event) => event.stopPropagation()}
                title={current ? `${selected?.name || modelOptionLabel(config, current)}${routeLabel ? ` · ${routeLabel}` : ''}` : pickerPlaceholder}
            >
                <ModelIcon model={current} icon={selected?.familyIcon} />
                <span className="canvas-model-picker-text min-w-0 flex-1 truncate text-left">{current ? `${selected?.name || modelOptionLabel(config, current)}${routeLabel ? ` · ${routeLabel}` : ''}` : pickerPlaceholder}</span>
            </SelectTrigger>
            <SelectContent
                data-canvas-no-zoom
                className={cn("z-[1200] max-w-[calc(100vw-24px)] rounded-xl border border-border/70 bg-popover p-1 shadow-lg [&_[data-position=popper]]:min-w-0 [&_[data-slot=select-item]>span:last-child]:min-w-0 [&_[data-slot=select-item]>span:last-child]:flex-1", options.length ? "w-[300px]" : "w-[240px]")}
                position="popper"
                align="start"
                side="bottom"
                sideOffset={6}
                onPointerDown={(event) => event.stopPropagation()}
                onMouseDown={(event) => event.stopPropagation()}
            >
                {groups.length ? (
                    groups.map((group) => (
                        <SelectGroup key={group.key}>
                            <SelectLabel className="flex items-center justify-between gap-2 px-2 py-1.5">
                                <span className="truncate font-medium text-foreground">{group.label}</span>
                                <span className="shrink-0 text-[10px] font-normal text-muted-foreground">{group.hint}</span>
                            </SelectLabel>
                            {group.models.map((model) => {
                                const info = serverInfo(model);
                                const hasVideoRoutes = capability === 'video' && onRouteSelect && Boolean(info?.routes.length);
                                if (!hasVideoRoutes || !info) return <SelectItem key={model} value={model} textValue={info?.name || modelOptionLabel(config, model)} disabled={Boolean(info && info.routeCount === 0 && model !== current)} className="items-start py-2">
                                    <ModelLabel config={config} model={model} info={info} />
                                </SelectItem>;
                                return <div key={model} className="mb-1 rounded-lg border border-border/50 p-1">
                                    <div className="px-2 py-1.5"><ModelLabel config={config} model={model} info={info} hideRoutes /></div>
                                    <SelectItem value={model} textValue={`${info.name} 自动选择`} className="my-0.5 py-2 pl-8 text-xs">
                                        <span className="flex w-full items-center justify-between gap-2"><span className="font-medium">自动选择</span><span className="text-muted-foreground">系统选择可用线路</span></span>
                                    </SelectItem>
                                    {info.routes.map((route) => {
                                        const keys = Object.keys(route.resolutionMultipliers ?? {});
                                        const paused = keys.length > 0 && !keys.some((key) => /^(480|720|1080|2k|4k)$/i.test(key));
                                        const resolution = parseVideoResolution(config.vquality);
                                        const multiplier = route.resolutionMultipliers?.[resolution];
                                        const unsupported = keys.length > 0 && multiplier === undefined;
                                        const name = displayRouteName(route.channelName);
                                        return <SelectItem key={route.id} value={routeValue(model, route.id)} textValue={`${info.name} ${name}`} disabled={paused} className="my-0.5 py-2 pl-8 text-xs">
                                            <span className="flex w-full items-center justify-between gap-2"><span className="font-medium">{name}</span><span className="shrink-0 text-muted-foreground">{paused ? '暂不可用' : unsupported ? '切换后调整清晰度' : `${formatCredits(route.baseCredits * (multiplier ?? 1), true)} 积分/${route.unit === 'second' ? '秒' : '次'}`}</span></span>
                                        </SelectItem>;
                                    })}
                                </div>;
                            })}
                        </SelectGroup>
                    ))
                ) : (
                    <SelectItem value="__empty__" disabled className="whitespace-normal py-2 text-xs leading-5">{emptyModelLabel(config, capability)}</SelectItem>
                )}
            </SelectContent>
        </Select>
    );
}

function groupModels(config: AiConfig, options: string[], infoOf: (model: string) => ServerModelInfo | undefined): ModelGroup[] {
    const groups = new Map<string, ModelGroup>();
    for (const model of options) {
        const info = infoOf(model);
        const channel = config.channels.find((item) => item.id === model.split("::")[0]);
        const key = info?.familyId || info?.familyName || channel?.id || "other";
        const existing = groups.get(key);
        if (existing) {
            existing.models.push(model);
            continue;
        }
        const label = info?.familyName || channel?.name || i18n.t("settingsPanels.model.select");
        const hint = info?.familyVendor || (info ? `${info.routeCount} 条线路` : channel?.baseUrl || "");
        groups.set(key, { key, label, hint, models: [model] });
    }
    return [...groups.values()];
}

function emptyModelLabel(config: AiConfig, capability?: ModelCapability) {
    if (capability === "video") return "暂无可用的视频模型，请联系管理员";
    const label = capability ? i18n.t(`settingsPanels.model.capabilities.${capability}`) : "";
    if (capability && config.models.length) return i18n.t("settingsPanels.model.assign", { capability: label });
    return config.models.length ? i18n.t("settingsPanels.model.noMatch", { capability: label }) : i18n.t("settingsPanels.model.addFirst");
}

function displayRouteName(name: string) {
    if (name.includes("稳定快速版")) return "稳定快速版";
    if (name.includes("按秒线路")) return "按秒线路";
    const backup = name.match(/备用线路\s*(\d+)/);
    return backup ? `标准线路 ${backup[1]}` : name;
}

function ModelLabel({ config, model, info, hideRoutes = false }: { config: AiConfig; model: string; info?: ServerModelInfo; hideRoutes?: boolean }) {
    if (!info) {
        return (
            <span className="flex min-w-0 items-center gap-2">
                <ModelIcon model={model} />
                <span className="truncate">{modelOptionLabel(config, model)}</span>
            </span>
        );
    }
    const min = formatCredits(info.minCredits, info.capability === "video");
    const max = formatCredits(info.maxCredits, info.capability === "video");
    const price = info.routeCount || info.minCredits > 0 ? `${min === max ? min : `${min}–${max}`} 积分${info.unit === "second" ? "/秒" : info.unit === "request" ? "/次" : ""}` : "价格待定";
    return (
        <span className="flex min-w-0 flex-1 items-start gap-2.5">
            <ModelIcon model={model} icon={info.familyIcon} />
            <span className="min-w-0 flex-1">
                <span className="flex items-center justify-between gap-2">
                    <span className="truncate text-sm font-medium text-foreground">{info.name}</span>
                    <span className="shrink-0 text-[10px] tabular-nums text-muted-foreground">{price}</span>
                </span>
                {!hideRoutes && (info.description || info.routes.length > 0) && <span className="mt-0.5 block truncate text-[11px] text-muted-foreground">{info.description || info.routes.map((route) => route.channelName).join(" / ")}</span>}
                {!hideRoutes && <span className="mt-1 flex items-center gap-2">
                    <span className="text-[10px] text-muted-foreground">{info.routeCount ? `${info.routeCount} 条线路` : "即将上线"}</span>
                    <span className="flex items-center gap-1">
                        {info.routes.slice(0, 7).map((route) => (
                            <span key={route.id} title={route.channelName} className="size-1.5 rounded-full bg-green-500" />
                        ))}
                    </span>
                </span>}
            </span>
        </span>
    );
}

function formatCredits(value: number, integer = false) {
    if (integer) return `${Number.isInteger(value) ? "" : "约"}${Math.round(value)}`;
    return Number.isInteger(value) ? String(value) : String(Number(value.toFixed(2)));
}

function ModelIcon({ model, icon }: { model: string; icon?: string | null }) {
    const src = icon || resolveModelIcon(modelOptionName(model));
    return src ? <img src={src} alt="" className="mt-0.5 size-4 shrink-0 dark:invert" /> : <Cpu className="mt-0.5 size-4 shrink-0 opacity-70" />;
}

function resolveModelIcon(model: string) {
    const name = model.toLowerCase();
    if (name.includes("claude") || name.includes("anthropic")) return "/icons/claude.svg";
    if (name.includes("gemini") || name.includes("google")) return "/icons/gemini.svg";
    if (name.includes("gpt") || name.includes("openai")) return "/icons/openai.svg";
    if (name.includes("grok")) return "/icons/grok.svg";
    if (name.includes("deepseek")) return "/icons/deepseek.svg";
    if (name.includes("glm")) return "/icons/glm.svg";
    return "";
}

import { useEffect, useMemo, useState } from "react";
import { ChevronLeft, ChevronRight } from "lucide-react";

import { trackPromoClick, type PromoItem } from "@/services/api/promo";
import { usePromoAction } from "./use-promo-action";
import "./promo.css";

const FALLBACK_RATIO = 2.28;

export function PromoCarousel({ items, variant = "default" }: { items: PromoItem[]; variant?: "default" | "hero" }) {
    const action = usePromoAction();
    const [index, setIndex] = useState(0);
    const [failed, setFailed] = useState<Set<string>>(() => new Set());
    const [paused, setPaused] = useState(false);
    const [ratio, setRatio] = useState(FALLBACK_RATIO);
    const visible = useMemo(() => items.filter((item) => item.enabled), [items]);

    useEffect(() => {
        if (index >= visible.length) setIndex(0);
    }, [index, visible.length]);

    useEffect(() => {
        if (visible.length < 2 || paused) return;
        const timer = window.setInterval(() => setIndex((value) => (value + 1) % visible.length), 5000);
        return () => window.clearInterval(timer);
    }, [paused, visible.length]);

    if (!visible.length) return null;
    const current = Math.min(index, visible.length - 1);
    const item = visible[current];
    const previous = visible.length > 1 ? visible[(current - 1 + visible.length) % visible.length] : null;
    const next = visible.length > 1 ? visible[(current + 1) % visible.length] : null;

    const run = () => {
        void trackPromoClick({ placement: "carousel", itemId: item.id });
        action(item);
    };

    // 预加载相邻两张，点击切换时立即出图，避免“点了没反应”的慢加载错觉
    useEffect(() => {
        if (visible.length < 2) return;
        const neighbours = [visible[(current + 1) % visible.length], visible[(current - 1 + visible.length) % visible.length]];
        for (const entry of neighbours) {
            if (entry && !failed.has(entry.id)) {
                const img = new window.Image();
                img.src = entry.imageUrl;
            }
        }
    }, [current, visible, failed]);

    const image = (entry: PromoItem, hero: boolean) => (
        <picture>
            {entry.mobileImageUrl ? <source media="(max-width: 760px)" srcSet={entry.mobileImageUrl} /> : null}
            {failed.has(entry.id) ? (
                // 加载失败的图不再从轮播中剔除（否则切换会回落到同一张，看起来“点不动”），
                // 改为显示兜底占位，保证切换始终有可见反馈
                <span className={hero ? "promo-carousel-fallback is-hero" : "promo-carousel-fallback"}>{entry.title || entry.alt}</span>
            ) : (
                <img
                    key={entry.id}
                    className={hero ? "promo-carousel-hero-media" : "promo-carousel-media"}
                    src={entry.imageUrl}
                    alt={entry.alt}
                    onLoad={(event) => {
                        const value = event.currentTarget.naturalWidth / event.currentTarget.naturalHeight;
                        if (value > 0.5 && value < 6) setRatio(value);
                    }}
                    onError={() => {
                        setFailed((value) => new Set(value).add(entry.id));
                    }}
                />
            )}
        </picture>
    );

    // 右下角分页器：仅保留「02 / 03」计数（短横线指示条已按需求移除）
    const pager =
        visible.length > 1 ? (
            <div className="promo-carousel-pager">
                <span className="promo-carousel-count">
                    <b>{String(current + 1).padStart(2, "0")}</b>
                    <span className="promo-carousel-count-sep">/</span>
                    {String(visible.length).padStart(2, "0")}
                </span>
            </div>
        ) : null;

    if (variant === "hero") {
        return (
            <section
                className="promo-carousel is-hero"
                aria-label="首页轮播"
                onMouseEnter={() => setPaused(true)}
                onMouseLeave={() => setPaused(false)}
                onFocusCapture={() => setPaused(true)}
                onBlurCapture={() => setPaused(false)}
            >
                <div className="promo-carousel-stage" style={{ aspectRatio: ratio }}>
                    {previous ? (
                        <div className="promo-carousel-peek is-prev" aria-hidden>
                            <img src={previous.imageUrl} alt="" onError={(event) => { event.currentTarget.style.display = "none"; }} />
                        </div>
                    ) : null}
                    {next ? (
                        <div className="promo-carousel-peek is-next" aria-hidden>
                            <img src={next.imageUrl} alt="" onError={(event) => { event.currentTarget.style.display = "none"; }} />
                        </div>
                    ) : null}

                    <button type="button" className="promo-carousel-main" onClick={run} aria-label={item.alt}>
                        {image(item, true)}
                    </button>

                    {visible.length > 1 ? (
                        <button type="button" className="promo-carousel-arrow is-prev" aria-label="上一张" onClick={() => setIndex((value) => (value - 1 + visible.length) % visible.length)}>
                            <ChevronLeft className="size-4" />
                        </button>
                    ) : null}
                    {visible.length > 1 ? (
                        <button type="button" className="promo-carousel-arrow is-next" aria-label="下一张" onClick={() => setIndex((value) => (value + 1) % visible.length)}>
                            <ChevronRight className="size-4" />
                        </button>
                    ) : null}
                </div>

                {pager}
            </section>
        );
    }

    return (
        <section
            className="promo-carousel"
            aria-label="首页轮播"
            onMouseEnter={() => setPaused(true)}
            onMouseLeave={() => setPaused(false)}
            onFocusCapture={() => setPaused(true)}
            onBlurCapture={() => setPaused(false)}
        >
            <button type="button" className="promo-carousel-slide" onClick={run} aria-label={item.alt}>
                {image(item, false)}
            </button>

            {visible.length > 1 ? (
                <>
                    <button type="button" className="promo-carousel-arrow is-prev" aria-label="上一张" onClick={() => setIndex((value) => (value - 1 + visible.length) % visible.length)}>
                        <ChevronLeft className="size-4" />
                    </button>
                    <button type="button" className="promo-carousel-arrow is-next" aria-label="下一张" onClick={() => setIndex((value) => (value + 1) % visible.length)}>
                        <ChevronRight className="size-4" />
                    </button>
                    {pager}
                </>
            ) : null}
        </section>
    );
}

import { useEffect, useRef, useState } from "react";
import { useTranslation } from "react-i18next";
import { App, Image, Spin } from "antd";
import { Link2, Mail, MessageCircle, Phone, QrCode, Send, UsersRound, X } from "lucide-react";

import { loadPromoConfig, type PromoContact, type PromoContactChannel } from "@/services/api/promo";
import { usePromoContactAction } from "./use-promo-contact-action";
import "./promo.css";

const ICONS: Record<PromoContactChannel, typeof MessageCircle> = {
    wechat: MessageCircle,
    wechat_group: UsersRound,
    wecom: UsersRound,
    qq: MessageCircle,
    qq_group: UsersRound,
    email: Mail,
    phone: Phone,
    telegram: Send,
    whatsapp: MessageCircle,
    link: Link2,
};

export function PromoContactButton({ variant = "sidebar" }: { variant?: "sidebar" | "topbar" }) {
    const { t } = useTranslation();
    const { message } = App.useApp();
    const activate = usePromoContactAction();
    const wrapperRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
    const [contacts, setContacts] = useState<PromoContact[]>([]);
    const [available, setAvailable] = useState(false);
    const [open, setOpen] = useState(false);
    const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false);

    useEffect(() => {
        void loadPromoConfig()
            .then((data) => {
                setContacts(data.contacts);
                setAvailable(data.contacts.length > 0);
            })
            .catch(() => setAvailable(false));
    }, []);

    useEffect(() => {
        if (!open) return;
        const closeOutside = (event: PointerEvent) => {
            if (!wrapperRef.current?.contains(event.target as Node)) setOpen(false);
        };
        const closeEscape = (event: KeyboardEvent) => {
            if (event.key === "Escape") setOpen(false);
        };
        document.addEventListener("pointerdown", closeOutside);
        document.addEventListener("keydown", closeEscape);
        return () => {
            document.removeEventListener("pointerdown", closeOutside);
            document.removeEventListener("keydown", closeEscape);
        };
    }, [open]);

    async function toggle() {
        if (open) {
            setOpen(false);
            return;
        }
        setOpen(true);
        setLoading(true);
        try {
            const data = await loadPromoConfig();
            setContacts(data.contacts);
            setAvailable(data.contacts.length > 0);
        } catch (error) {
            message.error(error instanceof Error ? error.message : t("navigation.contactFetchError"));
        } finally {
            setLoading(false);
        }
    }

    if (!available) return null;

    return (
        <div ref={wrapperRef} className="relative">
            <button type="button" className={variant === "topbar" ? "promo-contact-link is-topbar" : "promo-contact-link mb-1"} onClick={() => void toggle()} aria-expanded={open}>
                <MessageCircle className="size-4 shrink-0" />
                <span>{t("navigation.contact")}</span>
            </button>
            {open ? (
                <div className={variant === "topbar" ? "promo-community-popover is-topbar" : "promo-community-popover"} role="dialog" aria-label={t("navigation.communityTitle")}>
                    <div className="promo-community-head">
                        <div>
                            <strong>{t("navigation.communityTitle")}</strong>
                            <span>{t("navigation.communitySubtitle")}</span>
                        </div>
                        <button type="button" className="promo-community-close" onClick={() => setOpen(false)} aria-label={t("navigation.close")}>
                            <X className="size-3.5" />
                        </button>
                    </div>
                    {loading ? (
                        <div className="grid min-h-32 place-items-center"><Spin size="small" /></div>
                    ) : (
                        <div className={contacts.length === 1 ? "promo-community-grid is-single" : "promo-community-grid"}>
                            {contacts.map((contact) => {
                                const Icon = ICONS[contact.channel] ?? QrCode;
                                return (
                                    <div key={contact.id} className="promo-community-card">
                                        <div className="promo-community-qr">
                                            {contact.qrUrl ? (
                                                <Image
                                                    src={contact.qrUrl}
                                                    alt={`${contact.name} 二维码`}
                                                    width="100%"
                                                    height="100%"
                                                    className="promo-community-image"
                                                    preview={{ mask: t("navigation.viewQr") }}
                                                />
                                            ) : (
                                                <span className="promo-community-placeholder"><Icon className="size-8" /></span>
                                            )}
                                        </div>
                                        <div className="promo-community-meta">
                                            <strong>{contact.name || t(`navigation.contactChannels.${contact.channel}`)}</strong>
                                            <span>{t(`navigation.contactChannels.${contact.channel}`)}</span>
                                            {contact.description ? <small>{contact.description}</small> : null}
                                        </div>
                                        {!contact.qrUrl ? (
                                            <button type="button" className="promo-community-action" onClick={() => activate(contact)}>
                                                {t("navigation.contactAction")}
                                            </button>
                                        ) : null}
                                    </div>
                                );
                            })}
                        </div>
                    )}
                    <div className="promo-community-foot">{t("navigation.communityFooter")}</div>
                </div>
            ) : null}
        </div>
    );
}

import { useEffect, useState } from "react";
import { Gift, X } from "lucide-react";

import { trackPromoClick, type PromoItem } from "@/services/api/promo";
import { canShowPromo, markPromoShown } from "./promo-frequency";
import { usePromoAction } from "./use-promo-action";
import "./promo.css";

const STORAGE_PREFIX = "sundas:promo:corner:";

/**
 * 右下角浮动卡片：只有文字和按钮的轻量引导位。
 * 频率按浏览器本地记录，和居中弹窗相互独立。
 * 关闭（X）只隐藏当次页面，不写入任何记录 —— 刷新后只要没到频率上限还会出现；
 * 频率只在用户真正点击（卡片主体 / CTA 按钮）时才写入。
 */
export function PromoCorner({ item, workbench = false }: { item: PromoItem | null; workbench?: boolean }) {
    const action = usePromoAction();
    const [open, setOpen] = useState(false);

    useEffect(() => {
        setOpen(false);
        if (!item || !canShowPromo(STORAGE_PREFIX, item)) return;
        const timer = window.setTimeout(() => setOpen(true), 900);
        return () => window.clearTimeout(timer);
    }, [item]);

    if (!item) return null;

    const clickable = item.actionType !== "none";

    const run = () => {
        markPromoShown(STORAGE_PREFIX, item);
        void trackPromoClick({ placement: "corner", itemId: item.id });
        if (clickable) action(item);
        setOpen(false);
    };

    return (
        <div className={`promo-corner${workbench ? " promo-corner--workbench" : ""}${open ? " is-open" : ""}`} role="dialog" aria-label={item.title || "活动提醒"}>
            <button
                type="button"
                className="promo-corner-close"
                onClick={() => setOpen(false)}
                aria-label="关闭"
            >
                <X className="size-3.5" />
            </button>
            <button type="button" className="promo-corner-body" onClick={run} disabled={!clickable}>
                <span className="promo-corner-icon" aria-hidden="true">
                    <Gift className="size-[19px]" strokeWidth={2.1} />
                </span>
                <span className="promo-corner-text">
                    <strong className="promo-corner-title">{item.title || "活动提醒"}</strong>
                    {item.description ? <span className="promo-corner-note">{item.description}</span> : null}
                </span>
            </button>
            {item.ctaLabel ? (
                <button type="button" className="promo-corner-cta" onClick={run} disabled={!clickable}>
                    {item.ctaLabel}
                </button>
            ) : null}
        </div>
    );
}

FILE: web/src/components/promo/promo-frequency.ts

import type { PromoItem } from "@/services/api/promo";

/**
 * 按浏览器本地记录判断是否应该展示。
 * visit = 每次都展示；session = 每个会话一次；daily = 每天一次；24h = 距上次至少 24 小时。
 */
export function canShowPromo(storagePrefix: string, item: PromoItem) {
    if (item.frequency === "visit") return true;
    if (item.frequency === "session") return sessionStorage.getItem(`${storagePrefix}${item.id}:session`) !== "1";
    if (item.frequency === "daily") return localStorage.getItem(`${storagePrefix}${item.id}:day`) !== new Date().toDateString();
    const last = Number(localStorage.getItem(`${storagePrefix}${item.id}:time`) ?? 0);
    return !last || Date.now() - last >= 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000;
}

export function markPromoShown(storagePrefix: string, item: PromoItem) {
    if (item.frequency === "visit") return;
    if (item.frequency === "session") {
        sessionStorage.setItem(`${storagePrefix}${item.id}:session`, "1");
        return;
    }
    if (item.frequency === "daily") {
        localStorage.setItem(`${storagePrefix}${item.id}:day`, new Date().toDateString());
        return;
    }
    localStorage.setItem(`${storagePrefix}${item.id}:time`, String(Date.now()));
}
