import { useEffect, useState } from "react";
import { Modal } from "antd";
import { ArrowRight, X } from "lucide-react";

import { trackPromoClick, type PromoItem } from "@/services/api/promo";
import { canShowPromo, markPromoShown } from "./promo-frequency";
import { useCountdown } from "./use-countdown";
import { usePromoAction } from "./use-promo-action";
import "./promo.css";

const STORAGE_PREFIX = "sundas:promo:popup:";

function pad(value: number) {
    return String(value).padStart(2, "0");
}

export function PromoPopup({ item }: { item: PromoItem | null }) {
    const action = usePromoAction();
    const [open, setOpen] = useState(false);
    const [imageFailed, setImageFailed] = useState(false);
    const countdown = useCountdown(open ? (item?.countdownAt ?? null) : null);
    const lines = (item?.description ?? "")
        .split(/\r?\n/)
        .map((line) => line.trim())
        .filter(Boolean);
    const clickable = Boolean(item && item.ctaLabel.trim() && item.actionType !== "none");
    const hasBody = lines.length > 0 || clickable;

    useEffect(() => {
        setOpen(false);
        setImageFailed(false);
        if (!item || !canShowPromo(STORAGE_PREFIX, item)) return;
        if (item.countdownAt && new Date(item.countdownAt).getTime() <= Date.now()) return;
        const timer = window.setTimeout(() => {
            markPromoShown(STORAGE_PREFIX, item);
            setOpen(true);
        }, 1200);
        return () => window.clearTimeout(timer);
    }, [item]);

    useEffect(() => {
        if (countdown?.expired) setOpen(false);
    }, [countdown?.expired]);

    if (!item) return null;

    const showImage = Boolean(item.imageUrl) && !imageFailed;
    const showCard = showImage || hasBody;

    const run = () => {
        void trackPromoClick({ placement: "popup", itemId: item.id });
        action(item);
        setOpen(false);
    };

    return (
        <Modal
            open={open && showCard}
            onCancel={() => setOpen(false)}
            footer={null}
            centered
            width={520}
            closable={false}
            className="promo-popup-modal"
            styles={{
                container: { padding: 0, background: "transparent", boxShadow: "none" },
                body: { padding: 0 },
                mask: { background: "rgba(8, 7, 6, 0.66)", backdropFilter: "blur(6px)" },
            }}
        >
            <div className={`promo-popup-card${showImage ? "" : " is-text-only"}`}>
                <button type="button" className="promo-popup-close" onClick={() => setOpen(false)} aria-label="关闭">
                    <X className="size-4" />
                </button>
                {showImage ? (
                    <div className={`promo-popup-hero${item.mobileImageUrl ? " has-mobile-art" : ""}`}>
                        <picture>
                            {item.mobileImageUrl ? <source media="(max-width: 760px)" srcSet={item.mobileImageUrl} /> : null}
                            <img
                                src={item.imageUrl}
                                alt={item.alt || item.title}
                                onError={() => {
                                    setImageFailed(true);
                                    if (!hasBody) setOpen(false);
                                }}
                            />
                        </picture>
                    </div>
                ) : null}
                {hasBody ? (
                    <div className="promo-popup-body">
                        {countdown && !countdown.expired ? (
                            <div className="promo-popup-timer" aria-label="活动倒计时">
                                <span>距结束</span>
                                <b>{pad(countdown.days)}</b>
                                <i>:</i>
                                <b>{pad(countdown.hours)}</b>
                                <i>:</i>
                                <b>{pad(countdown.minutes)}</b>
                                <i>:</i>
                                <b>{pad(countdown.seconds)}</b>
                            </div>
                        ) : null}
                        {item.title ? <h2 className="promo-popup-title">{item.title}</h2> : null}
                        {lines.length > 1 ? (
                            <ul className="promo-popup-points">
                                {lines.map((line) => (
                                    <li key={line}>
                                        <span className="promo-popup-point-mark" aria-hidden />
                                        {line}
                                    </li>
                                ))}
                            </ul>
                        ) : lines.length === 1 ? (
                            <p className="promo-popup-description">{lines[0]}</p>
                        ) : null}
                        {clickable ? (
                            <button type="button" className="promo-popup-cta" onClick={run}>
                                <span>{item.ctaLabel}</span>
                                <ArrowRight className="size-4" />
                            </button>
                        ) : null}
                    </div>
                ) : null}
            </div>
        </Modal>
    );
}

import { useEffect, useState } from "react";
import { X } from "lucide-react";

import { trackPromoClick, type PromoItem } from "@/services/api/promo";
import { useCountdown } from "./use-countdown";
import { usePromoAction } from "./use-promo-action";
import "./promo.css";

export function PromoTopBar({ item }: { item: PromoItem | null }) {
    const action = usePromoAction();
    const [closed, setClosed] = useState(false);
    const countdown = useCountdown(item?.countdownAt ?? null);

    useEffect(() => {
        if (!item) return;
        setClosed(sessionStorage.getItem(`sundas:promo:topbar:${item.id}`) === "1");
    }, [item]);

    if (!item || closed || countdown?.expired) return null;

    const clickable = item.actionType !== "none";
    const run = () => {
        if (!clickable) return;
        void trackPromoClick({ placement: "topbar", itemId: item.id });
        action(item);
    };

    return (
        <div className={clickable ? "promo-topbar is-clickable" : "promo-topbar"}>
            <div
                className="promo-topbar-inner"
                role={clickable ? "link" : undefined}
                tabIndex={clickable ? 0 : undefined}
                onClick={run}
                onKeyDown={(event) => {
                    if (!clickable) return;
                    if (event.key === "Enter" || event.key === " ") {
                        event.preventDefault();
                        run();
                    }
                }}
            >
                {countdown ? (
                    <span className="promo-topbar-countdown" aria-label="活动倒计时">
                        <b key={`d-${countdown.days}`}>{String(countdown.days).padStart(2, "0")}</b><em>:</em>
                        <b key={`h-${countdown.hours}`}>{String(countdown.hours).padStart(2, "0")}</b><em>:</em>
                        <b key={`m-${countdown.minutes}`}>{String(countdown.minutes).padStart(2, "0")}</b><em>:</em>
                        <b key={`s-${countdown.seconds}`}>{String(countdown.seconds).padStart(2, "0")}</b>
                    </span>
                ) : null}
                <span className="promo-topbar-text">{item.title}</span>
                {item.ctaLabel && clickable ? <span className="promo-topbar-cta">{item.ctaLabel}</span> : null}
            </div>
            <button
                type="button"
                className="promo-topbar-close"
                aria-label="关闭活动条"
                onClick={(event) => {
                    event.stopPropagation();
                    sessionStorage.setItem(`sundas:promo:topbar:${item.id}`, "1");
                    setClosed(true);
                }}
            >
                <X className="size-3.5" />
            </button>
        </div>
    );
}

FILE: web/src/components/promo/use-countdown.ts

import { useEffect, useMemo, useState } from "react";

/** Live countdown for promo campaigns; returns null when no deadline is configured. */
export function useCountdown(value: string | null) {
    const end = useMemo(() => (value ? new Date(value).getTime() : null), [value]);
    const [now, setNow] = useState(() => Date.now());

    useEffect(() => {
        if (!end) return;
        setNow(Date.now());
        const timer = window.setInterval(() => setNow(Date.now()), 1000);
        return () => window.clearInterval(timer);
    }, [end]);

    if (!end) return null;
    const remaining = Math.max(0, end - now);
    return {
        expired: remaining <= 0,
        days: Math.floor(remaining / 86_400_000),
        hours: Math.floor((remaining % 86_400_000) / 3_600_000),
        minutes: Math.floor((remaining % 3_600_000) / 60_000),
        seconds: Math.floor((remaining % 60_000) / 1000),
    };
}

FILE: web/src/components/promo/use-promo-action.ts

import copy from "copy-to-clipboard";
import { App } from "antd";
import { useNavigate } from "react-router-dom";
import { useTranslation } from "react-i18next";

import { usePromoContactStore } from "@/stores/use-promo-contact-store";
import type { PromoItem } from "@/services/api/promo";

export function usePromoAction() {
    const navigate = useNavigate();
    const { message } = App.useApp();
    const { t } = useTranslation();
    const openContact = usePromoContactStore((state) => state.openDialog);

    return (item: Pick<PromoItem, "actionType" | "actionValue">) => {
        if (item.actionType === "none") return;
        if (item.actionType === "internal") {
            navigate(item.actionValue);
            return;
        }
        if (item.actionType === "external") {
            window.open(item.actionValue, "_blank", "noopener,noreferrer");
            return;
        }
        if (item.actionType === "contact") {
            openContact();
            return;
        }
        copy(item.actionValue);
        message.success(t("common.copied"));
    };
}

FILE: web/src/components/promo/use-promo-contact-action.ts

import copy from "copy-to-clipboard";
import { App } from "antd";

import { trackPromoClick, type PromoContact } from "@/services/api/promo";

export function usePromoContactAction() {
    const { message } = App.useApp();

    return (contact: PromoContact) => {
        void trackPromoClick({ placement: "contact", contactId: contact.id });
        if (!contact.value) return;
        if (contact.channel === "email") {
            window.location.href = `mailto:${contact.value}`;
            return;
        }
        if (contact.channel === "phone") {
            window.location.href = `tel:${contact.value.replace(/[^\d+]/g, "")}`;
            return;
        }
        if (contact.channel === "link") {
            window.open(contact.value, "_blank", "noopener,noreferrer");
            return;
        }
        if (contact.channel === "whatsapp" && !contact.value.startsWith("http")) {
            window.open(`https://wa.me/${contact.value.replace(/\D/g, "")}`, "_blank", "noopener,noreferrer");
            return;
        }
        if (contact.channel === "telegram" && !contact.value.startsWith("http") && !contact.value.startsWith("@")) {
            window.open(`https://t.me/${contact.value}`, "_blank", "noopener,noreferrer");
            return;
        }
        copy(contact.value);
        message.success("已复制");
    };
}

FILE: web/src/components/prompt-optimize-button.tsx

import type { CSSProperties } from "react";
import { useEffect, useRef } from "react";
import { App, Button, Tooltip } from "antd";
import { Sparkle } from "lucide-react";
import { useTranslation } from "react-i18next";

import { usePromptOptimizer } from "@/hooks/use-prompt-optimizer";
import { modelOptionName } from "@/stores/use-config-store";
import { ApiError } from "@/services/api/client";
import { cn } from "@/lib/utils";
import type { PromptOptimizerCapability } from "@/services/api/prompt-optimizer";

type Props = {
    prompt: string;
    model: string;
    capability: PromptOptimizerCapability;
    onOptimized: (next: string) => void;
    disabled?: boolean;
    className?: string;
    style?: CSSProperties;
};

export function PromptOptimizeButton({ prompt, model, capability, onOptimized, disabled, className, style }: Props) {
    const { t } = useTranslation();
    const { message } = App.useApp();
    const { optimize, optimizing, cancel } = usePromptOptimizer();
    const promptRef = useRef(prompt);
    promptRef.current = prompt;

    useEffect(() => {
        cancel();
    }, [prompt, model, capability, cancel]);

    const run = async () => {
        const original = prompt.trim();
        if (!original || !model || optimizing) return;
        try {
            const result = await optimize({ prompt: original, model: modelOptionName(model), capability });
            if (promptRef.current.trim() !== original) {
                message.warning(t("common.optimizePromptChanged"));
                return;
            }
            onOptimized(result.prompt);
            message.open({
                type: "success",
                duration: 6,
                content: (
                    <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-2">
                        {t("common.optimizePromptApplied", { credits: result.creditsCharged })}
                        <Button
                            type="link"
                            size="small"
                            className="!h-auto !p-0"
                            onClick={() => {
                                if (promptRef.current === result.prompt) onOptimized(original);
                            }}
                        >
                            {t("common.optimizePromptUndo")}
                        </Button>
                    </span>
                ),
            });
        } catch (error) {
            if (error instanceof Error && error.name === "AbortError") return;
            if (error instanceof ApiError && error.status === 402) {
                message.error(t("common.optimizePromptInsufficientCredits"));
            } else if (error instanceof ApiError && error.status === 503) {
                message.error(t("common.optimizePromptUnavailable"));
            } else if (error instanceof ApiError && error.status === 429) {
                message.error(t("common.optimizePromptRateLimited"));
            } else {
                message.error(error instanceof Error ? error.message : t("common.optimizePromptFailed"));
            }
        }
    };

    const blocked = disabled || !prompt.trim() || !model || optimizing;
    return (
        <Tooltip title={blocked && !optimizing ? t("common.optimizePromptHint") : t("common.optimizePrompt")}>
            <Button
                type="text"
                shape="circle"
                size="small"
                loading={optimizing}
                disabled={blocked}
                aria-label={t("common.optimizePrompt")}
                className={cn(
                    "!absolute !bottom-2 !right-2 z-10 !h-7 !w-7 !min-w-7 !rounded-full !p-0 border border-border/60 bg-background/80 shadow-sm backdrop-blur transition hover:bg-muted",
                    className,
                )}
                style={style}
                icon={optimizing ? undefined : <Sparkle className="size-3.5" />}
                onMouseDown={(event) => event.stopPropagation()}
                onPointerDown={(event) => event.stopPropagation()}
                onClick={() => void run()}
            />
        </Tooltip>
    );
}

import { useEffect, useMemo, useState } from "react";
import { ImageOff } from "lucide-react";

import { BrandName } from "@/components/brand/brand-wordmark";
import { promptImageUrl } from "@/lib/prompt-image";

// 封面占位：只用四档深灰 + 极弱蓝色倾向，避免彩虹渐变（即梦规范）
const GRADIENTS = [
    "linear-gradient(135deg, #232323 0%, #1a1a1a 62%, #151515 100%)",
    "linear-gradient(160deg, #1f1f1f 0%, #191919 55%, #212121 100%)",
    "linear-gradient(120deg, rgba(216,255,62,0.10) 0%, #1a1a1a 58%, #141414 100%)",
    "linear-gradient(200deg, #202020 0%, #171717 60%, #1f1f1f 100%)",
    "linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(0,202,224,0.08) 0%, #1b1b1b 60%, #131313 100%)",
    "linear-gradient(180deg, #222222 0%, #181818 70%, #121212 100%)",
    "linear-gradient(115deg, #1d1d1d 0%, #232323 50%, #171717 100%)",
    "linear-gradient(150deg, rgba(255,255,255,0.06) 0%, #1a1a1a 55%, #141414 100%)",
];

export function PromptCover({ src, alt, className = "", compact = false }: { src?: string; alt: string; className?: string; compact?: boolean }) {
    const [failed, setFailed] = useState(false);
    useEffect(() => setFailed(false), [src]);

    const url = promptImageUrl(src);
    const gradient = useMemo(() => {
        const seed = Array.from(alt).reduce((sum, char) => sum + (char.codePointAt(0) ?? 0), 0);
        return GRADIENTS[seed % GRADIENTS.length];
    }, [alt]);

    if (!url || failed) {
        return (
            <div className={`relative grid w-full place-items-center overflow-hidden ${className}`} style={{ backgroundImage: gradient }} role="img" aria-label={alt}>
                <div
                    className="absolute inset-0 opacity-40"
                    style={{
                        backgroundImage:
                            "radial-gradient(circle at 20% 15%, rgba(255,255,255,.55), transparent 42%), radial-gradient(circle at 85% 80%, rgba(255,255,255,.35), transparent 45%)",
                    }}
                />
                <div className="relative flex flex-col items-center gap-1 px-3 text-center">
                    {compact ? <ImageOff className="size-4 text-white/70" /> : <span className="text-3xl font-semibold text-white/85">{alt.slice(0, 1)}</span>}
                    {compact ? null : <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-1 text-[10px] font-medium uppercase tracking-[0.25em] text-white/60"><BrandName text="sundas" imageClassName="opacity-60" imageHeight="0.95em" />prompt</span>}
                </div>
            </div>
        );
    }

    return <img src={url} alt={alt} className={className} loading="lazy" decoding="async" referrerPolicy="no-referrer" onError={() => setFailed(true)} />;
}

import { Search } from "lucide-react";
import { type UIEvent, useEffect, useState } from "react";
import { App, Button, Empty, Input, Modal, Spin, Tag } from "antd";
import { useTranslation } from "react-i18next";

import { ALL_PROMPTS_OPTION } from "@/services/api/prompts";
import { cn } from "@/lib/utils";
import { PromptCard } from "./prompt-card";
import { usePromptList } from "./use-prompt-list";

export function PromptSelectDialog({ open, onOpenChange, onSelect }: { open: boolean; onOpenChange: (open: boolean) => void; onSelect: (prompt: string) => void }) {
    const { message } = App.useApp();
    const { t } = useTranslation();
    const [keyword, setKeyword] = useState("");
    const [selectedTags, setSelectedTags] = useState<string[]>([]);
    const [selectedCategory, setSelectedCategory] = useState(ALL_PROMPTS_OPTION);
    const { query, items, tags: promptTags, categories: promptCategories } = usePromptList({ keyword, tags: selectedTags, category: selectedCategory, enabled: open });
    const toggleTag = (tag: string) => {
        if (tag === ALL_PROMPTS_OPTION) return setSelectedTags([]);
        setSelectedTags((items) => (items.includes(tag) ? items.filter((item) => item !== tag) : [...items, tag]));
    };
    const selectPrompt = (prompt: string) => {
        onSelect(prompt);
        onOpenChange(false);
    };

    useEffect(() => {
        if (query.isError) message.error(query.error instanceof Error ? query.error.message : t("prompts.loadFailed"));
    }, [message, query.error, query.isError, t]);

    const handleListScroll = (event: UIEvent<HTMLDivElement>) => {
        const target = event.currentTarget;
        if (query.hasNextPage && !query.isFetching && !query.isFetchNextPageError && target.scrollTop + target.clientHeight >= target.scrollHeight - 160) void query.fetchNextPage();
    };

    return (
        <Modal title={t("prompts.library")} open={open} onCancel={() => onOpenChange(false)} footer={null} width={880} centered>
            <div className="grid h-[62dvh] min-h-0 gap-5 sm:grid-cols-[200px_minmax(0,1fr)]" data-canvas-no-zoom onWheelCapture={(event) => event.stopPropagation()}>
                <aside className="thin-scrollbar min-h-0 overflow-y-auto border-r border-border pr-4 dark:border-border">
                    <div className="mb-2 text-xs font-semibold uppercase tracking-widest text-muted-foreground">{t("prompts.category")}</div>
                    <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-1.5">
                        {promptCategories.map((category) => (
                            <Tag.CheckableTag key={category} checked={selectedCategory === category} className={cn("prompt-filter-tag", selectedCategory === category && "is-active")} onChange={() => setSelectedCategory(category)}>
                                {category === ALL_PROMPTS_OPTION ? t("common.all") : category}
                            </Tag.CheckableTag>
                        ))}
                    </div>
                    <div className="mb-2 mt-5 text-xs font-semibold uppercase tracking-widest text-muted-foreground">{t("prompts.tags")}</div>
                    <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-1.5">
                        {promptTags.map((tag) => {
                            const active = tag === ALL_PROMPTS_OPTION ? selectedTags.length === 0 : selectedTags.includes(tag);
                            return (
                                <Tag.CheckableTag key={tag} checked={active} className={cn("prompt-filter-tag", active && "is-active")} onChange={() => toggleTag(tag)}>
                                    {tag === ALL_PROMPTS_OPTION ? t("common.all") : tag}
                                </Tag.CheckableTag>
                            );
                        })}
                    </div>
                </aside>
                <section className="flex min-h-0 min-w-0 flex-col">
                    <Input size="large" prefix={<Search className="size-4 text-muted-foreground" />} value={keyword} onChange={(event) => setKeyword(event.target.value)} placeholder={t("prompts.searchTitle")} />
                    <div className="thin-scrollbar mt-4 min-h-0 flex-1 overflow-y-auto pr-2" data-canvas-no-zoom onScroll={handleListScroll} onWheelCapture={(event) => event.stopPropagation()}>
                        {query.isLoading ? (
                            <div className="flex h-40 items-center justify-center">
                                <Spin />
                            </div>
                        ) : null}
                        <div className="grid gap-3 sm:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-5">
                            {items.map((item) => (
                                <PromptCard key={item.id} item={item} onOpen={() => selectPrompt(item.prompt)} onCopy={() => selectPrompt(item.prompt)} compact />
                            ))}
                        </div>
                        {!query.isLoading && items.length === 0 ? <Empty image={Empty.PRESENTED_IMAGE_SIMPLE} description={t("prompts.empty")} className="py-8" /> : null}
                        {query.hasNextPage ? (
                            <div className="py-4 text-center">
                                <Button type="text" loading={query.isFetchingNextPage} onClick={() => void query.fetchNextPage()}>{query.isFetchNextPageError ? t("canvas.sidePanel.loadFailedRetry") : t("prompts.loadMore")}</Button>
                            </div>
                        ) : null}
                    </div>
                </section>
            </div>
        </Modal>
    );
}

FILE: web/src/components/prompts/prompt-video-cover.tsx

import { useEffect, useRef, useState } from "react";

/**
 * 视频封面：默认显示视频首帧（#t=0.5 避免黑帧），hover 时静音自动播放，移开后暂停并回到封面帧。
 * 用于灵感大厅等卡片场景，无需额外点击即可预览。
 */
export function PromptVideoCover({ src, poster, alt, className = "" }: { src: string; poster?: string; alt: string; className?: string }) {
    const ref = useRef<HTMLVideoElement>(null);
    const hovered = useRef(false);
    const [loadedSrc, setLoadedSrc] = useState<string>();
    // #t=0.5：让 preload="metadata" 停在前半秒，避免部分视频首帧为黑屏
    const srcWithFrame = src.includes("#") ? src : `${src}#t=0.5`;

    useEffect(() => {
        const video = ref.current;
        if (!video) return;
        const observer = new IntersectionObserver(entries => {
            if (entries.some(entry => entry.isIntersecting)) {
                setLoadedSrc(src);
                observer.disconnect();
            }
        }, { rootMargin: "200px" });
        observer.observe(video);
        return () => {
            observer.disconnect();
            hovered.current = false;
            video.pause();
        };
    }, [src]);

    const start = () => {
        const video = ref.current;
        if (!video || !hovered.current) return;
        // 浏览器只允许静音自动播放；这里再强制一次，避免 muted 未生效导致 play() 被拒绝
        video.muted = true;
        void video.play()?.catch(() => undefined);
    };

    return (
        <video
            ref={ref}
            src={loadedSrc === src ? srcWithFrame : undefined}
            poster={poster || undefined}
            muted
            loop
            playsInline
            preload="metadata"
            aria-label={alt}
            className={className}
            onMouseEnter={() => { hovered.current = true; setLoadedSrc(src); start(); }}
            onLoadedData={start}
            onPlay={() => { if (!hovered.current) ref.current?.pause(); }}
            onMouseLeave={() => {
                hovered.current = false;
                const video = ref.current;
                if (!video) return;
                video.pause();
                try {
                    video.currentTime = 0.5;
                } catch {
                    /* metadata 未就绪时忽略 */
                }
            }}
        />
    );
}

FILE: web/src/components/prompts/use-prompt-list.ts

import { useEffect, useMemo, useState } from "react";
import { useInfiniteQuery } from "@tanstack/react-query";

import { ALL_PROMPTS_OPTION, fetchPrompts } from "@/services/api/prompts";

export const PROMPT_PAGE_SIZE = 20;

export function usePromptList({ keyword, tags = [], category = ALL_PROMPTS_OPTION, sourceId, metadata = true, enabled = true }: { keyword: string; tags?: string[]; category?: string; sourceId?: string; metadata?: boolean; enabled?: boolean }) {
    const [debouncedKeyword, setDebouncedKeyword] = useState(keyword);
    useEffect(() => {
        const timer = setTimeout(() => setDebouncedKeyword(keyword), 300);
        return () => clearTimeout(timer);
    }, [keyword]);
    const query = useInfiniteQuery({
        queryKey: ["prompts", debouncedKeyword, [...tags].sort(), category, sourceId, metadata],
        queryFn: ({ pageParam, signal }) => fetchPrompts({ keyword: debouncedKeyword, tag: tags, category, sourceId, page: pageParam, pageSize: PROMPT_PAGE_SIZE, metadata: metadata && pageParam === 1, signal }),
        initialPageParam: 1,
        getNextPageParam: (lastPage) => (lastPage.hasMore && lastPage.items.length ? lastPage.page + 1 : undefined),
        enabled: enabled && keyword.trim() === debouncedKeyword.trim(),
    });
    const firstPage = query.data?.pages[0];
    return {
        query,
        items: useMemo(() => query.data?.pages.flatMap((page) => page.items) || [], [query.data?.pages]),
        tags: useMemo(() => [ALL_PROMPTS_OPTION, ...(firstPage?.tags || [])], [firstPage?.tags]),
        categories: useMemo(() => [ALL_PROMPTS_OPTION, ...(firstPage?.categories || [])], [firstPage?.categories]),
        total: firstPage?.total || 0,
    };
}

import { useState, type ButtonHTMLAttributes, type ReactNode } from "react";

import { cn } from "@/lib/utils";

/**
 * Switch — 开关（自研，button role=switch，无依赖）。
 *
 * 设计约束（对齐 ui/README 与 ADR-0008）：
 * - <button type="button" role="switch" aria-checked> 承载语义与键盘（Space/Enter 原生），
 *   :focus-visible outline 落自身；无裸色、只消费三层 token。
 * - 开 = bg-foreground + 反色 thumb（bg-background 语义对齐 Checkbox 选中态），
 *   关 = bg-surface-tertiary + 发丝内描边 + surface-strong 抬升 thumb（同 SegmentedControl 选中面）。
 * - thumb 滑动用 translate-x 位移（尺寸档固定行程），motion-reduce 关闭过渡。
 * - data-state="on|off" 暴露给上下文 CSS 覆盖（admin 语义绿等保留于页面层，不侵入组件）。
 * - API 对齐 AntD Switch：checked/defaultChecked/onChange/disabled/size/checkedChildren/
 *   unCheckedChildren/loading + aria-* 透传；受控与否由 checked 是否传入决定，
 *   onChange(checked) 单参。顶层组件接收 checked/onChange → Form.Item valuePropName="checked" 注入兼容。
 * 对标：AntD Switch；boardui base/switch。
 */

export interface SwitchProps extends Omit<ButtonHTMLAttributes<HTMLButtonElement>, "type" | "size" | "onChange"> {
    /** 开关尺寸。默认 md；AntD small → sm 映射。 */
    size?: "sm" | "md";
    /** 受控：是否开启 */
    checked?: boolean;
    /** 非受控初始值 */
    defaultChecked?: boolean;
    /** loading：拇指位换转圈，忽略点击（视觉保留 checked 态） */
    loading?: boolean;
    /** 开启时轨道内左侧文案（2 字宽度档） */
    checkedChildren?: ReactNode;
    /** 关闭时轨道内右侧文案 */
    unCheckedChildren?: ReactNode;
    /** 变化回调（AntD 同签名：仅布尔参） */
    onChange?: (checked: boolean) => void;
}

/** 几何档：轨道尺寸与 thumb 行程（thumb 用 left-0.5 起始 + translate-x 档位） */
const SWITCH_SIZE: Record<"sm" | "md", { root: string; thumbPlain: string; thumbText: string; hasTextRoot: string }> = {
    sm: {
        root: "h-5 w-8 rounded-full",
        thumbPlain: "size-3.5 data-[state=on]:translate-x-3.5",
        thumbText: "size-3.5 data-[state=on]:translate-x-3.5",
        hasTextRoot: "",
    },
    md: {
        root: "h-6 w-11 rounded-full",
        thumbPlain: "size-4 data-[state=on]:translate-x-6",
        thumbText: "size-4 data-[state=on]:translate-x-9",
        hasTextRoot: "w-14",
    },
};

export function Switch({ size = "md", checked: checkedProp, defaultChecked = false, loading = false, checkedChildren, unCheckedChildren, onChange, disabled, className, "aria-label": ariaLabel, ...props }: SwitchProps) {
    const [innerChecked, setInnerChecked] = useState(defaultChecked);
    const controlled = checkedProp !== undefined;
    const checked = controlled ? checkedProp : innerChecked;
    const hasText = checkedChildren !== undefined || unCheckedChildren !== undefined;

    const handleClick = () => {
        if (disabled || loading) {
            return;
        }
        const next = !checked;
        if (!controlled) {
            setInnerChecked(next);
        }
        onChange?.(next);
    };

    const geometry = SWITCH_SIZE[size];
    const thumbClass = hasText ? geometry.thumbText : geometry.thumbPlain;

    return (
        <button
            type="button"
            role="switch"
            data-slot="switch"
            data-state={checked ? "on" : "off"}
            aria-checked={checked}
            aria-label={ariaLabel}
            aria-busy={loading || undefined}
            disabled={disabled}
            onClick={handleClick}
            className={cn(
                "relative inline-flex shrink-0 select-none items-center align-middle transition-colors motion-reduce:transition-none",
                "data-[state=on]:bg-foreground",
                "data-[state=off]:bg-surface-tertiary data-[state=off]:ring-1 data-[state=off]:ring-inset data-[state=off]:ring-foreground/15",
                "focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-ring focus-visible:ring-offset-1 focus-visible:ring-offset-background",
                "disabled:cursor-not-allowed disabled:opacity-45",
                geometry.root,
                hasText && size === "md" && geometry.hasTextRoot,
                className,
            )}
            {...props}
        >
            {/* 关态文案（右侧） */}
            {unCheckedChildren !== undefined ? (
                <span
                    aria-hidden="true"
                    className={cn("absolute top-1/2 right-1.5 -translate-y-1/2 text-xs leading-none font-medium transition-opacity motion-reduce:transition-none", checked ? "text-foreground/55 opacity-0" : "text-foreground/55 opacity-100")}
                >
                    {unCheckedChildren}
                </span>
            ) : null}
            {/* 开态文案（左侧，反色） */}
            {checkedChildren !== undefined ? (
                <span aria-hidden="true" className={cn("absolute top-1/2 left-1.5 -translate-y-1/2 text-xs leading-none font-medium transition-opacity motion-reduce:transition-none", checked ? "text-background opacity-100" : "text-background opacity-0")}>
                    {checkedChildren}
                </span>
            ) : null}
            {/* thumb / loading 转圈 */}
            {loading ? (
                <span aria-hidden="true" className={cn("absolute inset-0 m-auto size-3.5 animate-spin rounded-full border-[1.5px] border-current border-t-transparent", checked ? "text-background" : "text-foreground/60")} />
            ) : (
                <span
                    aria-hidden="true"
                    data-state={checked ? "on" : "off"}
                    className={cn("sc-switch-thumb absolute left-0.5 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 rounded-full border border-border/80 bg-surface-strong transition-transform duration-200 ease-out motion-reduce:transition-none", thumbClass)}
                />
            )}
        </button>
    );
}

import type { ReactNode } from "react";
import { Tooltip as AntTooltip } from "antd";

export type TooltipPlacement = "top" | "bottom" | "left" | "right" | "topLeft" | "topRight" | "bottomLeft" | "bottomRight";

export type TooltipProps = {
    title?: ReactNode;
    placement?: TooltipPlacement;
    children: ReactNode;
};

/**
 * Tooltip — 气泡提示（sundas 版）。
 *
 * BeefTV 用的是 react-aria-components 自研浮层；sundas 没有这个依赖，
 * 这里落到已有的 antd Tooltip 上，保持同名同 props（title / placement / children），
 * 调用方零改动。title 为空时不渲染浮层，与 BeefTV 行为一致。
 */
export function Tooltip({ title, placement = "top", children }: TooltipProps) {
    if (title === undefined || title === null || title === "") return <>{children}</>;
    return (
        <AntTooltip title={title} placement={placement} mouseEnterDelay={0.2}>
            {children}
        </AntTooltip>
    );
}

/**
 * 优化后的图片组件 - 带懒加载和骨架屏
 */
import { useState } from "react";
import "../loading/skeleton.css";

interface OptimizedImageProps {
    src: string;
    alt: string;
    className?: string;
    width?: number;
    height?: number;
    aspectRatio?: string;
}

export function OptimizedImage({
    src,
    alt,
    className = "",
    width,
    height,
    aspectRatio = "16/9"
}: OptimizedImageProps) {
    const [loaded, setLoaded] = useState(false);
    const [error, setError] = useState(false);

    return (
        <div
            className={`relative overflow-hidden ${className}`}
            style={{ aspectRatio }}
        >
            {/* 骨架屏 - 图片加载时显示 */}
            {!loaded && !error && (
                <div className="skeleton skeleton-media absolute inset-0" />
            )}

            {/* 错误状态 */}
            {error && (
                <div className="absolute inset-0 flex items-center justify-center bg-black/20">
                    <span className="text-xs text-white/60">加载失败</span>
                </div>
            )}

            {/* 实际图片 */}
            <img
                src={src}
                alt={alt}
                width={width}
                height={height}
                loading="lazy"
                decoding="async"
                className={`w-full h-full object-cover transition-opacity duration-300 ${
                    loaded ? "opacity-100" : "opacity-0"
                }`}
                onLoad={() => setLoaded(true)}
                onError={() => {
                    setLoaded(false);
                    setError(true);
                }}
            />
        </div>
    );
}

/**
 * 使用示例：
 *
 * <OptimizedImage
 *     src={item.coverUrl}
 *     alt={item.title}
 *     className="home-prompt-cover"
 *     aspectRatio="16/9"
 * />
 */

import { type ReactNode, useEffect } from "react";
import { Slider } from "antd";
import { useTranslation } from "react-i18next";

import i18n from "@/i18n";
import { ImageSettingsTheme } from "@/components/image-settings-panel";
import { type CanvasTheme } from "@/lib/canvas-theme";
import { clampVideoSecondsToRange, computeVideoSize, formatVideoResolution, inferVideoRatio, parseVideoResolution, readVideoDimensions, videoRatioOptions, videoResolutionOptionsFromMap, videoSecondsRangeForDurations } from "@/lib/media-size";
import { modelOptionName, type AiConfig, useConfigStore } from "@/stores/use-config-store";

const videoModeOptions = [
    { value: "frames", labelKey: "frames" },
    { value: "reference", labelKey: "reference" },
];

export const videoResolutionOptions = videoResolutionOptionsFromMap();
export const videoSizeOptions = videoRatioOptions.map((item) => ({ value: item.value, get label() { return item.value === "auto" ? i18n.t("settingsPanels.common.auto") : item.value; } }));

type VideoSettingsPanelProps = {
    config: AiConfig;
    model?: string;
    onConfigChange: (key: "vquality" | "size" | "videoSeconds" | "videoGenerateAudio" | "videoWatermark" | "videoMode", value: string) => void;
    theme: CanvasTheme;
    showTitle?: boolean;
    className?: string;
};

export function VideoSettingsPanel({ config, model, onConfigChange, theme, showTitle = true, className = "w-[320px] space-y-4 rounded-2xl px-1 py-0.5" }: VideoSettingsPanelProps) {
    const { t } = useTranslation();
    const videoMode = normalizeVideoModeValue(config.videoMode);
    const resolution = parseVideoResolution(config.vquality);
    const serverModels = useConfigStore((state) => state.serverModels);
    const selectedVideoModel = modelOptionName(model || config.videoModel || config.model);
    const serverVideoModel = serverModels.find((model) => model.id === selectedVideoModel && model.capability === "video");
    const metadata = (serverVideoModel?.metadata ?? {}) as { durations?: { min?: number; max?: number }; aspectRatios?: string[] };
    const { min: minSeconds, max: maxSeconds } = videoSecondsRangeForDurations(metadata.durations);
    const seconds = Math.min(maxSeconds, Math.max(minSeconds, Math.floor(Number(config.videoSeconds) || 6)));
    const routeResolutions = config.videoRouteId ? serverVideoModel?.routes.find((route) => route.id === config.videoRouteId)?.resolutionMultipliers : undefined;
    const effectiveResolutions = routeResolutions ?? serverVideoModel?.resolutionMultipliers;
    const hasConfiguredResolutions = Boolean(serverVideoModel && Object.keys(effectiveResolutions ?? {}).length);
    const resolutionOptions = hasConfiguredResolutions ? videoResolutionOptionsFromMap(effectiveResolutions) : videoResolutionOptions;
    const selectedRatio = inferVideoRatio(config.size || "auto");
    const ratioOptions = metadata.aspectRatios?.length ? videoRatioOptions.filter((item) => metadata.aspectRatios?.includes(item.value)) : videoRatioOptions;
    const dimensions = readVideoDimensions(config.size || "auto", resolution, selectedRatio);
    const applySize = (nextResolution: string, ratio: string) => {
        onConfigChange("vquality", nextResolution);
        onConfigChange("size", computeVideoSize(nextResolution, ratio));
    };
    const selectResolution = (nextResolution: string) => {
        if (selectedRatio === "auto") onConfigChange("vquality", nextResolution);
        else applySize(nextResolution, selectedRatio);
    };
    const resolutionOptionsKey = resolutionOptions.map((item) => item.value).join(",");
    useEffect(() => {
        if (String(seconds) === String(config.videoSeconds)) return;
        onConfigChange("videoSeconds", String(seconds));
    }, [seconds, config.videoSeconds]);
    useEffect(() => {
        if (resolutionOptions.some((item) => item.value === resolution)) return;
        const fallback = resolutionOptions[0]?.value;
        if (fallback) {
            onConfigChange("vquality", fallback);
            if (selectedRatio !== "auto") onConfigChange("size", computeVideoSize(fallback, selectedRatio));
        }
    }, [hasConfiguredResolutions, resolution, resolutionOptionsKey, selectedRatio]);

    return (
        <ImageSettingsTheme theme={theme}>
            <div className={className} style={{ color: theme.node.text }} onMouseDown={(event) => event.stopPropagation()}>
                {showTitle ? <div className="text-lg font-semibold">{t("settingsPanels.video.title")}</div> : null}
                <SettingGroup title={t("settingsPanels.video.quality")} color={theme.node.muted}>
                    <div className="grid grid-cols-4 gap-2.5">
                        {resolutionOptions.map((item) => (
                            <OptionPill key={item.value} selected={resolution === item.value} theme={theme} onClick={() => selectResolution(item.value)}>
                                {item.label}
                            </OptionPill>
                        ))}
                        {!resolutionOptions.some(item => item.value === "4k") && <OptionPill selected={false} disabled theme={theme} onClick={() => {}}>4K</OptionPill>}
                    </div>
                    {!resolutionOptions.some(item => item.value === "4k") && <p className="text-xs" style={{ color: theme.node.muted }}>4K 需选择支持该清晰度的线路。</p>}
                </SettingGroup>
                <SettingGroup title={t("settingsPanels.video.size")} color={theme.node.muted}>
                    <div className="grid grid-cols-[1fr_auto_1fr] items-center gap-2.5">
                        <DimensionInput prefix="W" value={dimensions.width} disabled={selectedRatio === "auto"} theme={theme} onChange={(value) => updateDimension("width", value, dimensions, onConfigChange)} />
                        <span className="text-lg opacity-45">↔</span>
                        <DimensionInput prefix="H" value={dimensions.height} disabled={selectedRatio === "auto"} theme={theme} onChange={(value) => updateDimension("height", value, dimensions, onConfigChange)} />
                    </div>
                </SettingGroup>
                <SettingGroup title={t("settingsPanels.video.ratio")} color={theme.node.muted}>
                    <div className="grid grid-cols-4 gap-2.5">
                        {ratioOptions.map((item) => (
                            <button
                                key={item.value}
                                type="button"
                                className="flex h-[72px] cursor-pointer flex-col items-center justify-center gap-1.5 rounded-xl border bg-transparent text-sm transition hover:opacity-80"
                                style={{ borderColor: selectedRatio === item.value ? theme.node.text : theme.node.stroke, color: theme.node.text }}
                                onMouseDown={(event) => event.stopPropagation()}
                                onClick={() => applySize(resolution, item.value)}
                            >
                                <SizePreview width={item.width} height={item.height} color={theme.node.text} />
                                <span>{item.value === "auto" ? t("settingsPanels.common.auto") : item.value}</span>
                            </button>
                        ))}
                    </div>
                </SettingGroup>
                <SettingGroup title={t("settingsPanels.video.seconds")} color={theme.node.muted}>
                    <div className="flex items-center gap-3" onMouseDown={(event) => event.stopPropagation()}>
                        <Slider className="min-w-0 flex-1" min={minSeconds} max={maxSeconds} step={1} value={seconds} onChange={(value) => onConfigChange("videoSeconds", String(Array.isArray(value) ? value[0] : value))} />
                        <SecondsInput value={seconds} min={minSeconds} max={maxSeconds} theme={theme} onCommit={(value) => onConfigChange("videoSeconds", String(value))} />
                        <span className="shrink-0 text-sm" style={{ color: theme.node.muted }}>s</span>
                    </div>
                </SettingGroup>
                <SettingGroup title={t("settingsPanels.video.mode")} color={theme.node.muted}>
                    <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-2.5">
                        {videoModeOptions.map((item) => (
                            <OptionPill key={item.value} selected={videoMode === item.value} theme={theme} onClick={() => onConfigChange("videoMode", item.value)}>
                                {t(`settingsPanels.video.modes.${item.labelKey}`)}
                            </OptionPill>
                        ))}
                    </div>
                </SettingGroup>
            </div>
        </ImageSettingsTheme>
    );
}

export function videoResolutionLabel(value: string) {
    return formatVideoResolution(value);
}

export function videoSizeLabel(value: string) {
    const ratio = inferVideoRatio(value);
    return ratio === "auto" ? i18n.t("settingsPanels.video.adaptive") : ratio;
}

export function videoSecondsLabel(value: string) {
    if (String(value).trim() === "-1") return i18n.t("settingsPanels.video.smart");
    return `${value || "6"}s`;
}

export function videoModeLabel(value: string) {
    return i18n.t(`settingsPanels.video.modes.${normalizeVideoModeValue(value)}`);
}

export function normalizeVideoModeValue(value: string | undefined) {
    return value === "reference" ? "reference" : "frames";
}

export function normalizeVideoSizeValue(value: string, resolution = "720") {
    if (value === "auto") return "auto";
    if (/^\d+x\d+$/.test(value || "")) return value;
    const ratio = inferVideoRatio(value);
    return ratio === "auto" ? "auto" : computeVideoSize(resolution, ratio);
}

export function normalizeVideoResolutionValue(value: string) {
    return parseVideoResolution(value);
}

function updateDimension(key: "width" | "height", value: number | null, dimensions: { width: number; height: number }, onConfigChange: VideoSettingsPanelProps["onConfigChange"]) {
    const next = Math.max(1, Math.floor(value || dimensions[key] || 720));
    onConfigChange("size", `${key === "width" ? next : dimensions.width}x${key === "height" ? next : dimensions.height}`);
}

function OptionPill({ selected, disabled = false, theme, onClick, children }: { selected: boolean; disabled?: boolean; theme: CanvasTheme; onClick: () => void; children: ReactNode }) {
    return (
        <button type="button" disabled={disabled} className="h-9 cursor-pointer rounded-full border px-2 text-sm transition hover:opacity-80 disabled:cursor-not-allowed disabled:opacity-35" style={{ background: "transparent", borderColor: selected ? theme.node.text : theme.node.stroke, color: theme.node.text }} onMouseDown={(event) => event.stopPropagation()} onClick={onClick}>
            {children}
        </button>
    );
}

function SettingGroup({ title, color, children }: { title: string; color: string; children: ReactNode }) {
    return (
        <div className="space-y-2.5">
            <div className="text-xs font-medium" style={{ color }}>
                {title}
            </div>
            {children}
        </div>
    );
}

function SecondsInput({ value, min, max, theme, onCommit }: { value: number; min: number; max: number; theme: CanvasTheme; onCommit: (value: number) => void }) {
    const commit = (input: HTMLInputElement) => {
        const next = Number(clampVideoSecondsToRange(input.value, min, max));
        input.value = String(next);
        onCommit(next);
    };

    return (
        <label className="flex h-9 w-[68px] shrink-0 overflow-hidden rounded-xl text-sm" style={{ background: theme.node.fill, color: theme.node.text }}>
            <input
                type="number"
                min={min}
                max={max}
                className="min-w-0 flex-1 bg-transparent px-2 text-center outline-none [appearance:textfield] [&::-webkit-inner-spin-button]:appearance-none [&::-webkit-outer-spin-button]:appearance-none"
                defaultValue={value}
                key={value}
                onBlur={(event) => commit(event.currentTarget)}
                onKeyDown={(event) => {
                    if (event.key === "Enter") event.currentTarget.blur();
                }}
                onMouseDown={(event) => event.stopPropagation()}
            />
        </label>
    );
}

function DimensionInput({ prefix, value, disabled, theme, onChange }: { prefix: string; value: number; disabled: boolean; theme: CanvasTheme; onChange: (value: number | null) => void }) {
    return (
        <label className="flex h-9 overflow-hidden rounded-xl text-sm" style={{ background: theme.node.fill, color: theme.node.text, opacity: disabled ? 0.55 : 1 }}>
            <span className="grid w-9 place-items-center" style={{ color: theme.node.muted }}>
                {prefix}
            </span>
            <input type="number" min={1} disabled={disabled} className="min-w-0 flex-1 bg-transparent px-2 outline-none [appearance:textfield] [&::-webkit-inner-spin-button]:appearance-none [&::-webkit-outer-spin-button]:appearance-none" value={value || ""} onChange={(event) => onChange(Number(event.target.value) || null)} onMouseDown={(event) => event.stopPropagation()} />
        </label>
    );
}

function SizePreview({ width, height, color }: { width: number; height: number; color: string }) {
    if (!width || !height) return null;
    const longSide = Math.max(width, height);
    const previewWidth = Math.max(10, Math.round((width / longSide) * 26));
    const previewHeight = Math.max(10, Math.round((height / longSide) * 26));
    return <span className="rounded-[3px] border-2" style={{ width: previewWidth, height: previewHeight, borderColor: color }} />;
}

import i18n from "@/i18n";
import { CanvasNodeType } from "@/types/canvas";
import type { CanvasNodeMetadata } from "@/types/canvas";
import { getNodeSpec as getRegistryNodeSpec } from "@/lib/canvas/node-registry";

type CanvasNodeSpec = {
    width: number;
    height: number;
    title: string;
    metadata?: CanvasNodeMetadata;
};

export const NODE_DEFAULT_SIZE = {
    [CanvasNodeType.Image]: { width: 340, height: 240, get title() { return i18n.t("canvas.nodeTypes.image"); } },
    [CanvasNodeType.Text]: { width: 340, height: 240, get title() { return i18n.t("canvas.nodeTypes.text"); } },
    [CanvasNodeType.Config]: { width: 340, height: 240, get title() { return i18n.t("canvas.nodeTypes.config"); } },
    [CanvasNodeType.Video]: { width: 420, height: 236, get title() { return i18n.t("canvas.nodeTypes.video"); } },
    [CanvasNodeType.Audio]: { width: 340, height: 120, get title() { return i18n.t("canvas.nodeTypes.audio"); } },
    [CanvasNodeType.Group]: { width: 760, height: 480, get title() { return i18n.t("canvas.nodeTypes.group"); } },
} satisfies Record<CanvasNodeType, { width: number; height: number; title: string }>;

export const NODE_SPECS = {
    [CanvasNodeType.Image]: {
        width: 340, height: 240, get title() { return NODE_DEFAULT_SIZE[CanvasNodeType.Image].title; },
        metadata: { content: "", status: "idle" },
    },
    [CanvasNodeType.Text]: {
        width: 340, height: 240, get title() { return NODE_DEFAULT_SIZE[CanvasNodeType.Text].title; },
        metadata: { content: "", status: "idle", fontSize: 14 },
    },
    [CanvasNodeType.Config]: {
        width: 340, height: 240, get title() { return NODE_DEFAULT_SIZE[CanvasNodeType.Config].title; },
        metadata: { content: "", status: "idle", generationMode: "image" },
    },
    [CanvasNodeType.Video]: {
        width: 420, height: 236, get title() { return NODE_DEFAULT_SIZE[CanvasNodeType.Video].title; },
        metadata: { content: "", status: "idle" },
    },
    [CanvasNodeType.Audio]: {
        width: 340, height: 120, get title() { return NODE_DEFAULT_SIZE[CanvasNodeType.Audio].title; },
        metadata: { content: "", status: "idle" },
    },
    [CanvasNodeType.Group]: {
        width: 760, height: 480, get title() { return NODE_DEFAULT_SIZE[CanvasNodeType.Group].title; },
        metadata: { status: "idle" },
    },
} satisfies Record<CanvasNodeType, CanvasNodeSpec>;

// Return built-in specs directly and resolve plugin types from the registry.
export function getNodeSpec(type: string) {
    if ((Object.values(CanvasNodeType) as string[]).includes(type)) return NODE_SPECS[type as CanvasNodeType];
    const spec = getRegistryNodeSpec(type);
    return { width: spec.width, height: spec.height, title: spec.title, metadata: spec.metadata };
}

// Runtime configuration access layer.
// Priority: window.__RUNTIME_CONFIG__ (injected by the container entrypoint) > build-time VITE_ variables > defaults.
// This supports both configuring the same image with docker run -e and injecting values during custom builds.
//
// Each analytics provider has its own variable; configured providers are enabled independently and all are disabled by default.
// Only GA4 and Baidu are supported. Both accept IDs only, and script URLs are assembled in code without arbitrary scripts or inline JavaScript.

type RuntimeConfig = {
    ANALYTICS_GA4_ID?: string; // GA4 measurement ID (G-XXXX)
    ANALYTICS_BAIDU_ID?: string; // Baidu Analytics site ID
};

declare global {
    interface Window {
        __RUNTIME_CONFIG__?: RuntimeConfig;
    }
}

const runtime: RuntimeConfig = (typeof window !== "undefined" && window.__RUNTIME_CONFIG__) || {};

function read(key: keyof RuntimeConfig, buildTime: string | undefined, fallback = ""): string {
    const value = runtime[key];
    if (typeof value === "string" && value.trim()) return value.trim();
    if (typeof buildTime === "string" && buildTime.trim()) return buildTime.trim();
    return fallback;
}

export const ANALYTICS_GA4_ID = read("ANALYTICS_GA4_ID", import.meta.env.VITE_ANALYTICS_GA4_ID);

import { cloudSaveStatus, hasLocalMedia } from "@/lib/cloud-sync-status";
import { useCloudSyncStatus } from "@/stores/use-cloud-sync-status";
import { readAllAssetPages, type AssetPage } from "@/lib/asset-pagination";
import * as React from "react";
import { notification } from "antd";
import deepEqual from "fast-deep-equal";

import { localForageStorage } from "@/lib/localforage-storage";
import { createSerializedWriter } from "@/lib/serialized-writer";
import { decideProjectMerge, type ProjectSyncBaseline } from "@/lib/canvas/project-sync-merge";
import { apiRequest, ApiError, type ApiRequestInit } from "@/services/api/client";
import { flushAssetAccount, useAssetStore, type Asset } from "@/stores/use-asset-store";
