import { useEffect, useState } from "react";
import { App as AntApp, Button, Input, InputNumber, Modal, Select, Switch, Table, Tabs } from "antd";
import type { TableColumnsType } from "antd";

import { useAdminRequest } from "../use-admin-request";
import { useAdminPermissions } from "../permissions";
import { ADMIN_AUTOFILL_OFF, AdminBadge, AdminField, AdminPanel } from "./ui";
import { ModelEditorModal, type AdminFamily, type AdminModel } from "./model-editor";
import { ChannelBalances } from './channel-balances';

type Channel = {
    id: string;
    name: string;
    textMode: string;
    protocol: string;
    baseUrl: string;
    enabled: boolean;
    modelCount: number;
    healthStatus: string;
    latencyMs: number | null;
    checkedAt: string | null;
    healthMessage: string | null;
};
type Plan = { id: string; name: string; days: number; priceCents: number; monthlyCredits: number; tierId: string | null; enabled: boolean; sort: number };
type MembershipTier = { id: string; level: number; name: string; description: string; consumptionDiscount: number; grantCredits: number; enabled: boolean };
type RechargePackage = { id: string; name: string; credits: number; priceCents: number; originalPriceCents: number | null; description: string; enabled: boolean; sort: number };

const CAPABILITIES = [
    { value: "image", label: "图片" },
    { value: "video", label: "视频" },
    { value: "text", label: "文本" },
    { value: "audio", label: "音频" },
];

function healthBadge(status: string) {
    if (status === "healthy") return <AdminBadge tone="positive">正常</AdminBadge>;
    if (status === "degraded") return <AdminBadge tone="warning">波动</AdminBadge>;
    if (status === "down") return <AdminBadge tone="danger">异常</AdminBadge>;
    return <AdminBadge tone="neutral">未检测</AdminBadge>;
}

function priceRange(routes: AdminModel["routes"]) {
    const values = routes.map((route) => Number(route.baseCredits)).filter((value) => Number.isFinite(value) && value > 0);
    if (!values.length) return "—";
    const min = Math.min(...values);
    const max = Math.max(...values);
    return min === max ? `${min}` : `${min}–${max}`;
}

export function CatalogTab() {
    const permissions = useAdminPermissions();
    const apiRequest = useAdminRequest();
    const { message, modal } = AntApp.useApp();
    const [channels, setChannels] = useState<Channel[]>([]);
    const [models, setModels] = useState<AdminModel[]>([]);
    const [families, setFamilies] = useState<AdminFamily[]>([]);
    const [plans, setPlans] = useState<Plan[]>([]);
    const [tiers, setTiers] = useState<MembershipTier[]>([]);
    const [packages, setPackages] = useState<RechargePackage[]>([]);
    const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false);
    const [activeTab, setActiveTab] = useState(() => permissions.includes("channels.read") ? "channels" : permissions.includes("models.read") ? "models" : "tiers");
    const permissionKey = permissions.join("|");

    const [channelModal, setChannelModal] = useState<{ open: boolean; id?: string; name: string; textMode: string; baseUrl: string; apiKey: string; protocol?: string; accessKeyId?: string; accessKeySecret?: string; sameAccountRotation?:boolean }>({ open: false, name: "", textMode: "responses", baseUrl: "", apiKey: "" });
    const [testingChannel, setTestingChannel] = useState(false);
    const [channelModels, setChannelModels] = useState<string[]>([]);
    const [discoveredModels, setDiscoveredModels] = useState<string[]>([]);
    const [familyModal, setFamilyModal] = useState<{ open: boolean; id?: string; name: string; vendor: string; description: string; icon: string; sort: number }>({ open: false, name: "", vendor: "", description: "", icon: "", sort: 0 });
    const [modelOpen, setModelOpen] = useState(false);
    const [editingModel, setEditingModel] = useState<AdminModel | null>(null);
    const [planModal, setPlanModal] = useState<{ open: boolean; id?: string; name: string; days: number; priceYuan: number; monthlyCredits: number; tierId: string; enabled: boolean }>({ open: false, name: "", days: 30, priceYuan: 59, monthlyCredits: 500, tierId: "", enabled: true });
    const [tierModal, setTierModal] = useState<{ open: boolean; id?: string; level: number; name: string; description: string; discountZhe: number; grantCredits: number; enabled: boolean }>({ open: false, level: 1, name: "", description: "", discountZhe: 10, grantCredits: 0, enabled: true });
    const [packageModal, setPackageModal] = useState<{ open: boolean; id?: string; name: string; credits: number; priceYuan: number; originalPriceYuan: number; description: string; sort: number; enabled: boolean }>({ open: false, name: "", credits: 100, priceYuan: 10, originalPriceYuan: 0, description: "", sort: 0, enabled: true });

    async function load() {
        setLoading(true);
        try {
            const [channelData, modelData, familyData, planData, tierData, packageData] = await Promise.all([
                permissions.includes("channels.read") ? apiRequest<{ channels: Channel[] }>("/api/admin/channels") : Promise.resolve({channels: []}),
                permissions.includes("models.read") ? apiRequest<{ models: AdminModel[] }>("/api/admin/models") : Promise.resolve({models: []}),
                permissions.includes("models.read") ? apiRequest<{ families: AdminFamily[] }>("/api/admin/model-families") : Promise.resolve({families: []}),
                permissions.includes("catalog.read") ? apiRequest<{ plans: Plan[] }>("/api/admin/plans") : Promise.resolve({plans: []}),
                permissions.includes("catalog.read") ? apiRequest<{ tiers: MembershipTier[] }>("/api/admin/membership-tiers") : Promise.resolve({tiers: []}),
                permissions.includes("catalog.read") ? apiRequest<{ packages: RechargePackage[] }>("/api/admin/recharge-packages") : Promise.resolve({packages: []}),
            ]);
            setChannels(channelData.channels);
            setModels(modelData.models);
            setFamilies(familyData.families);
            setPlans(planData.plans);
            setTiers(tierData.tiers);
            setPackages(packageData.packages);
        } catch (error) {
            message.error(error instanceof Error ? error.message : String(error));
        } finally {
            setLoading(false);
        }
    }

    useEffect(() => {
        void load();
    }, [permissionKey]);

    useEffect(() => {
        const permitted = ["channels", "balances"].includes(activeTab) ? permissions.includes("channels.read") : ["models", "families"].includes(activeTab) ? permissions.includes("models.read") : permissions.includes("catalog.read");
        if (!permitted) setActiveTab(permissions.includes("channels.read") ? "channels" : permissions.includes("models.read") ? "models" : "tiers");
    }, [permissionKey, activeTab]);

    useEffect(() => {
        if (!permissions.includes("channels.manage")) setChannelModal(current => ({ ...current, open:false, apiKey:"", accessKeyId:'', accessKeySecret:'' }));
        if (!permissions.includes("models.manage")) { setModelOpen(false); setFamilyModal(current => ({ ...current, open:false })); }
        if (!permissions.includes("catalog.manage")) { setPlanModal(current => ({ ...current, open:false })); setTierModal(current => ({ ...current, open:false })); setPackageModal(current => ({ ...current, open:false })); }
    }, [permissionKey]);

    useEffect(() => {
        if (!channelModal.open) setChannelModels([]);
    }, [channelModal.open]);

    async function saveChannel() {
        const aliyun = channelModal.protocol === 'aliyun-viapi';
        if (aliyun && (channelModal.accessKeyId || channelModal.accessKeySecret) && (!channelModal.accessKeyId || !channelModal.accessKeySecret)) { message.error('请同时填写 AccessKey ID 和 Secret'); return; }
        const apiKey = aliyun ? (channelModal.accessKeyId && channelModal.accessKeySecret ? JSON.stringify({ accessKeyId: channelModal.accessKeyId, accessKeySecret: channelModal.accessKeySecret }) : '') : channelModal.apiKey;
        const payload = { sameAccountRotation:channelModal.sameAccountRotation === true, name: channelModal.name, protocol: channelModal.protocol || 'openai', textMode: channelModal.textMode, baseUrl: channelModal.baseUrl, ...(apiKey ? { apiKey } : {}) };
        try {
            await apiRequest(channelModal.id ? `/api/admin/channels/${channelModal.id}` : "/api/admin/channels", { method: channelModal.id ? "PATCH" : "POST", json: payload });
            setChannelModal({ open: false, name: "", textMode: "responses", baseUrl: "", apiKey: "" });
            await load();
        } catch (error) {
            message.error(error instanceof Error ? error.message : String(error));
        }
    }

    async function saveFamily() {
        try {
            await apiRequest(familyModal.id ? `/api/admin/model-families/${familyModal.id}` : "/api/admin/model-families", {
                method: familyModal.id ? "PATCH" : "POST",
                json: { name: familyModal.name, vendor: familyModal.vendor, description: familyModal.description, icon: familyModal.icon, sort: familyModal.sort },
            });
            setFamilyModal({ open: false, name: "", vendor: "", description: "", icon: "", sort: 0 });
            await load();
        } catch (error) {
            message.error(error instanceof Error ? error.message : String(error));
        }
    }

    async function savePlan() {
        try {
            await apiRequest(planModal.id ? `/api/admin/plans/${planModal.id}` : "/api/admin/plans", {
                method: planModal.id ? "PATCH" : "POST",
                json: { name: planModal.name, days: planModal.days, priceCents: Math.round(planModal.priceYuan * 100), monthlyCredits: planModal.monthlyCredits, tierId: planModal.tierId, enabled: planModal.enabled },
            });
            setPlanModal({ open: false, name: "", days: 30, priceYuan: 59, monthlyCredits: 500, tierId: "", enabled: true });
            await load();
        } catch (error) {
            message.error(error instanceof Error ? error.message : String(error));
        }
    }

    async function saveTier() {
        try {
            await apiRequest(`/api/admin/membership-tiers/${tierModal.id}`, {
                method: "PATCH",
                json: {
                    name: tierModal.name,
                    description: tierModal.description,
                    consumptionDiscount: Number((tierModal.discountZhe / 10).toFixed(4)),
                    grantCredits: tierModal.grantCredits,
                    enabled: tierModal.enabled,
                },
            });
            setTierModal({ ...tierModal, open: false });
            await load();
        } catch (error) {
            message.error(error instanceof Error ? error.message : String(error));
        }
    }

    async function savePackage() {
        try {
            await apiRequest(packageModal.id ? `/api/admin/recharge-packages/${packageModal.id}` : "/api/admin/recharge-packages", {
                method: packageModal.id ? "PATCH" : "POST",
                json: {
                    name: packageModal.name,
                    credits: packageModal.credits,
                    priceCents: Math.round(packageModal.priceYuan * 100),
                    originalPriceCents: packageModal.originalPriceYuan > 0 ? Math.round(packageModal.originalPriceYuan * 100) : null,
                    description: packageModal.description,
                    sort: packageModal.sort,
                    enabled: packageModal.enabled,
                },
            });
            setPackageModal({ open: false, name: "", credits: 100, priceYuan: 10, originalPriceYuan: 0, description: "", sort: 0, enabled: true });
            await load();
        } catch (error) {
            message.error(error instanceof Error ? error.message : String(error));
        }
    }

    async function testChannel() {
        setTestingChannel(true);
        try {
            const result = await apiRequest<{ count: number; models: string[] }>("/api/admin/channels/test", {
                method: "POST",
                json: { id: channelModal.id, baseUrl: channelModal.baseUrl, apiKey: channelModal.apiKey },
            });
            setChannelModels(result.models);
            setDiscoveredModels(result.models);
            message.success(`连接成功，当前 Key 可见 ${result.count} 个模型`);
            if (channelModal.id) await load();
        } catch (error) {
            setChannelModels([]);
            message.error(error instanceof Error ? error.message : String(error));
        } finally {
            setTestingChannel(false);
        }
    }

    function remove(path: string, label: string) {
        modal.confirm({
            title: `删除${label}？`,
            okButtonProps: { danger: true },
            onOk: async () => {
                await apiRequest(path, { method: "DELETE" });
                await load();
            },
        });
    }

                        <InputNumber {...ADMIN_AUTOFILL_OFF} name="sundas-plan-monthly-credits" className="w-full" min={0} value={planModal.monthlyCredits} onChange={(value) => setPlanModal({ ...planModal, monthlyCredits: Number(value) || 0 })} />
                    </AdminField>

                        <Select
                            className="w-full"
                            value={planModal.tierId || null}
                            onChange={(value) => setPlanModal({ ...planModal, tierId: value ?? "" })}
                            options={[{ value: "", label: "不绑定档位" }, ...tiers.map((tier) => ({ value: tier.id, label: `${tier.level} · ${tier.name}` }))]}
                        />
                    </AdminField>
                    <div className="flex items-center justify-between rounded-[9px] border border-[var(--admin-line)] bg-[var(--admin-panel-soft)] px-3 py-2.5">
                        <div className="text-xs font-medium text-[var(--admin-ink)]">启用套餐</div>
                        <Switch checked={planModal.enabled} onChange={(checked) => setPlanModal({ ...planModal, enabled: checked })} />
                    </div>
                </div>
            </Modal>

                <div className="space-y-4 pt-1">
                    <AdminField label="档位名称" required>
                        <Input {...ADMIN_AUTOFILL_OFF} name="sundas-tier-name" value={tierModal.name} onChange={(event) => setTierModal({ ...tierModal, name: event.target.value })} placeholder="例如 执笔者" />
                    </AdminField>
                    <AdminField label="会员权益描述" hint="显示在会员套餐卡片上；请填写真实提供的权益。">
                        <Input.TextArea {...ADMIN_AUTOFILL_OFF} name="sundas-tier-description" rows={3} value={tierModal.description} onChange={(event) => setTierModal({ ...tierModal, description: event.target.value })} placeholder="例如：适合日常创作，享受图片与视频生成积分优惠。" />
                    </AdminField>
                    <div className="grid gap-4 sm:grid-cols-2">
                        <AdminField label="生成折扣（折）" hint="9.5 表示 9.5 折，10 表示标准计费；新购/续费订单采用此配置，已购会员保留购买时折扣。">
                            <InputNumber {...ADMIN_AUTOFILL_OFF} name="sundas-tier-discount" className="w-full" min={0.1} max={10} step={0.1} value={tierModal.discountZhe} onChange={(value) => setTierModal({ ...tierModal, discountZhe: Number(value) || 10 })} />
                        </AdminField>
                        <AdminField label="开通赠送积分">
                            <InputNumber {...ADMIN_AUTOFILL_OFF} name="sundas-tier-grant" className="w-full" min={0} value={tierModal.grantCredits} onChange={(value) => setTierModal({ ...tierModal, grantCredits: Number(value) || 0 })} />
                        </AdminField>
                    </div>
                    <div className="flex items-center justify-between rounded-[9px] border border-[var(--admin-line)] bg-[var(--admin-panel-soft)] px-3 py-2.5">
                        <div className="text-xs font-medium text-[var(--admin-ink)]">启用档位</div>
                        <Switch checked={tierModal.enabled} onChange={(checked) => setTierModal({ ...tierModal, enabled: checked })} />
                    </div>
                </div>
            </Modal>

            <Modal title={packageModal.id ? "编辑充值套餐" : "新增充值套餐"} open={packageModal.open} onCancel={() => setPackageModal({ ...packageModal, open: false })} onOk={() => void savePackage()} okText="保存" width={500}>
                <div className="space-y-4 pt-1">
                    <AdminField label="套餐名称" required>
                        <Input {...ADMIN_AUTOFILL_OFF} name="sundas-package-name" value={packageModal.name} onChange={(event) => setPackageModal({ ...packageModal, name: event.target.value })} placeholder="例如 100 积分" />
                    </AdminField>
                    <div className="grid gap-4 sm:grid-cols-2">
                        <AdminField label="到账积分">
                            <InputNumber {...ADMIN_AUTOFILL_OFF} name="sundas-package-credits" className="w-full" min={1} value={packageModal.credits} onChange={(value) => setPackageModal({ ...packageModal, credits: Number(value) || 1 })} />
                        </AdminField>
                        <AdminField label="实付价格（元）">
                            <InputNumber {...ADMIN_AUTOFILL_OFF} name="sundas-package-price" className="w-full" min={0.01} step={1} value={packageModal.priceYuan} onChange={(value) => setPackageModal({ ...packageModal, priceYuan: Number(value) || 0 })} />
                        </AdminField>
                    </div>
                    <div className="grid gap-4 sm:grid-cols-2">
                        <AdminField label="原价（元）" hint="留空则不展示划线价。">
                            <InputNumber {...ADMIN_AUTOFILL_OFF} name="sundas-package-original-price" className="w-full" min={0} step={1} value={packageModal.originalPriceYuan} onChange={(value) => setPackageModal({ ...packageModal, originalPriceYuan: Number(value) || 0 })} />
                        </AdminField>

import { useEffect, useState } from 'react';
import { Alert, App, Button, InputNumber, Modal, Select, Table } from 'antd';
import type { TableColumnsType } from 'antd';
import { useAdminRequest, useAdminScope } from '../use-admin-request';
import { useAdminPermissions } from '../permissions';
import { AdminBadge, AdminField, AdminPanel } from './ui';

type Snapshot = {available:number|null;account:number|null;key:number|null;unlimited:boolean;unit:string;scope:string;note:string};
type Balance = {id:string;name:string;enabled:boolean;provider:string;threshold:number;thresholdUnit:string|null;status:string;message:string;snapshot:Snapshot|null;checkedAt:string|null;succeededAt:string|null;stale:boolean;alert:string;supported:boolean};
const formats = [{value:'auto',label:'自动识别已接入渠道'}, {value:'token',label:'New API Key 额度接口'}, {value:'yaohuo',label:'妖火余额接口'}, {value:'aggc',label:'视频线路 B 余额接口'}, {value:'off',label:'暂不查询'}];
const display = (n:number|null|undefined) => n == null ? '未提供' : n.toLocaleString('zh-CN',{maximumFractionDigits:4});
const date = (s:string|null) => s ? new Date(s).toLocaleString('zh-CN') : '尚未查询';

export function ChannelBalances() {
    const api = useAdminRequest(), scope = useAdminScope(), permissions = useAdminPermissions();
    const canManage = permissions.includes('channels.manage');
    const {message} = App.useApp();
    const [items,setItems] = useState<Balance[]>([]), [loading,setLoading] = useState(false), [busy,setBusy] = useState<string|null>(null);
    const [editing,setEditing] = useState<Balance|null>(null), [saving,setSaving] = useState(false);
    async function load() {
        setLoading(true);
        try {const data = await api<{items:Balance[]}>('/api/admin/channels/balances');setItems(data.items);}
        catch(e){if(scope.current())message.error(e instanceof Error?e.message:'读取失败');}
        finally{if(scope.current())setLoading(false);}
    }
    useEffect(()=>{void load();},[api]);
    useEffect(()=>{if(!canManage)setEditing(null);},[canManage]);
    async function refresh(rows:Balance[]) {
        setBusy(rows.length===1?rows[0].id:'all');
        try {
            for(const row of rows) {
                await api(`/api/admin/channels/${row.id}/balance/refresh`,{method:'POST',json:{}});
                await load();
            }
            if(scope.current())message.success('查询完成，请查看各渠道状态');
        }catch(e){if(scope.current())message.error(e instanceof Error?e.message:'查询失败');}
        finally{if(scope.current())setBusy(null);}
    }
    async function save() {
        if(!editing)return;setSaving(true);
        try {await api(`/api/admin/channels/${editing.id}/balance`,{method:'PATCH',json:{provider:editing.provider,threshold:editing.threshold}});setEditing(null);await load();message.success('预警设置已保存');}
        catch(e){if(scope.current())message.error(e instanceof Error?e.message:'保存失败');}
        finally{if(scope.current())setSaving(false);}
    }
    const low = items.filter(i=>i.enabled&&['low','empty'].includes(i.alert));
    const unknown = items.filter(i=>i.enabled&&(i.status!=='ok'||i.snapshot?.available==null||i.stale));
    const columns:TableColumnsType<Balance> = [
        {title:'渠道',dataIndex:'name',width:210,render:(name:string,row)=><div><strong>{name}</strong><div className="mt-1"><AdminBadge tone={row.enabled?'positive':'neutral'}>{row.enabled?'已启用':'已停用（不自动查询）'}</AdminBadge></div></div>},
        {title:'可用额度 / 余额',width:240,render:(_,row)=><div>{row.snapshot?<><strong className="tabular-nums">{display(row.snapshot.available)} {row.snapshot.unit}</strong><div className="text-xs text-[var(--admin-muted)]">{row.snapshot.scope} · {row.status==='ok'?'查询时余额':'上次成功记录，当前不可确认'}</div><div className="mt-1 text-xs">账户：{display(row.snapshot.account)}<br/>Key：{row.snapshot.unlimited?'无限额':display(row.snapshot.key)}</div></>:<span>—</span>}</div>},
        {title:'预警状态',width:285,render:(_,row)=>{
            const label = row.status==='unsupported'?'未接入查询':row.status==='error'?'查询失败':row.status==='unknown'?'待查询':row.stale?'数据待刷新':row.alert==='empty'?'额度已耗尽':row.alert==='low'?'额度不足预警':row.alert==='unit_changed'?'单位变化，请重设阈值':row.snapshot?.available==null?'账户余额未知':row.threshold===0?'仅监测耗尽':'高于预警阈值';
            const tone = ['empty','low'].includes(row.alert)?'danger':row.status!=='ok'||row.stale||row.alert!=='normal'?'warning':'positive';
            return <div><AdminBadge tone={tone}>{label}</AdminBadge><div className="mt-2 text-xs text-[var(--admin-muted)]">{row.message}</div><div className="mt-1 text-xs">阈值：{row.threshold>0?`${display(row.threshold)} ${row.thresholdUnit??''}`:'未设置（余额 ≤ 0 时提醒）'}</div></div>;
        }},
        {title:'查询时间',width:195,render:(_,row)=><div className="text-xs">最近查询：{date(row.checkedAt)}<br/>最近成功：{date(row.succeededAt)}</div>},
        ...(canManage?[{title:'操作',key:'actions',width:165,render:(_:unknown,row:Balance)=><div className="flex flex-wrap gap-2"><Button size="small" disabled={!!busy||!row.supported} loading={busy===row.id} onClick={()=>void refresh([row])}>刷新额度</Button><Button size="small" disabled={!!busy} onClick={()=>setEditing({...row})}>设置预警</Button></div>}]:[]),
    ];
    return <AdminPanel title="上游额度预警" description="每 30 分钟查询已启用渠道；只查询余额，不发起生成、不修改线路。不同上游单位不相加，Key 无限额不等于账户余额充足。" actions={<div className="flex flex-wrap gap-2"><Button onClick={()=>void load()} loading={loading}>刷新列表</Button>{canManage&&<Button disabled={!!busy} loading={busy==='all'} onClick={()=>void refresh(items.filter(i=>i.enabled&&i.supported))}>查询全部额度</Button>}</div>}>
        <div className="mb-4 space-y-2" aria-live="polite">
            {!!low.length&&<Alert showIcon type="warning" title={`${low.length} 个渠道低额度：${low.map(i=>i.name).join('、')}`} />}
            {!!unknown.length&&<Alert showIcon type="info" title={`${unknown.length} 个已启用渠道的当前余额尚不能确认，请查看查询状态。`} />}
            <p className="text-xs text-[var(--admin-muted)]">设置阈值后，余额小于或等于阈值即提示；查询失败保留上次记录及时间，不当作 0。多个渠道共用同一上游账户时，不要重复汇总余额。</p>
        </div>
        <Table rowKey="id" loading={loading} dataSource={items} columns={columns} pagination={false} scroll={{x:1100}} />
        <Modal title={`额度预警 · ${editing?.name??''}`} open={!!editing&&canManage} onCancel={()=>setEditing(null)} onOk={()=>void save()} confirmLoading={saving} destroyOnHidden>
            {editing&&<div className="space-y-4 py-3"><AdminField label="额度查询方式" hint="仅使用渠道已有地址及服务端密钥；未接入的服务需要其官方余额接口。"><Select className="w-full" value={editing.provider} options={formats} onChange={provider=>setEditing({...editing,provider,threshold:0})}/></AdminField>
            <AdminField label={`低额度阈值${editing.snapshot?'（'+editing.snapshot.unit+'）':''}`} hint="先查询成功确认单位，再设置阈值；0 表示只提醒额度耗尽。"><InputNumber className="w-full" min={0} value={editing.threshold} onChange={n=>setEditing({...editing,threshold:n??0})}/></AdminField></div>}
        </Modal>
    </AdminPanel>;
}

FILE: web/src/pages/admin/components/dashboard.tsx

import { useCallback, useEffect, useState } from "react";
import dayjs from "dayjs";
import { Button } from "antd";
import { ArrowUpRight, ReceiptText, RefreshCw, Settings2, UsersRound } from "lucide-react";
import { Link } from "react-router-dom";

import { useAdminRequest } from "../use-admin-request";
import { AdminBadge, AdminLoading, AdminPanel, AdminStat } from "./ui";
import { adminDashboardApi } from "@/services/api/admin/dashboard";
import { useAdminPermissions } from "../permissions";

type Dashboard = {
    users: { total: number; today: number };
    orders: { todayCount: number; gmvCents: number };
    credits: { issued: number; consumed: number };
    tasks: { total: number; succeeded: number; failed: number; inProgress: number; review: number };
    unreviewedPaymentNotifications: number;
};

export function DashboardTab() {
    const permissions = useAdminPermissions();
    const apiRequest = useAdminRequest();
    const [data, setData] = useState<Dashboard | null>(null);
    const [error, setError] = useState("");
    const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false);
    const [todos, setTodos] = useState<{ key:string; label:string; count:number; tab:string }[]>([]);

    const load = useCallback(async () => {
        setLoading(true);
        setError("");
        try {
            const now = dayjs();
            const range = new URLSearchParams({ from: now.startOf("day").toISOString(), to: now.toISOString() });
            const [dashboard, pending] = await Promise.all([apiRequest<Dashboard>(`/api/admin/dashboard?${range.toString()}`), adminDashboardApi(apiRequest).todos()]);
            setData(dashboard); setTodos(pending.items);
        } catch (reason) {
            setError(reason instanceof Error ? reason.message : String(reason));
        } finally {
            setLoading(false);
        }
    }, []);

    useEffect(() => {
        void load();
    }, [load]);

    if (!data && loading) return <AdminLoading label="正在读取今日数据" />;
    if (!data && error) {
        return (
            <AdminPanel title="数据暂时不可用" description={error} actions={<Button icon={<RefreshCw className="size-4" />} onClick={() => void load()} loading={loading}>重试</Button>}>
                <p className="text-sm text-[var(--admin-muted)]">检查 API 服务是否正常，然后重试。</p>
            </AdminPanel>
        );
    }
    if (!data) return null;

    const finished = data.tasks.succeeded + data.tasks.failed;
    const hasFinished = finished > 0;
    const successRate = hasFinished ? Math.round((data.tasks.succeeded / finished) * 100) : 0;
    const taskTone = !hasFinished ? "neutral" : successRate >= 95 ? "positive" : successRate >= 90 ? "warning" : "danger";
    const taskLabel = !hasFinished ? "暂无已结束任务" : successRate >= 95 ? "运行稳定" : successRate >= 90 ? "需要关注" : "异常偏高";
    const creditMax = Math.max(data.credits.issued, data.credits.consumed, 1);
    const netCredits = data.credits.issued - data.credits.consumed;

    return (
        <div className="space-y-5">
            <AdminPanel title="待处理事项" description="异常仍然存在时会继续显示，不因填写核对记录而消失。"><div className="flex flex-wrap gap-3">{todos.map(item => <Link key={item.key} to={`/admin?tab=${item.tab}${item.key === "tasks" ? "&review=pending" : ["wallet", "lots", "unlinked"].includes(item.key) ? "&view=held" : ""}`} className="rounded border border-[var(--admin-line)] px-3 py-2">{item.label}：{item.count}</Link>)}</div></AdminPanel>
            <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-3">
                <p className="text-xs text-[var(--admin-muted)]">今天的实时运营快照，数据来自订单、积分账本与生成任务。</p>
                <Button size="small" icon={<RefreshCw className="size-3.5" />} loading={loading} onClick={() => void load()}>
                    刷新
                </Button>
            </div>

            <section className="overflow-hidden rounded-[14px] border border-[var(--admin-line)] bg-[var(--admin-panel)]">
                <div className="grid divide-y divide-[var(--admin-line)] sm:grid-cols-2 sm:divide-x sm:divide-y-0 xl:grid-cols-4">
                    <AdminStat label="今日 GMV" value={formatMoney(data.orders.gmvCents)} note={`${data.orders.todayCount} 笔已支付订单`} accent />
                    <AdminStat label="用户总数" value={formatNumber(data.users.total)} note={`今日新增 ${formatNumber(data.users.today)}`} />
                    <AdminStat label="今日消耗积分" value={formatNumber(data.credits.consumed)} note={`发放 ${formatNumber(data.credits.issued)} · 净变化 ${netCredits >= 0 ? "+" : ""}${formatNumber(netCredits)}`} />
                    <AdminStat label="任务成功率" value={hasFinished ? `${successRate}%` : "—"} note={`${formatNumber(data.tasks.succeeded)} / ${formatNumber(finished)} 个已结束任务成功`} />
                </div>
            </section>

            {data.unreviewedPaymentNotifications > 0 && <AdminPanel title="支付通知待核对" description={`有 ${formatNumber(data.unreviewedPaymentNotifications)} 条验签通过但未处理且未记录人工核对的通知；请结合支付平台确认。`} actions={<Link to="/admin?tab=orders">查看订单</Link>}>{null}</AdminPanel>}

            <div className="grid gap-5 xl:grid-cols-[1.1fr_0.9fr]">
                <AdminPanel
                    title="任务健康度"
                    description="今日创建的任务中，成功率按已结束的成功和失败任务计算。"
                    actions={<AdminBadge tone={taskTone}>{taskLabel}</AdminBadge>}
                >
                    <div className="flex items-end justify-between gap-4">
                        <div>
                            <div className="text-[34px] font-semibold leading-none tracking-[-0.04em] tabular-nums text-[var(--admin-ink)]">{hasFinished ? `${successRate}%` : "—"}</div>
                            <div className="mt-2 text-xs text-[var(--admin-muted)]">成功 {formatNumber(data.tasks.succeeded)} 个，已结束 {formatNumber(finished)} 个</div>
                        </div>
                        <div className="text-right text-xs text-[var(--admin-muted)]">
                            <div>失败 {formatNumber(data.tasks.failed)} 个 · 进行中 {formatNumber(data.tasks.inProgress)} 个</div>
                            <div className="mt-1">待核对 {formatNumber(data.tasks.review)} 个</div>
                        </div>
                    </div>
                    <div className="mt-6 h-2 overflow-hidden rounded-full bg-[var(--admin-panel-soft)]">
                        <div className="h-full rounded-full bg-[var(--admin-accent)] transition-[width] duration-500" style={{ width: `${hasFinished ? successRate : 0}%` }} />
                    </div>
                    <div className="mt-3 flex justify-between text-[11px] text-[var(--admin-muted)]">
                        <span>0%</span>
                        <span>目标 90%</span>
                        <span>100%</span>
                    </div>
                </AdminPanel>

                <AdminPanel title="积分流动" description="今天发放与消耗的积分规模，用于判断活动力度与消耗速度。">
                    <div className="space-y-5">
                        <CreditBar label="发放" value={data.credits.issued} max={creditMax} tone="accent" />
                        <CreditBar label="消耗" value={data.credits.consumed} max={creditMax} tone="ink" />
                    </div>
                    <div className="mt-6 flex items-center justify-between border-t border-[var(--admin-line)] pt-4 text-xs">
                        <span className="text-[var(--admin-muted)]">净变化</span>
                        <span className="font-semibold tabular-nums text-[var(--admin-ink)]">{netCredits >= 0 ? "+" : ""}{formatNumber(netCredits)}</span>
                    </div>
                </AdminPanel>
            </div>

            <AdminPanel title="常用入口" description="直接前往最常用的管理页面。">
                <div className="grid gap-px overflow-hidden rounded-[10px] border border-[var(--admin-line)] bg-[var(--admin-line)] sm:grid-cols-3">
                    {[
                        { to: "/admin?tab=users", permission: "users.read", icon: UsersRound, title: "用户与积分", description: "搜索用户、调整积分与访问状态" },
                        { to: "/admin?tab=orders", permission: "orders.read", icon: ReceiptText, title: "订单与退款", description: "查看支付流水，处理退款" },
                        { to: "/admin?tab=settings", permission: "settings.read", icon: Settings2, title: "系统设置", description: "邮件、支付、计费与订单参数" },
                    ].filter(item => permissions.includes(item.permission)).map((item) => (
                        <Link key={item.to} to={item.to} className="admin-quick-link group flex items-start gap-3 p-4 transition-colors">
                            <span className="grid size-9 shrink-0 place-items-center rounded-[9px] border border-[var(--admin-line)] bg-[var(--admin-panel-soft)] text-[var(--admin-muted)]">
                                <item.icon className="size-4" />
                            </span>
                            <span className="min-w-0 flex-1">
                                <span className="flex items-center gap-1 text-sm font-medium text-[var(--admin-ink)]">
                                    {item.title}
                                    <ArrowUpRight className="size-3.5 opacity-0 transition-opacity group-hover:opacity-60" />
                                </span>
                                <span className="mt-1 block text-xs leading-5 text-[var(--admin-muted)]">{item.description}</span>
                            </span>
                        </Link>
                    ))}
                </div>
            </AdminPanel>
        </div>
    );
}

function CreditBar({ label, value, max, tone }: { label: string; value: number; max: number; tone: "accent" | "ink" }) {
    return (
        <div>
            <div className="flex items-baseline justify-between gap-3">
                <span className="text-xs text-[var(--admin-muted)]">{label}</span>
                <span className="text-sm font-semibold tabular-nums text-[var(--admin-ink)]">{formatNumber(value)}</span>
            </div>
            <div className="mt-2 h-1.5 overflow-hidden rounded-full bg-[var(--admin-panel-soft)]">
                <div className={tone === "accent" ? "h-full rounded-full bg-[var(--admin-accent)]" : "h-full rounded-full bg-[var(--admin-ink)]/55"} style={{ width: `${Math.min(100, (value / max) * 100)}%` }} />
            </div>
        </div>
    );
}

function formatNumber(value: number) {
    return value.toLocaleString("zh-CN");
}

function formatMoney(cents: number) {
    return `¥${(cents / 100).toLocaleString("zh-CN", { minimumFractionDigits: 2, maximumFractionDigits: 2 })}`;
}

export function HeldTasksTab() {
    const permissions = useAdminPermissions();
    const apiRequest = useAdminRequest();
    const { message } = AntApp.useApp();
    const [data, setData] = useState<{ items: HeldTask[]; total: number }>({ items: [], total: 0 });
    const [page, setPage] = useState(1);
    const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false);
    const [checkedAt, setCheckedAt] = useState<number|null>(null);
    const [target, setTarget] = useState<HeldTask | null>(null);
    const [action, setAction] = useState<"release" | "recheck" | "attach" | "terminal">("release");
    const [note, setNote] = useState("");
    const [upstreamId, setUpstreamId] = useState("");
    const [saving, setSaving] = useState(false);

    async function load() {
        setLoading(true);
        try { setData(await apiRequest<{ items: HeldTask[]; total: number }>(`/api/admin/tasks/held?page=${page}&pageSize=20`)); setCheckedAt(Date.now()); }
        catch (error) { message.error(error instanceof Error ? error.message : String(error)); }
        finally { setLoading(false); }
    }
    useEffect(() => { if (permissions.includes("tasks.read")) void load(); }, [page, permissions]);

    async function release() {
        if (!target || !note.trim()) { message.warning("请填写核查说明"); return; }
        setSaving(true);
        try {
            const result = await apiRequest<{ releasedCredits: number; expiredCredits: number }>(`/api/admin/tasks/${target.id}/release`, { method: "POST", json: { note } });
            message.success(`已返还 ${result.releasedCredits} 积分${result.expiredCredits ? `，${result.expiredCredits} 积分冻结期间已到期` : ""}`);
            setTarget(null); setNote(""); await load();
        } catch (error) { message.error(error instanceof Error ? error.message : String(error)); }
        finally { setSaving(false); }
    }

    async function recheck() {
        if (!target || !note.trim()) { message.warning("请填写核查说明"); return; }
        setSaving(true);
        try {
            const result = await apiRequest<{ status: string }>(`/api/admin/tasks/${target.id}/recheck`, { method: "POST", json: { note } });
            if (result.status === "succeeded") message.success("上游已完成，结果已保存并结算");
            else if (result.status === "failed") message.success("上游确认失败，冻结积分已处理");
            else message.warning("上游状态或结果仍未确认，积分继续冻结");
            setTarget(null); setNote(""); await load();
        } catch (error) { message.error(error instanceof Error ? error.message : String(error)); }
        finally { setSaving(false); }
    }

    async function attach() {
        if (!target || !note.trim() || !upstreamId.trim()) { message.warning("请填写上游任务 ID 和核查说明"); return; }
        setSaving(true);
        try {
            await apiRequest(`/api/admin/tasks/${target.id}/attach-upstream`, { method: "POST", json: { note, upstreamId } });
            message.success("已补录，请查询上游任务");
            setTarget(null); setNote(""); setUpstreamId(""); await load();
        } catch (error) { message.error(error instanceof Error ? error.message : String(error)); }
        finally { setSaving(false); }
    }

    async function reconcileTerminal() {
        if (!target || !note.trim()) { message.warning("请填写核查说明"); return; }
        setSaving(true);
        try {
            const result = await apiRequest<{ settledCredits: number; releasedCredits: number; expiredCredits: number }>(`/api/admin/tasks/${target.id}/reconcile-terminal`, { method: "POST", json: { note } });
            message.success(result.settledCredits ? `已结算 ${result.settledCredits} 积分` : `已返还 ${result.releasedCredits} 积分${result.expiredCredits ? `，${result.expiredCredits} 积分冻结期间已到期` : ""}`);
            setTarget(null); setNote(""); await load();
        } catch (error) { message.error(error instanceof Error ? error.message : String(error)); }
        finally { setSaving(false); }
    }

    const columns: TableColumnsType<HeldTask> = [
        { title: "用户", dataIndex: "email" },
        { title: "任务 ID", dataIndex: "id", render: (id: string) => <span className="font-mono text-xs">{id}</span> },
        { title: "类型", dataIndex: "type" },
        { title: "模型", dataIndex: "modelName" },
        { title: "冻结积分", dataIndex: "heldCredits", align: "right", render: (value: number | null) => value ?? "无冻结记录" },
        { title: "上游任务 ID", dataIndex: "upstreamId", render: (id: string | null) => id || "未记录" },
        { title: "核对状态", render: (_value, row) => row.heldCredits === null ? row.error || "缺少有效冻结记录，需人工核对" : row.reservationMismatch ? row.reservationIssue || "冻结记录或消费流水异常，需人工核对" : !["queued", "running"].includes(row.status) ? `任务已${row.status === "succeeded" ? "成功" : "结束"}，冻结未关闭` : row.reconciliationRequired ? row.error || "需要人工核对" : "运行中" },
        { title: "创建时间", dataIndex: "createdAt", render: (value: string) => dayjs(value).format("YYYY-MM-DD HH:mm:ss") },
        { title: "处理", render: (_value, row) => row.heldCredits === null || row.reservationMismatch ? "请人工核对账目" : !["queued", "running"].includes(row.status) ? permissions.includes("tasks.resolve") ? <Button size="small" onClick={() => { setAction("terminal"); setTarget(row); setNote(""); }}>核对冻结</Button> : "—" : row.upstreamId
            ? permissions.includes("tasks.review") ? <Button size="small" disabled={!row.reconciliationRequired || (row.type !== "video" && !(row.type === 'image' && row.imageRecheckable))} onClick={() => { setAction("recheck"); setTarget(row); setNote(""); }}>查询上游</Button> : "—"
            : <div className="flex gap-2">{permissions.includes("tasks.resolve") && <Button size="small" onClick={() => { setAction("release"); setTarget(row); setNote(""); }}>核查并释放</Button>}{permissions.includes("tasks.review") && (row.type === "video" || (row.type === 'image' && row.imageRecheckable)) && row.reconciliationRequired && <Button size="small" onClick={() => { setAction("attach"); setTarget(row); setNote(""); setUpstreamId(row.submissionReference || ""); }}>补录上游 ID</Button>}</div> },
    ];
    return <>
        {permissions.includes("tasks.read") && <AdminPanel title="任务核对" description="显示未关闭冻结的任务，以及缺少有效冻结记录的未完成任务。已有上游任务 ID 的视频及支持核对的图片任务请通过上游核查；不要仅凭等待时间判断失败。" actions={<RefreshStatus checkedAt={checkedAt} onRefresh={()=>void load()} />} flush>
            <Table rowKey="id" columns={columns} dataSource={data.items} loading={loading} scroll={{ x: 1100 }} pagination={{ current: page, pageSize: 20, total: data.total, onChange: setPage }} />
        </AdminPanel>}
        {permissions.includes("credits.read") && <><ExpiryIssues /><WalletIssues /><UnlinkedReservations /></>}
        <Modal title={action === "recheck" ? "查询上游任务" : action === "attach" ? "补录上游任务 ID" : action === "terminal" ? "核对已结束任务的冻结" : "确认核查并释放积分"} open={Boolean(target)} onCancel={() => setTarget(null)} onOk={() => void (action === "recheck" ? recheck() : action === "attach" ? attach() : action === "terminal" ? reconcileTerminal() : release())} confirmLoading={saving} okText={action === "recheck" ? "查询一次" : action === "attach" ? "确认补录" : action === "terminal" ? "确认处理冻结" : "标记失败并释放"} cancelText="取消">
            <p>{action === "recheck" ? "将查询上游并尝试保存结果；确认成功或失败后按结果结算，无法确认时继续冻结积分。" : action === "attach" ? "请先确认此 ID 属于该用户、该渠道和这次生成任务；补录后可查询上游，不会重新创建任务。" : action === "terminal" ? `请先核实任务结果和积分账目。确认后，${target?.status === "succeeded" ? "按成功处理并结算冻结积分" : "按失败处理并释放仍有效的冻结积分"}。` : "仅在确认上游没有成功处理、且任务不会继续返回结果后执行。此操作不会取消上游任务，结果和费用需自行核对。"}</p>
            {action === "attach" && <label className="mt-3 block">上游任务 ID<Input value={upstreamId} onChange={(event) => setUpstreamId(event.target.value)} /></label>}
            <label className="mt-3 block">核查说明<Input.TextArea value={note} onChange={(event) => setNote(event.target.value)} maxLength={300} rows={3} /></label>
        </Modal>
    </>;
}

import { useEffect, useState } from "react";
import { App as AntApp, Button, Input, InputNumber, Select, Switch, Table } from "antd";
import type { TableColumnsType } from "antd";
import dayjs from "dayjs";
import { Link, useSearchParams } from "react-router-dom";

import { useAdminRequest } from "../use-admin-request";
import { ADMIN_AUTOFILL_OFF, AdminBadge, AdminField, AdminPanel, AdminStat, AdminToolbar } from "./ui";
import { useAdminPermissions } from "../permissions";

type InviteSettings = { enabled: boolean; rebatePercent: number; membershipRebatePercent: number };
type Relation = { id: string; inviterEmail: string; inviteeEmail: string; status: string; totalRebate: number; createdAt: string };
type Rebate = {
    id: string;
    orderNo: string;
    inviterEmail: string;
    inviteeEmail: string;
    orderCredits: number;
    amountCents: number;
    rebatePercent: number;
    rebateCredits: number;
    recoveredCredits: number | null;
    recoveryShortfall: number | null;
    status: string;
    createdAt: string;
    revokedAt: string | null;
};

const formatTime = (value?: string | null) => (value ? dayjs(value).format("YYYY-MM-DD HH:mm") : "-");

export function InviteTab() {
    const permissions = useAdminPermissions();
    const [urlParams] = useSearchParams();
    const apiRequest = useAdminRequest();
    const { message } = AntApp.useApp();
    const [settings, setSettings] = useState<InviteSettings>({ enabled: true, rebatePercent: 10, membershipRebatePercent: 10 });
    const [saving, setSaving] = useState(false);
    const [relations, setRelations] = useState<Relation[]>([]);
    const [relationTotal, setRelationTotal] = useState(0);
    const [relationPage, setRelationPage] = useState(1);
    const [keyword, setKeyword] = useState("");
    const [rebates, setRebates] = useState<Rebate[]>([]);
    const [rebateTotal, setRebateTotal] = useState(0);
    const [rebatePage, setRebatePage] = useState(1);
    const [totals, setTotals] = useState({ granted: 0, revoked: 0 });
    const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false);
    const [filterUser, setFilterUser] = useState(urlParams.get("userId") ?? "");
    const [relationStatus, setRelationStatus] = useState("");
    const [rebateStatus, setRebateStatus] = useState("");
    const [orderNo, setOrderNo] = useState(urlParams.get("orderNo") ?? "");
    const [from, setFrom] = useState("");
    const [to, setTo] = useState("");
    function appendFilters(params: URLSearchParams, status: string) {
        if (filterUser.trim()) params.set("userId", filterUser.trim());
        if (status) params.set("status", status);
        if (from) params.set("from", new Date(`${from}T00:00:00`).toISOString());
        if (to) { const end = new Date(`${to}T00:00:00`); end.setDate(end.getDate() + 1); params.set("to", end.toISOString()); }
    }

    async function loadSettings() {
        const data = await apiRequest<{ settings: InviteSettings }>("/api/admin/invite/settings");
        setSettings({ ...data.settings, membershipRebatePercent: Number(data.settings.membershipRebatePercent ?? data.settings.rebatePercent) || 0 });
    }

    async function loadRelations(currentPage = relationPage) {
        setLoading(true);
        try {
            const params = new URLSearchParams({ page: String(currentPage), pageSize: "20", keyword });
            appendFilters(params, relationStatus);
            const data = await apiRequest<{ items: Relation[]; total: number }>(`/api/admin/invite/relations?${params.toString()}`);
            setRelations(data.items);
            setRelationTotal(data.total);
        } catch (error) {
            message.error(error instanceof Error ? error.message : String(error));
        } finally {
            setLoading(false);
        }
    }

    async function loadRebates(currentPage = rebatePage) {
        setLoading(true);
        try {
            const params = new URLSearchParams({ page: String(currentPage), pageSize: "20" });
            appendFilters(params, rebateStatus);
            if (orderNo.trim()) params.set("orderNo", orderNo.trim());
            const data = await apiRequest<{ items: Rebate[]; total: number; totals: { granted: number; revoked: number } }>(`/api/admin/invite/rebates?${params}`);
            setRebates(data.items);
            setRebateTotal(data.total);
            setTotals(data.totals);
        } catch (error) {
            message.error(error instanceof Error ? error.message : String(error));
        } finally {
            setLoading(false);
        }
    }

    useEffect(() => {
        void loadSettings().catch((error: unknown) => message.error(error instanceof Error ? error.message : String(error)));
    }, []);

    useEffect(() => {
        void loadRelations();
    }, [relationPage]);

    useEffect(() => {
        void loadRebates();
    }, [rebatePage]);

    async function saveSettings() {
        setSaving(true);
        try {
            await apiRequest("/api/admin/invite/settings", { method: "PUT", json: settings });
            message.success("邀请设置已保存");
        } catch (error) {
            message.error(error instanceof Error ? error.message : String(error));
        } finally {
            setSaving(false);
        }
    }

    async function toggleRelation(relation: Relation) {
        const status = relation.status === "active" ? "disabled" : "active";
        try {
            await apiRequest(`/api/admin/invite/relations/${relation.id}`, { method: "PATCH", json: { status } });
            await loadRelations();
        } catch (error) {
            message.error(error instanceof Error ? error.message : String(error));
        }
    }

    const relationColumns: TableColumnsType<Relation> = [
        { title: "邀请人", dataIndex: "inviterEmail", render: (value: string) => <Link to={`/admin?tab=users&search=${encodeURIComponent(value)}`}>{value}</Link> },
        { title: "被邀请人", dataIndex: "inviteeEmail", render: (value: string) => <Link to={`/admin?tab=users&search=${encodeURIComponent(value)}`}>{value}</Link> },
        { title: "累计返佣", dataIndex: "totalRebate", align: "right", render: (value: number) => <span className="tabular-nums">{value.toLocaleString("zh-CN")}</span> },
        { title: "状态", dataIndex: "status", render: (value: string) => <AdminBadge tone={value === "active" ? "positive" : "neutral"}>{value === "active" ? "生效" : "已禁用"}</AdminBadge> },
        { title: "建立时间", dataIndex: "createdAt", render: formatTime },
        {
            title: "操作",
            key: "actions",
            align: "right",
            render: (_value, record) => (
                permissions.includes("invites.manage") ? <Button size="small" onClick={() => void toggleRelation(record)}>
                    {record.status === "active" ? "禁用" : "启用"}
                </Button> : null
            ),
        },
    ];

    const rebateColumns: TableColumnsType<Rebate> = [
        { title: "订单号", dataIndex: "orderNo", render: (value: string) => <Link to={`/admin?tab=orders&search=${encodeURIComponent(value)}`} className="font-mono text-[11px]">{value}</Link> },
        { title: "邀请人", dataIndex: "inviterEmail", render: (value: string) => <span className="text-[var(--admin-ink)]">{value}</span> },
        { title: "被邀请人", dataIndex: "inviteeEmail", render: (value: string) => <span className="text-[var(--admin-muted)]">{value}</span> },
        { title: "订单积分", dataIndex: "orderCredits", align: "right", render: (value: number) => <span className="tabular-nums">{value.toLocaleString("zh-CN")}</span> },
        { title: "比例", dataIndex: "rebatePercent", align: "right", render: (value: number) => <span className="tabular-nums">{Number(value)}%</span> },
        { title: "返佣积分", dataIndex: "rebateCredits", align: "right", render: (value: number) => <span className="font-medium tabular-nums">{value.toLocaleString("zh-CN")}</span> },
        { title: "实际扣回", dataIndex: "recoveredCredits", align: "right", render: (value: number | null) => value == null ? "—" : value },
        { title: "扣回差额", dataIndex: "recoveryShortfall", align: "right", render: (value: number | null) => value == null ? "—" : value },
        { title: "状态", dataIndex: "status", render: (value: string) => <AdminBadge tone={value === "granted" ? "positive" : "danger"}>{value === "granted" ? "已发放" : "已撤回"}</AdminBadge> },
        { title: "时间", dataIndex: "createdAt", render: formatTime },
    ];

    return (
        <div className="space-y-4">
            <div className="grid gap-4 sm:grid-cols-3">
                <AdminStat label="累计发放返佣" value={totals.granted.toLocaleString("zh-CN")} note="积分" accent />
                <AdminStat label="已撤销返佣" value={totals.revoked.toLocaleString("zh-CN")} note="原返佣额度，实际扣回见明细" />
                <AdminStat label="邀请关系" value={relationTotal.toLocaleString("zh-CN")} note="一个用户只能被邀请一次" />
            </div>

            <AdminPanel
                title="返佣规则"
                description="被邀请人充值或会员订单支付成功后，按对应比例给邀请人发放积分；订单退款时自动撤回并扣回。"
                actions={
                    <Button type="primary" size="small" disabled={!permissions.includes("invites.manage")} loading={saving} onClick={() => void saveSettings()}>
                        保存设置
                    </Button>
                }
            >
                <div className="grid gap-4 sm:grid-cols-3">
                    <AdminField label="积分充值返佣比例（%）" hint="按充值订单到账积分计算，例如 10 表示充值 100 积分返 10 积分。">
                        <InputNumber
                            {...ADMIN_AUTOFILL_OFF}
                            name="sundas-invite-credits-percent"
                            className="w-full"
                            disabled={!permissions.includes("invites.manage")}
                            min={0}
                            max={100}
                            step={1}
                            value={settings.rebatePercent}
                            onChange={(value) => setSettings({ ...settings, rebatePercent: Number(value) || 0 })}
                        />
                    </AdminField>
                    <AdminField label="会员订单返佣比例（%）" hint="按会员套餐订单到账积分计算，例如 10 表示到账 100 积分返 10 积分。">
                        <InputNumber
                            {...ADMIN_AUTOFILL_OFF}
                            name="sundas-invite-membership-percent"
                            className="w-full"
                            disabled={!permissions.includes("invites.manage")}
                            min={0}
                            max={100}
                            step={1}
                            value={settings.membershipRebatePercent}
                            onChange={(value) => setSettings({ ...settings, membershipRebatePercent: Number(value) || 0 })}
                        />
                    </AdminField>
                    <div className="flex items-center justify-between rounded-[9px] border border-[var(--admin-line)] bg-[var(--admin-panel-soft)] px-3 py-2.5">
                        <div>
                            <div className="text-xs font-medium text-[var(--admin-ink)]">启用邀请返佣</div>
                            <div className="mt-0.5 text-[11px] text-[var(--admin-muted)]">关闭后不再发放新的返佣</div>
                        </div>
                        <Switch disabled={!permissions.includes("invites.manage")} checked={settings.enabled} onChange={(checked) => setSettings({ ...settings, enabled: checked })} />
                    </div>
                </div>
            </AdminPanel>

            <AdminPanel title="邀请关系" description="禁用后该关系不再产生返佣，已发放的积分不会扣回。" flush>
                <AdminToolbar>
                    <Input placeholder="用户 ID" value={filterUser} onChange={e => setFilterUser(e.target.value)} className="max-w-[220px]" />
                    <Select value={relationStatus} onChange={setRelationStatus} options={[{value:"",label:"全部关系"},{value:"active",label:"生效"},{value:"disabled",label:"禁用"}]} />
                    <Input type="date" value={from} onChange={e => setFrom(e.target.value)} className="max-w-[160px]" />
                    <Input type="date" value={to} onChange={e => setTo(e.target.value)} className="max-w-[160px]" />
                    <Input.Search
                        allowClear
                        placeholder="搜索邮箱"
                        className="max-w-[260px]"
                        value={keyword}
                        onChange={(event) => setKeyword(event.target.value)}
                        onSearch={() => {
                            if (relationPage === 1) void loadRelations(1);
                            else setRelationPage(1);
                        }}
                    />
                    <Button onClick={() => { if (relationPage === 1) void loadRelations(1); else setRelationPage(1); }}>查询关系</Button>
                </AdminToolbar>
                <Table<Relation>
                    rowKey="id"
                    loading={loading}
                    dataSource={relations}
                    columns={relationColumns}
                    scroll={{ x: 860 }}
                    pagination={{ current: relationPage, pageSize: 20, total: relationTotal, onChange: setRelationPage, size: "small" }}
                />
            </AdminPanel>

            <AdminPanel title="返佣记录" description="同一笔订单只返佣一次；退款后状态变为已撤回并扣回积分。" flush>
                <AdminToolbar><Input placeholder="订单号" value={orderNo} onChange={e => setOrderNo(e.target.value)} className="max-w-[240px]" /><Select value={rebateStatus} onChange={setRebateStatus} options={[{value:"",label:"全部返佣"},{value:"granted",label:"已发放"},{value:"revoked",label:"已撤回"}]} /><Button onClick={() => { if (rebatePage === 1) void loadRebates(1); else setRebatePage(1); }}>查询</Button></AdminToolbar>
                <Table<Rebate>
                    rowKey="id"
                    loading={loading}
                    dataSource={rebates}
                    columns={rebateColumns}
                    scroll={{ x: 1080 }}
                    pagination={{ current: rebatePage, pageSize: 20, total: rebateTotal, onChange: setRebatePage, size: "small" }}
                />
            </AdminPanel>
        </div>
    );
}
