import { useEffect, useState } from "react";
import { App as AntApp, AutoComplete, Button, Input, InputNumber, Modal, Select, Switch } from "antd";
import { Plus, Trash2 } from "lucide-react";

import { useAdminRequest } from "../use-admin-request";
import { ADMIN_AUTOFILL_OFF, AdminBadge, AdminField } from "./ui";

export type AdminFamily = {
    id: string;
    name: string;
    vendor: string;
    description: string;
    icon: string;
    sort: number;
    modelCount?: number;
};

export type AdminModelRoute = {
    id?: string;
    channelId: string;
    channelName?: string;
    unit: string;
    baseCredits: number | string;
    resolutionMultipliers: Record<string, number>;
    priority: number;
    weight: number;
    enabled: boolean;
    healthStatus?: string;
};

export type AdminModel = {
    id: string;
    familyId: string | null;
    familyName: string | null;
    upstreamName: string;
    displayName: string;
    description: string;
    capability: string;
    metadata: Record<string, unknown>;
    enabled: boolean;
    sort: number;
    routes: AdminModelRoute[];
};

type ChannelOption = { id: string; name: string; enabled: boolean; healthStatus?: string };
type ResolutionRow = { value: string; multiplier: number };
type RouteDraft = {
    channelId: string;
    unit: string;
    baseCredits: number;
    priority: number;
    weight: number;
    enabled: boolean;
    resolutions: ResolutionRow[];
};
type MetadataDraft = {
    visionInput: boolean;
    upscaleAdapter: string;
    imageProtocol: string;
    tags: string;
    refImages: number;
    refVideos: number;
    refAudios: number;
    durationMin: number;
    durationMax: number;
    aspectRatios: string;
    docsUrl: string;
    promptSkill: string;
};

type PromptSkillOption = { key: string; label: string; capability: "image" | "video"; description: string };

const CAPABILITIES = [
    { value: "image", label: "图片" },
    { value: "video", label: "视频" },
    { value: "text", label: "文本" },
    { value: "audio", label: "音频" },
];
const IMAGE_PROTOCOLS = [
    { value: "", label: "OpenAI Images（默认）" },
    { value: "gemini", label: "Gemini 原生" },
    { value: "gpt88", label: "GPT88" },
    { value: "catcode", label: "Catcode" },
    { value: "cangyuan", label: "Cangyuan" },
];
const UNITS = [
    { value: "image", label: "按张" },
    { value: "second", label: "按秒" },
    { value: "request", label: "按次" },
    { value: "1k_chars", label: "按千字符" },
];
const UNITS_BY_CAPABILITY: Record<string, string[]> = {
    image: ["image", "request"],
    video: ["second", "request"],
    text: ["request"],
    audio: ["1k_chars", "request"],
};
const defaultResolutions: ResolutionRow[] = [
    { value: "720", multiplier: 1 },
    { value: "1080", multiplier: 2 },
];

function unitsFor(capability: string) {
    return UNITS.filter((unit) => (UNITS_BY_CAPABILITY[capability] ?? []).includes(unit.value));
}

function nextUnit(capability: string, current: string) {
    const allowed = UNITS_BY_CAPABILITY[capability] ?? [];
    return allowed.includes(current) ? current : allowed[0] ?? "request";
}

function normalizeResolutionKey(value: string) {
    return String(value || "").trim().toLowerCase().replace(/p$/i, "");
}

function resolutionRowsFromMap(multipliers: Record<string, number> | undefined): ResolutionRow[] {
    const rows = Object.entries(multipliers ?? {}).map(([value, multiplier]) => ({ value: normalizeResolutionKey(value), multiplier: Number(multiplier) > 0 ? Number(multiplier) : 1 }));
    const unique = rows.filter((row, index) => row.value && rows.findIndex((item) => item.value === row.value) === index);
    return unique.length ? unique : defaultResolutions.map((row) => ({ ...row }));
}

function resolutionsToMap(rows: ResolutionRow[]) {
    const multipliers: Record<string, number> = {};
    for (const row of rows) {
        const value = normalizeResolutionKey(row.value);
        if (!value || multipliers[value] !== undefined) continue;
        multipliers[value] = Number(row.multiplier) > 0 ? Number(row.multiplier) : 1;
    }
    return multipliers;
}

function metadataDraftOf(metadata: Record<string, unknown> | undefined): MetadataDraft {
    const reference = (metadata?.referenceLimits ?? {}) as Record<string, unknown>;
    const durations = (metadata?.durations ?? {}) as Record<string, unknown>;
    return {
        upscaleAdapter: String((metadata?.upscale as { adapter?: string } | undefined)?.adapter ?? ''),
        imageProtocol: String(metadata?.imageProtocol ?? ""),
        tags: Array.isArray(metadata?.tags) ? metadata.tags.join(", ") : "",
        refImages: Number(reference.images) || 0,
        refVideos: Number(reference.videos) || 0,
        refAudios: Number(reference.audios) || 0,
        durationMin: Number(durations.min) || 0,
        durationMax: Number(durations.max) || 0,
        aspectRatios: Array.isArray(metadata?.aspectRatios) ? metadata.aspectRatios.join(", ") : "",
        docsUrl: String(metadata?.docsUrl ?? ""),
        promptSkill: String(metadata?.promptSkill ?? ""),
        visionInput: metadata?.visionInput === true,
    };
}

function metadataFromDraft(draft: MetadataDraft): Record<string, unknown> {
    const referenceLimits = {
        ...(draft.refImages > 0 ? { images: draft.refImages } : {}),
        ...(draft.refVideos > 0 ? { videos: draft.refVideos } : {}),
        ...(draft.refAudios > 0 ? { audios: draft.refAudios } : {}),
    };
    const durations = {
        ...(draft.durationMin > 0 ? { min: draft.durationMin } : {}),
        ...(draft.durationMax > 0 ? { max: draft.durationMax } : {}),
    };
    const aspectRatios = draft.aspectRatios.split(",").map((item) => item.trim()).filter(Boolean);
    return {
        ...(draft.upscaleAdapter ? { upscale: { enabled: true, adapter: draft.upscaleAdapter } } : {}),
        visionInput: draft.visionInput,
        ...(draft.tags.trim() ? { tags: draft.tags.split(",").map((item) => item.trim()).filter(Boolean) } : {}),
        ...(Object.keys(referenceLimits).length ? { referenceLimits } : {}),
        ...(Object.keys(durations).length ? { durations } : {}),
        ...(aspectRatios.length ? { aspectRatios } : {}),
        ...(draft.docsUrl.trim() ? { docsUrl: draft.docsUrl.trim() } : {}),
        ...(draft.promptSkill ? { promptSkill: draft.promptSkill } : {}),
    };
}

function routeDraftsOf(model: AdminModel | null, channels: ChannelOption[]): RouteDraft[] {
    if (model?.routes?.length) {
        return model.routes.map((route) => ({
            channelId: route.channelId,
            unit: nextUnit(model.capability, route.unit),
            baseCredits: Number(route.baseCredits) || 1,
            priority: Number(route.priority) || 0,
            weight: Number(route.weight) || 100,
            enabled: route.enabled !== false,
            resolutions: resolutionRowsFromMap(route.resolutionMultipliers),
        }));
    }
    return [
        {
            channelId: channels[0]?.id ?? "",
            unit: model?.capability === "video" ? "second" : "request",
            baseCredits: 1,
            priority: 0,
            weight: 100,
            enabled: true,
            resolutions: defaultResolutions.map((row) => ({ ...row })),
        },
    ];
}

export function ModelEditorModal({
    open,
    model,
    families,
    channels,
    modelSuggestions,
    onClose,
    onSaved,
}: {
    open: boolean;
    model: AdminModel | null;
    families: AdminFamily[];
    channels: ChannelOption[];
    modelSuggestions: string[];
    onClose: () => void;
    onSaved: () => Promise<void> | void;
}) {
    const apiRequest = useAdminRequest();
    const { message } = AntApp.useApp();
    const [familyId, setFamilyId] = useState("");
    const [upstreamName, setUpstreamName] = useState("");
    const [displayName, setDisplayName] = useState("");
    const [description, setDescription] = useState("");
    const [capability, setCapability] = useState("image");
    const [metadata, setMetadata] = useState<MetadataDraft>(metadataDraftOf({}));
    const [routes, setRoutes] = useState<RouteDraft[]>([]);
    const [enabled, setEnabled] = useState(true);
    const [saving, setSaving] = useState(false);
    const [promptSkills, setPromptSkills] = useState<PromptSkillOption[]>([]);
    const imageResolutionPricing = capability === 'image' && Boolean(model?.metadata?.cangyuanImage);

    useEffect(() => {
        if (!open) return;
        setFamilyId(model?.familyId ?? families[0]?.id ?? "");
        setUpstreamName(model?.upstreamName ?? "");
        setDisplayName(model?.displayName ?? "");
        setDescription(model?.description ?? "");
        setCapability(model?.capability ?? "image");
        setMetadata(metadataDraftOf(model?.metadata));
        setRoutes(routeDraftsOf(model, channels));
        setEnabled(model?.enabled !== false);
    }, [open, model]);

    useEffect(() => {
        if (!open) return;
        let alive = true;
        apiRequest<{ skills: PromptSkillOption[] }>("/api/admin/prompt-skills")
            .then((data) => { if (alive) setPromptSkills(data.skills); })
            .catch(() => { if (alive) setPromptSkills([]); });
        return () => { alive = false; };
    }, [open, apiRequest]);

    function updateRoute(index: number, patch: Partial<RouteDraft>) {
        setRoutes((current) => current.map((route, routeIndex) => (routeIndex === index ? { ...route, ...patch } : route)));
    }

    function changeCapability(value: string) {
        setCapability(value);
        setMetadata((current) => ({
            ...current,
            upscaleAdapter: '',
            promptSkill: promptSkills.some((skill) => skill.key === current.promptSkill && skill.capability === value) ? current.promptSkill : "",
        }));
        setRoutes((current) => current.map((route) => ({ ...route, unit: nextUnit(value, route.unit) })));
    }

    async function save() {
        if (metadata.upscaleAdapter && routes.some(route => !(route.baseCredits > 0))) { message.error('请填写超分模型的实际售价'); return; }
        if (!upstreamName.trim()) {
            message.error("请填写上游模型名");
            return;
        }
        if (!routes.length || routes.some((route) => !route.channelId)) {
            message.error("请至少配置一条完整线路");
            return;
        }
        setSaving(true);
        try {
            const { tags: _tags, referenceLimits: _referenceLimits, durations: _durations, aspectRatios: _aspectRatios, docsUrl: _docsUrl, promptSkill: _promptSkill, ...protocolMetadata } = model?.metadata ?? {};
            const editedMetadata = metadataFromDraft(metadata);
            if (protocolMetadata.videoProtocol === "tongxin") {
                editedMetadata.referenceLimits = { ...(editedMetadata.referenceLimits as Record<string, number> | undefined), videos: 0, audios: 0 };
            }
            const nextMetadata = { ...protocolMetadata, ...editedMetadata };
            if (!metadata.upscaleAdapter) delete nextMetadata.upscale;
            if (capability === "image" && metadata.imageProtocol) nextMetadata.imageProtocol = metadata.imageProtocol;
            else delete nextMetadata.imageProtocol;
            if (capability === "image" || capability === "video") {
                if (metadata.promptSkill) nextMetadata.promptSkill = metadata.promptSkill;
                else delete nextMetadata.promptSkill;
            } else {
                delete nextMetadata.promptSkill;
            }
            const payload = {
                familyId: familyId || null,
                upstreamName: upstreamName.trim(),
                displayName: displayName.trim() || upstreamName.trim(),
                description,
                capability,
                metadata: nextMetadata,
                enabled,
                routes: routes.map((route) => ({
                    channelId: route.channelId,
                    unit: route.unit,
                    baseCredits: route.baseCredits,
                    resolutionMultipliers: capability === "video" || imageResolutionPricing ? resolutionsToMap(route.resolutions) : {},
                    priority: route.priority,
                    weight: route.weight,
                    enabled: route.enabled,
                })),
            };
            await apiRequest(model?.id ? `/api/admin/models/${model.id}` : "/api/admin/models", {
                method: model?.id ? "PATCH" : "POST",
                json: payload,
            });
            message.success("模型已保存");
            await onSaved();
        } catch (error) {
            message.error(error instanceof Error ? error.message : String(error));
        } finally {
            setSaving(false);
        }
    }

    return (
        <Modal title={model ? "编辑模型" : "新增模型"} open={open} onCancel={onClose} onOk={() => void save()} okText="保存" confirmLoading={saving} width={760}>
            <div className="max-h-[70vh] space-y-5 overflow-y-auto pr-1 pt-1">
                <div className="grid gap-4 sm:grid-cols-2">
                    <AdminField label="模型族" hint="用于前台按 Seedance、Grok 等系列分组。">
                        <Select className="w-full" value={familyId || undefined} placeholder="未分组" onChange={setFamilyId} options={families.map((family) => ({ value: family.id, label: family.name }))} allowClear />
                    </AdminField>
                    <AdminField label="能力">
                        <Select className="w-full" value={capability} onChange={changeCapability} options={CAPABILITIES} />
                    </AdminField>
                    <AdminField label="上游模型名" required>
                        <AutoComplete className="w-full" value={upstreamName} onChange={setUpstreamName} options={modelSuggestions.map(value => ({ value }))} filterOption={(input, option) => String(option?.value ?? "").toLowerCase().includes(input.toLowerCase())} placeholder="选择已获取的模型，或手动输入名称" />
                    </AdminField>
                    <AdminField label="展示名">
                        <Input {...ADMIN_AUTOFILL_OFF} name="sundas-model-display-name" value={displayName} onChange={(event) => setDisplayName(event.target.value)} placeholder="用户看到的名字" />
                    </AdminField>
                </div>

                <AdminField label="模型描述" hint="显示在模型选择器详情里，可写适用场景、限制等。">
                    <Input.TextArea {...ADMIN_AUTOFILL_OFF} name="sundas-model-description" value={description} onChange={(event) => setDescription(event.target.value)} autoSize={{ minRows: 2, maxRows: 4 }} placeholder="例如：1080p 快速生成，适合口播和商品展示。" />
                </AdminField>

                {capability === 'text' && <AdminField label="图像理解能力" hint="仅在已验证上游支持图片输入时启用，供创作助手检查真实参考帧。"><label><input type="checkbox" checked={metadata.visionInput} onChange={event => setMetadata({ ...metadata, visionInput: event.target.checked })} /> 支持图像理解</label></AdminField>}
                {(capability === 'image' || capability === 'video') && <AdminField label="模型用途" hint="超分使用阿里云 VIAPI 渠道；配置售价并完成实际验收后启用，不会出现在普通生成列表。">
                    <Select className="w-full" value={metadata.upscaleAdapter} options={[{ value: '', label: '普通生成 / 编辑' },
                        { value: capability === 'image' ? 'aliyun-image-super-resolution' : 'aliyun-video-super-resolution', label: capability === 'image' ? '阿里云图片超分（1–4 倍）' : '阿里云视频超分（2 倍）' }]}
                        onChange={value => { setMetadata({ ...metadata, upscaleAdapter: value }); if (value) { setUpstreamName(capability === 'image' ? 'MakeSuperResolutionImage' : 'SuperResolveVideo'); setEnabled(false); setRoutes(items => items.map(item => ({ ...item, baseCredits: 0, resolutions: [] }))); } }} />
                </AdminField>}

                {capability === "image" || capability === "video" ? (
                    <AdminField label="提示词优化 Skill" hint="默认自动识别；也可按模型系列手动指定。">
                        <Select
                            className="w-full"
                            allowClear
                            value={metadata.promptSkill || undefined}
                            placeholder="自动识别"
                            options={promptSkills.filter((skill) => skill.capability === capability).map((skill) => ({ value: skill.key, label: skill.label }))}
                            onChange={(value) => setMetadata({ ...metadata, promptSkill: value ?? "" })}
                        />
                    </AdminField>
                ) : null}

                <div className="rounded-[9px] border border-[var(--admin-line)] p-3">
                    <div className="mb-3 text-xs font-medium text-[var(--admin-ink)]">能力与限制</div>
                    <div className="grid gap-3 sm:grid-cols-3">
                        <AdminField label="参考图上限">
                            <InputNumber {...ADMIN_AUTOFILL_OFF} name="sundas-model-ref-images" className="w-full" min={0} value={metadata.refImages} onChange={(value) => setMetadata({ ...metadata, refImages: Number(value) || 0 })} />
                        </AdminField>
                        {capability === "image" ? <AdminField label="图片协议" hint="Gemini 图片模型请选择 Gemini 原生。">
                            <Select className="w-full" value={metadata.imageProtocol} onChange={(value) => setMetadata({ ...metadata, imageProtocol: value })} options={IMAGE_PROTOCOLS} />
                        </AdminField> : null}
                        <AdminField label="参考视频上限">
                            <InputNumber {...ADMIN_AUTOFILL_OFF} name="sundas-model-ref-videos" className="w-full" min={0} value={metadata.refVideos} onChange={(value) => setMetadata({ ...metadata, refVideos: Number(value) || 0 })} />
                        </AdminField>
                        <AdminField label="参考音频上限">
                            <InputNumber {...ADMIN_AUTOFILL_OFF} name="sundas-model-ref-audios" className="w-full" min={0} value={metadata.refAudios} onChange={(value) => setMetadata({ ...metadata, refAudios: Number(value) || 0 })} />
                        </AdminField>
                        {capability === "video" ? (
                            <>
                                <AdminField label="最短时长（秒）">
                                    <InputNumber {...ADMIN_AUTOFILL_OFF} name="sundas-model-duration-min" className="w-full" min={0} value={metadata.durationMin} onChange={(value) => setMetadata({ ...metadata, durationMin: Number(value) || 0 })} />
                                </AdminField>
                                <AdminField label="最长时长（秒）">
                                    <InputNumber {...ADMIN_AUTOFILL_OFF} name="sundas-model-duration-max" className="w-full" min={0} value={metadata.durationMax} onChange={(value) => setMetadata({ ...metadata, durationMax: Number(value) || 0 })} />
                                </AdminField>
                                <AdminField label="宽高比">
                                    <Input {...ADMIN_AUTOFILL_OFF} name="sundas-model-aspect-ratios" value={metadata.aspectRatios} onChange={(event) => setMetadata({ ...metadata, aspectRatios: event.target.value })} placeholder="16:9, 9:16, 1:1" />
                                </AdminField>
                            </>
                        ) : null}
                    </div>
                    <div className="mt-3 grid gap-3 sm:grid-cols-2">
                        <AdminField label="标签">
                            <Input {...ADMIN_AUTOFILL_OFF} name="sundas-model-tags" value={metadata.tags} onChange={(event) => setMetadata({ ...metadata, tags: event.target.value })} placeholder="快速, 人物, 口播" />
                        </AdminField>
                        <AdminField label="文档链接">
                            <Input {...ADMIN_AUTOFILL_OFF} name="sundas-model-docs-url" value={metadata.docsUrl} onChange={(event) => setMetadata({ ...metadata, docsUrl: event.target.value })} placeholder="https://..." />
                        </AdminField>
                    </div>
                </div>

                <div className="space-y-3">
                    <div className="flex items-center justify-between gap-3">
                        <div>
                            <div className="text-xs font-medium text-[var(--admin-ink)]">模型线路</div>
                            <div className="mt-0.5 text-[11px] text-[var(--admin-muted)]">一个模型绑多个渠道；前台只显示一次，网关按优先级和健康状态选路。</div>
                        </div>
                        <Button size="small" icon={<Plus size={13} />} onClick={() => setRoutes([...routes, { channelId: channels[0]?.id ?? "", unit: nextUnit(capability, "request"), baseCredits: 1, priority: routes.length, weight: 100, enabled: true, resolutions: defaultResolutions.map((row) => ({ ...row })) }])}>
                            添加线路
                        </Button>
                    </div>
                    {routes.map((route, index) => (
                        <div key={index} className="space-y-3 rounded-[9px] border border-[var(--admin-line)] bg-[var(--admin-panel-soft)] p-3">
                            <div className="flex items-center justify-between gap-3">
                                <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                                    <span className="text-xs font-medium text-[var(--admin-ink)]">线路 {index + 1}</span>
                                    {route.channelId ? <AdminBadge tone={route.enabled ? "positive" : "neutral"}>{route.enabled ? "启用" : "停用"}</AdminBadge> : null}
                                </div>
                                <Button type="text" danger icon={<Trash2 size={14} />} aria-label="删除线路" onClick={() => setRoutes(routes.filter((_item, routeIndex) => routeIndex !== index))} />
                            </div>
                            <div className="grid gap-3 sm:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-4">
                                <AdminField label="渠道" required>
                                    <Select className="w-full" value={route.channelId || undefined} placeholder="选择渠道" onChange={(value) => updateRoute(index, { channelId: value })} options={channels.map((channel) => ({ value: channel.id, label: `${channel.name}${channel.healthStatus === "down" ? "（异常）" : ""}` }))} />
                                </AdminField>
                                <AdminField label="计量单位">
                                    <Select className="w-full" value={route.unit} onChange={(value) => updateRoute(index, { unit: value })} options={unitsFor(capability)} />
                                </AdminField>
                                <AdminField label="单价（积分）">
                                    <InputNumber {...ADMIN_AUTOFILL_OFF} name={`sundas-route-credits-${index}`} className="w-full" min={0.0001} step={0.5} value={route.baseCredits} onChange={(value) => updateRoute(index, { baseCredits: Number(value) || 0 })} />
                                </AdminField>
                                <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-2">
                                    <AdminField label="优先级">
                                        <InputNumber {...ADMIN_AUTOFILL_OFF} name={`sundas-route-priority-${index}`} className="w-full" value={route.priority} onChange={(value) => updateRoute(index, { priority: Number(value) || 0 })} />
                                    </AdminField>
                                    <AdminField label="权重">
                                        <InputNumber {...ADMIN_AUTOFILL_OFF} name={`sundas-route-weight-${index}`} className="w-full" min={1} value={route.weight} onChange={(value) => updateRoute(index, { weight: Number(value) || 100 })} />
                                    </AdminField>
                                </div>
                            </div>
                            <div className="flex items-center justify-between gap-3">
                                <span className="text-[11px] text-[var(--admin-muted)]">优先级越小越先尝试，权重用于同优先级排序。</span>
                                <Switch checked={route.enabled} onChange={(checked) => updateRoute(index, { enabled: checked })} />
                            </div>
                            {capability === "video" || imageResolutionPricing ? (
                                <div className="space-y-2 border-t border-[var(--admin-line)] pt-3">
                                    <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
                                        <span className="text-[11px] text-[var(--admin-muted)]">该线路支持的分辨率</span>
                                        <Button size="small" type="text" icon={<Plus size={12} />} onClick={() => updateRoute(index, { resolutions: [...route.resolutions, { value: "", multiplier: 1 }] })}>分辨率</Button>
                                    </div>
                                    {route.resolutions.map((row, resolutionIndex) => (
                                        <div key={resolutionIndex} className="grid grid-cols-[1fr_100px_28px] gap-2">
                                            <Input {...ADMIN_AUTOFILL_OFF} name={`sundas-route-resolution-${index}-${resolutionIndex}`} value={row.value} placeholder="720 / 1080 / 2k / 4k" onChange={(event) => updateRoute(index, { resolutions: route.resolutions.map((item, itemIndex) => (itemIndex === resolutionIndex ? { ...item, value: event.target.value } : item)) })} />
                                            <InputNumber {...ADMIN_AUTOFILL_OFF} name={`sundas-route-resolution-multiplier-${index}-${resolutionIndex}`} className="w-full" min={0.1} step={0.1} value={row.multiplier} onChange={(value) => updateRoute(index, { resolutions: route.resolutions.map((item, itemIndex) => (itemIndex === resolutionIndex ? { ...item, multiplier: Number(value) || 1 } : item)) })} />
                                            <Button type="text" danger icon={<Trash2 size={13} />} aria-label="删除分辨率" onClick={() => updateRoute(index, { resolutions: route.resolutions.filter((_item, itemIndex) => itemIndex !== resolutionIndex) })} />
                                        </div>
                                    ))}
                                </div>
                            ) : null}
                        </div>
                    ))}
                </div>

                <div className="flex items-center justify-between rounded-[9px] border border-[var(--admin-line)] bg-[var(--admin-panel-soft)] px-3 py-2.5">
                    <div>
                        <div className="text-xs font-medium text-[var(--admin-ink)]">启用模型</div>
                        <div className="mt-0.5 text-[11px] text-[var(--admin-muted)]">关闭后前台不会展示该模型。</div>
                    </div>
                    <Switch checked={enabled} onChange={setEnabled} />
                </div>
            </div>
        </Modal>
    );
}

type PendingNotification = { id: string; provider: string; orderNo: string | null; createdAt: string; tradeStatus: string | null; tradeNo: string | null; money: string | null; orderStatus: string | null; orderAmountCents: number | null; reason: string; reviewedAt: string | null; reviewNote: string | null; reviewedBy: string | null };

function PaymentNotifications() {
    const permissions = useAdminPermissions();
    const apiRequest = useAdminRequest();
    const { message } = AntApp.useApp();
    const [data, setData] = useState<{ items: PendingNotification[]; total: number }>({ items: [], total: 0 });
    const [page, setPage] = useState(1);
    const [reviewFilter, setReviewFilter] = useState("unreviewed");
    const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false);
    const [target, setTarget] = useState<PendingNotification | null>(null);
    const [note, setNote] = useState("");
    const [saving, setSaving] = useState(false);
    const loadSequence = useRef(0);
    async function load() {
        const sequence = ++loadSequence.current;
        setLoading(true);
        try { const result = await apiRequest<{ items: PendingNotification[]; total: number }>(`/api/admin/payment-notifications/unprocessed?page=${page}&pageSize=20&review=${reviewFilter}`); if (sequence === loadSequence.current) setData(result); }
        catch (error) { if (sequence === loadSequence.current) message.error(error instanceof Error ? error.message : String(error)); }
        finally { if (sequence === loadSequence.current) setLoading(false); }
    }
    useEffect(() => { void load(); return () => { loadSequence.current++; }; }, [page, reviewFilter]);
    async function review() {
        if (!target || !note.trim()) { message.warning("请填写核对说明"); return; }
        setSaving(true);
        try {
            await apiRequest(`/api/admin/payment-notifications/${target.id}/review`, { method: "POST", json: { note: note.trim() } });
            message.success("已记录人工核对，不改变支付状态"); setTarget(null); setNote(""); await load();
        } catch (error) { message.error(error instanceof Error ? error.message : String(error)); }
        finally { setSaving(false); }
    }
    const columns: TableColumnsType<PendingNotification> = [
        { title: "收到时间", dataIndex: "createdAt", render: (value: string) => dayjs(value).format("YYYY-MM-DD HH:mm:ss") },
        { title: "渠道", dataIndex: "provider" },
        { title: "订单号", dataIndex: "orderNo", render: (value: string | null) => value || "未提供" },
        { title: "平台交易号", dataIndex: "tradeNo", render: (value: string | null) => value || "未提供" },
        { title: "通知状态", dataIndex: "tradeStatus", render: (value: string | null) => value || "未提供" },
        { title: "通知金额", dataIndex: "money", render: (value: string | null) => value || "未提供" },
        { title: "当前核对结果", dataIndex: "reason" },
        { title: "站内订单", render: (_value, row) => row.orderStatus ? `${STATUS[row.orderStatus]?.label ?? row.orderStatus} · ¥${((row.orderAmountCents ?? 0) / 100).toFixed(2)}` : "未找到" },
        { title: "人工核对", render: (_value, row) => row.reviewedAt ? <span>已记录：{row.reviewNote} · {dayjs(row.reviewedAt).format("YYYY-MM-DD HH:mm:ss")} · 管理员 {row.reviewedBy}</span> : permissions.includes("orders.manage") ? <Button size="small" onClick={() => { setTarget(row); setNote(""); }}>记录核对</Button> : "未核对" },
    ];
    return <><AdminPanel title="未处理支付通知" description="仅列出验签通过、未处理且状态为成功或未提供状态的通知。核对结果基于当前订单信息，历史失败重试即使后续成功仍会保留；请对照支付平台核实，不代表资金已到账，也不会自动重放。" actions={<Button size="small" onClick={() => void load()}>刷新</Button>} flush>
        <AdminToolbar><Segmented value={reviewFilter} onChange={(value) => { setPage(1); setReviewFilter(String(value)); }} options={[{ label: "待人工核对", value: "unreviewed" }, { label: "已记录核对", value: "reviewed" }, { label: "全部", value: "all" }]} /></AdminToolbar>
        <Table rowKey="id" columns={columns} dataSource={data.items} loading={loading} scroll={{ x: 1100 }} pagination={{ current: page, pageSize: 20, total: data.total, onChange: setPage, showSizeChanger: false }} />
    </AdminPanel><Modal title="记录人工核对" open={Boolean(target)} onCancel={() => { if (!saving) setTarget(null); }} onOk={() => void review()} confirmLoading={saving} okText="保存核对记录" cancelText="取消">
        <p>通知 {target?.id}，订单 {target?.orderNo || "未提供"}。请先核实支付平台及站内订单；这里只记录核对说明，不会处理通知、修改订单或发放积分。</p>
        <Input.TextArea value={note} onChange={(event) => setNote(event.target.value)} rows={3} placeholder="填写核对结果和依据" />
    </Modal></>;
}

const STATUS: Record<string, { label: string; tone: AdminBadgeTone }> = {

type OrderSummary = {
    revenueCents: number;
    refundCents: number;
    netCents: number;
    paidOrders: number;
    paidUsers: number;
    credits: number;
    planRevenueCents: number;

type SummaryPreset = "today" | "24h" | "week" | "month" | "lastWeek" | "lastMonth";
const SUMMARY_PRESETS: { label: string; value: SummaryPreset }[] = [
    { label: "当天", value: "today" },
    { label: "近24小时", value: "24h" },
    { label: "本周", value: "week" },
    { label: "本月", value: "month" },
    { label: "上周", value: "lastWeek" },
    { label: "上月", value: "lastMonth" },
];
function weekStart(now: Dayjs) {
    return now.subtract((now.day() + 6) % 7, "day").startOf("day");
}
function rangeForPreset(preset: SummaryPreset): [Dayjs, Dayjs] {
    const now = dayjs();
    if (preset === "24h") return [now.subtract(24, "hour"), now];
    if (preset === "week") return [weekStart(now), now];
    if (preset === "month") return [now.startOf("month"), now];
    if (preset === "lastWeek") return [weekStart(now).subtract(7, "day"), weekStart(now)];
    if (preset === "lastMonth") return [now.subtract(1, "month").startOf("month"), now.startOf("month")];
    return [now.startOf("day"), now];
}
function formatRange(range: [Dayjs, Dayjs]) {
    return `${range[0].format("YYYY-MM-DD HH:mm")} ~ ${range[1].format("YYYY-MM-DD HH:mm")}`;
}
function formatMoney(cents: number) {
    return `¥${(cents / 100).toLocaleString("zh-CN", { minimumFractionDigits: 2, maximumFractionDigits: 2 })}`;
}

];

export function OrdersTab() {
    const permissions = useAdminPermissions();
    const [urlParams] = useSearchParams();
    const apiRequest = useAdminRequest();
    const { message } = AntApp.useApp();
    const [status, setStatus] = useState("");
    const [search, setSearch] = useState(urlParams.get("search") ?? "");
    const [query, setQuery] = useState(urlParams.get("search") ?? "");
    const [page, setPage] = useState(1);
    const [data, setData] = useState<{ items: AdminOrder[]; total: number }>({ items: [], total: 0 });
    const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false);
    const [summaryPreset, setSummaryPreset] = useState<SummaryPreset | "">("today");
    const [summaryRange, setSummaryRange] = useState<[Dayjs, Dayjs]>(() => rangeForPreset("today"));
    const [summary, setSummary] = useState<OrderSummary | null>(null);
    const [summaryLoading, setSummaryLoading] = useState(false);
    const [summaryError, setSummaryError] = useState("");
    const [target, setTarget] = useState<AdminOrder | null>(null);
    const [deduct, setDeduct] = useState(true);
    const [note, setNote] = useState("");
    const [refunding, setRefunding] = useState(false);
    const [refundPreview, setRefundPreview] = useState<{ refundAmountCents: number; durationDays: number; calculatedAt: string; canRefund: boolean } | null>(null);
    const [previewError, setPreviewError] = useState("");
    const [reviewTarget, setReviewTarget] = useState<AdminOrder | null>(null);
    const [review, setReview] = useState<FulfillmentReview | null>(null);
    const [reviewError, setReviewError] = useState("");
    const [externalAmount, setExternalAmount] = useState("");
    const [externalNote, setExternalNote] = useState("");
    const [externalConfirmed, setExternalConfirmed] = useState(false);
    const [noFulfillmentConfirmed, setNoFulfillmentConfirmed] = useState(false);
    const [recordingExternal, setRecordingExternal] = useState(false);

    useEffect(() => {
        let active = true;
        setReview(null); setReviewError(""); setExternalAmount(""); setExternalNote(""); setExternalConfirmed(false); setNoFulfillmentConfirmed(false);
        if (reviewTarget) void apiRequest<FulfillmentReview>(`/api/admin/orders/${encodeURIComponent(reviewTarget.orderNo)}/fulfillment-review`)
            .then((value) => { if (active) setReview(value); })
            .catch((error) => { if (active) setReviewError(error instanceof Error ? error.message : String(error)); });
        return () => { active = false; };
    }, [reviewTarget?.orderNo]);

    useEffect(() => {
        let active = true;
        setRefundPreview(null); setPreviewError("");
        if (target?.type === "plan") {
            void apiRequest<{ refundAmountCents: number; durationDays: number; calculatedAt: string; canRefund: boolean }>(`/api/admin/orders/${encodeURIComponent(target.orderNo)}/refund-preview`)
                .then((value) => { if (active) setRefundPreview(value); })
                .catch((error) => { if (active) setPreviewError(error instanceof Error ? error.message : String(error)); });
        }
        return () => { active = false; };
    }, [target?.orderNo, target?.type]);

    async function load() {
        setLoading(true);
        try {
            const params = new URLSearchParams({ page: String(page), pageSize: "20", status, search: query });
            setData(await apiRequest<{ items: AdminOrder[]; total: number }>(`/api/admin/orders?${params.toString()}`));
        } catch (error) {
            message.error(error instanceof Error ? error.message : String(error));
        } finally {
            setLoading(false);
        }
    }

    useEffect(() => {
        void load();
    }, [page, status, query]);

    useEffect(() => {
        let active = true;
        setSummaryLoading(true);
        setSummaryError("");
        const params = new URLSearchParams({ from: summaryRange[0].toISOString(), to: summaryRange[1].toISOString() });
        void apiRequest<OrderSummary>(`/api/admin/orders/summary?${params.toString()}`)
            .then((value) => { if (active) setSummary(value); })
            .catch((error) => { if (active) setSummaryError(error instanceof Error ? error.message : String(error)); })
            .finally(() => { if (active) setSummaryLoading(false); });
        return () => { active = false; };
    }, [summaryRange[0].valueOf(), summaryRange[1].valueOf()]);

    async function refund() {
        if (!target) return;
        setRefunding(true);
        try {
            const result = await apiRequest<{ deducted: number; shortfall: number; waived: number; rebateDeducted: number; rebateShortfall: number; refundAmountCents?: number; previousCycleTarget?: number; previousCycleAdjustment?: number }>(`/api/admin/orders/${target.orderNo}/refund`, {
                method: "POST",
                json: { deduct, note },
            });
            message.success(`已记录退款${result.refundAmountCents !== undefined ? ` ¥${(result.refundAmountCents / 100).toFixed(2)}，需另行在支付平台处理资金` : ""}，扣回 ${result.deducted} 积分${result.previousCycleTarget !== undefined ? `；旧周期保留 ${result.previousCycleTarget} 积分，调整 ${result.previousCycleAdjustment}` : ""}${result.shortfall ? `，差额 ${result.shortfall}` : ""}${result.waived ? `，未要求扣回 ${result.waived}` : ""}；返佣扣回 ${result.rebateDeducted}${result.rebateShortfall ? `，差额 ${result.rebateShortfall}` : ""}`);
            setTarget(null);
            setNote("");
            await load();
        } catch (error) {
            message.error(error instanceof Error ? error.message : String(error));
        } finally {
            setRefunding(false);
        }
    }

    async function recordExternalRefund() {
        if (!reviewTarget || !externalConfirmed || !noFulfillmentConfirmed || !externalNote.trim() || !/^\d+(?:\.\d{1,2})?$/.test(externalAmount.trim())) { message.warning("请填写实际退款金额、核对说明并完成两项确认"); return; }
        const [yuan, fraction = ""] = externalAmount.trim().split(".");
        const amountCents = Number(yuan) * 100 + Number(fraction.padEnd(2, "0"));
        if (!Number.isSafeInteger(amountCents) || amountCents <= 0 || amountCents > reviewTarget.amountCents) { message.warning("退款金额须大于零且不超过实付金额"); return; }
        setRecordingExternal(true);
        try {
            await apiRequest(`/api/admin/orders/${encodeURIComponent(reviewTarget.orderNo)}/record-external-refund`, { method: "POST", json: { amountCents, note: externalNote.trim(), confirmedExternalRefund: true, confirmedNoFulfillment: true } });
            message.success("已登记管理员确认的外部退款；系统未调用支付平台");
            setReviewTarget(null); await load();
        } catch (error) { message.error(error instanceof Error ? error.message : String(error)); }
        finally { setRecordingExternal(false); }
    }

    const columns: TableColumnsType<AdminOrder> = [
        { title: "订单号", dataIndex: "orderNo", render: (value: string) => <span className="font-medium tabular-nums text-[var(--admin-ink)]">{value}{permissions.includes("invites.read") && <> · <Link to={`/admin?tab=invite&orderNo=${encodeURIComponent(value)}`}>返佣记录</Link></>}</span> },
        { title: "用户", dataIndex: "email", render: (value: string) => <span className="text-[var(--admin-muted)]">{value}</span> },
        { title: "类型", dataIndex: "type", render: (value: string) => (value === "plan" ? "会员" : "积分") },
        { title: "金额", dataIndex: "amountCents", align: "right", render: (value: number) => <span className="font-medium tabular-nums text-[var(--admin-ink)]">¥{(value / 100).toFixed(2)}</span> },
        { title: "积分", dataIndex: "credits", align: "right", render: (value: number) => <span className="tabular-nums">{value.toLocaleString("zh-CN")}</span> },
        { title: "状态", dataIndex: "status", render: (value: string, row) => <AdminBadge tone={row.fulfillmentIssue ? "warning" : STATUS[value]?.tone ?? "neutral"}>{row.fulfillmentIssue ? "支付成功，权益待核对" : STATUS[value]?.label ?? value}</AdminBadge> },
        { title: "权益异常", dataIndex: "fulfillmentIssue", render: (value: string | null) => value ?? "—" },
        { title: "退款积分", render: (_value, row) => row.status !== "refunded" ? "—" : row.refundDeductRequested === null ? "历史记录未知" : row.refundDeductRequested ? `扣回 ${row.refundCreditDeducted} / ${row.refundCreditTarget}` : `未要求扣回 ${row.refundCreditTarget}` },
        { title: "记录应退", render: (_value, row) => row.refundAmountCents == null ? "—" : `¥${(row.refundAmountCents / 100).toFixed(2)}` },
        { title: "创建", dataIndex: "createdAt", render: (value: string) => <span className="tabular-nums text-[var(--admin-muted)]">{dayjs(value).format("MM-DD HH:mm")}</span> },
        {
            title: "操作",
            key: "actions",
            align: "right",
            render: (_value, record) =>
                record.fulfillmentIssue ? <Button size="small" onClick={() => setReviewTarget(record)}>查看核对信息</Button> : record.status === "paid" && permissions.includes("orders.manage") ? (
                    <Button size="small" danger onClick={() => setTarget(record)}>
                        退款
                    </Button>
                ) : null,
        },
    ];

    return (
        <div className="space-y-5">
            <Tabs
                defaultActiveKey="summary"
                items={[
                    {
                        key: "summary",
                        label: "账单总览",
                        children: <AdminPanel
                title="订单总览"

                    if (!value?.[0] || !value[1]) return;
                    setSummaryPreset("");
                    setSummaryRange([value[0].startOf("day"), value[1].endOf("day")]);
                }} />}
                flush
            >

                        setSummaryPreset(preset);
                        setSummaryRange(rangeForPreset(preset));
                    }} />

                {summaryError ? <p className="border-b border-[var(--admin-line)] px-5 py-3 text-xs text-[var(--admin-danger)]">{summaryError}</p> : null}
                <div className="grid divide-y divide-[var(--admin-line)] sm:grid-cols-2 sm:divide-x sm:divide-y-0 xl:grid-cols-3">
                    <AdminStat label="净收入" value={summaryLoading || !summary ? "—" : formatMoney(summary.netCents)} note={summary ? `支付 ${formatMoney(summary.revenueCents)} · 退款 ${formatMoney(summary.refundCents)}` : "加载中"} accent />
                    <AdminStat label="支付订单" value={summaryLoading || !summary ? "—" : summary.paidOrders.toLocaleString("zh-CN")} note={summary ? `${summary.paidUsers.toLocaleString("zh-CN")} 位用户 · 客单价 ${formatMoney(summary.paidOrders ? summary.revenueCents / summary.paidOrders : 0)}` : "加载中"} />
                    <AdminStat label="退款金额" value={summaryLoading || !summary ? "—" : formatMoney(summary.refundCents)} note="按退款时间统计" />
                    <AdminStat label="会员收入" value={summaryLoading || !summary ? "—" : formatMoney(summary.planRevenueCents)} note="已支付会员订单" />
                    <AdminStat label="积分收入" value={summaryLoading || !summary ? "—" : formatMoney(summary.creditRevenueCents)} note="已支付积分订单" />

                </div>

                        key: "orders",

                <AdminToolbar>

                                setPage(1);

                    <Segmented
                        value={status}
                        onChange={(value) => {
                            setPage(1);
                            setStatus(String(value));
                        }}
                        options={STATUS_OPTIONS}
                    />
                    <span className="ml-auto text-xs text-[var(--admin-muted)]">共 {data.total.toLocaleString("zh-CN")} 笔</span>
                </AdminToolbar>
                <Table<AdminOrder>
                    rowKey="orderNo"
                    loading={loading}
                    dataSource={data.items}
                    columns={columns}
                    scroll={{ x: 980 }}
                    pagination={{ current: page, pageSize: 20, total: data.total, onChange: setPage, showSizeChanger: false }}
                />
            </AdminPanel>,
                    },
                    {
                        key: "notifications",
                        label: "未处理支付通知",
                        children: <PaymentNotifications />,
                    },
                ]}
            />

            <Modal title="订单权益核对" open={Boolean(reviewTarget)} onCancel={() => { if (!recordingExternal) setReviewTarget(null); }} closable={!recordingExternal} maskClosable={!recordingExternal} footer={<div className="flex justify-end gap-2"><Button disabled={recordingExternal} onClick={() => setReviewTarget(null)}>关闭</Button>{permissions.includes("orders.manage") && <Button danger loading={recordingExternal} disabled={!review || !externalConfirmed || !noFulfillmentConfirmed} onClick={() => void recordExternalRefund()}>登记外部已退款</Button>}</div>} width={640}>
                {reviewError ? <p>{reviewError}</p> : !review ? <p>正在加载核对信息…</p> : <div className="space-y-3 text-sm">
                    <p>{review.order.fulfillmentIssue}</p>
                    <p>订单 {review.order.orderNo} · 已付 ¥{(review.order.amountCents / 100).toFixed(2)} · 支付时间 {review.order.paidAt ? dayjs(review.order.paidAt).format("YYYY-MM-DD HH:mm:ss") : "未知"}</p>
                    <p>支付通知：共 {review.notifications.total} 条，验签通过 {review.notifications.verified} 条，已处理 {review.notifications.processed} 条。</p>
                    {review.quote ? <div className="rounded border border-[var(--admin-line)] p-3"><p>报价时原会员</p><p>订阅 ID：{review.quote.subscriptionId ?? "未知"}</p><p>原订单 ID：{review.quote.previousOrderId ?? "未知"}</p><p>原套餐 ID：{review.quote.previousPlanId ?? "未知"}</p><p>到期时间：{review.quote.previousEndsAt ? dayjs(review.quote.previousEndsAt).format("YYYY-MM-DD HH:mm:ss") : "未知"}；周期积分：{review.quote.previousMonthlyCredits ?? "未知"}</p><p>下次发放：{review.quote.previousNextGrantAt ? dayjs(review.quote.previousNextGrantAt).format("YYYY-MM-DD HH:mm:ss") : "无或未记录"}；报价时间：{review.quote.quotedAt ? dayjs(review.quote.quotedAt).format("YYYY-MM-DD HH:mm:ss") : "未知"}</p></div> : <p>订单没有升档报价快照，请结合历史订单人工核对。</p>}
                    <div className="rounded border border-[var(--admin-line)] p-3"><p>当前相关会员记录</p>{review.subscriptions.length ? review.subscriptions.map((item) => <p key={item.id}>{item.planName ?? item.planId} · {item.status} · 到期 {dayjs(item.endsAt).format("YYYY-MM-DD HH:mm:ss")} · 周期积分 {item.monthlyCredits ?? "未知"} · 订阅 {item.id} · 当前订单 {item.currentOrderId ?? "未知"} · 下次发放 {item.nextGrantAt ? dayjs(item.nextGrantAt).format("YYYY-MM-DD HH:mm:ss") : "无或未记录"}</p>) : <p>没有可显示的当前会员记录。</p>}</div>
                    <p>系统不会调用或核实支付平台。仅在已核实该订单未发放权益、应退资金处理完成后登记实际金额；登记会结束此订单的待核对状态。</p>
                    <AdminField label="支付平台实际退款金额（元）"><Input value={externalAmount} onChange={(event) => setExternalAmount(event.target.value)} placeholder="例如 150.00" inputMode="decimal" /></AdminField>
                    <AdminField label="核对说明或支付平台退款凭证"><Input.TextArea value={externalNote} onChange={(event) => setExternalNote(event.target.value)} maxLength={300} rows={2} /></AdminField>
                    <Checkbox checked={externalConfirmed} onChange={(event) => setExternalConfirmed(event.target.checked)}>已核实该订单应退资金处理完成及实际退款金额</Checkbox>
                    <Checkbox checked={noFulfillmentConfirmed} onChange={(event) => setNoFulfillmentConfirmed(event.target.checked)}>已核实该订单未发放会员权益及积分</Checkbox>
                </div>}
            </Modal>
            <Modal
                title="退款确认"
                open={Boolean(target)}
                onCancel={() => setTarget(null)}
                onOk={() => void refund()}
                okText="确认退款"
                okButtonProps={{ danger: true, disabled: target?.type === "plan" && (!refundPreview?.canRefund || !deduct) }}
                confirmLoading={refunding}
                width={480}
            >
                <div className="space-y-4 pt-1">
                    <div className="rounded-[10px] border border-[var(--admin-line)] bg-[var(--admin-panel-soft)] px-4 py-3">
                        <div className="flex items-center justify-between gap-3">
                            <span className="font-medium tabular-nums text-[var(--admin-ink)]">{target?.orderNo}</span>
                            <span className="font-semibold tabular-nums text-[var(--admin-ink)]">¥{((target?.amountCents ?? 0) / 100).toFixed(2)}</span>
                        </div>
                        <div className="mt-1 text-xs text-[var(--admin-muted)]">{target?.email}</div>
                    </div>
                    {target?.type === "plan" && <p className="rounded-[9px] border border-[var(--admin-warning-line)] bg-[var(--admin-warning-soft)] px-3 py-2 text-xs leading-5 text-[var(--admin-warning)]">
                        {previewError || (refundPreview ? `按约 ${refundPreview.durationDays} 天权益时长估算可退 ¥${(refundPreview.refundAmountCents / 100).toFixed(2)}，计算时间 ${dayjs(refundPreview.calculatedAt).format("YYYY-MM-DD HH:mm:ss")}。${refundPreview.canRefund ? "最终金额以提交时计算结果为准；若账目不完整或有冻结，提交时会拒绝处理。" : "该订单暂不支持自动处理，请人工核对。"}` : "正在计算比例退款金额…")}
                    </p>}
                    <Checkbox checked={deduct} onChange={(event) => setDeduct(event.target.checked)}>
                        扣回该订单发放的积分
                    </Checkbox>
                    <AdminField label="备注">
                        <Input {...ADMIN_AUTOFILL_OFF} name="sundas-order-refund-note" value={note} onChange={(event) => setNote(event.target.value)} placeholder="备注（可选）" />
                    </AdminField>
                    <p className="rounded-[9px] border border-[var(--admin-warning-line)] bg-[var(--admin-warning-soft)] px-3 py-2 text-xs leading-5 text-[var(--admin-warning)]">
                        {target?.type === "plan" ? "系统只记录应退金额并调整会员权益，不会调用支付平台退款接口；请按记录金额另行处理资金。" : "系统只标记退款，不会调用支付平台退款接口。请先在支付平台完成原路退回。"}
                    </p>
                </div>
            </Modal>
        </div>
    );
}
