import { useEffect, useState } from "react";
import { App as AntApp, Button, DatePicker, Input, InputNumber, Modal, Select, Table, Tabs } from "antd";
import type { TableColumnsType } from "antd";
import dayjs, { type Dayjs } from "dayjs";
import { Plus } from "lucide-react";

import { useAdminRequest } from "../use-admin-request";
import { useAdminPermissions } from "../permissions";
import { ADMIN_AUTOFILL_OFF, AdminBadge, AdminField, AdminPanel, AdminToolbar, type AdminBadgeTone } from "./ui";

type Batch = { id: string; name: string; credits: number; count: number; used: number; expiresAt: string | null; createdAt: string };
type Code = { id: string; code: string; credits: number; status: string; expiresAt: string | null; usedAt: string | null; usedBy: string | null };

const STATUS: Record<string, { label: string; tone: AdminBadgeTone }> = {
    unused: { label: "未使用", tone: "positive" },
    used: { label: "已使用", tone: "neutral" },
    void: { label: "已作废", tone: "danger" },
};

export function RedeemTab() {
    const permissions = useAdminPermissions();
    const apiRequest = useAdminRequest();
    const { message, modal } = AntApp.useApp();
    const [batches, setBatches] = useState<Batch[]>([]);
    const [codes, setCodes] = useState<Code[]>([]);
    const [batchId, setBatchId] = useState("");
    const [status, setStatus] = useState("");
    const [page, setPage] = useState(1);
    const [total, setTotal] = useState(0);
    const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false);
    const [activeTab, setActiveTab] = useState("codes");
    const [generating, setGenerating] = useState(false);
    const [generateOpen, setGenerateOpen] = useState(false);
    const [name, setName] = useState("");
    const [credits, setCredits] = useState(100);
    const [count, setCount] = useState(10);
    const [expiresAt, setExpiresAt] = useState<Dayjs | null>(null);

    async function loadBatches() {
        const data = await apiRequest<{ batches: Batch[] }>("/api/admin/redeem/batches");
        setBatches(data.batches);
    }

    async function loadCodes() {
        setLoading(true);
        try {
            const params = new URLSearchParams({ page: String(page), pageSize: "20", status, batchId });
            const data = await apiRequest<{ items: Code[]; total: number }>(`/api/admin/redeem/codes?${params.toString()}`);
            setCodes(data.items);
            setTotal(data.total);
        } catch (error) {
            message.error(error instanceof Error ? error.message : String(error));
        } finally {
            setLoading(false);
        }
    }

    useEffect(() => {
        void loadBatches().catch((error: unknown) => message.error(error instanceof Error ? error.message : String(error)));
    }, []);

    useEffect(() => {
        void loadCodes();
    }, [batchId, status, page]);

    async function generate() {
        setGenerating(true);
        try {
            const result = await apiRequest<{ generated: number }>("/api/admin/redeem/batches", {
                method: "POST",
                json: { name, credits, count, expiresAt: expiresAt ? expiresAt.toISOString() : null },
            });
            message.success(`已生成 ${result.generated} 个兑换码`);
            setGenerateOpen(false);
            setName("");
            setActiveTab("codes");
            await loadBatches();
            await loadCodes();
        } catch (error) {
            message.error(error instanceof Error ? error.message : String(error));
        } finally {
            setGenerating(false);
        }
    }

    function voidCode(code: Code) {
        modal.confirm({
            title: "作废该兑换码？",
            content: code.code,
            okButtonProps: { danger: true },
            onOk: async () => {
                await apiRequest(`/api/admin/redeem/codes/${code.id}/void`, { method: "POST" });
                await loadCodes();
            },
        });
    }

    const batchColumns: TableColumnsType<Batch> = [
        { title: "批次", dataIndex: "name", render: (value: string) => <span className="font-medium text-[var(--admin-ink)]">{value || "未命名批次"}</span> },
        { title: "面额", dataIndex: "credits", align: "right", render: (value: number) => <span className="tabular-nums">{value.toLocaleString("zh-CN")}</span> },
        { title: "数量", dataIndex: "count", align: "right", render: (value: number) => <span className="tabular-nums">{value}</span> },
        { title: "已用", dataIndex: "used", align: "right", render: (value: number) => <span className="tabular-nums">{value}</span> },
        { title: "过期", dataIndex: "expiresAt", render: (value: string | null) => <span className="text-[var(--admin-muted)]">{value ? dayjs(value).format("YYYY-MM-DD") : "永久"}</span> },
        {
            title: "操作",
            key: "actions",
            align: "right",
            render: (_value, record) => (
                <div className="flex justify-end gap-1.5">
                    <Button
                        size="small"
                        onClick={() => {
                            setBatchId(record.id);
                            setPage(1);
                            setActiveTab("codes");
                        }}
                    >
                        查看
                    </Button>
                    {permissions.includes("redeem.export") && <Button size="small" onClick={() => window.open(`/api/admin/redeem/batches/${record.id}/export`, "_blank")}>
                        导出
                    </Button>}
                </div>
            ),
        },
    ];

    const codeColumns: TableColumnsType<Code> = [
        { title: "兑换码", dataIndex: "code", render: (value: string) => <span className="font-medium tabular-nums text-[var(--admin-ink)]">{value}</span> },
        { title: "面额", dataIndex: "credits", align: "right", render: (value: number) => <span className="tabular-nums">{value.toLocaleString("zh-CN")}</span> },
        { title: "状态", dataIndex: "status", render: (value: string) => <AdminBadge tone={STATUS[value]?.tone ?? "neutral"}>{STATUS[value]?.label ?? value}</AdminBadge> },
        { title: "使用者", dataIndex: "usedBy", render: (value: string | null) => <span className="text-[var(--admin-muted)]">{value ?? "-"}</span> },
        { title: "使用时间", dataIndex: "usedAt", render: (value: string | null) => <span className="tabular-nums text-[var(--admin-muted)]">{value ? dayjs(value).format("MM-DD HH:mm") : "-"}</span> },
        {
            title: "操作",
            key: "actions",
            align: "right",
            render: (_value, record) => (permissions.includes("redeem.manage") && record.status === "unused" ? <Button size="small" danger onClick={() => voidCode(record)}>作废</Button> : null),
        },
    ];

    return (
        <div>
            <Tabs
                activeKey={activeTab}
                onChange={setActiveTab}
                tabBarExtraContent={
                    permissions.includes("redeem.manage") && <Button type="primary" icon={<Plus className="size-4" />} onClick={() => setGenerateOpen(true)}>
                        生成兑换码
                    </Button>
                }
                items={[
                    {
                        key: "codes",
                        label: `兑换码 ${total}`,
                        children: (
                            <AdminPanel flush>
                                <AdminToolbar>
                                    <Select
                                        className="w-36"
                                        value={status}
                                        onChange={(value) => {
                                            setStatus(value);
                                            setPage(1);
                                        }}
                                        options={[
                                            { value: "", label: "全部状态" },
                                            { value: "unused", label: "未使用" },
                                            { value: "used", label: "已使用" },
                                            { value: "void", label: "已作废" },
                                        ]}
                                    />
                                    {batchId ? (
                                        <AdminBadge tone="accent" dot={false}>
                                            已筛选批次
                                            <button type="button" className="ml-1 underline underline-offset-2" onClick={() => setBatchId("")}>
                                                清除
                                            </button>
                                        </AdminBadge>
                                    ) : null}
                                    <span className="ml-auto text-xs text-[var(--admin-muted)]">共 {total.toLocaleString("zh-CN")} 个兑换码</span>
                                </AdminToolbar>
                                <Table<Code>
                                    rowKey="id"
                                    loading={loading}
                                    dataSource={codes}
                                    columns={codeColumns}
                                    scroll={{ x: 780 }}
                                    pagination={{ current: page, pageSize: 20, total, onChange: setPage, showSizeChanger: false }}
                                />
                            </AdminPanel>
                        ),
                    },
                    {
                        key: "batches",
                        label: `批次 ${batches.length}`,
                        children: (
                            <AdminPanel flush>
                                <AdminToolbar>
                                    <span className="text-xs text-[var(--admin-muted)]">批次用于追踪一次生成的一批兑换码，可按批次导出。</span>
                                </AdminToolbar>
                                <Table<Batch> rowKey="id" dataSource={batches} columns={batchColumns} pagination={false} scroll={{ x: 760 }} />
                            </AdminPanel>
                        ),
                    },
                ]}
            />

            <Modal
                title="生成兑换码"
                open={generateOpen}
                onCancel={() => setGenerateOpen(false)}
                onOk={() => void generate()}
                okText="生成"
                confirmLoading={generating}
                width={480}
            >
                <div className="space-y-4 pt-1">
                    <AdminField label="批次备注" hint="只用于后台识别，不会展示给用户。">
                        <Input {...ADMIN_AUTOFILL_OFF} name="sundas-redeem-batch-name" value={name} onChange={(event) => setName(event.target.value)} placeholder="例如 十月活动" />
                    </AdminField>
                    <div className="grid gap-4 sm:grid-cols-2">
                        <AdminField label="面额（积分）" required>
                            <InputNumber {...ADMIN_AUTOFILL_OFF} name="sundas-redeem-credits" className="w-full" min={1} value={credits} onChange={(value) => setCredits(Number(value) || 1)} />
                        </AdminField>
                        <AdminField label="数量" required>
                            <InputNumber {...ADMIN_AUTOFILL_OFF} name="sundas-redeem-count" className="w-full" min={1} max={5000} value={count} onChange={(value) => setCount(Number(value) || 1)} />
                        </AdminField>
                    </div>
                    <AdminField label="过期时间" hint="留空表示永久有效。">
                        <DatePicker className="w-full" showTime value={expiresAt} onChange={setExpiresAt} placeholder="永久有效" />
                    </AdminField>
                </div>
            </Modal>
        </div>
    );
}

type SettingsTab = { key: string; label: string; description: string; icon: typeof Globe2; sections: SectionKey[] };

const TABS: SettingsTab[] = [
    { key: "site", label: "站点", description: "站点名称和描述会出现在页面元信息与前台展示中。", icon: Globe2, sections: ["site"] },
    { key: "home", label: "首页文案", description: "覆盖首页各区块的标题、描述与按钮文案；留空表示沿用内置默认文案（跟随界面语言）。保存后刷新前台页面生效。", icon: Home, sections: ["home"] },
    { key: "smtp", label: "邮件", description: "注册验证码、找回密码等邮件依赖这里的 SMTP 配置。", icon: Mail, sections: ["smtp"] },
    { key: "payments", label: "支付渠道", description: "至少启用一个渠道；密钥只写入不回显，保存后下一次支付请求生效。", icon: CreditCard, sections: ["alipay", "epay", "zpay"] },
    { key: "billing", label: "计费", description: "会员折扣、活动倍率和积分价格会直接影响下单与生成扣费。", icon: Calculator, sections: ["billing"] },
    { key: "orders", label: "支付方式与订单", description: "控制支付订单的有效期与收银台展示的支付方式。", icon: ReceiptText, sections: ["payment"] },
    { key: "storage", label: "存储", description: "配置每个用户的媒体存储空间上限，用户头像菜单会显示已用容量。", icon: HardDrive, sections: ["storage"] },
    { key: "creationChat", label: "对话看图", description: "配置创作聊天专用的视觉模型和启用状态。", icon: Sparkles, sections: ["creationChat"] },
    { key: "promptOptimizer", label: "提示词优化", description: "选择前台提示词优化使用的文本模型（Chat / Responses）；按该模型现有价格正常扣积分。", icon: Sparkles, sections: ["promptOptimizer"] },
];

type SettingsState = Record<string, Record<string, unknown>>;

export function SettingsTab() {
    const apiRequest = useAdminRequest();
    const { message } = AntApp.useApp();
    const [settings, setSettings] = useState<SettingsState>({});
    const [saved, setSaved] = useState<SettingsState>({});
    const [activeTab, setActiveTab] = useState("site");
    const [saving, setSaving] = useState("");
    const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
    const [error, setError] = useState("");

    const load = useCallback(async () => {
        setLoading(true);
        setError("");
        try {
            const data = await apiRequest<{ settings: SettingsState }>("/api/admin/settings");
            setSettings(data.settings);
            setSaved(data.settings);
        } catch (reason) {
            const text = reason instanceof Error ? reason.message : String(reason);
            setError(text);
            message.error(text);
        } finally {
            setLoading(false);
        }
    }, [message]);

    useEffect(() => {
        void load();
    }, [load]);

    function update(section: SectionKey, field: string, value: unknown) {
        setSettings((previous) => ({ ...previous, [section]: { ...(previous[section] ?? {}), [field]: value } }));
    }

    function isDirty(tab: SettingsTab) {
        return tab.sections.some((section) => JSON.stringify(settings[section] ?? {}) !== JSON.stringify(saved[section] ?? {}));
    }

    async function save(tab: SettingsTab) {
        setSaving(tab.key);
        try {
            for (const section of tab.sections) {
                await apiRequest(`/api/admin/settings/${section}`, { method: "PUT", json: { value: settings[section] ?? {} } });
            }
            setSaved((previous) => {
                const next = { ...previous };
                for (const section of tab.sections) next[section] = settings[section] ?? {};
                return next;
            });
            if (tab.sections.includes("site")) clearSiteInfoCache();
            message.success("设置已保存，下一次请求生效");
        } catch (reason) {
            message.error(reason instanceof Error ? reason.message : String(reason));
        } finally {
            setSaving("");
        }
    }

    if (loading) return <AdminLoading label="正在读取系统设置" />;
    if (error && !Object.keys(settings).length) {
        return (
            <AdminPanel title="设置暂时不可用" description={error} actions={<Button icon={<RefreshCw className="size-4" />} onClick={() => void load()}>重试</Button>}>
                <p className="text-sm text-[var(--admin-muted)]">检查 API 服务或管理员权限后重试。</p>
            </AdminPanel>
        );
    }

    return (
        <div>
            <div className="mb-5 flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-3">
                <p className="text-xs leading-5 text-[var(--admin-muted)]">修改保存后立即写入数据库，支付与邮件参数会在下一次请求使用。</p>
                <AdminBadge tone="neutral" dot={false}>按页签分别保存</AdminBadge>
            </div>
            <Tabs
                activeKey={activeTab}
                onChange={setActiveTab}
                items={TABS.map((tab) => ({
                    key: tab.key,
                    label: (
                        <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-2">
                            <span className="hidden sm:inline-flex">
                                <tab.icon className="size-3.5" />
                            </span>
                            {tab.label}
                            {isDirty(tab) ? <span className="size-1.5 rounded-full bg-[var(--admin-warning)]" /> : null}
                        </span>
                    ),
                    children: (
                        <SettingsPane
                            tab={tab}
                            settings={settings}
                            update={update}
                            dirty={isDirty(tab)}
                            saving={saving === tab.key}
                            disabled={Boolean(saving)}
                            onSave={() => void save(tab)}
                        />
                    ),
                }))}
            />
        </div>
    );
}

function SettingsPane({
    tab,
    settings,
    update,
    dirty,
    saving,
    disabled,
    onSave,
}: {
    tab: SettingsTab;
    settings: SettingsState;
    update: (section: SectionKey, field: string, value: unknown) => void;
    dirty: boolean;
    saving: boolean;
    disabled: boolean;
    onSave: () => void;
}) {
    const canManage = useAdminPermissions().includes("settings.manage");
    return (
        <AdminPanel
            title={tab.label}
            description={tab.description}
            actions={dirty ? <AdminBadge tone="warning" dot={false}>有未保存修改</AdminBadge> : <AdminBadge tone="positive" dot={false}>已同步</AdminBadge>}
        >
            <form autoComplete="off" onSubmit={(event) => event.preventDefault()}>
                <fieldset disabled={!canManage}>
                {tab.key === "payments" ? (
                    <div className="grid gap-4 xl:grid-cols-2">
                        {tab.sections.map((section) => (
                            <PaymentSection key={section} section={SECTIONS[section]} settings={settings} update={update} />
                        ))}
                    </div>
                ) : (
                    <SectionFields section={SECTIONS[tab.sections[0]]} settings={settings} update={update} />
                )}
                <div className="mt-6 flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-3 border-t border-[var(--admin-line)] pt-4">
                    <span className="text-[11px] text-[var(--admin-muted)]">保存后立即生效；密钥类字段不会回显明文。</span>
                    {canManage && <Button type="primary" loading={saving} disabled={!dirty || disabled} onClick={onSave}>
                        保存更改
                    </Button>}
                </div>
                </fieldset>
            </form>
        </AdminPanel>
    );
}

function PaymentSection({
    section,
    settings,
    update,
}: {
    section: Section;
    settings: SettingsState;
    update: (section: SectionKey, field: string, value: unknown) => void;
}) {
    const enabled = Boolean(settings[section.key]?.enabled);
    return (
        <section className="rounded-[12px] border border-[var(--admin-line)] bg-[var(--admin-panel-soft)] p-4">
            <div className="mb-4 flex items-center justify-between gap-3">
                <h3 className="text-sm font-semibold text-[var(--admin-ink)]">{section.title}</h3>
                <AdminBadge tone={enabled ? "positive" : "neutral"}>{enabled ? "已启用" : "未启用"}</AdminBadge>
            </div>
            <div className="grid gap-4">
                {section.fields.filter((field) => field.type !== "bool").map((field) => (
                    <SettingControl key={field.name} section={section} field={field} settings={settings} update={update} />
                ))}
            </div>
            <div className="mt-4 border-t border-[var(--admin-line)] pt-4">
                {section.fields.filter((field) => field.type === "bool").map((field) => (
                    <SettingControl key={field.name} section={section} field={field} settings={settings} update={update} />
                ))}
            </div>
        </section>
    );
}

function SectionFields({ section, settings, update }: { section: Section; settings: SettingsState; update: (section: SectionKey, field: string, value: unknown) => void }) {
    return (
        <div className="grid gap-x-5 gap-y-5 md:grid-cols-2">
            {section.fields.map((field) => (
                <SettingControl key={field.name} section={section} field={field} settings={settings} update={update} className={field.span === 2 ? "md:col-span-2" : undefined} />
            ))}
        </div>
    );
}

function SettingControl({
    section,
    field,
    settings,
    update,
    className,
}: {
    section: Section;
    field: SettingField;
    settings: SettingsState;
    update: (section: SectionKey, field: string, value: unknown) => void;
    className?: string;
}) {
    const value = settings[section.key]?.[field.name];
    const name = `sundas-${section.key}-${field.name}`;
    const apiRequest = useAdminRequest();
    const [promptSources, setPromptSources] = useState<{ id: string; name: string }[]>([]);
    const [models, setModels] = useState<{ id: string; displayName: string; capability: string; enabled: boolean; routes: { unit: string; protocol: string; textMode: string; enabled: boolean }[] }[]>([]);

    useEffect(() => {
        if (field.type !== "source") return;
        let alive = true;
        fetchPromptSources().then((list) => { if (alive) setPromptSources(list); }).catch(() => { if (alive) setPromptSources([]); });
        return () => { alive = false; };
    }, [field.type]);

    useEffect(() => {
        if (field.type !== "model") return;
        let alive = true;
        apiRequest<{ models: { id: string; displayName: string; capability: string; enabled: boolean; routes: { unit: string; protocol: string; textMode: string; enabled: boolean }[] }[] }>("/api/admin/models")
            .then((data) => { if (alive) setModels(data.models); })
            .catch(() => { if (alive) setModels([]); });
        return () => { alive = false; };
    }, [apiRequest, field.type]);

    if (field.type === "source") {
        return (
            <AdminField label={field.label} hint={field.hint} className={className}>
                <Select
                    className="w-full"
                    allowClear
                    value={String(value ?? "") || undefined}
                    placeholder={field.placeholder}
                    options={promptSources.map((source) => ({ label: `${source.name}（${source.id}）`, value: source.id }))}
                    onChange={(next) => update(section.key, field.name, next ?? "")}
                />
            </AdminField>
        );
    }

    if (field.type === "model") {
        const options = models.filter((model) => model.enabled && model.capability === field.modelCapability
            && model.routes.some((route) => route.enabled && route.unit === "request" && route.protocol === "openai"))
            .map((model) => ({ value: model.id, label: model.displayName }));
        return (
            <AdminField label={field.label} hint={field.hint} className={className}>
                <Select
                    className="w-full"
                    showSearch
                    allowClear
                    optionFilterProp="label"
                    value={String(value ?? "") || undefined}
                    placeholder={field.placeholder}
                    options={options}
                    notFoundContent="暂无已启用的 OpenAI 文本模型"
                    onChange={(next) => update(section.key, field.name, next ?? "")}
                />
            </AdminField>
        );
    }

    if (field.type === "bool") {
        return (
            <AdminField label={field.label} hint={field.hint} className={className}>
                <div className="flex h-[38px] items-center justify-between rounded-[9px] border border-[var(--admin-line)] bg-[var(--admin-panel)] px-3">
                    <span className="text-xs text-[var(--admin-muted)]">{value ? "已启用" : "未启用"}</span>
                    <Switch checked={Boolean(value)} onChange={(checked) => update(section.key, field.name, checked)} />
                </div>
            </AdminField>
        );
    }

    if (field.type === "payTypes") {
        return (
            <AdminField label={field.label} hint={field.hint} className={className}>
                <Checkbox.Group name={name} value={Array.isArray(value) ? value : []}
                    options={[{ label: "微信支付", value: "wxpay" }, { label: "支付宝", value: "alipay" }]}
                    onChange={(next) => update(section.key, field.name, next)} />
            </AdminField>
        );
    }

    if (field.type === "textarea") {
        return (
            <AdminField label={field.label} hint={field.hint} className={className}>
                <Input.TextArea {...ADMIN_AUTOFILL_OFF} name={name} rows={3} value={String(value ?? "")} placeholder={field.placeholder} onChange={(event) => update(section.key, field.name, event.target.value)} />
            </AdminField>
        );
    }

    if (field.type === "number") {
        return (
            <AdminField label={field.label} hint={field.hint} className={className}>
                <InputNumber {...ADMIN_AUTOFILL_OFF} name={name} className="w-full" value={Number(value ?? 0)} step={field.step} onChange={(next) => update(section.key, field.name, Number(next) || 0)} />
            </AdminField>
        );
    }

    if (field.type === "list") {
        return (
            <AdminField label={field.label} hint={field.hint} className={className}>
                <Input
                    {...ADMIN_AUTOFILL_OFF}
                    name={name}
                    value={Array.isArray(value) ? value.join(", ") : String(value ?? "")}
                    placeholder={field.placeholder}
                    onChange={(event) => update(section.key, field.name, event.target.value.split(",").map((item) => item.trim()).filter(Boolean))}
                />
            </AdminField>
        );
    }

    return (
        <AdminField label={field.label} hint={field.hint} className={className}>
            {field.type === "password" ? (
                <Input.Password {...ADMIN_AUTOFILL_OFF} autoComplete="new-password" name={name} value={String(value ?? "")} placeholder={field.placeholder} onChange={(event) => update(section.key, field.name, event.target.value)} />
            ) : (
                <Input {...ADMIN_AUTOFILL_OFF} name={name} value={String(value ?? "")} placeholder={field.placeholder} onChange={(event) => update(section.key, field.name, event.target.value)} />
            )}
        </AdminField>
    );
}

import type { ReactNode } from "react";
import { Spin } from "antd";

import { cn } from "@/lib/utils";

export function AdminPanel({
    title,
    description,
    actions,
    children,
    className,
    bodyClassName,
    flush = false,
}: {
    title?: ReactNode;
    description?: ReactNode;
    actions?: ReactNode;
    children: ReactNode;
    className?: string;
    bodyClassName?: string;
    flush?: boolean;
}) {
    return (
        <section className={cn("overflow-hidden rounded-[14px] border border-[var(--admin-line)] bg-[var(--admin-panel)]", className)}>
            {title || description || actions ? (
                <div className="flex flex-wrap items-start justify-between gap-3 border-b border-[var(--admin-line)] px-5 py-4">
                    <div className="min-w-0">
                        {title ? <h2 className="text-[15px] font-semibold tracking-[-0.01em] text-[var(--admin-ink)]">{title}</h2> : null}
                        {description ? <p className="mt-1 max-w-[72ch] text-xs leading-5 text-[var(--admin-muted)]">{description}</p> : null}
                    </div>
                    {actions ? <div className="ml-auto flex shrink-0 flex-wrap items-center gap-2">{actions}</div> : null}
                </div>
            ) : null}
            <div className={cn(flush ? "" : "p-5", bodyClassName)}>{children}</div>
        </section>
    );
}

export function AdminToolbar({ children, className }: { children: ReactNode; className?: string }) {
    return <div className={cn("flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2 border-b border-[var(--admin-line)] px-5 py-3", className)}>{children}</div>;
}

export function AdminField({
    label,
    hint,
    required,
    children,
    className,
}: {
    label: ReactNode;
    hint?: ReactNode;
    required?: boolean;
    children: ReactNode;
    className?: string;
}) {
    return (
        <label className={cn("block", className)}>
            <span className="mb-1.5 flex items-center gap-1 text-xs font-medium text-[var(--admin-muted)]">
                {label}
                {required ? <span className="text-[var(--admin-danger)]">*</span> : null}
            </span>
            {children}
            {hint ? <span className="mt-1.5 block text-[11px] leading-4 text-[var(--admin-muted)]">{hint}</span> : null}
        </label>
    );
}

export const ADMIN_AUTOFILL_OFF = {
    autoComplete: "off",
    "data-lpignore": "true",
    "data-1p-ignore": "true",
    "data-form-type": "other",
} as const;

export type AdminBadgeTone = "neutral" | "positive" | "warning" | "danger" | "accent";

const BADGE_TONES: Record<AdminBadgeTone, string> = {
    neutral: "border-[var(--admin-line)] bg-[var(--admin-panel-soft)] text-[var(--admin-muted)]",
    positive: "border-[var(--admin-positive-line)] bg-[var(--admin-positive-soft)] text-[var(--admin-positive)]",
    warning: "border-[var(--admin-warning-line)] bg-[var(--admin-warning-soft)] text-[var(--admin-warning)]",
    danger: "border-[var(--admin-danger-line)] bg-[var(--admin-danger-soft)] text-[var(--admin-danger)]",
    accent: "border-[rgba(212,255,58,0.38)] bg-[var(--admin-accent-soft)] text-[var(--admin-ink)] dark:text-[var(--admin-accent)]",
};

export function AdminBadge({ tone = "neutral", children, dot = true }: { tone?: AdminBadgeTone; children: ReactNode; dot?: boolean }) {
    return (
        <span className={cn("inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 rounded-full border px-2 py-0.5 text-[11px] font-medium leading-5", BADGE_TONES[tone])}>
            {dot ? <span className="size-1.5 rounded-full bg-current" /> : null}
            {children}
        </span>
    );
}

export function AdminStat({ label, value, note, accent = false }: { label: ReactNode; value: ReactNode; note?: ReactNode; accent?: boolean }) {
    return (
        <div className="min-w-0 px-5 py-5 sm:px-6">
            <div className="flex items-center justify-between gap-3">
                <span className="text-xs font-medium text-[var(--admin-muted)]">{label}</span>
                {accent ? <span className="size-1.5 rounded-full bg-[var(--admin-accent)]" /> : null}
            </div>
            <div className="mt-2.5 text-[28px] font-semibold leading-none tracking-[-0.035em] tabular-nums text-[var(--admin-ink)]">{value}</div>
            {note ? <div className="mt-2.5 text-[11px] leading-4 text-[var(--admin-muted)]">{note}</div> : null}
        </div>
    );
}

export function AdminLoading({ label = "加载中" }: { label?: string }) {
    return (
        <div className="flex min-h-40 flex-col items-center justify-center gap-2">
            <Spin size="small" />
            <span className="text-xs text-[var(--admin-muted)]">{label}</span>
        </div>
    );
}

import { useEffect, useState } from "react";
import type { Key } from "react";
import { App as AntApp, Button, Input, InputNumber, Modal, Select, Table } from "antd";
import type { TableColumnsType } from "antd";
import dayjs from "dayjs";
import { RefreshCw, Search } from "lucide-react";
import { useSearchParams } from "react-router-dom";

import { useAdminRequest } from "../use-admin-request";
import { ADMIN_AUTOFILL_OFF, AdminBadge, AdminField, AdminPanel, AdminToolbar } from "./ui";
import { UserDetail } from "../users/user-detail";
import { useAdminPermissions } from "../permissions";

type AdminUser = {
    id: string;
    email: string;
    displayName: string;
    role: string;
    status: string;
    balance: number;
    held: number;
    member: boolean;
    createdAt: string;
    lastLoginAt: string | null;
};

export function UsersTab() {
    const permissions = useAdminPermissions();
    const [urlParams] = useSearchParams();
    const apiRequest = useAdminRequest();
    const { message, modal } = AntApp.useApp();
    const [search, setSearch] = useState(urlParams.get("search") ?? "");
    const [query, setQuery] = useState(urlParams.get("search") ?? "");
    const [statusFilter, setStatusFilter] = useState("");
    const [page, setPage] = useState(1);
    const [data, setData] = useState<{ items: AdminUser[]; total: number }>({ items: [], total: 0 });
    const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false);
    const [target, setTarget] = useState<AdminUser | null>(null);
    const [detailUserId, setDetailUserId] = useState<string | null>(null);
    const [amount, setAmount] = useState(0);
    const [remark, setRemark] = useState("");
    const [adjusting, setAdjusting] = useState(false);
    const [selected, setSelected] = useState<Key[]>([]);
    const [batchStatus, setBatchStatus] = useState<"active" | "banned" | null>(null);
    const [batchNote, setBatchNote] = useState("");
    const [batchResult, setBatchResult] = useState<{ id: string; success: boolean; error?: string }[] | null>(null);

    async function load() {
        setLoading(true);
        try {
            const params = new URLSearchParams({ page: String(page), pageSize: "20", search: query, status: statusFilter });
            const result = await apiRequest<{ items: AdminUser[]; total: number }>(`/api/admin/users?${params}`);
            setData(result);
        } catch (error) {
            message.error(error instanceof Error ? error.message : String(error));
        } finally {
            setLoading(false);
        }
    }

    useEffect(() => {
        void load();
    }, [page, query, statusFilter]);

    async function adjust() {
        if (!target) return;
        setAdjusting(true);
        try {
            await apiRequest(`/api/admin/users/${target.id}/credits`, { method: "POST", json: { amount, remark } });
            message.success("积分已调整");
            setTarget(null);
            setAmount(0);
            setRemark("");
            await load();
        } catch (error) {
            message.error(error instanceof Error ? error.message : String(error));
        } finally {
            setAdjusting(false);
        }
    }

    function toggleStatus(user: AdminUser) {
        modal.confirm({
            title: user.status === "active" ? "禁用该用户？" : "恢复该用户？",
            content: user.email,
            okText: user.status === "active" ? "禁用" : "恢复",
            okButtonProps: { danger: user.status === "active" },
            onOk: async () => {
                await apiRequest(`/api/admin/users/${user.id}`, { method: "PATCH", json: { status: user.status === "active" ? "banned" : "active" } });
                await load();
            },
        });
    }

    async function batchUpdate() {
        if (!batchStatus || !batchNote.trim()) { message.warning("请填写操作原因"); return; }
        setAdjusting(true);
        try {
            const result = await apiRequest<{ results: { id: string; success: boolean; error?: string }[] }>("/api/admin/users/batch-status", { method: "POST", json: { userIds: selected, status: batchStatus, note: batchNote } });
            setBatchStatus(null); setBatchNote(""); setSelected([]); setBatchResult(result.results); await load();
        } catch (error) { message.error(error instanceof Error ? error.message : String(error)); }
        finally { setAdjusting(false); }
    }

    const columns: TableColumnsType<AdminUser> = [
        {
            title: "用户",
            dataIndex: "email",
            render: (value: string, record) => (
                <div className="min-w-0">
                    <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                        <span className="truncate font-medium text-[var(--admin-ink)]">{value}</span>
                        {record.role === "admin" ? <AdminBadge tone="accent">管理员</AdminBadge> : null}
                    </div>
                    <div className="mt-0.5 truncate text-xs text-[var(--admin-muted)]">{record.displayName || "未设置昵称"}</div>
                </div>
            ),
        },
        {
            title: "积分",
            dataIndex: "balance",
            render: (value: number, record) => (
                <div>
                    <div className="font-medium tabular-nums text-[var(--admin-ink)]">{value.toLocaleString("zh-CN")}</div>
                    {record.held ? <div className="mt-0.5 text-[11px] text-[var(--admin-muted)]">冻结 {record.held}</div> : null}
                </div>
            ),
        },
        { title: "会员", dataIndex: "member", render: (value: boolean) => <AdminBadge tone={value ? "positive" : "neutral"}>{value ? "会员" : "普通"}</AdminBadge> },
        { title: "状态", dataIndex: "status", render: (value: string) => <AdminBadge tone={value === "active" ? "positive" : "danger"}>{value === "active" ? "正常" : "禁用"}</AdminBadge> },
        { title: "注册时间", dataIndex: "createdAt", render: (value: string) => <span className="tabular-nums text-[var(--admin-muted)]">{dayjs(value).format("YYYY-MM-DD HH:mm")}</span> },
        {
            title: "操作",
            key: "actions",
            align: "right",
            render: (_value, record) => (
                <div className="flex justify-end gap-1.5">
                    <Button size="small" onClick={() => setDetailUserId(record.id)}>详情</Button>
                    {permissions.includes("credits.adjust") && <Button size="small" onClick={() => setTarget(record)}>
                        调积分
                    </Button>}
                    {permissions.includes("users.manage") && <Button size="small" danger={record.status === "active"} onClick={() => toggleStatus(record)}>
                        {record.status === "active" ? "禁用" : "恢复"}
                    </Button>}
                </div>
            ),
        },
    ];

    return (
        <div className="space-y-5">
            <UserDetail userId={detailUserId} onClose={() => setDetailUserId(null)} onChanged={() => void load()} />
            <AdminPanel title="用户列表" description="按邮箱或昵称搜索，调整积分或控制账户访问。" actions={<Button size="small" icon={<RefreshCw className="size-3.5" />} loading={loading} onClick={() => void load()}>刷新</Button>} flush>
                <AdminToolbar>
                    <div className="w-full sm:w-80">
                        <Input.Search
                            {...ADMIN_AUTOFILL_OFF}
                            name="sundas-admin-user-search"
                            placeholder="搜索邮箱或昵称"
                            value={search}
                            onChange={(event) => setSearch(event.target.value)}
                            onSearch={(value) => {
                                setPage(1);
                                setQuery(value.trim());
                            }}
                            className="w-full"
                            allowClear
                            prefix={<Search className="size-4 text-[var(--admin-muted)]" />}
                        />
                    </div>
                    <Select value={statusFilter} onChange={value => { setPage(1); setStatusFilter(value); }} options={[{ value: "", label: "全部状态" }, { value: "active", label: "正常" }, { value: "banned", label: "已禁用" }]} />
                    <span className="ml-auto text-xs text-[var(--admin-muted)]">共 {data.total.toLocaleString("zh-CN")} 位用户</span>
                    {permissions.includes("users.manage") && <><Button disabled={!selected.length} onClick={() => setBatchStatus("active")}>批量恢复</Button><Button danger disabled={!selected.length} onClick={() => setBatchStatus("banned")}>批量禁用</Button></>}
                </AdminToolbar>
                <Table<AdminUser>
                    rowKey="id"
                    loading={loading}
                    dataSource={data.items}
                    columns={columns}
                    rowSelection={permissions.includes("users.manage") ? { selectedRowKeys: selected, onChange: setSelected } : undefined}
                    scroll={{ x: 900 }}
                    pagination={{ current: page, pageSize: 20, total: data.total, onChange: setPage, showSizeChanger: false }}
                />
            </AdminPanel>

            <Modal title={`确认${batchStatus === "banned" ? "禁用" : "恢复"} ${selected.length} 位用户`} open={Boolean(batchStatus)} onCancel={() => { setBatchStatus(null); setBatchNote(""); }} onOk={() => void batchUpdate()} confirmLoading={adjusting}>
                <p>选中用户：{selected.join("、")}</p><AdminField label="操作原因"><Input value={batchNote} onChange={event => setBatchNote(event.target.value)} /></AdminField>
            </Modal>
            <Modal title="批量操作结果" open={Boolean(batchResult)} onCancel={() => setBatchResult(null)} footer={<Button onClick={() => setBatchResult(null)}>关闭</Button>}>
                {batchResult?.map(item => <p key={item.id}>{item.id}：{item.success ? "成功" : item.error}</p>)}
            </Modal>

            <Modal
                title="调整积分"
                open={Boolean(target)}
                onCancel={() => setTarget(null)}
                onOk={() => void adjust()}
                okText="确认调整"
                confirmLoading={adjusting}
                okButtonProps={{ disabled: amount === 0 }}
                width={460}
            >
                <div className="space-y-4 pt-1">
                    <div className="rounded-[10px] border border-[var(--admin-line)] bg-[var(--admin-panel-soft)] px-4 py-3">
                        <div className="truncate text-sm font-medium text-[var(--admin-ink)]">{target?.email}</div>
                        <div className="mt-1 text-xs text-[var(--admin-muted)]">
                            当前余额 <span className="font-semibold tabular-nums text-[var(--admin-ink)]">{target?.balance ?? 0}</span>
                            {target?.held ? ` · 冻结 ${target.held}` : ""}
                        </div>
                    </div>
                    <AdminField label="调整数量" hint="正数增加，负数扣减；扣减时最多扣到余额为 0。">
                        <InputNumber {...ADMIN_AUTOFILL_OFF} name="sundas-user-credit-amount" className="w-full" value={amount} onChange={(value) => setAmount(Number(value) || 0)} placeholder="例如 100 或 -50" />
                    </AdminField>
                    <AdminField label="备注">
                        <Input {...ADMIN_AUTOFILL_OFF} name="sundas-user-credit-remark" value={remark} onChange={(event) => setRemark(event.target.value)} placeholder="说明这次调整的原因" />
                    </AdminField>
                </div>
            </Modal>
        </div>
    );
}

import { useEffect, useState } from "react";
import { App as AntApp, ConfigProvider, Drawer } from "antd";

import { BrandWordmark } from "@/components/brand/brand-wordmark";

type TabKey = "dashboard" | "users" | "orders" | "tasks" | "catalog" | "redeem" | "announcements" | "promo" | "invite" | "settings" | "audit" | "prompts" | "access" | "analytics" | "prompt-items";

const TAB_PERMISSION: Record<TabKey, string[]> = {
    "prompt-items": ["prompts.read"], dashboard: ["dashboard.read"], users: ["users.read"], orders: ["orders.read"], tasks: ["tasks.read"],
    catalog: ["channels.read", "models.read", "catalog.read"], redeem: ["redeem.read"], announcements: ["announcements.read"],
    promo: ["promo.read"], invite: ["invites.read"], settings: ["settings.read"], audit: ["audit.read"], prompts: ["prompts.read"], access: ["admins.manage"], analytics: ["tasks.read"],
};
function canAccessTab(key: TabKey, permissions: string[] | null) {
    if (!permissions) return false;
    if (key === "tasks") return permissions.includes("tasks.read") || permissions.includes("credits.read");
    if (key === "catalog") return TAB_PERMISSION.catalog.some(permission => permissions.includes(permission));
    return TAB_PERMISSION[key].every(permission => permissions.includes(permission));
}

type NavItem = {
    key: TabKey;
    label: string;
    icon: LucideIcon;
    title: string;
    description: string;
};

const NAV_GROUPS: { label: string; items: NavItem[] }[] = [
    {
        label: "总览",
        items: [{ key: "dashboard", label: "看板", icon: LayoutDashboard, title: "今日概览", description: "今天的收入、用户、积分与生成任务健康度。" }],
    },
    {
        label: "运营",

const MENU = NAV_GROUPS.flatMap((group) => group.items);
const DATE_FORMAT = new Intl.DateTimeFormat("zh-CN", { year: "numeric", month: "long", day: "numeric", weekday: "long" });

function isTabKey(value: string | null): value is TabKey {
    return MENU.some((item) => item.key === value);
}

export default function AdminPage() {
    const userId = useAuthStore((state) => state.user?.id ?? null);
    const sessionEpoch = useAuthStore((state) => state.sessionEpoch);
    return (
        <RequireAdmin>
            <AdminTheme key={`${sessionEpoch}:${userId ?? ""}`} />
        </RequireAdmin>
    );
}

function AdminTheme() {
    const dark = useThemeStore((state) => state.theme) === "dark";
    return (
        <ConfigProvider theme={getAdminThemeConfig(dark)}>
            <AntApp>
                <AdminShell />
            </AntApp>
        </ConfigProvider>
    );
}

function AdminShell() {
    const user = useAuthStore((state) => state.user);
    const request = useAdminRequest();
    const [permissions, setPermissions] = useState<string[] | null>(null);
    const [permissionError, setPermissionError] = useState("");
    useEffect(() => {
        let current = true;
        setPermissions(null); setPermissionError("");
        const refresh = () => accessApi(request).me().then(result => { if (current) { setPermissions(result.permissions); setPermissionError(""); } }).catch(error => { if (current) setPermissionError(error instanceof Error ? error.message : String(error)); });
        void refresh();
        window.addEventListener("sundas-admin-permissions-changed", refresh);
        return () => { current = false; window.removeEventListener("sundas-admin-permissions-changed", refresh); };
    }, [request]);
    const [searchParams, setSearchParams] = useSearchParams();
    const [mobileOpen, setMobileOpen] = useState(false);
    const tabParam = searchParams.get("tab");
    const allowed = MENU.filter(item => canAccessTab(item.key, permissions));
    const activeTab: TabKey = isTabKey(tabParam) && allowed.some(item => item.key === tabParam) ? tabParam : allowed[0]?.key ?? "dashboard";
    const meta = MENU.find((item) => item.key === activeTab) ?? MENU[0];

    function selectTab(key: TabKey) {
        setSearchParams({ tab: key }, { replace: true });
        setMobileOpen(false);
    }

    useEffect(() => {
        document.body.classList.add("admin-theme");
        return () => document.body.classList.remove("admin-theme");
    }, []);

    useEffect(() => {
        const previous = document.title;
        document.title = `${meta.title} · sundas 管理后台`;
        return () => {
            document.title = previous;
        };
    }, [meta.title]);

    if (permissionError) return <div className="p-8">权限加载失败：{permissionError}，请刷新页面重试。</div>;
    if (!permissions) return <div className="p-8">正在加载管理员权限…</div>;
    if (!allowed.length) return <div className="p-8">当前账号没有可访问的后台页面。</div>;

    return (
        <AdminPermissionsContext.Provider value={permissions}><div className="admin-shell flex h-dvh overflow-hidden">
            <aside className="hidden w-[248px] shrink-0 flex-col bg-[var(--admin-sidebar)] lg:flex">
                <SidebarBrand />
                <AdminNav active={activeTab} onSelect={selectTab} permissions={permissions} />
                <SidebarFooter email={user?.email} />
            </aside>

            <Drawer
                open={mobileOpen}
                onClose={() => setMobileOpen(false)}
                placement="left"
                width={280}
                closable={false}
                styles={{ body: { padding: 0, background: "var(--admin-sidebar)" } }}
            >
                <div className="flex h-full flex-col bg-[var(--admin-sidebar)]">
                    <div className="flex h-[72px] items-center justify-between border-b border-white/10 px-5">
                        <BrandWordmark height={18} />
                        <button type="button" onClick={() => setMobileOpen(false)} className="grid size-8 place-items-center rounded-lg text-white/60 transition hover:bg-white/10 hover:text-white" aria-label="关闭菜单">
                            <X className="size-4" />
                        </button>
                    </div>
                    <AdminNav active={activeTab} onSelect={selectTab} permissions={permissions} />
                    <SidebarFooter email={user?.email} />
                </div>
            </Drawer>

            <div className="flex min-w-0 flex-1 flex-col">
                <div className="flex items-center justify-between border-b border-[var(--admin-line)] px-4 py-3 lg:hidden">
                    <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                        <BrandWordmark height={15} />
                        <span className="text-[11px] text-[var(--admin-muted)]">管理后台</span>
                    </div>
                    <button type="button" onClick={() => setMobileOpen(true)} className="grid size-9 place-items-center rounded-lg border border-[var(--admin-line)] text-[var(--admin-ink)]" aria-label="打开菜单">
                        <Menu className="size-4" />
                    </button>
                </div>

                <header className="border-b border-[var(--admin-line)] bg-[var(--admin-bg)]">
                    <div className="mx-auto flex w-full max-w-[1480px] flex-col px-5 py-6 sm:px-8 lg:px-10">
                        <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5 text-[11px] text-[var(--admin-muted)]">
                            <span>管理后台</span>
                            <ChevronRight className="size-3" />
                            <span>{NAV_GROUPS.find((group) => group.items.some((item) => item.key === activeTab))?.label}</span>
                        </div>
                        <div className="mt-2 flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-x-6 gap-y-3">
                            {/* 行内 margin：全局 markdown 排版对 h1/p 的 margin 会盖掉 tailwind 间距类，这里显式归零以保证与右侧区块垂直居中对齐 */}
                            <h1 style={{ margin: 0 }} className="min-w-0 text-[26px] font-semibold leading-tight tracking-[-0.035em] text-[var(--admin-ink)]">{meta.title}</h1>
                            <div className="flex shrink-0 items-center gap-3">
                                <div className="hidden text-right md:block">
                                    <div className="text-xs leading-5 text-[var(--admin-muted)]">{DATE_FORMAT.format(new Date())}</div>
                                    <div className="text-[11px] leading-4 text-[var(--admin-muted)]">{user?.email}</div>
                                </div>
                                <div className="grid size-9 place-items-center rounded-full border border-[var(--admin-line)] bg-[var(--admin-panel)] text-xs font-semibold text-[var(--admin-ink)]">
                                    {(user?.email?.[0] ?? "A").toUpperCase()}
                                </div>
                            </div>
                        </div>
                        <p style={{ margin: "16px 0 0" }} className="max-w-[70ch] text-sm leading-6 text-[var(--admin-muted)]">{meta.description}</p>
                    </div>
                </header>

                <main className="min-h-0 flex-1 overflow-y-auto">
                    <PageTransition className="mx-auto w-full max-w-[1480px] px-5 py-6 sm:px-8 lg:px-10 lg:py-8">
                        {activeTab === "dashboard" ? <DashboardTab /> : null}
                        {activeTab === "users" ? <UsersTab /> : null}
                        {activeTab === "prompts" ? <PromptSourcesTab /> : null}
                        {activeTab === "access" ? <AccessTab /> : null}
                        {activeTab === "analytics" ? <AnalyticsTab /> : null}
                        {activeTab === "orders" ? <OrdersTab /> : null}
                        {activeTab === "tasks" ? <TasksTab /> : null}
                        {activeTab === "catalog" ? <CatalogTab /> : null}
                        {activeTab === "redeem" ? <RedeemTab /> : null}
                        {activeTab === "announcements" ? <AnnouncementsTab /> : null}
                        {activeTab === "promo" ? <PromoConfigTab /> : null}
                        {activeTab === "prompt-items" ? <PromptsTab /> : null}
                        {activeTab === "invite" ? <InviteTab /> : null}
                        {activeTab === "settings" ? <SettingsTab /> : null}
                        {activeTab === "audit" ? <AuditTab /> : null}
                    </PageTransition>
                </main>
            </div>
        </div></AdminPermissionsContext.Provider>
    );
}

function SidebarBrand() {
    return (
        <div className="flex h-[88px] items-center gap-3 border-b border-[var(--admin-sidebar-line)] px-5">
            <BrandWordmark height={18} />
            <span className="rounded-full border border-white/15 px-2 py-0.5 text-[10px] text-white/45">Admin</span>
        </div>
    );
}

function AdminNav({ active, onSelect, permissions }: { active: TabKey; onSelect: (key: TabKey) => void; permissions: string[] }) {
    return (
        <nav className="flex-1 overflow-y-auto px-3 py-5">
            {NAV_GROUPS.filter(group => group.items.some(item => canAccessTab(item.key, permissions))).map((group) => (
                <div key={group.label} className="mb-6 last:mb-0">
                    <div className="mb-2 px-3 text-[10px] text-white/35">{group.label}</div>
                    <div className="space-y-1.5">
                        {group.items.filter(item => canAccessTab(item.key, permissions)).map((item) => {
                            const Icon = item.icon;
                            const selected = active === item.key;
                            return (
                                <button
                                    key={item.key}
                                    type="button"
                                    onClick={() => onSelect(item.key)}
                                    aria-current={selected ? "page" : undefined}
                                    className={cn(
                                        "relative flex w-full items-center gap-2.5 rounded-[9px] px-3 py-2.5 text-left text-[13px] transition-colors",
                                        selected
                                            ? "bg-white/[0.07] text-white"
                                            : "text-[var(--admin-sidebar-text)] hover:bg-white/[0.06] hover:text-white",
                                    )}
                                >
                                    {selected ? <span className="absolute left-0 top-1/2 h-4 w-[3px] -translate-y-1/2 rounded-r-full bg-[var(--admin-accent)]" /> : null}
                                    <Icon className={cn("size-4", selected ? "text-[var(--admin-accent)]" : "text-[var(--admin-sidebar-muted)]")} />
                                    <span className="min-w-0 flex-1 truncate">{item.label}</span>
                                    {selected ? <span className="size-1.5 rounded-full bg-[var(--admin-accent)]" /> : null}
                                </button>
                            );
                        })}
                    </div>
                </div>
            ))}
        </nav>
    );
}

function SidebarFooter({ email }: { email?: string }) {
    return (
        <div className="border-t border-[var(--admin-sidebar-line)] p-4">
            <div className="truncate text-center text-[11px] text-white/45">{email}</div>
            <Link
                to="/"
                className="admin-sidebar-cta mt-2.5 inline-flex h-10 w-full items-center justify-center gap-1.5 rounded-full px-4 text-[13px] font-semibold"
            >
                <WandSparkles className="size-4" />
                返回前台
                <ArrowUpRight className="size-3.5" />
            </Link>
        </div>
    );
}

import { useEffect, useState } from "react";
import { App as AntApp, Button, Input, Modal, Select, Switch, Table, Tag } from "antd";
import type { TableColumnsType } from "antd";
import dayjs from "dayjs";
import { promptAdminApi, type PromptJob, type PromptJobSource, type PromptSource } from "@/services/api/admin/prompts";
import { useAdminRequest } from "../use-admin-request";
import { AdminField, AdminPanel } from "../components/ui";
import { useAdminPermissions } from "../permissions";

const labels: Record<string, string> = { queued: "等待中", running: "同步中", succeeded: "成功", partial_failed: "部分失败", failed: "失败", skipped: "已跳过" };
const time = (value: string | null) => value ? dayjs(value).format("YYYY-MM-DD HH:mm:ss") : "—";

export function PromptSourcesTab() {
    const request = useAdminRequest();
    const permissions = useAdminPermissions();
    const api = promptAdminApi(request);
    const { message } = AntApp.useApp();
    const [sources, setSources] = useState<PromptSource[]>([]);
    const [enabledFilter, setEnabledFilter] = useState("");
    const [jobs, setJobs] = useState<PromptJob[]>([]);
    const [page, setPage] = useState(1);
    const [total, setTotal] = useState(0);
    const [pageSize, setPageSize] = useState(20);
    const [sourceFilter, setSourceFilter] = useState("");
    const [statusFilter, setStatusFilter] = useState("");
    const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false);
    const [busy, setBusy] = useState("");
    const [draft, setDraft] = useState<{ id: string; name: string; url: string; homepage: string; enabled: boolean } | null>(null);
    const [creating, setCreating] = useState(false);
    const [detail, setDetail] = useState<{ job: PromptJob; sources: PromptJobSource[] } | null>(null);
    const report = (error: unknown) => message.error(error instanceof Error ? error.message : String(error));
    async function load(current = page, source = sourceFilter, status = statusFilter) {
        setLoading(true);
        try {
            const [sourceData, jobData] = await Promise.all([api.sources(), api.jobs(current, source, status)]);
            setSources(sourceData.sources); setJobs(jobData.items); setTotal(jobData.total); setPageSize(jobData.pageSize); setPage(current);
        } catch (error) { report(error); } finally { setLoading(false); }
    }
    useEffect(() => { void load(1); }, [request]);
    async function toggle(source: PromptSource, enabled: boolean) {
        setBusy(source.id);
        try { await api.enable(source.id, enabled); await load(); } catch (error) { report(error); } finally { setBusy(""); }
    }
    async function sync(sourceId?: string) {
        setBusy(sourceId ?? "all");
        try {
            const result = await api.sync(sourceId);
            message.success(result.reused
                ? result.status === "queued" ? "来源已有等待中的同步任务，可在历史中查看" : "来源正在同步，可在历史中查看"
                : "同步任务已登记，请在历史中查看执行状态");
            if (result.existingJobIds.length && !result.reused) message.info("部分来源已有同步任务，请在历史中查看");
            await load(1);
        } catch (error) { report(error); } finally { setBusy(""); }
    }
    async function showJob(id: string) { try { setDetail(await api.job(id)); } catch (error) { report(error); } }
    async function saveSource() {
        if (!draft) return;
        setBusy('save');
        try { await api.save(draft, creating); setDraft(null); message.success('来源已保存，可单独提交同步'); await load(); }
        catch (error) { report(error); } finally { setBusy(''); }
    }
    const columns: TableColumnsType<PromptSource> = [
        { title: "来源", dataIndex: "name", render: (name: string, row) => <div><div>{name}</div><div className="text-xs text-[var(--admin-muted)] break-all">{row.url}</div></div> },
        { title: "启用", dataIndex: "enabled", render: (enabled: boolean, row) => <Switch checked={enabled} loading={busy === row.id} disabled={Boolean(busy) || !permissions.includes("prompts.manage")} onChange={(value) => void toggle(row, value)} /> },
        { title: "提示词数量", dataIndex: "promptCount" },
        { title: "最近成功", dataIndex: "lastSyncAt", render: time },
        { title: "最近错误", dataIndex: "lastError", render: (value: string) => value || "—" },
        { title: "操作", render: (_, row) => <div className="flex gap-2">{permissions.includes('prompts.manage') && <Button size="small" disabled={Boolean(busy)} onClick={() => { setCreating(false); setDraft({ id: row.id, name: row.name, url: row.url, homepage: row.homepage, enabled: row.enabled }); }}>编辑</Button>}{permissions.includes("prompts.sync") && <Button size="small" disabled={!row.enabled || Boolean(busy)} onClick={() => void sync(row.id)}>同步</Button>}</div> },
    ];
    const jobColumns: TableColumnsType<PromptJob> = [
        { title: "提交时间", dataIndex: "createdAt", render: time },
        { title: "方式", dataIndex: "trigger", render: (value: string) => value === "manual" ? "手动" : "自动" },
        { title: "操作人", dataIndex: "requestedByEmail", render: (value: string | null) => value ?? "系统" },
        { title: "状态", dataIndex: "status", render: (value: string) => <Tag>{labels[value] ?? value}</Tag> },
        { title: "完成时间", dataIndex: "finishedAt", render: time },
        { title: "操作", render: (_, row) => <Button size="small" onClick={() => void showJob(row.id)}>查看</Button> },
    ];
    const resultColumns: TableColumnsType<PromptJobSource> = [
        { title: "来源", dataIndex: "sourceName" }, { title: "状态", dataIndex: "status", render: (v: string) => labels[v] ?? v },
        { title: "读取", dataIndex: "fetched" }, { title: "保留", dataIndex: "kept" }, { title: "过滤", dataIndex: "filtered" },
        { title: "开始", dataIndex: "startedAt", render: time }, { title: "结束", dataIndex: "finishedAt", render: time }, { title: "说明", dataIndex: "error", render: (v: string) => v || "—" },
    ];
    return <div className="space-y-5">
        <AdminPanel title="提示词来源" description="停用后隐藏该来源，已同步内容保留。" actions={<div className="flex gap-2">{permissions.includes('prompts.manage') && <Button disabled={Boolean(busy)} onClick={() => { setCreating(true); setDraft({ id: '', name: '', url: '', homepage: '', enabled: false }); }}>新增来源</Button>}<Button onClick={() => void load()} loading={loading}>刷新</Button>{permissions.includes("prompts.sync") && <Button type="primary" disabled={Boolean(busy)} onClick={() => void sync()}>同步全部</Button>}</div>} flush>
            <div className="p-4"><Select value={enabledFilter} style={{minWidth:140}} onChange={setEnabledFilter} options={[{value:"",label:"全部来源"},{value:"enabled",label:"已启用"},{value:"disabled",label:"已停用"}]} /></div>
            <Table rowKey="id" columns={columns} dataSource={sources.filter(source => !enabledFilter || source.enabled === (enabledFilter === "enabled"))} loading={loading} pagination={false} scroll={{ x: 900 }} />
        </AdminPanel>
        <AdminPanel title="同步历史" description="同步结果需要刷新查看。" flush><div className="flex flex-wrap gap-2 p-4"><Select value={sourceFilter} style={{ minWidth: 220 }} options={[{ value: "", label: "全部来源" }, ...sources.map(source => ({ value: source.id, label: source.name }))]} onChange={value => { setSourceFilter(value); void load(1, value, statusFilter); }} /><Select value={statusFilter} style={{ minWidth: 140 }} options={[{ value: "", label: "全部状态" }, ...["queued", "running", "succeeded", "partial_failed", "failed"].map(value => ({ value, label: labels[value] }))]} onChange={value => { setStatusFilter(value); void load(1, sourceFilter, value); }} /></div><Table rowKey="id" columns={jobColumns} dataSource={jobs} loading={loading} pagination={{ current: page, total, pageSize, showSizeChanger: false, onChange: (value) => void load(value) }} scroll={{ x: 800 }} /></AdminPanel>
        <Modal title={creating ? '新增提示词来源' : '编辑提示词来源'} open={Boolean(draft)} confirmLoading={busy === 'save'} onOk={() => void saveSource()} onCancel={() => { if (!busy) setDraft(null); }} maskClosable={!busy} closable={!busy} okText="保存">
            <p className="mb-4 text-sm">来源需返回标准 JSON 数组，条目包含 title、prompt、coverUrl。保存后启用并提交同步，失败详情在同步历史查看。</p>
            {draft && <div className="space-y-3">
                <AdminField label="来源 ID（创建后不可修改）"><Input value={draft.id} disabled={!creating || Boolean(busy)} onChange={event => setDraft({ ...draft, id: event.target.value })} placeholder="例如 my-prompts" /></AdminField>
                <AdminField label="名称"><Input value={draft.name} disabled={Boolean(busy)} onChange={event => setDraft({ ...draft, name: event.target.value })} /></AdminField>
                <AdminField label="HTTPS JSON 地址"><Input value={draft.url} disabled={Boolean(busy)} onChange={event => setDraft({ ...draft, url: event.target.value })} /></AdminField>
                <AdminField label="来源主页（可选）"><Input value={draft.homepage} disabled={Boolean(busy)} onChange={event => setDraft({ ...draft, homepage: event.target.value })} /></AdminField>
                <AdminField label="启用"><Switch checked={draft.enabled} disabled={Boolean(busy)} onChange={enabled => setDraft({ ...draft, enabled })} /></AdminField>
            </div>}
        </Modal>
        <Modal title="同步结果" open={Boolean(detail)} onCancel={() => setDetail(null)} footer={<Button onClick={() => setDetail(null)}>关闭</Button>} width={1000}>
            <p>状态：{detail ? labels[detail.job.status] ?? detail.job.status : ""}　任务：{detail?.job.id}　操作人：{detail?.job.requestedByEmail ?? "系统"}</p>
            {detail?.job.error ? <p>{detail.job.error}</p> : null}
            <Table rowKey="sourceId" columns={resultColumns} dataSource={detail?.sources ?? []} pagination={false} scroll={{ x: 900 }} />
        </Modal>
    </div>;
}

import { useState } from "react";
import { App, Button, Input, Modal, Select } from "antd";
import dayjs from "dayjs";
import { creditReviewApi, type IssueReview } from "@/services/api/admin/credit-review";
import { accessApi } from "@/services/api/admin/access";
import { useAdminRequest } from "../use-admin-request";
import { AdminField } from "../components/ui";
const labels:Record<string,string>={pending:"待核对",follow_up:"继续跟进",resolved:"已核对"};

import { Descriptions } from "antd";
import type { AdminTask } from "@/services/api/admin/tasks";
const keys:Record<string,string>={imageDiagnostic:"图片任务诊断",videoSubmission:"上游提交诊断",prompt:"提示词",n:"生成数量",size:"尺寸",seconds:"时长（秒）",resolution:"分辨率",mode:"模式",chars:"输入字符数",channelName:"渠道",modelName:"模型",unit:"计费单位",baseCredits:"单位基础积分",base:"折扣前积分",member:"会员计费",discount:"会员折扣倍率",promo:"活动倍率",quotedCredits:"预扣积分",url:"结果地址",mimeType:"媒体类型",textLength:"文本长度",imageCount:"图片数量",usage:"用量"};
function fields(value:Record<string,unknown>|null|undefined) {
    if (!value) return [];
    return Object.entries(value).filter(([key,item]) => key in keys && item !== null && item !== undefined).map(([key,item])=>({key,label:keys[key],children:typeof item === "boolean" ? (item ? "是" : "否") : typeof item === "object" ? JSON.stringify(item) : String(item)}));
}
export function TaskSummary({task}:{task:AdminTask}) {
    const params=fields(task.params), snapshot=fields(task.executionSnapshot), result=fields(task.resultSummary);
    return <div className="space-y-3"><h3>生成参数</h3>{params.length?<Descriptions bordered size="small" column={1} items={params}/>:<p>无参数摘要</p>}<h3>执行信息</h3>{snapshot.length?<Descriptions bordered size="small" column={1} items={snapshot}/>:<p>没有执行快照</p>}<h3>结果摘要</h3>{result.length?<Descriptions bordered size="small" column={1} items={result}/>:<p>暂无结果摘要</p>}</div>;
}

import { useMemo } from "react";
import { ApiError, apiRequest, type ApiRequestInit } from "@/services/api/client";
import { useAuthStore } from "@/stores/use-auth-store";
import { matchesCanvasSession } from "@/lib/canvas/canvas-session";

export function createAdminRequest(owner: string | null, epoch: number) {
    const check = () => {
        const auth = useAuthStore.getState();
        if (!owner || auth.user?.role !== "admin" || !matchesCanvasSession(owner, epoch, auth)) throw new Error("管理员会话已变化，请重新操作");
    };
    return async <T = unknown>(path: string, init: ApiRequestInit = {}): Promise<T> => {
        check();
        const headers = new Headers(init.headers);
        headers.set("X-Sundas-User", owner!);
        let result: T;
        try {
            result = await apiRequest<T>(path, { ...init, headers: Object.fromEntries(headers.entries()) });
        } catch (error) {
            if (error instanceof ApiError && error.status === 403 && path !== "/api/admin/me") window.dispatchEvent(new Event("sundas-admin-permissions-changed"));
            throw error;
        }
        check();
        return result;
    };
}

export function useAdminRequest() {
    const owner = useAuthStore((state) => state.user?.id ?? null);
    const epoch = useAuthStore((state) => state.sessionEpoch);
    return useMemo(() => createAdminRequest(owner, epoch), [owner, epoch]);
}

export function useAdminScope() {
    const owner = useAuthStore((state) => state.user?.id ?? null);
    const epoch = useAuthStore((state) => state.sessionEpoch);
    return useMemo(() => ({ owner, current: () => {
        const auth = useAuthStore.getState();
        return Boolean(owner && auth.user?.role === "admin" && matchesCanvasSession(owner, epoch, auth));
    } }), [owner, epoch]);
}

import { saveAs } from "file-saver";

import { createZip, readZip } from "@/lib/zip";
import { getMediaBlob } from "@/services/file-storage";
import { getImageBlob } from "@/services/image-storage";
import { captureAccountSession } from "@/lib/account-session";
import { importMediaFiles, remapImportedMedia } from "@/lib/imported-media";
import type { Asset } from "@/stores/use-asset-store";

type AssetExportFile = {
    app: "sundas";
    version: 1;
    exportedAt: string;
    assets: Asset[];
    files: AssetExportItem[];
};

type AssetExportItem = {
    storageKey: string;
    path: string;
    mimeType: string;
    bytes: number;
};

export async function exportAssets(assets: Asset[], filename: string) {
    const session = captureAccountSession();
    const files: AssetExportItem[] = [];
    const zipFiles: { name: string; data: BlobPart }[] = [];

    await Promise.all(
        assets.map(async (asset) => {
            if (asset.kind !== "image" && asset.kind !== "video" && asset.kind !== "audio") return;
            const storageKey = asset.data.storageKey;
            if (!storageKey) return;
            const blob = asset.kind === "image" ? await getImageBlob(storageKey) : await getMediaBlob(storageKey);
            if (!blob) throw new Error("素材引用的本地文件缺失，无法完整导出；请先恢复文件后重试。");
            const path = `files/${safeFileName(storageKey)}.${fileExtension(blob.type, asset.kind)}`;
            files.push({ storageKey, path, mimeType: blob.type || asset.data.mimeType, bytes: blob.size });
            zipFiles.push({ name: path, data: blob });
        }),
    );

    const data: AssetExportFile = { app: "sundas", version: 1, exportedAt: new Date().toISOString(), assets, files };
    session.check();
    const zip = await createZip([{ name: "assets.json", data: JSON.stringify(data, null, 2) }, ...zipFiles]);
    session.check();
    saveAs(zip, filename);
}

export async function readAssetPackage(file: File) {
    const session = captureAccountSession();
    const owner = session.owner;
    if (!owner) throw new Error("请先登录");
    const zip = await readZip(file);
    session.check();
    const assetFile = zip.get("assets.json");
    if (!assetFile) throw new Error("missing assets.json");
    const data = JSON.parse(await assetFile.text()) as AssetExportFile;
    session.check();
    if (data.app !== "sundas" || data.version !== 1 || !Array.isArray(data.assets) || !Array.isArray(data.files)) throw new Error("不支持的素材文件");
    const media = await importMediaFiles(zip, data.files, owner, session.check);
    session.check();
    return remapImportedMedia(data.assets, media);
}

function safeFileName(value: string) {
    return value.replace(/[\\/:*?"<>|]/g, "_");
}

function fileExtension(mimeType: string, kind: Asset["kind"]) {
    if (mimeType.includes("png")) return "png";
    if (mimeType.includes("jpeg")) return "jpg";
    if (mimeType.includes("webp")) return "webp";
    if (mimeType.includes("gif")) return "gif";
    if (mimeType.includes("mp4")) return "mp4";
    if (mimeType.includes("webm")) return "webm";
    return kind === "image" ? "png" : "bin";
}
