import { useEffect, useRef, useState } from "react";
import { App, Button, Empty, Modal, Pagination, Popconfirm, Spin, Tag } from "antd";
import dayjs from "dayjs";
import { FileClock, Image as ImageIcon, Trash2, Video } from "lucide-react";
import { useTranslation } from "react-i18next";

import { Link } from "react-router-dom";
import { formatBytes } from "@/lib/image-utils";
import { useAuthStore } from "@/stores/use-auth-store";
import { storageSources, releaseStorageSource, type StorageSource, cleanupHistoryStorage, deleteStorageMedia, fetchStorageItems, fetchStorageSummary, type StorageItem, type StorageSummary } from "@/services/api/storage";

export function HistoryFilesPanel() {
    const { t } = useTranslation();
    const { message } = App.useApp();
    const refreshWallet = useAuthStore(state => state.refreshWallet);
    const [summary, setSummary] = useState<StorageSummary | null>(null);
    const [items, setItems] = useState<StorageItem[]>([]);
    const [total, setTotal] = useState(0);
    const [page, setPage] = useState(1);
    const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false);
    const [deleting, setDeleting] = useState<string | null>(null);
    const [protectedOnly, setProtectedOnly] = useState(false);
    const [detail, setDetail] = useState<StorageItem | null>(null);
    const [cleaning, setCleaning] = useState(false);

    const loadVersion = useRef(0);
    const load = async (nextPage = page) => {
        const version = ++loadVersion.current;
        setLoading(true);
        try {
            const [nextSummary, nextItems] = await Promise.all([
                fetchStorageSummary(),
                fetchStorageItems("history_uploads", nextPage, 20, protectedOnly),
            ]);
            if (version !== loadVersion.current) return;
            setSummary(nextSummary);
            setItems(nextItems.items);
            setTotal(nextItems.total);
            setPage(nextPage);
        } catch (error) {
            message.error(error instanceof Error ? error.message : t("assets.historyLoadFailed"));
        } finally { if(version === loadVersion.current) setLoading(false); }
    };

    useEffect(() => { void load(1); }, [protectedOnly]);

    const remove = async (item: StorageItem) => {
        setDeleting(item.id);
        try {
            await deleteStorageMedia(item.id);
            message.success(t("assets.historyCleaned"));
            await load(page);
            await refreshWallet().catch(() => undefined);
        } catch (error) {
            message.error(error instanceof Error ? error.message : t("assets.historyCleanupFailed"));
        } finally { setDeleting(null); }
    };

    const cleanupAll = async () => {
        setCleaning(true);
        try {
            const result = await cleanupHistoryStorage();
            if (result.failed) message.warning(t("assets.historyCleanupAllPartial", { count: result.deleted, failed: result.failed }));
            else message.success(t("assets.historyCleanupAllDone", { count: result.deleted }));
            await load(1);
            await refreshWallet().catch(() => undefined);
        } catch (error) {
            message.error(error instanceof Error ? error.message : t("assets.historyCleanupFailed"));
        } finally { setCleaning(false); }
    };

    const percent = summary?.limitBytes ? Math.min(100, summary.usedBytes / summary.limitBytes * 100) : 0;

    return (
        <div className="flex flex-col gap-4">
            <div className="rounded-2xl border border-border bg-card/60 p-4 backdrop-blur-sm">
                <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-3">
                    <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-2 text-sm font-medium"><FileClock className="size-4" />{t("assets.historyTitle")}</span>
                    <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
                        <span className="text-xs tabular-nums text-muted-foreground">{formatBytes(summary?.usedBytes ?? 0)} / {formatBytes(summary?.limitBytes ?? 0)}</span>
                        <Popconfirm
                            title={t("assets.historyCleanupAllConfirm", { count: summary?.cleanableFiles ?? 0, size: formatBytes(summary?.cleanableBytes ?? 0) })}
                            okText={t("assets.historyCleanupAll")}
                            cancelText={t("common.cancel")}
                            onConfirm={() => void cleanupAll()}
                            disabled={!summary?.cleanableFiles}
                        >
                            <Button danger size="small" icon={<Trash2 className="size-3.5" />} loading={cleaning} disabled={!summary?.cleanableFiles}>
                                {t("assets.historyCleanupAll")}
                            </Button>
                        </Popconfirm>
                    </div>
                </div>
                <p className="mt-2 text-xs leading-5 text-muted-foreground">{t("assets.historyDescription")}</p>
                <div className="mt-3 h-1.5 overflow-hidden rounded-full bg-muted">
                    <span className="block h-full rounded-full bg-[#D8FF3E]" style={{ width: `${percent}%` }} />
                </div>
            </div>

            <div className="flex gap-2">
                <Button size="small" type={protectedOnly ? 'text' : 'default'} onClick={() => setProtectedOnly(false)}>历史文件</Button>
                <Button size="small" type={protectedOnly ? 'default' : 'text'} onClick={() => setProtectedOnly(true)}>被占用的文件</Button>
            </div>
            {detail && <SourceDialog key={detail.id} item={detail} close={() => setDetail(null)} changed={() => void load(page)} />}
            <Spin spinning={loading}>
                <div className="space-y-2">
                    {items.length ? items.map(item => (
                        <div key={item.id} className="flex items-center gap-3 rounded-xl border border-border bg-card/40 px-3 py-2.5">
                            {item.kind === "image" ? (
                                <img src={item.url} alt={item.name} loading="lazy" className="size-12 shrink-0 rounded-lg border border-border bg-muted object-cover" />
                            ) : (
                                <span className="inline-flex size-12 shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded-lg bg-muted text-muted-foreground">
                                    {item.kind === "video" ? <Video className="size-4" /> : <ImageIcon className="size-4" />}
                                </span>
                            )}
                            <div className="min-w-0 flex-1">
                                <div className="truncate text-xs text-foreground">{item.name}</div>
                                <div className="mt-0.5 truncate text-[11px] text-muted-foreground">{item.mime} · {formatBytes(item.bytes)} · {dayjs(item.createdAt).format("YYYY-MM-DD HH:mm")}</div>
                            </div>
                            {item.pinned ? <Tag className="m-0">{t("assets.historyInUse")}</Tag> : null}
                            {!item.canDelete && <Button size="small" onClick={() => setDetail(item)}>查看占用</Button>}
                            {item.canDelete ? (
                                <Popconfirm title={t("assets.historyCleanupConfirm")} okText={t("assets.historyCleanup")} cancelText={t("common.cancel")} onConfirm={() => void remove(item)}>
                                    <Button danger type="text" size="small" loading={deleting === item.id} icon={<Trash2 className="size-3.5" />}>{t("assets.historyCleanup")}</Button>
                                </Popconfirm>
                            ) : null}
                        </div>
                    )) : <Empty image={Empty.PRESENTED_IMAGE_SIMPLE} description={t("assets.historyEmpty")} />}
                </div>
            </Spin>

            {total > 20 ? <Pagination className="text-center" size="small" current={page} pageSize={20} total={total} showSizeChanger={false} onChange={(next) => void load(next)} /> : null}
            <p className="text-[11px] text-muted-foreground">{t("assets.historyHint")}</p>
        </div>
    );
}

const sourceNames:Record<string,string> = {prompt:'提示词',promo:'站点展示',contact:'站点联系',canvas:'画布',asset:'素材库',document:'制作稿',command:'编辑历史',run:'制作记录',upscale:'超分记录',director:'导演台记录',capture:'抽帧记录',character:'人物工作流'};
function SourceDialog({item,close,changed}:{item:StorageItem;close:()=>void;changed:()=>void}) {
    const {message} = App.useApp();
    const [data,setData] = useState<Awaited<ReturnType<typeof storageSources>>>();
    const [error,setError] = useState('');
    const [busy,setBusy] = useState(false);
    useEffect(() => {
        let active=true;
        storageSources(item.id).then(value=>{if(active)setData(value);}).catch(e=>{if(active)setError(e.message);});
        return ()=>{active=false;};
    },[item.id]);
    async function release(source:StorageSource) {
        setBusy(true);
        try {
            await releaseStorageSource(item.id,source);
            changed();
            setData(await storageSources(item.id));
        } catch(e) { message.error(e instanceof Error ? e.message : '释放失败'); }
        finally { setBusy(false); }
    }
    return <Modal open title="文件占用来源" footer={null} onCancel={close}>
        {error || (!data && <Spin />)}
        {data && <div className="space-y-3">
            {data.sources.map(s=><div key={s.kind+s.owner} className="flex items-center justify-between gap-2">
                <span className="min-w-0 break-all">{s.draft?'超分草稿':sourceNames[s.kind]} · {s.title || s.owner}</span>
                {s.kind==='canvas' && <Link to={`/canvas/${s.owner}`}>打开画布</Link>}
                {s.releasable && <Popconfirm title={s.draft?'删除这个未提交的超分草稿？':'解除这条历史对文件的占用？'}
                    description="文件仍会保留。之后删除文件可能影响历史回放。" onConfirm={()=>release(s)}>
                    <Button size="small" disabled={busy}>{s.draft?'删除草稿':'解除占用'}</Button>
                </Popconfirm>}
            </div>)}
            {data.pinned && <p>文件有固定保护。旧记录未保存完整的固定来源，需要人工核对。</p>}
            {data.active && <p>有任务正在使用或核对该文件。</p>}
            {data.disputed && <p>素材归属待核对。</p>}
            {!data.sources.length && !data.pinned && !data.active && !data.disputed && <p>{item.canDelete?'文件可删除。':'其他站点引用或占用状态已变化，请刷新列表。'}</p>}
        </div>}
    </Modal>;
}

const kindOptions = ["all", "text", "image", "video", "audio"] as const;

export default function AssetsPage() {

        setEditingAsset(null);
        setImageDraft(null);
        setIsAssetOpen(false);
        setPreviewAsset(null);
        setDeletingAsset(null);
        setFormKind("text");
        form.resetFields();
        setPresentedSession(sessionKey);
    }, [sessionKey, form]);
    const coverUrl = Form.useWatch("coverUrl", form) || "";
    const title = Form.useWatch("title", form) || "";
    const tags = Form.useWatch("tags", form) || [];
    const content = Form.useWatch("content", form) || "";
    const validAssets = useMemo(() => assets.filter((asset) => asset.kind === "text" || asset.kind === "image" || asset.kind === "video" || asset.kind === "audio"), [assets]);

    const filteredAssets = useMemo(() => {
        const query = keyword.trim().toLowerCase();
        return validAssets.filter((asset) => {
            if (kindFilter !== "all" && asset.kind !== kindFilter) return false;
            if (!query) return true;
            return assetSearchText(asset).includes(query);
        });
    }, [validAssets, keyword, kindFilter]);

    const visibleAssets = useMemo(() => {
        const start = (page - 1) * pageSize;
        return filteredAssets.slice(start, start + pageSize);
    }, [filteredAssets, page, pageSize]);

    useEffect(() => {
        const maxPage = Math.max(1, Math.ceil(filteredAssets.length / pageSize));
        setPage((value) => Math.min(value, maxPage));
    }, [filteredAssets.length, pageSize]);

    const openCreate = () => {
        if (!isAssetViewCurrent()) return;
        setEditingAsset(null);
        setImageDraft(null);
        setFormKind("text");
        form.setFieldsValue({ kind: "text", title: "", coverUrl: "", tags: [], source: t("assets.manual"), note: "", content: "" });
        setIsAssetOpen(true);
    };

    const openEdit = (asset: Asset) => {
        if (!isAssetViewCurrent()) return;
        setEditingAsset(asset);
        setFormKind(asset.kind);
        setImageDraft(asset.kind === "image" ? asset.data : null);
        form.setFieldsValue({
            kind: asset.kind,
            title: asset.title,
            coverUrl: asset.coverUrl,
            tags: asset.tags || [],
            source: asset.source,
            note: asset.note,
            content: asset.kind === "text" ? asset.data.content : "",
        });
        setIsAssetOpen(true);
    };

    const saveAsset = async () => {
        if (!isAssetViewCurrent()) return;
        let session: ReturnType<typeof captureAccountSession>;
        try { session = captureAccountSession(); } catch { return; }
        const values = await form.validateFields();
        try { session.check(); } catch { return; }
        const base = {
            title: values.title.trim(),
            coverUrl: values.coverUrl?.trim() || (values.kind === "image" && imageDraft ? imageDraft.dataUrl : ""),
            tags: values.tags || [],
            source: values.source?.trim(),
            note: values.note?.trim(),
            metadata: editingAsset?.metadata || { source: "manual" },
        };

        if ((formKind === "video" || formKind === "audio") && editingAsset && (editingAsset.kind === "video" || editingAsset.kind === "audio")) {
            updateAsset(editingAsset.id, { ...base, kind: editingAsset.kind, data: editingAsset.data });
        } else if (values.kind === "text") {
            const asset = { ...base, kind: "text" as const, data: { content: (values.content || "").trim() } };
            editingAsset ? updateAsset(editingAsset.id, asset) : addAsset(asset);
        } else {
            if (!imageDraft) {
                message.error(t("assets.selectImage"));
                return;
            }
            const asset = { ...base, kind: "image" as const, data: imageDraft };
            editingAsset ? updateAsset(editingAsset.id, asset) : addAsset(asset);
        }

        message.success(editingAsset ? t("assets.updated") : t("assets.saved"));
        setIsAssetOpen(false);
    };

    const readCoverFile = async (file?: File) => {
        if (!file || !isAssetViewCurrent()) return;
        let session: ReturnType<typeof captureAccountSession>;

    const readImageFile = async (file?: File) => {

        if ((asset.kind !== "image" && asset.kind !== "video" && asset.kind !== "audio") || !isAssetViewCurrent()) return;
        try {
            const session = captureAccountSession();
            const ext = asset.data.mimeType?.split("/")[1]?.split("+")[0] || (asset.kind === "video" ? "mp4" : "png");
            const filename = `${asset.title || "asset"}.${ext}`;
            const cloudUrl = asset.kind !== 'image' ? asset.data.url : asset.data.dataUrl;
            if (cloudUrl && downloadCloudMedia(cloudUrl, filename)) return;
            const blob = await readAssetMediaBlob(asset);
            session.check();
            if (!blob) {
                message.error(t("assets.downloadFailed"));

            message.error(t("assets.downloadFailed"));

            const session = captureAccountSession();
            const owner = session.owner;

            session.check();
            if (!owner || currentMediaOwner() !== owner) throw new Error("登录账户已变化，请重新导入");
            importedAssets.forEach((asset) => {
                const payload = { ...asset } as Record<string, unknown>;
                delete payload.id;
                delete payload.createdAt;
                delete payload.updatedAt;
                addAsset(payload as Parameters<typeof addAsset>[0]);
            });
            message.success(t("assets.imported", { count: importedAssets.length }));
        } catch {
            message.error(t("assets.importFailed"));
        } finally {
            if (assetInputRef.current) assetInputRef.current.value = "";
        }
    };

    const confirmDelete = () => {
        if (!isAssetViewCurrent()) return;
        if (!deletingAsset) return;
        removeAsset(deletingAsset.id);
        message.success(t("assets.deleted"));
        setDeletingAsset(null);
    };

    if (!authReady || !hydrated || presentedSession !== sessionKey || !isAssetAccountActive(userId)) return <main className="flex h-full items-center justify-center text-sm text-stone-500">{t("canvas.loading")}</main>;

    return (
        <div className="page-surface flex h-full flex-col overflow-hidden bg-background text-foreground">
            <main className="jm-page">
                <div className="jm-page-inner flex min-h-full flex-col gap-6">
                    <header className="jm-page-head">
                        <div>
                            <h1 className="jm-page-title">{t("assets.title")}</h1>
                            <p className="jm-page-desc">{t("assets.description")}</p>
                        </div>
                        <div className="jm-segment" role="tablist">
                            {([["assets", t("assets.tabAssets")], ["history", t("assets.tabHistory")]] as const).map(([key, label]) => (
                                <button

                                        const url = new URL(window.location.href);
                                        if (key === "history") url.searchParams.set("tab", "history");
                                        else url.searchParams.delete("tab");
                                        window.history.replaceState(null, "", url.toString());
                                    }}
                                >
                                    {label}
                                </button>
                            ))}
                        </div>
                    </header>

                    {libraryTab === "assets" ? (
                        <>
                    <div className="flex flex-col gap-3 lg:flex-row lg:items-center lg:justify-between">
                        <div className="flex min-w-0 flex-wrap items-center gap-2">
                            {kindOptions.map((option) => (

                                    type="button"

                            <label className="jm-search sm:w-[280px]">
                                <Search className="size-4 shrink-0" />
                                <input
                                    value={keyword}
                                    placeholder={t("assets.search")}
                                    onChange={(event) => {
                                        setPage(1);
                                        setKeyword(event.target.value);
                                    }}
                                />
                            </label>
                            <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                                <Button icon={<Download className="size-4" />} onClick={() => void exportAllAssets()}>
                                    {t("assets.export")}
                                </Button>
                                <Button icon={<Upload className="size-4" />} onClick={() => assetInputRef.current?.click()}>

                                </Button>

                                    <Plus className="size-4" />
                                    {t("assets.add")}
                                </button>
                            </div>
                        </div>
                    </div>

                    {visibleAssets.length ? (
                        <div className="grid gap-4 sm:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3 xl:grid-cols-4">
                            {visibleAssets.map((asset) => (
                                <AssetCard key={asset.id} asset={asset} onOpen={() => setPreviewAsset(asset)} onEdit={() => openEdit(asset)} onCopy={copyAssetText} onDownload={downloadImage} onDelete={() => setDeletingAsset(asset)} />
                            ))}
                        </div>
                    ) : (
                        <div className="jm-card jm-empty">
                            <div className="jm-empty-icon">
                                <FolderOpen className="size-8" strokeWidth={1.5} />
                            </div>
                            <h2 className="jm-empty-title">{validAssets.length ? t("assets.empty") : t("assets.emptyTitle")}</h2>
                            <p className="jm-empty-desc">{validAssets.length ? t("assets.noMatchHint") : t("assets.emptyHint")}</p>
                            {validAssets.length ? null : (
                                <button type="button" className="jm-btn jm-btn-primary mt-4" onClick={openCreate}>
                                    <Plus className="size-4" />
                                    {t("assets.add")}
                                </button>
                            )}
                        </div>
                    )}

                    {filteredAssets.length ? (
                        <div className="mt-auto flex flex-col items-center justify-between gap-3 border-t border-border pt-5 sm:flex-row">
                            <p className="text-[11.5px] text-muted-foreground">{t("assets.total", { count: filteredAssets.length })}</p>
                            <Pagination
                                current={page}
                                pageSize={pageSize}
                                total={filteredAssets.length}
                                showSizeChanger
                                pageSizeOptions={[10, 20, 50, 100]}
                                onChange={(nextPage, nextPageSize) => {
                                    setPage(nextPage);
                                    setPageSize(nextPageSize);
                                }}
                            />
                        </div>
                    ) : null}
                        </>
                    ) : <HistoryFilesPanel />}
                </div>
            </main>

            <Modal title={editingAsset ? t("assets.edit") : t("assets.add")} open={isAssetOpen} width={980} onCancel={() => setIsAssetOpen(false)} onOk={() => void saveAsset()} okText={t("common.save")} cancelText={t("common.cancel")} destroyOnHidden>
                <div className="grid gap-6 pt-1 lg:grid-cols-[minmax(0,1fr)_320px]">
                    <Form form={form} layout="vertical" requiredMark={false} initialValues={{ kind: "text", tags: [] }}>
                        {formKind === "video" || formKind === "audio" ? (
                            <Form.Item label={t("assets.type")}>
                                <Tag className="m-0">{t(`assets.kinds.${formKind}`)}</Tag>
                            </Form.Item>
                        ) : (
                            <Form.Item name="kind" label={t("assets.type")}>
                                <Select
                                    options={[
                                        { label: t("assets.kinds.text"), value: "text" },
                                        { label: t("assets.kinds.image"), value: "image" },
                                    ]}
                                    onChange={(value) => setFormKind(value)}
                                />
                            </Form.Item>
                        )}
                        <Form.Item name="title" label={t("assets.fields.title")} rules={[{ required: true, message: t("assets.fields.titleRequired") }]}>
                            <Input size="large" placeholder={t("assets.fields.titlePlaceholder")} />
                        </Form.Item>
                        <Form.Item name="coverUrl" label={t("assets.fields.coverUrl")}>
                            <Space.Compact className="w-full">
                                <Input placeholder={t("assets.fields.coverPlaceholder")} />
                                <Button icon={<Upload className="size-3.5" />} onClick={() => coverInputRef.current?.click()}>
                                    {t("common.upload")}
                                </Button>
                            </Space.Compact>
                        </Form.Item>
                        <Form.Item name="tags" label={t("assets.fields.tags")}>
                            <Select mode="tags" tokenSeparators={[",", "，"]} placeholder={t("assets.fields.tagsPlaceholder")} />
                        </Form.Item>
                        <div className="grid gap-4 sm:grid-cols-2">
                            <Form.Item name="source" label={t("assets.fields.source")}>
                                <Input placeholder={t("assets.fields.sourcePlaceholder")} />
                            </Form.Item>
                            <Form.Item name="note" label={t("assets.fields.note")}>
                                <Input placeholder={t("assets.fields.optional")} />
                            </Form.Item>
                        </div>
                        {formKind === "text" ? (
                            <Form.Item name="content" label={t("assets.fields.textContent")} rules={[{ required: true, message: t("assets.fields.textRequired") }]}>
                                <Input.TextArea rows={8} placeholder={t("assets.fields.textPlaceholder")} />
                            </Form.Item>
                        ) : formKind === "audio" && editingAsset?.kind === "audio" ? (
                            <Form.Item label="音频"><audio src={editingAsset.data.url} controls onError={refreshExpiredMedia} /></Form.Item>
                        ) : formKind === "video" && editingAsset?.kind === "video" ? (
                            <Form.Item label={t("assets.fields.videoContent")}>
                                <video onError={refreshExpiredMedia} src={editingAsset.data.url} controls playsInline className="aspect-video w-full rounded-lg bg-black" />
                            </Form.Item>
                        ) : (
                            <Form.Item label={t("assets.fields.imageContent")} required>
                                <div className="rounded-lg border border-dashed border-border p-4 dark:border-border">
                                    <Button icon={<Upload className="size-4" />} onClick={() => imageInputRef.current?.click()}>
                                        {t("assets.selectImageFile")}
                                    </Button>
                                    {imageDraft ? (
                                        <Typography.Text type="secondary" className="ml-3 text-xs">
                                            {imageDraft.width}x{imageDraft.height} · {formatBytes(imageDraft.bytes)}
                                        </Typography.Text>
                                    ) : (
                                        <Typography.Text type="secondary" className="ml-3 text-xs">
                                            {t("assets.noImageSelected")}
                                        </Typography.Text>
                                    )}
                                </div>
                            </Form.Item>
                        )}
                    </Form>
                    <div className="rounded-xl border border-border bg-muted p-4 dark:border-border dark:bg-background">
                        <Typography.Text strong>{t("assets.preview")}</Typography.Text>
                        <div className="mt-3 overflow-hidden rounded-lg border border-border bg-background dark:border-border">
                            {coverUrl || imageDraft?.dataUrl ? (
                                <img src={coverUrl || imageDraft?.dataUrl} alt="" className="aspect-[4/3] w-full object-cover" />
                            ) : (
                                <div className="flex aspect-[4/3] items-center justify-center bg-muted p-5 text-center text-sm text-muted-foreground dark:bg-muted">{content || t("assets.noCover")}</div>
                            )}
                            <div className="p-4">
                                <Typography.Text strong ellipsis className="block">
                                    {title || t("assets.untitled")}
                                </Typography.Text>
                                <div className="mt-2 flex flex-wrap gap-1.5">
                                    {tags.length ? (
                                        tags.map((tag) => (
                                            <Tag key={tag} className="m-0">
                                                {tag}
                                            </Tag>
                                        ))
                                    ) : (
                                        <Tag className="m-0">{t("assets.untagged")}</Tag>
                                    )}
                                </div>
                            </div>
                        </div>
                    </div>
                </div>
                <input
                    ref={coverInputRef}
                    type="file"
                    accept="image/*"
                    className="hidden"
                    onChange={(event) => {
                        void readCoverFile(event.target.files?.[0]);
                        event.target.value = "";
                    }}
                />
                <input
                    ref={imageInputRef}
                    type="file"
                    accept="image/*"
                    className="hidden"
                    onChange={(event) => {
                        void readImageFile(event.target.files?.[0]);
                        event.target.value = "";
                    }}
                />
            </Modal>

            <AssetDrawer asset={previewAsset} onClose={() => setPreviewAsset(null)} onCopy={copyAssetText} onDownload={downloadImage} />

            <input ref={assetInputRef} type="file" accept="application/zip,.zip" className="hidden" onChange={(event) => void importAssetZip(event.target.files?.[0])} />

            <Modal title={t("assets.deleteTitle")} open={Boolean(deletingAsset)} onCancel={() => setDeletingAsset(null)} onOk={confirmDelete} okText={t("common.delete")} okButtonProps={{ danger: true }} cancelText={t("common.cancel")}>
                {t("assets.deleteConfirm", { name: deletingAsset?.title })}
            </Modal>
        </div>
    );
}

function AssetCard({ asset, onOpen, onEdit, onCopy, onDownload, onDelete }: { asset: Asset; onOpen: () => void; onEdit: () => void; onCopy: (asset: Asset) => void; onDownload: (asset: Asset) => void; onDelete: () => void }) {
    const { t } = useTranslation();
    useSyncExternalStore(subscribeImagePreviews, getImagePreviewRevision);
    const cover = assetCoverUrl(asset) || (asset.kind === "video" ? asset.data.url : "");
    const summary = assetSummary(asset);
    const KindIcon = asset.kind === "text" ? FileText : asset.kind === "image" ? ImageIcon : Film;
    const canDownload = asset.kind === "image" || asset.kind === "video" || asset.kind === "audio";

    return (
        <article className="asset-card group relative flex flex-col overflow-hidden rounded-2xl border border-border bg-card transition-all duration-200 hover:-translate-y-0.5">
            <button type="button" onClick={onOpen} className="relative block w-full cursor-pointer overflow-hidden bg-muted text-left" aria-label={asset.title}>
                {cover ? (
                    <MediaThumbnail source={cover} kind={asset.kind === "video" && cover === asset.data.url ? "video" : "image"} alt={asset.title} className="grid aspect-[4/3] w-full place-items-center" imageClassName="size-full object-cover transition-transform duration-500 ease-out group-hover:scale-[1.04]" fallback={<KindIcon className="size-6 opacity-60"/>} />
                ) : (
                    <div className="asset-card-fallback relative flex aspect-[4/3] w-full items-center overflow-hidden p-4">
                        <span aria-hidden className="asset-card-fallback-quote">
                            “
                        </span>
                        <p className="relative line-clamp-4 text-[12px] leading-[1.75] text-foreground/75">{asset.kind === "text" ? asset.data.content : t("assets.noCover")}</p>
                    </div>
                )}
                <span className="absolute left-2.5 top-2.5 inline-flex items-center gap-1 rounded-full border border-black/5 bg-white/85 px-2 py-0.5 text-[10.5px] font-medium text-neutral-800 backdrop-blur-sm dark:border-white/10 dark:bg-black/55 dark:text-white/85">
                    <KindIcon className="size-3" strokeWidth={2} />
                    {t(`assets.kinds.${asset.kind}`)}
                </span>
            </button>

            <div className="flex min-w-0 flex-1 flex-col p-4">
                <button type="button" onClick={onOpen} className="cursor-pointer text-left">
                    <h2 className="line-clamp-1 text-[15px] font-semibold leading-6 text-foreground">{asset.title}</h2>
                </button>
                {/* 无封面的文本资产，预览区已经展示正文，正文里不再重复一遍 */}
                {cover || asset.kind !== "text" ? <p className="mt-1 line-clamp-2 text-[11.5px] leading-5 text-muted-foreground">{summary}</p> : null}                <div className="mt-2.5 flex flex-wrap gap-1.5">
                    {(asset.tags || []).slice(0, 3).map((tag) => (
                        <span key={tag} className="rounded-md bg-muted px-1.5 py-0.5 text-[10.5px] text-muted-foreground">
                            {tag}
                        </span>
                    ))}
                    {(asset.tags || []).length > 3 ? <span className="px-1 text-[10.5px] text-muted-foreground">+{(asset.tags || []).length - 3}</span> : null}
                    {!asset.tags?.length ? <span className="rounded-md border border-dashed border-border px-1.5 py-0.5 text-[10.5px] text-muted-foreground/70">{t("assets.noTags")}</span> : null}
                </div>

                <div className="mt-auto pt-3">
                    <div className="flex items-center justify-between gap-2 border-t border-border pt-2.5">
                        <span className="min-w-0 truncate text-[11px] text-muted-foreground">{asset.source || t("assets.unknownSource")}</span>
                        <div className="flex shrink-0 items-center gap-0.5">
                            <CardIconButton label={t("common.view")} onClick={onOpen}>
                                <Eye className="size-3.5" />
                            </CardIconButton>
                            <CardIconButton label={t("common.edit")} onClick={onEdit}>
                                <PencilLine className="size-3.5" />
                            </CardIconButton>
                            {asset.kind === "text" ? (
                                <CardIconButton label={t("common.copy")} onClick={() => void onCopy(asset)}>
                                    <Copy className="size-3.5" />
                                </CardIconButton>
                            ) : null}
                            {canDownload ? (
                                <CardIconButton label={t("common.download")} onClick={() => onDownload(asset)}>
                                    <Download className="size-3.5" />
                                </CardIconButton>
                            ) : null}
                            <CardIconButton label={t("common.delete")} danger onClick={onDelete}>
                                <Trash2 className="size-3.5" />
                            </CardIconButton>
                        </div>
                    </div>
                </div>
            </div>
        </article>
    );
}

function CardIconButton({ label, danger, onClick, children }: { label: string; danger?: boolean; onClick: () => void; children: ReactNode }) {
    return (
        <button
            type="button"
            title={label}
            aria-label={label}
            onClick={onClick}
            className={cn("asset-icon-btn grid size-7 cursor-pointer place-items-center rounded-lg text-muted-foreground transition-colors", danger && "is-danger")}
        >
            {children}
        </button>
    );
}

function AssetDrawer({ asset, onClose, onCopy, onDownload }: { asset: Asset | null; onClose: () => void; onCopy: (asset: Asset) => void; onDownload: (asset: Asset) => void }) {
    const { t } = useTranslation();
    const archive = useMediaArchive(asset?.kind === "video" ? asset.data.url : undefined);
    useSyncExternalStore(subscribeImagePreviews, getImagePreviewRevision);
    const cover = asset ? asset.coverUrl || (asset.kind === "image" ? asset.data.dataUrl : "") : "";
    return (
        <Drawer title={t("assets.details")} open={Boolean(asset)} size="large" onClose={onClose}>
            {asset ? (
                <div className="space-y-5">
                    {cover ? (
                        <Image src={assetCoverUrl(asset)} preview={{ src: cover }} alt={asset.title} className="rounded-lg" />
                    ) : (
                        <div className="rounded-lg border border-border bg-muted p-5 text-sm leading-6 text-muted-foreground dark:border-border dark:bg-muted dark:text-foreground/80">{asset.kind === "text" ? asset.data.content : t("assets.noCover")}</div>
                    )}
                    <div>
                        <Typography.Title level={4} className="!mb-2">
                            {asset.title}
                        </Typography.Title>
                        <Space size={[4, 4]} wrap>
                            <Tag>{t(`assets.kinds.${asset.kind}`)}</Tag>
                            {(asset.tags || []).map((tag) => (
                                <Tag key={tag}>{tag}</Tag>
                            ))}
                        </Space>
                    </div>
                    <div className="rounded-lg border border-border p-4 dark:border-border">
                        {asset.kind === "text" ? (
                            <Typography.Text type="secondary" className="block text-xs">
                                {t("assets.fields.textContent")}
                            </Typography.Text>
                        ) : null}
                        {asset.kind === "text" ? (
                            <Typography.Paragraph className="mt-2 whitespace-pre-wrap">{asset.data.content}</Typography.Paragraph>
                        ) : asset.kind === "audio" ? (
                            <audio src={asset.data.url} controls onError={refreshExpiredMedia} className="mt-2 w-full" />
                        ) : asset.kind === "video" ? (
                            <video onError={refreshExpiredMedia} src={asset.data.url} controls playsInline className="mt-2 aspect-video w-full rounded-lg bg-black" />
                        ) : asset.kind === "model" ? (
                            <Typography.Text className="mt-2 block">
                                {asset.data.fileName || "3D 模型"} · {formatBytes(asset.data.bytes)} · {asset.data.mimeType}
                            </Typography.Text>
                        ) : (
                            <Typography.Text className="mt-2 block">
                                {asset.data.width}x{asset.data.height} · {formatBytes(asset.data.bytes)} · {asset.data.mimeType}
                            </Typography.Text>
                        )}
                    </div>
                    {asset.note ? (
                        <div>
                            <Typography.Text type="secondary">{t("assets.fields.note")}</Typography.Text>
                            <Typography.Paragraph className="mt-1">{asset.note}</Typography.Paragraph>
                        </div>
                    ) : null}
                    <Space>
                        {archive && <Button disabled={archive.disabled} onClick={archive.run}>{archive.label}</Button>}
                        {asset.kind === "text" ? (
                            <Button type="primary" icon={<Copy className="size-4" />} onClick={() => onCopy(asset)}>
                                {t("assets.copyText")}
                            </Button>
                        ) : null}
                        {asset.kind === "image" || asset.kind === "video" || asset.kind === "audio" ? (
                            <Button type="primary" icon={<Download className="size-4" />} onClick={() => onDownload(asset)}>
                                {asset.kind === "audio" ? "下载音频" : asset.kind === "video" ? t("assets.downloadVideo") : t("assets.downloadImage")}
                            </Button>
                        ) : null}
                    </Space>
                </div>
            ) : null}
        </Drawer>
    );
}

async function readAssetMediaBlob(asset: Extract<Asset, { kind: "image" | "video" | "audio" }>) {
    const storageKey = asset.data.storageKey;
    if (storageKey) {
        const stored = asset.kind === "image" ? await getImageBlob(storageKey) : await getMediaBlob(storageKey);
        if (stored) return stored;
    }
    const url = asset.kind !== "image" ? asset.data.url : asset.data.dataUrl || asset.coverUrl;
    if (!url) return null;
    const response = await fetch(url);
    return response.ok ? response.blob() : null;
}

function assetSummary(asset: Asset) {
    if (asset.kind === "text") return asset.data.content;
    if (asset.kind === "model") return `${asset.data.fileName || "3D 模型"} · ${formatBytes(asset.data.bytes)} · ${asset.data.mimeType}`;
    return `${asset.data.width}x${asset.data.height} · ${formatBytes(asset.data.bytes)} · ${asset.data.mimeType}`;
}

function assetSearchText(asset: Asset) {
    return [asset.title, asset.source || "", asset.note || "", (asset.tags || []).join(" "), asset.kind === "text" ? asset.data.content : asset.data.mimeType].join(" ").toLowerCase();
}

import { useEffect, useRef } from "react";
import { useNavigate, useSearchParams } from "react-router-dom";

import HomePage from "@/pages/home";
import { useAuthStore } from "@/stores/use-auth-store";
import { useAuthDialogStore, type AuthMode } from "@/stores/use-auth-dialog-store";

/**
 * /login、/register、/forgot-password 三个地址的落地页。
 *
 * 登录已经改为弹窗形态（参照即梦），所以这些地址不再渲染独立页面：
 * 先渲染首页作为背景，再自动浮出对应模式的弹窗；关掉弹窗就回首页。
 * 这样旧链接、`?redirect=` 回跳、RequireAuth 的重定向都继续有效。
 */
export function AuthGate({ mode }: { mode: AuthMode }) {
    const [params] = useSearchParams();
    const redirect = params.get("redirect") || "/";
    const invite = params.get("invite") || "";
    const open = useAuthDialogStore((state) => state.open);
    const user = useAuthStore((state) => state.user);
    const navigate = useNavigate();
    const openedRef = useRef(false);

    useEffect(() => {
        if (openedRef.current) return;
        openedRef.current = true;
        open(mode, { redirect, invite });
    }, [mode, redirect, invite, open]);

    // 已经登录（含从别的标签页登录）直接落到目标页
    useEffect(() => {
        if (user) navigate(redirect, { replace: true });
    }, [user, redirect, navigate]);

    // 关闭后回首页由 AuthDialog 的 closeDialog 处理：它知道当前是否停在 /login 这类地址。
    // 这里不再监听 mode 变 null，否则会和「登录成功后跳 redirect」抢路由。

    return <HomePage landing suppressPromo />;
}

import { useCallback, useEffect, useMemo, useState, type Dispatch, type MutableRefObject, type SetStateAction } from "react";

import i18n from "@/i18n";
import { useAgentStore } from "@/stores/use-agent-store";
import { useAuthStore } from "@/stores/use-auth-store";
import { isCanvasAccountActive } from "@/stores/canvas/use-canvas-store";
import { matchesCanvasSession } from "@/lib/canvas/canvas-session";
import { guardGenerationUpdate } from "@/lib/canvas/generation-account";
import { applyCanvasAgentOps, type CanvasAgentOp, type CanvasAgentSnapshot } from "@/lib/canvas/canvas-agent-ops";
import type { CanvasNodeGenerationMode } from "@/components/canvas/canvas-node-prompt-panel";
import type { CanvasConnection, CanvasNodeData, ContextMenuState, ViewportTransform } from "@/types/canvas";

type GenerateNodeRef = MutableRefObject<((nodeId: string, mode: CanvasNodeGenerationMode, prompt: string) => Promise<void>) | null>;

type AgentBridgeParams = {
    active: boolean;
    projectId: string;
    title: string | undefined;
    nodes: CanvasNodeData[];
    connections: CanvasConnection[];
    selectedNodeIds: Set<string>;
    viewport: ViewportTransform;
    nodesRef: MutableRefObject<CanvasNodeData[]>;
    connectionsRef: MutableRefObject<CanvasConnection[]>;
    selectedNodeIdsRef: MutableRefObject<Set<string>>;
    viewportRef: MutableRefObject<ViewportTransform>;
    generateNodeRef: GenerateNodeRef;
    setNodes: Dispatch<SetStateAction<CanvasNodeData[]>>;
    setConnections: Dispatch<SetStateAction<CanvasConnection[]>>;
    setSelectedNodeIds: Dispatch<SetStateAction<Set<string>>>;
    setSelectedConnectionId: Dispatch<SetStateAction<string | null>>;
    setViewport: Dispatch<SetStateAction<ViewportTransform>>;
    setContextMenu: Dispatch<SetStateAction<ContextMenuState | null>>;
};

/**
 * Bridge between the canvas and local Agent: publish the current snapshot and apply/undo capabilities
 * to the Agent store for the local Codex panel. All members except applyAgentOps are internal.
 */
export function useAgentBridge(params: AgentBridgeParams) {
    const { active, projectId, title, nodes, connections, selectedNodeIds, viewport, nodesRef, connectionsRef, selectedNodeIdsRef, viewportRef, generateNodeRef, setNodes, setConnections, setSelectedNodeIds, setSelectedConnectionId, setViewport, setContextMenu } =
        params;
    const owner = useAuthStore((state) => state.user?.id ?? null);
    const sessionEpoch = useAuthStore((state) => state.sessionEpoch);
    const isCurrent = () => active && matchesCanvasSession(owner, sessionEpoch, useAuthStore.getState()) && isCanvasAccountActive(owner);
    const setAgentCanvasContext = useAgentStore((state) => state.setCanvasContext);
    const [agentUndoSnapshot, setAgentUndoSnapshot] = useState<CanvasAgentSnapshot | null>(null);
    const projectTitle = title || i18n.t("canvas.project.untitled");

    const agentSnapshot = useMemo<CanvasAgentSnapshot>(() => ({ projectId, title: projectTitle, nodes, connections, selectedNodeIds: Array.from(selectedNodeIds), viewport }), [connections, projectTitle, nodes, projectId, selectedNodeIds, viewport]);
    const applyAgentOps = useCallback(
        (ops?: CanvasAgentOp[]) => {
            if (!isCurrent()) throw new Error("画布会话已变化，请重新打开画布");
            const safeOps = Array.isArray(ops) ? ops.filter((op) => op?.type) : [];
            const before = { projectId, title: projectTitle, nodes: nodesRef.current, connections: connectionsRef.current, selectedNodeIds: Array.from(selectedNodeIdsRef.current), viewport: viewportRef.current };
            const generationOps = safeOps.filter((op): op is Extract<CanvasAgentOp, { type: "run_generation" }> => op.type === "run_generation" && Boolean(op.nodeId));
            const next = applyCanvasAgentOps(
                before,
                safeOps.filter((op) => op.type !== "run_generation"),
            );
            nodesRef.current = next.nodes;
            connectionsRef.current = next.connections;
            selectedNodeIdsRef.current = new Set(next.selectedNodeIds);
            viewportRef.current = next.viewport;
            setAgentUndoSnapshot(before);
            setNodes(guardGenerationUpdate(isCurrent, next.nodes));
            setConnections(guardGenerationUpdate(isCurrent, next.connections));
            setSelectedNodeIds(guardGenerationUpdate(isCurrent, new Set(next.selectedNodeIds)));
            setSelectedConnectionId(guardGenerationUpdate<string | null>(isCurrent, null));
            setViewport(guardGenerationUpdate(isCurrent, next.viewport));
            setContextMenu(guardGenerationUpdate<ContextMenuState | null>(isCurrent, null));
            if (generationOps.length) {
                queueMicrotask(() =>
                    generationOps.forEach((op) => {
                        if (!isCurrent()) return;
                        const target = nodesRef.current.find((node) => node.id === op.nodeId);
                        const prompt = op.prompt?.trim() ? op.prompt : (target?.metadata?.composerContent ?? target?.metadata?.prompt ?? "");
                        void generateNodeRef.current?.(op.nodeId, op.mode || target?.metadata?.generationMode || "image", prompt);
                    }),
                );
            }
            return { ...next, projectId, title: projectTitle };
        },
        [projectTitle, projectId, active, owner, sessionEpoch],
    );
    const undoAgentOps = useCallback(() => {
        if (!agentUndoSnapshot || !isCurrent()) return null;
        nodesRef.current = agentUndoSnapshot.nodes;
        connectionsRef.current = agentUndoSnapshot.connections;
        selectedNodeIdsRef.current = new Set(agentUndoSnapshot.selectedNodeIds);
        viewportRef.current = agentUndoSnapshot.viewport;
        setNodes(guardGenerationUpdate(isCurrent, agentUndoSnapshot.nodes));
        setConnections(guardGenerationUpdate(isCurrent, agentUndoSnapshot.connections));
        setSelectedNodeIds(guardGenerationUpdate(isCurrent, new Set(agentUndoSnapshot.selectedNodeIds)));
        setSelectedConnectionId(guardGenerationUpdate<string | null>(isCurrent, null));
        setViewport(guardGenerationUpdate(isCurrent, agentUndoSnapshot.viewport));
        setContextMenu(guardGenerationUpdate<ContextMenuState | null>(isCurrent, null));
        setAgentUndoSnapshot(null);
        return { ...agentUndoSnapshot, projectId, title: projectTitle };
    }, [agentUndoSnapshot, projectTitle, projectId, active, owner, sessionEpoch]);

    useEffect(() => { setAgentUndoSnapshot(null); }, [owner, sessionEpoch]);

    useEffect(() => {
        if (!isCurrent()) { setAgentCanvasContext(null); return; }
        setAgentCanvasContext({ snapshot: agentSnapshot, applyOps: applyAgentOps, undoOps: undoAgentOps, canUndo: Boolean(agentUndoSnapshot) });
        return () => setAgentCanvasContext(null);
    }, [agentSnapshot, applyAgentOps, agentUndoSnapshot, setAgentCanvasContext, undoAgentOps, active, owner, sessionEpoch]);

    return { applyAgentOps };
}

import { useEffect, useRef } from "react";
import { useNavigate, useSearchParams } from "react-router-dom";
import { App, Button } from "antd";
import { Download, FileUp, LayoutGrid, Plus } from "lucide-react";
import { useTranslation } from "react-i18next";

import { readCanvasPackage } from "@/lib/canvas/canvas-import";
import { captureAccountSession } from "@/lib/account-session";
import { matchesCanvasSession } from "@/lib/canvas/canvas-session";
import { currentMediaOwner } from "@/services/cloud-media";
import { CanvasDeleteProjectsDialog } from "@/components/canvas/canvas-delete-projects-dialog";
import { CanvasProjectCard } from "@/components/canvas/canvas-project-card";
import { isCanvasAccountActive, useCanvasStore } from "@/stores/canvas/use-canvas-store";
import { useAuthStore } from "@/stores/use-auth-store";
import { useCanvasUiStore } from "@/stores/canvas/use-canvas-ui-store";
import { exportCanvasProjects } from "@/lib/canvas/canvas-export";
import { hasAgentUrlBootstrap } from "@/lib/agent/agent-url-bootstrap";

export default function CanvasPage() {
    const { message } = App.useApp();
    const { t } = useTranslation();
    const navigate = useNavigate();
    const [searchParams] = useSearchParams();
    const inputRef = useRef<HTMLInputElement>(null);
    const autoOpenRef = useRef(false);
    const hydrated = useCanvasStore((state) => state.hydrated);
    const userId = useAuthStore((state) => state.user?.id ?? null);
    const authReady = useAuthStore((state) => state.ready);
    const sessionEpoch = useAuthStore((state) => state.sessionEpoch);
    const accountReady = authReady && hydrated && isCanvasAccountActive(userId);
    const isCurrent = () => matchesCanvasSession(userId, sessionEpoch, useAuthStore.getState()) && isCanvasAccountActive(userId);
    const projects = useCanvasStore((state) => state.projects);
    const createProject = useCanvasStore((state) => state.createProject);
    const importProject = useCanvasStore((state) => state.importProject);
    const selectedIds = useCanvasUiStore((state) => state.selectedProjectIds);
    const setDeleteIds = useCanvasUiStore((state) => state.setDeleteProjectIds);

    const mode = searchParams.get("mode");
    const agentMode = mode === "new" || mode === "recent" || mode === "choose";
    const agentQuery = agentMode ? `?${searchParams.toString()}` : "";
    const enterProject = (id: string) => {
        if (!isCurrent()) return;
        const agentHash = hasAgentUrlBootstrap(window.location.hash) ? window.location.hash : "";
        navigate(`/canvas/${id}${agentQuery}${agentHash}`, { replace: Boolean(agentHash) });
    };
    const createAndEnter = () => { if (isCurrent()) enterProject(createProject()); };
    const importCanvas = async (file?: File) => {
        if (!file || !isCurrent()) return;
        try {
            const session = captureAccountSession();
            const owner = session.owner;
            const projects = await readCanvasPackage(file);
            session.check();
            if (!owner || currentMediaOwner() !== owner) throw new Error("登录账户已变化，请重新导入");
            projects.forEach(importProject);
            message.success(t("canvas.imported", { count: projects.length }));
        } catch {
            message.error(t("canvas.importFailed"));
        } finally {
            if (inputRef.current) inputRef.current.value = "";
        }
    };

    useEffect(() => {
        if (!accountReady || !isCurrent() || autoOpenRef.current || (mode !== "new" && mode !== "recent")) return;
        autoOpenRef.current = true;
        enterProject(mode === "new" ? createProject() : projects[0]?.id || createProject());
    }, [accountReady, createProject, mode, projects, t]);

    if (!accountReady) return <main className="flex h-full items-center justify-center bg-background text-sm text-muted-foreground">{t("canvas.loading")}</main>;

    if (hydrated && (mode === "new" || mode === "recent")) return <main className="flex h-full items-center justify-center bg-background text-sm text-muted-foreground">{t("canvas.opening")}</main>;

    return (
        // 外层必须是定高 flex 列：jm-page 靠 flex:1 + overflow-y 自己滚；
        // 少了这层它会被内容撑到全高，再被 layout 的 overflow-hidden 裁掉（表现为没有滚动条、底部卡片点不到）
        <div className="page-surface flex h-full min-h-0 flex-col overflow-hidden bg-background text-foreground">
            <main className="jm-page">
                <div className="jm-page-inner flex flex-col gap-6">
                    <header className="jm-page-head">
                        <div className="min-w-0">
                            <p className="mb-2 text-xs leading-4 text-muted-foreground">{t("canvas.library")}</p>
                            <h1 className="jm-page-title">{t("canvas.title")}</h1>
                        </div>
                        <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2">
                            {selectedIds.length ? (
                                <>
                                    <Button disabled={!hydrated} icon={<Download className="size-4" />} onClick={() => { if (isCurrent()) void exportCanvasProjects(projects.filter((project) => selectedIds.includes(project.id)), `${t("canvas.title")}-${selectedIds.length}`).catch((error) => message.error(error instanceof Error ? error.message : t("canvas.sidePanel.exportFailed"))); }}>
                                        {t("canvas.exportSelected")}
                                    </Button>
                                    <Button disabled={!hydrated} onClick={() => { if (isCurrent()) setDeleteIds(selectedIds); }}>
                                        {t("canvas.deleteSelected")}
                                    </Button>
                                </>
                            ) : null}
                            {projects.length ? (
                                <Button disabled={!hydrated} onClick={() => { if (isCurrent()) setDeleteIds(projects.map((project) => project.id)); }}>
                                    {t("canvas.deleteAll")}
                                </Button>
                            ) : null}
                            <Button disabled={!hydrated} icon={<FileUp className="size-4" />} onClick={() => { if (isCurrent()) inputRef.current?.click(); }}>
                                {t("canvas.import")}
                            </Button>
                            <button type="button" disabled={!hydrated} className="jm-btn jm-btn-primary" onClick={createAndEnter}>
                                <Plus className="size-4" />
                                {t("canvas.create")}
                            </button>
                        </div>
                    </header>

                    {!hydrated ? (
                        <section className="flex min-h-[360px] items-center justify-center text-sm text-muted-foreground">{t("canvas.loading")}</section>
                    ) : projects.length ? (
                        <div className="jm-canvas-grid">
                            {projects.map((project) => (
                                <CanvasProjectCard key={project.id} project={project} />
                            ))}
                        </div>
                    ) : (
                        <section className="jm-card jm-empty min-h-[360px]">
                            <div className="jm-empty-icon"><LayoutGrid className="size-8" strokeWidth={1.5} /></div>
                            <h2 className="jm-empty-title">{t("canvas.empty")}</h2>
                            <p className="jm-empty-desc">{t("canvas.emptyDescription")}</p>
                            <button type="button" className="jm-btn jm-btn-primary mt-4" onClick={createAndEnter}>
                                <Plus className="size-4" />
                                {t("canvas.create")}
                            </button>
                        </section>
                    )}
                </div>

                <input ref={inputRef} type="file" accept="application/zip,.zip" className="hidden" onChange={(event) => void importCanvas(event.target.files?.[0])} />
                <CanvasDeleteProjectsDialog />
            </main>
        </div>
    );
}

function applyGeneratedVideo(item: CanvasNodeData, video: UploadedFile, extra: CanvasNodeData["metadata"] = {}): CanvasNodeData {
    const videoSize = fitNodeSize(video.width || item.width, video.height || item.height, VIDEO_NODE_MAX_WIDTH, VIDEO_NODE_MAX_HEIGHT);
    return {
        ...item,
        width: videoSize.width,
        height: videoSize.height,
        position: { x: item.position.x + item.width / 2 - videoSize.width / 2, y: item.position.y + item.height / 2 - videoSize.height / 2 },
        metadata: { ...item.metadata, ...videoMetadata(video), videoStatusMessage: undefined, ...extra },
    };
}

export default function CanvasPage() {
    const [mounted, setMounted] = useState(false);
    const [cloudRestoreVersion, setCloudRestoreVersion] = useState(0);
    const projectId = useParams<{ id: string }>().id;
    const owner = useAuthStore((state) => state.user?.id ?? null);
    const sessionEpoch = useAuthStore((state) => state.sessionEpoch);

    useEffect(() => {
        setMounted(true);
    }, []);

    useEffect(() => {
        const restoreCloud = (event: Event) => {
            const detail = (event as CustomEvent<{ projectId: string; owner: string; sessionEpoch: number }>).detail;
            if (detail?.projectId !== projectId || detail.owner !== owner || detail.sessionEpoch !== sessionEpoch || !matchesCanvasSession(owner, sessionEpoch, useAuthStore.getState()) || !isCanvasAccountActive(owner)) return;
            setCloudRestoreVersion((version) => version + 1);
        };
        window.addEventListener("sundas:canvas-conflict-resolved", restoreCloud);
        return () => window.removeEventListener("sundas:canvas-conflict-resolved", restoreCloud);
    }, [projectId, owner, sessionEpoch]);

    if (!mounted) return <CanvasRefreshShell />;

    return <InfiniteCanvasPage key={`${projectId}:${owner}:${sessionEpoch}:${cloudRestoreVersion}`} />;
}

function isRecoverableVideoCreateError(error: unknown) {
    const message = error instanceof Error ? error.message : "";
    return /（(?:502|503|504|524)）|服务异常/.test(message);
}

function measureFocusFrame(container: HTMLDivElement | null, nodeId: string) {
    if (!container) return {};
    const nodeRect = container.querySelector<HTMLElement>(`[data-node-id="${nodeId}"]`)?.getBoundingClientRect();
    const panelRect = container.querySelector<HTMLElement>(`[data-node-id="${nodeId}"] [data-node-panel]`)?.getBoundingClientRect();
    const toolbarRect = document.querySelector<HTMLElement>(`[data-node-toolbar="${nodeId}"]`)?.getBoundingClientRect();
    const dockRect = document.querySelector<HTMLElement>("[data-canvas-bottom-toolbar]")?.getBoundingClientRect();
    const below = nodeRect && panelRect ? panelRect.bottom - nodeRect.bottom : 0;
    const above = nodeRect && toolbarRect ? nodeRect.top - toolbarRect.top : 0;
    return { above, below, bottomInset: dockRect && below > 0 ? Math.max(0, container.getBoundingClientRect().bottom - dockRect.top) : 0 };
}

    const [splitNodeId, setSplitNodeId] = useState<string | null>(null);
    const [upscaleNodeId, setUpscaleNodeId] = useState<string | null>(null);
    const [superResolveNodeId, setSuperResolveNodeId] = useState<string | null>(null);
    const [creativePanel, setCreativePanel] = useState<"production" | "production-export" | "agent" | "character" | null>(null);
    const [toolHandoff, setToolHandoff] = useState<CreativeToolHandoff>();
    const toolBaseRef = useRef<{ projectId: string; owner: string; epoch: number; updatedAt: string; nodes: CanvasNodeData[]; connections: CanvasConnection[]; production?: ProductionDocument; directorScenes: DirectorScene[] } | null>(null);
    const [angleNodeId, setAngleNodeId] = useState<string | null>(null);
    const [previewNodeId, setPreviewNodeId] = useState<string | null>(null);
    const [hoverPreviewNodeId, setHoverPreviewNodeId] = useState<string | null>(null);
    const [previewImageId, setPreviewImageId] = useState<string | null>(null);
    const [titleEditing, setTitleEditing] = useState(false);
    const [titleDraft, setTitleDraft] = useState("");
    const [historyState, setHistoryState] = useState({ canUndo: false, canRedo: false });
    const [expandedBatchNodeIds, setExpandedBatchNodeIds] = useState<Set<string>>(new Set());
    const [isNodeDragging, setIsNodeDragging] = useState(false);
    const [isNodeResizing, setIsNodeResizing] = useState(false);
    const [dropTargetGroupId, setDropTargetGroupId] = useState<string | null>(null);
    const [referencePickerNodeId, setReferencePickerNodeId] = useState<string | null>(null);

    const nodesRef = useRef(nodes);
    const connectionsRef = useRef(connections);
    const productionRef = useRef(production);
    const directorScenesRef = useRef(directorScenes);
    const activeProjectIdRef = useRef(projectId);
    activeProjectIdRef.current = projectId;
    const loadedProjectIdRef = useRef<string | null>(null);
    const selectedNodeIdsRef = useRef(selectedNodeIds);
    const viewportRef = useRef(viewport);
    const focusAnimRef = useRef<number | null>(null);
    const generateNodeRef = useRef<((nodeId: string, mode: CanvasNodeGenerationMode, prompt: string) => Promise<void>) | null>(null);
    const connectingParamsRef = useRef(connectingParams);
    const connectionTargetNodeIdRef = useRef(connectionTargetNodeId);
    const selectionBoxRef = useRef(selectionBox);
    const pendingConnectionCreateRef = useRef(pendingConnectionCreate);
    const generationRequestsRef = useRef(new Map<string, CanvasGenerationRequest>());
    const generationOwnersRef = useRef(createGenerationAccountBindings());
    const authUserId = useAuthStore((state) => state.user?.id ?? null);
    const authReady = useAuthStore((state) => state.ready);
    const authSessionEpoch = useAuthStore((state) => state.sessionEpoch);
    const previousAuthUserIdRef = useRef(authUserId);
    const previousAuthEpochRef = useRef(authSessionEpoch);
    const loadedAuthUserIdRef = useRef<string | null>(null);
    const loadedAuthEpochRef = useRef<number | null>(null);
    const videoPollIdsRef = useRef(new Set<string>());

    useEffect(() => {
        if (previousAuthUserIdRef.current === authUserId && previousAuthEpochRef.current === authSessionEpoch) return;
        previousAuthUserIdRef.current = authUserId;
        previousAuthEpochRef.current = authSessionEpoch;
        generationRequestsRef.current.forEach((request) => request.controller.abort());
        generationRequestsRef.current.clear();
        if (historyCommitTimerRef.current) clearTimeout(historyCommitTimerRef.current);
        if (viewportSaveTimerRef.current) clearTimeout(viewportSaveTimerRef.current);
        historyCommitTimerRef.current = null;
        viewportSaveTimerRef.current = null;
        historyRef.current = { past: [], future: [] };
        lastHistoryRef.current = null;
        applyingHistoryRef.current = false;
        loadedAuthEpochRef.current = null;
        setHistoryState({ canUndo: false, canRedo: false });
        setProjectLoaded(false);
        setCreativePanel(null);
        setToolHandoff(undefined);
        setSuperResolveNodeId(null);
        directorScenesRef.current = [];
        setDirectorScenes([]);
        setDirectorOpen(false);
        setStoryboardOpen(false);
        toolBaseRef.current = null;
        setRunningNodeId(null);
        setNodes([]);
        setConnections([]);
        setProduction(undefined);
        setChatSessions([]);
        setActiveChatId(null);
    }, [authUserId, authSessionEpoch]);

    const createHistoryEntry = useCallback(
        (): CanvasHistoryEntry => ({
            nodes: nodesRef.current,
            connections: connectionsRef.current,
            production: productionRef.current,
            directorScenes: directorScenesRef.current,
            chatSessions,
            activeChatId,
            backgroundMode,
            showImageInfo,
        }),
        [activeChatId, backgroundMode, chatSessions, showImageInfo],
    );
    const isLoadedCanvasCurrent = () => !invalidatedRef.current && loadedProjectIdRef.current === activeProjectIdRef.current && matchesCanvasSession(loadedAuthUserIdRef.current, loadedAuthEpochRef.current, useAuthStore.getState()) && isCanvasAccountActive(loadedAuthUserIdRef.current);

    const cleanupCanvasFiles = useCallback(
        (extra?: unknown) => {
            cleanupAssetImages({ extra, history: historyRef.current, lastHistory: lastHistoryRef.current });
        },
        [cleanupAssetImages],
    );

    const startGenerationRequest = useCallback((targetNodeId: string, originNodeId: string, runningId = originNodeId, controller = new AbortController()) => {
        const auth = useAuthStore.getState();
        generationOwnersRef.current.bind(controller.signal, auth.ready && auth.user ? auth.user.id : null, auth.sessionEpoch);
        const previous = generationRequestsRef.current.get(targetNodeId);
        if (previous?.controller !== controller) previous?.controller.abort();
        generationRequestsRef.current.set(targetNodeId, { targetNodeId, originNodeId, runningNodeId: runningId, controller });
        return controller;
    }, []);

    const generationAccountOptions = (signal: AbortSignal, _config: Parameters<typeof buildGenerationConfig>[0]) => generationOwnersRef.current.options(signal);
    const isGenerationAccountCurrent = (signal: AbortSignal) => {
        const auth = useAuthStore.getState();
        return generationOwnersRef.current.isCurrent(signal, auth.ready ? auth.user?.id ?? null : null, auth.sessionEpoch);
    };
    const isGenerationAccountOwner = (signal: AbortSignal) => {
        const auth = useAuthStore.getState();
        return generationOwnersRef.current.isOwner(signal, auth.ready ? auth.user?.id ?? null : null, auth.sessionEpoch);
    };

    const finishGenerationRequest = useCallback((targetNodeId: string, controller: AbortController) => {
        const request = generationRequestsRef.current.get(targetNodeId);
        if (request?.controller === controller) generationRequestsRef.current.delete(targetNodeId);
    }, []);

    const videoProgressOptions = (nodeId: string, signal: AbortSignal, config: Parameters<typeof buildGenerationConfig>[0]) => ({
        ...generationAccountOptions(signal, config),
        onProgress: (videoStatusMessage: string) => setNodes(prev => isGenerationAccountCurrent(signal) ? prev.map(item => item.id === nodeId && item.metadata?.videoStatusMessage !== videoStatusMessage ? { ...item, metadata: { ...item.metadata, videoStatusMessage } } : item) : prev),
    });

    const completeVideoNodeTask = useCallback(
        async (nodeId: string, config: Parameters<typeof buildGenerationConfig>[0], prompt: string, images: Parameters<typeof createVideoGenerationTask>[2], signal: AbortSignal, extra: CanvasNodeData["metadata"] = {}, videos: ReferenceVideo[] = [], audios: ReferenceAudio[] = []) => {
            // 先把任务 ID 交给服务端，网关超时/断线时仍可用它找回已经创建的任务。
            const clientTaskId = crypto.randomUUID();
            setNodes(prev => isGenerationAccountCurrent(signal) ? prev.map(item => item.id === nodeId ? { ...item, metadata: { ...item.metadata, videoStatusMessage: '正在提交' } } : item) : prev);
            const requestOptions = { ...generationAccountOptions(signal, config), videos, audios, clientTaskId };
            const markTask = (taskId: string | undefined, provider: "openai" | "gemini" | "plugin" = "openai") => setNodes((prev) => isGenerationAccountCurrent(signal) ? prev.map((item) => (item.id === nodeId ? { ...item, metadata: { ...item.metadata, ...(taskId ? { videoTaskId: taskId, videoTaskProvider: provider === "gemini" ? "gemini" as const : "openai" as const, model: config.model } : { videoTaskId: undefined }) } } : item)) : prev);
            markTask(clientTaskId);
            let task: { id: string; provider: "openai" | "gemini" | "plugin"; model: string };
            try {
                task = await createVideoGenerationTask(config, prompt, images, requestOptions);
            } catch (error) {
                if (!isRecoverableVideoCreateError(error)) {
                    markTask(undefined);
                    throw error;
                }
                let recovered = false;
                for (let attempt = 0; attempt < 3 && !recovered; attempt += 1) {
                    try {
                        await pollVideoGenerationTask(config, { id: clientTaskId, provider: "openai", model: config.model }, requestOptions);
                        recovered = true;
                    } catch (pollError) {
                        if (signal.aborted) throw pollError;
                        await new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, 2000));
                    }
                }
                if (!recovered) {
                    markTask(undefined);
                    throw error;
                }
                task = { id: clientTaskId, provider: "openai", model: config.model };
            }
            if (task.provider === "plugin") markTask(undefined);
            else markTask(task.id, task.provider);
            const video = await storeGeneratedVideo(await waitForVideoGenerationTask(config, task, videoProgressOptions(nodeId, signal, config)), { signal, expectedOwner: generationOwnersRef.current.owner(signal) });
            setNodes((prev) => isGenerationAccountCurrent(signal) ? prev.map((item) => (item.id === nodeId ? applyGeneratedVideo(item, video, { prompt, model: config.model, ...extra }) : item)) : prev);
        },
        [],
    );

    const pollVideoNodeTask = useCallback(
        async (node: CanvasNodeData, silent = false) => {
            const taskId = node.metadata?.videoTaskId;
            if (!taskId || node.metadata?.content || generationRequestsRef.current.has(node.id) || videoPollIdsRef.current.has(node.id)) return;
            videoPollIdsRef.current.add(node.id);
            let controller: AbortController | undefined;
            try {
                const generationConfig = buildGenerationConfig(effectiveConfig, node, "video");
                if (!isAiConfigReady(generationConfig, generationConfig.model)) {
                    if (silent) {
                        setNodes((prev) => prev.map((item) => (item.id === node.id ? { ...item, metadata: { ...item.metadata, status: NODE_STATUS_ERROR, errorDetails: t("workbench.configFirst") } } : item)));
                        return;
                    }
                    openConfigDialog(true);
                    return;
                }
                setRunningNodeId(node.id);
                setNodes((prev) => prev.map((item) => (item.id === node.id ? { ...item, metadata: { ...item.metadata, status: NODE_STATUS_LOADING, errorDetails: undefined } } : item)));
                controller = startGenerationRequest(node.id, node.id, node.id);
                const video = await storeGeneratedVideo(await waitForVideoGenerationTask(generationConfig, { id: taskId, provider: node.metadata?.videoTaskProvider === "gemini" ? "gemini" : "openai", model: generationConfig.model }, videoProgressOptions(node.id, controller.signal, generationConfig)), { signal: controller.signal, expectedOwner: generationOwnersRef.current.owner(controller.signal) });
                setNodes((prev) =>
                    !isGenerationAccountCurrent(controller!.signal) ? prev : prev.map((item) =>
                        item.id === node.id
                            ? applyGeneratedVideo(item, video, {
                                  prompt: item.metadata?.prompt,
                                  model: generationConfig.model,
                                  size: generationConfig.size,
                                  seconds: generationConfig.videoSeconds,
                                  vquality: generationConfig.vquality,
                                  generateAudio: generationConfig.videoGenerateAudio,
                                  watermark: generationConfig.videoWatermark,
                                  videoMode: generationConfig.videoMode,
                                  videoRouteId: generationConfig.videoRouteId,
                              })
                            : item,
                    ),
                );
            } catch (error) {
                if (isGenerationCanceled(error)) return;
                if (controller && !isGenerationAccountCurrent(controller.signal)) return;
                const errorDetails = friendlyErrorMessage(error instanceof Error ? error.message : t("canvas.projectPage.generationFailed"));
                message.error(errorDetails);
                setNodes((prev) =>
                    controller && !isGenerationAccountCurrent(controller.signal) ? prev : prev.map((item) =>
                        item.id === node.id
                            ? {
                                  ...item,
                                  metadata: {
                                      ...item.metadata,
                                      status: item.metadata?.content ? NODE_STATUS_SUCCESS : NODE_STATUS_ERROR,
                                      errorDetails: item.metadata?.content ? undefined : errorDetails,
                                      ...(isVideoTaskFailed(error) ? { videoTaskId: undefined } : {}),
                                  },
                              }
                            : item,
                    ),
                );
            } finally {
                videoPollIdsRef.current.delete(node.id);
                if (controller) {
                    finishGenerationRequest(node.id, controller);
                    setRunningNodeId((current) => (isGenerationAccountOwner(controller!.signal) && current === node.id ? null : current));
                }
            }
        },
        [effectiveConfig, finishGenerationRequest, isAiConfigReady, message, openConfigDialog, startGenerationRequest, t],
    );

    const stopGenerationByRunningId = useCallback((runningId: string) => {
        const affectedNodeIds = new Set<string>();
        generationRequestsRef.current.forEach((request) => {
            if (request.runningNodeId !== runningId) return;
            request.controller.abort();
            generationRequestsRef.current.delete(request.targetNodeId);
            affectedNodeIds.add(request.targetNodeId);
            affectedNodeIds.add(request.originNodeId);
        });
        setRunningNodeId((current) => (current === runningId ? null : current));
        if (!affectedNodeIds.size) return;
        setNodes((prev) =>
            prev.map((node) =>
                affectedNodeIds.has(node.id) && node.metadata?.status === NODE_STATUS_LOADING
                    ? {
                          ...node,
                          metadata: {
                              ...node.metadata,
                              status: NODE_STATUS_IDLE,
                              errorDetails: undefined,
                              images: node.metadata.images?.map((image) => (image.status === NODE_STATUS_LOADING ? { ...image, status: NODE_STATUS_ERROR, errorDetails: t("common.requestCanceled") } : image)),
                              texts: node.metadata.texts?.map((text) => (text.status === NODE_STATUS_LOADING ? { ...text, status: NODE_STATUS_ERROR, errorDetails: t("common.requestCanceled") } : text)),
                          },
                      }
                    : node,
            ),
        );
    }, [t]);

    const confirmStopGeneration = useCallback(
        (nodeId: string) => {
            modal.confirm({
                title: t("canvas.projectPage.stopTitle"),
                content: t("canvas.projectPage.stopDescription"),
                okText: t("canvas.projectPage.stop"),
                cancelText: t("canvas.projectPage.continue"),
                okButtonProps: { danger: true },
                onOk: () => stopGenerationByRunningId(nodeId),
            });
        },
        [modal, stopGenerationByRunningId, t],
    );

    useLayoutEffect(() => {
        invalidatedRef.current = false;
        const invalidate = () => {
            // Old uploads may still resolve: permanently retire this editor before its replacement mounts.
            invalidatedRef.current = true;
            loadedProjectIdRef.current = null;
            loadedAuthUserIdRef.current = null;
            loadedAuthEpochRef.current = null;
            toolBaseRef.current = null;
            generationRequestsRef.current.forEach((request) => request.controller.abort());
            generationRequestsRef.current.clear();
            if (historyCommitTimerRef.current) clearTimeout(historyCommitTimerRef.current);
            if (viewportSaveTimerRef.current) clearTimeout(viewportSaveTimerRef.current);
            if (focusAnimRef.current) cancelAnimationFrame(focusAnimRef.current);
            if (rafRef.current) cancelAnimationFrame(rafRef.current);
            historyCommitTimerRef.current = viewportSaveTimerRef.current = null;
            focusAnimRef.current = rafRef.current = null;
            dragRef.current.isDraggingNode = nodeDraggingRef.current = false;
