                if (isGenerationCanceled(error) || !isGenerationAccountCurrent(runController.signal)) return;
                const errorDetails = error instanceof Error ? error.message : t("canvas.projectPage.generationFailed");
                message.error(errorDetails);
                setOwnedNodes((prev) =>
                    prev.map((node) =>
                        node.id === nodeId || pendingChildIds.includes(node.id)
                            ? node.id === nodeId && !markSourceStatus
                                ? node
                                : {
                                      ...node,
                                      metadata: {
                                          ...node.metadata,
                                          status: NODE_STATUS_ERROR,
                                          errorDetails,
                                          ...(isVideoTaskFailed(error) && node.type === CanvasNodeType.Video ? { videoTaskId: undefined } : {}),
                                      },
                                  }
                            : node,
                    ),
                );
            } finally {
                finishGenerationRequest(nodeId, runController);
                setRunningNodeId((current) => isGenerationAccountOwner(runController.signal) && current === nodeId ? null : current);
            }
        },
        [completeVideoNodeTask, effectiveConfig, finishGenerationRequest, isAiConfigReady, message, openConfigDialog, startGenerationRequest, t],
    );
    useEffect(() => {
        generateNodeRef.current = handleGenerateNode;
    }, [handleGenerateNode]);

    const handleRetryNode = useCallback(
        async (node: CanvasNodeData, imageId?: string) => {
            if (hasResumableVideoTask(node)) {
                await pollVideoNodeTask(node);
                return;
            }
            const sourceNode = findRetrySourceNode(node.id, nodesRef.current, connectionsRef.current) || node;
            const savedImageMetadata = node.type === CanvasNodeType.Image ? node.metadata : undefined;
            const hasSavedImageMetadata = Boolean(savedImageMetadata?.generationType);
            const generationConfig =
                hasSavedImageMetadata && savedImageMetadata
                    ? {
                          ...effectiveConfig,
                          model: savedImageMetadata.model || effectiveConfig.imageModel || effectiveConfig.model,
                          quality: savedImageMetadata.quality || effectiveConfig.quality,
                          size: savedImageMetadata.size || effectiveConfig.size,
                          background: savedImageMetadata.background ?? effectiveConfig.background,
                          count: "1",
                      }
                    : { ...buildGenerationConfig(effectiveConfig, sourceNode, node.type === CanvasNodeType.Text ? "text" : node.type === CanvasNodeType.Video ? "video" : node.type === CanvasNodeType.Audio ? "audio" : "image"), count: "1" };
            if (!isAiConfigReady(generationConfig, generationConfig.model)) {
                openConfigDialog(true);
                return;
            }

            const retryAuth = useAuthStore.getState();
            const retryOwner = retryAuth.user?.id ?? null;
            const isRetryOwner = () => { const auth = useAuthStore.getState(); return Boolean(retryOwner && auth.ready && auth.user?.id === retryOwner && auth.sessionEpoch === retryAuth.sessionEpoch); };
            if (!isRetryOwner()) return;
            const context = hasSavedImageMetadata ? null : await hydrateNodeGenerationContext(buildNodeGenerationContext(sourceNode.id, nodesRef.current, connectionsRef.current, sourceNode.metadata?.prompt || node.metadata?.prompt || ""));
            if (!isRetryOwner()) return;
            const prompt = (savedImageMetadata?.prompt || context?.prompt || "").trim();
            if (!prompt) {
                message.warning(t("canvas.projectPage.retryPromptMissing"));
                return;
            }
            const generationType = savedImageMetadata?.generationType;
            const useReferenceImages = generationType ? generationType === "edit" : Boolean(context?.referenceImages.length);
            const retryReferenceImages =
                hasSavedImageMetadata && savedImageMetadata ? await resolveMetadataReferences(savedImageMetadata) : useReferenceImages ? (context?.referenceImages.length ? context.referenceImages : sourceNodeReferenceImages(sourceNode)) : [];
            if (!isRetryOwner()) return;
            if (useReferenceImages && !retryReferenceImages) {
                message.error(t("canvas.projectPage.referenceMissing"));
                setNodes((prev) => isRetryOwner() ? prev.map((item) => (item.id === node.id ? { ...item, metadata: { ...item.metadata, status: item.metadata?.content ? NODE_STATUS_SUCCESS : NODE_STATUS_ERROR, errorDetails: item.metadata?.content ? undefined : t("canvas.projectPage.referenceMissing"), images: item.metadata?.images?.map((image) => (image.id === imageId ? { ...image, status: NODE_STATUS_ERROR, errorDetails: t("canvas.projectPage.referenceMissing") } : image)) } } : item)) : prev);
                return;
            }
            const retryImages = retryReferenceImages || [];

            setRunningNodeId(node.id);
            setNodes((prev) => isRetryOwner() ? prev.map((item) => (item.id === node.id ? { ...item, metadata: { ...item.metadata, status: NODE_STATUS_LOADING, errorDetails: undefined, images: item.metadata?.images?.map((image) => (image.id === imageId ? { ...image, status: NODE_STATUS_LOADING, errorDetails: undefined } : image)) } } : item)) : prev);
            const controller = startGenerationRequest(node.id, sourceNode.id, node.id);
            const setOwnedNodes = (update: Parameters<typeof setNodes>[0]) => setNodes(guardGenerationUpdate(() => isGenerationAccountCurrent(controller.signal), update));

            try {
                if (node.type === CanvasNodeType.Text) {
                    if (!context) return;
                    let streamed = "";
                    const answer = await requestImageQuestion(
                        generationConfig,
                        buildNodeResponseMessages({ ...context, prompt }),
                        (text) => {
                            streamed = text;
                            setOwnedNodes((prev) => prev.map((item) => (item.id === node.id ? { ...item, type: CanvasNodeType.Text, metadata: { ...item.metadata, content: text, status: NODE_STATUS_LOADING } } : item)));
                        },
                        generationAccountOptions(controller.signal, generationConfig),
                    );
                    setOwnedNodes((prev) => prev.map((item) => (item.id === node.id ? { ...item, type: CanvasNodeType.Text, metadata: { ...item.metadata, content: answer || streamed, prompt, status: NODE_STATUS_SUCCESS } } : item)));
                    return;
                }
                if (node.type === CanvasNodeType.Video) {
                    await completeVideoNodeTask(node.id, generationConfig, prompt, retryImages, controller.signal, {
                        size: generationConfig.size,
                        seconds: generationConfig.videoSeconds,
                        vquality: generationConfig.vquality,
                        generateAudio: generationConfig.videoGenerateAudio,
                        watermark: generationConfig.videoWatermark,
                        videoMode: generationConfig.videoMode,
                        videoRouteId: generationConfig.videoRouteId,
                    }, context?.referenceVideos || [], context?.referenceAudios || []);
                    return;
                }
                if (node.type === CanvasNodeType.Audio) {
                    const requestId = String(node.metadata?.audioRequestId || crypto.randomUUID());
                    setOwnedNodes(prev => prev.map(item => item.id === node.id ? { ...item, metadata: { ...item.metadata, audioRequestId: requestId } } : item));
                    const audio = await requestStoredAudio(generationConfig, prompt, { ...generationAccountOptions(controller.signal, generationConfig), requestId });
                    setOwnedNodes((prev) => prev.map((item) => (item.id === node.id ? { ...item, metadata: { ...item.metadata, ...audioMetadata(audio), prompt, ...buildAudioGenerationMetadata(generationConfig) } } : item)));
                    return;
                }

                const image = useReferenceImages
                    ? await requestEdit(generationConfig, prompt, retryImages, generationAccountOptions(controller.signal, generationConfig)).then((items) => items[0])
                    : await requestGeneration(generationConfig, prompt, generationAccountOptions(controller.signal, generationConfig)).then((items) => items[0]);
                const uploadedImage = await uploadImage(image.dataUrl, { signal: controller.signal, expectedOwner: generationOwnersRef.current.owner(controller.signal) });
                const imageConfig = NODE_DEFAULT_SIZE[CanvasNodeType.Image];
                const retryImage: CanvasNodeImage = {
                    id: imageId || node.metadata?.primaryImageId || nanoid(),
                    status: NODE_STATUS_SUCCESS,
                    content: uploadedImage.url,
                    storageKey: uploadedImage.storageKey,
                    naturalWidth: uploadedImage.width,
                    naturalHeight: uploadedImage.height,
                    bytes: uploadedImage.bytes,
                    mimeType: uploadedImage.mimeType,
                };
                const generationMetadata = savedImageMetadata?.generationType
                    ? {
                          generationType: savedImageMetadata.generationType,
                          model: generationConfig.model,
                          size: generationConfig.size,
                          quality: generationConfig.quality,
                          ...(generationConfig.background ? { background: generationConfig.background } : {}),
                          count: savedImageMetadata.count || 1,
                          references: savedImageMetadata.references,
                      }
                    : buildImageGenerationMetadata(useReferenceImages ? "edit" : "generation", generationConfig, 1, retryImages);
                setOwnedNodes((prev) =>
                    prev.map((item) => {
                        if (item.id !== node.id) return item;
                        const makePrimary = !imageId || !item.metadata?.content;
                        const edge = imageId ? Math.max(item.width, item.height) : 0;
                        const imageSize = imageId && item.metadata?.freeResize ? { width: item.width, height: item.height } : imageId ? fitNodeSize(uploadedImage.width, uploadedImage.height, edge, edge) : fitNodeSize(uploadedImage.width, uploadedImage.height, imageConfig.width, imageConfig.height);
                        return {
                            ...item,
                            type: CanvasNodeType.Image,
                            ...(makePrimary ? { width: imageSize.width, height: imageSize.height, ...(imageId ? { position: { x: item.position.x + item.width / 2 - imageSize.width / 2, y: item.position.y + item.height / 2 - imageSize.height / 2 } } : {}) } : {}),
                            metadata: {
                                ...item.metadata,
                                ...(makePrimary ? imageMetadata(uploadedImage) : { status: NODE_STATUS_SUCCESS }),
                                images: item.metadata?.images?.map((current) => (current.id === retryImage.id ? retryImage : current)),
                                primaryImageId: makePrimary ? retryImage.id : item.metadata?.primaryImageId,
                                prompt,
                                ...generationMetadata,
                            },
                        };
                    }),
                );
            } catch (error) {
                if (isGenerationCanceled(error) || !isGenerationAccountCurrent(controller.signal)) return;
                const errorDetails = error instanceof Error ? error.message : t("canvas.projectPage.generationFailed");
                message.error(errorDetails);
                setOwnedNodes((prev) =>
                    prev.map((item) =>
                        item.id === node.id
                            ? {
                                  ...item,
                                  metadata: {
                                      ...item.metadata,
                                      status: node.type === CanvasNodeType.Text ? NODE_STATUS_ERROR : item.metadata?.content ? NODE_STATUS_SUCCESS : NODE_STATUS_ERROR,
                                      errorDetails: node.type === CanvasNodeType.Text ? errorDetails : item.metadata?.content ? undefined : errorDetails,
                                      images: item.metadata?.images?.map((image) => (image.id === imageId ? { ...image, status: NODE_STATUS_ERROR, errorDetails } : image)),
                                      ...(isVideoTaskFailed(error) && item.type === CanvasNodeType.Video ? { videoTaskId: undefined } : {}),
                                  },
                              }
                            : item,
                    ),
                );
            } finally {
                finishGenerationRequest(node.id, controller);
                setRunningNodeId((current) => isGenerationAccountOwner(controller.signal) && current === node.id ? null : current);
            }
        },
        [completeVideoNodeTask, effectiveConfig, finishGenerationRequest, isAiConfigReady, message, openConfigDialog, pollVideoNodeTask, startGenerationRequest, t],
    );

    const deleteBatchImage = useCallback((nodeId: string, imageId: string) => {
        const node = nodesRef.current.find((item) => item.id === nodeId);
        if ((node?.metadata?.images?.length || 0) <= 2) setExpandedBatchNodeIds((current) => new Set([...current].filter((id) => id !== nodeId)));
        setNodes((prev) =>
            prev.map((item) => {
                if (item.id !== nodeId) return item;
                const images = item.metadata?.images?.filter((image) => image.id !== imageId) || [];
                return { ...item, metadata: { ...item.metadata, images, count: images.length, primaryImageId: item.metadata?.primaryImageId === imageId ? images[0]?.id : item.metadata?.primaryImageId } };
            }),
        );
    }, []);

    const retryBatchImage = useCallback((node: CanvasNodeData, imageId: string) => void handleRetryNode(node, imageId), [handleRetryNode]);

    const generateImageFromTextNode = useCallback(
        (node: CanvasNodeData) => {
            const prompt = (node.metadata?.content || node.metadata?.prompt || "").trim();
            if (!prompt) {
                message.warning(t("canvas.projectPage.emptyTextImage"));
                return;
            }
            const sourceNode = nodesRef.current.find((item) => item.id === node.id);
            if (!sourceNode) return;
            const nodeSize = getNodeSpec(CanvasNodeType.Config);
            const configNode = createCanvasNode(
                CanvasNodeType.Config,
                {
                    x: sourceNode.position.x + sourceNode.width + 96 + nodeSize.width / 2,
                    y: sourceNode.position.y + sourceNode.height / 2,
                },
                {
                    prompt: "",
                    model: effectiveConfig.imageModel || effectiveConfig.model,
                    size: effectiveConfig.size,
                    count: getGenerationCount(effectiveConfig.canvasImageCount || effectiveConfig.count),
                },
            );
            const connection = { id: nanoid(), fromNodeId: sourceNode.id, toNodeId: configNode.id };
            const nextNodes = nodesRef.current.map((item) => (item.id === sourceNode.id ? { ...item, metadata: { ...item.metadata, content: prompt, prompt, status: NODE_STATUS_SUCCESS } } : item)).concat(configNode);
            const nextConnections = [...connectionsRef.current, connection];
            nodesRef.current = nextNodes;
            connectionsRef.current = nextConnections;
            setNodes(nextNodes);
            setConnections(nextConnections);
            setSelectedNodeIds(new Set([configNode.id]));
            setSelectedConnectionId(null);
            setDialogNodeId(configNode.id);
        },
        [effectiveConfig.canvasImageCount, effectiveConfig.count, effectiveConfig.imageModel, effectiveConfig.model, effectiveConfig.size, message, t],
    );

    const insertAssistantImage = useCallback(
        async (image: CanvasAssistantImage) => {
            const storedImage = image.storageKey ? { url: image.dataUrl, storageKey: image.storageKey, width: 1, height: 1, bytes: 0, mimeType: "image/png" } : await uploadImage(image.dataUrl);
            await ensureImagePreview(storedImage.storageKey);
            const meta = storedImage.width === 1 && storedImage.height === 1 ? await readImageMeta(storedImage.url) : storedImage;
            const config = fitNodeSize(meta.width, meta.height);
            const center = screenToCanvas((containerRef.current?.getBoundingClientRect().left || 0) + size.width / 2, (containerRef.current?.getBoundingClientRect().top || 0) + size.height / 2);
            const id = `image-${Date.now()}-${Math.random().toString(36).slice(2, 7)}`;
            const node: CanvasNodeData = {
                id,
                type: CanvasNodeType.Image,
                title: image.prompt.slice(0, 32) || "Generated Image",
                position: { x: center.x - config.width / 2, y: center.y - config.height / 2 },
                width: config.width,
                height: config.height,
                metadata: { ...imageMetadata({ ...storedImage, width: meta.width, height: meta.height }), prompt: image.prompt },
            };

            setNodes((prev) => [...prev, node]);
            setSelectedNodeIds(new Set([id]));
            setSelectedConnectionId(null);
            setDialogNodeId(id);
        },
        [screenToCanvas, size.height, size.width],
    );

    const insertAssistantText = useCallback(
        (text: string, title?: string) => {
            const center = screenToCanvas((containerRef.current?.getBoundingClientRect().left || 0) + size.width / 2, (containerRef.current?.getBoundingClientRect().top || 0) + size.height / 2);
            const node = {
                ...createCanvasNode(CanvasNodeType.Text, center, { content: text, status: NODE_STATUS_SUCCESS }),
                title: title || text.slice(0, 32) || "Assistant Text",
            };

            setNodes((prev) => [...prev, node]);
            setSelectedNodeIds(new Set([node.id]));
            setSelectedConnectionId(null);
        },
        [screenToCanvas, size.height, size.width],
    );

    const handleAssetInsert = useCallback(
        (payload: InsertAssetPayload) => {
            if (payload.kind === "text") {
                insertAssistantText(payload.content, payload.title);
            } else if (payload.kind === "audio") {
                const spec = NODE_DEFAULT_SIZE[CanvasNodeType.Audio];
                const center = screenToCanvas((containerRef.current?.getBoundingClientRect().left || 0) + size.width / 2, (containerRef.current?.getBoundingClientRect().top || 0) + size.height / 2);
                const id = `audio-${crypto.randomUUID()}`;
                setNodes(prev => [...prev, { id, type: CanvasNodeType.Audio, title: payload.title, position: { x: center.x - spec.width / 2, y: center.y - spec.height / 2 }, width: spec.width, height: spec.height, metadata: { content: payload.url, storageKey: payload.storageKey, status: NODE_STATUS_SUCCESS } }]);
                setSelectedNodeIds(new Set([id]));
            } else if (payload.kind === "video") {
                const spec = NODE_DEFAULT_SIZE[CanvasNodeType.Video];
                const center = screenToCanvas((containerRef.current?.getBoundingClientRect().left || 0) + size.width / 2, (containerRef.current?.getBoundingClientRect().top || 0) + size.height / 2);
                const id = `video-${Date.now()}-${Math.random().toString(36).slice(2, 7)}`;
                const nextSize = fitNodeSize(payload.width || spec.width, payload.height || spec.height, VIDEO_NODE_MAX_WIDTH, VIDEO_NODE_MAX_HEIGHT);
                setNodes((prev) => [
                    ...prev,
                    {
                        id,
                        type: CanvasNodeType.Video,
                        title: payload.title,
                        position: { x: center.x - nextSize.width / 2, y: center.y - nextSize.height / 2 },
                        width: nextSize.width,
                        height: nextSize.height,
                        metadata: { content: payload.url, storageKey: payload.storageKey, status: NODE_STATUS_SUCCESS, naturalWidth: payload.width, naturalHeight: payload.height },
                    },
                ]);
                setSelectedNodeIds(new Set([id]));
            } else {
                insertAssistantImage({ id: `asset-${Date.now()}`, prompt: payload.title, dataUrl: payload.dataUrl, storageKey: payload.storageKey });
            }
            setAssetPickerOpen(false);
        },
        [insertAssistantImage, insertAssistantText, screenToCanvas, size.height, size.width],
    );

    // Memoize every callback and render function passed to CanvasNode.
    // CanvasNode uses React.memo, but new prop references would invalidate it on every render and rerender every node
    // during click, hover, or viewport changes, which is especially expensive for Markdown. These useCallback values
    // and their memoized map/handler dependencies remain stable during interaction, so unchanged nodes do not rerender.
    const handleNodeHoverStart = useCallback((nodeId: string) => {
        if (nodeDraggingRef.current) return;
        setHoveredNodeId(nodeId);
    }, []);
    const handleNodeHoverEnd = useCallback((nodeId: string) => {
        setHoveredNodeId((current) => (current === nodeId ? null : current));
    }, []);
    const handleNodeViewImage = useCallback((node: CanvasNodeData, imageId?: string) => {
        setPreviewNodeId(node.id);
        setPreviewImageId(imageId || null);
    }, []);
    const handleNodeRetry = useCallback(
        (node: CanvasNodeData) => {
            if (node.type === CanvasNodeType.Text && (node.metadata?.textCount || 1) > 1) {
                void generateNodeRef.current?.(node.id, "text", node.metadata?.prompt || "");
                return;
            }
            void handleRetryNode(node);
        },
        [handleRetryNode],
    );
    const handleNodeContextMenu = useCallback((event: ReactMouseEvent, nodeId: string) => {
        event.preventDefault();
        event.stopPropagation();
        setSelectedNodeIds((current) => (current.has(nodeId) ? current : new Set([nodeId])));
        setSelectedConnectionId(null);
        setContextMenu({ type: "node", x: event.clientX, y: event.clientY, nodeId });
    }, []);

    const renderNodePanel = useCallback(
        (panelNode: CanvasNodeData) =>
            panelNode.type === CanvasNodeType.Config ? (
                <CanvasConfigComposer
                    nodeId={panelNode.id}
                    nodes={nodes}
                    value={panelNode.metadata?.composerContent ?? panelNode.metadata?.prompt ?? ""}
                    inputs={configInputsById.get(panelNode.id) || []}
                    connectedNodes={connectedNodesByNodeId.get(panelNode.id) || []}
                    onChange={(composerContent) => handleConfigNodeChange(panelNode.id, { composerContent })}
                    onClose={() => setDialogNodeId(null)}
                    onDisconnectReference={disconnectNodeReference}
                    onStartReferenceSelection={startNodeReferenceSelection}
                />
            ) : (
                <CanvasNodePromptPanel
                    node={panelNode}
                    nodes={nodes}
                    connections={connections}
                    isRunning={runningNodeId === panelNode.id}
                    mentionReferences={mentionReferencesByNodeId.get(panelNode.id) || EMPTY_REFERENCES}
                    connectedNodes={connectedNodesByNodeId.get(panelNode.id) || []}
                    onPromptChange={handleNodePromptChange}
                    onConfigChange={handleConfigNodeChange}
                    onGenerate={handleGenerateNode}
                    onStop={confirmStopGeneration}
                    onDisconnectReference={disconnectNodeReference}
                    onStartReferenceSelection={startNodeReferenceSelection}
                    modeOverride={getNodeDefinition(panelNode.type)?.useBuiltinPanel?.mode}
                    onImageSettingsOpenChange={(open) => {
                        setNodeImageSettingsOpen(open);
                        if (open) setToolbarNodeId(null);
                    }}
                />
            ),
        [configInputsById, confirmStopGeneration, connectedNodesByNodeId, connections, disconnectNodeReference, handleConfigNodeChange, handleGenerateNode, handleNodePromptChange, mentionReferencesByNodeId, nodes, runningNodeId, startNodeReferenceSelection],
    );

    const renderNodeContentPanel = useCallback(
        (contentNode: CanvasNodeData) => (
            <CanvasConfigNodePanel
                node={contentNode}
                nodes={nodes}
                connections={connections}
                isRunning={runningNodeId === contentNode.id}
                inputSummary={getInputSummary(configInputsById.get(contentNode.id) || [])}
                onConfigChange={handleConfigNodeChange}
                onComposerToggle={() => setDialogNodeId((current) => (current === contentNode.id ? null : contentNode.id))}
                onStop={confirmStopGeneration}
                onGenerate={(nodeId) => {
                    const target = nodesRef.current.find((item) => item.id === nodeId);
                    void handleGenerateNode(nodeId, target?.metadata?.generationMode || "image", target?.metadata?.composerContent ?? target?.metadata?.prompt ?? "");
                }}
            />
        ),
        [configInputsById, confirmStopGeneration, connections, handleConfigNodeChange, handleGenerateNode, nodes, runningNodeId],
    );

    const hoverPreviewNode = hoverPreviewNodeId ? nodeById.get(hoverPreviewNodeId) || null : null;
    const hoverPreviewMedia =
        hoverPreviewNode && (hoverPreviewNode.type === CanvasNodeType.Image || hoverPreviewNode.type === CanvasNodeType.Video) && hoverPreviewNode.metadata?.content
            ? {
                  video: hoverPreviewNode.type === CanvasNodeType.Video,
                  src: hoverPreviewNode.metadata.content,
                  width: hoverPreviewNode.metadata.naturalWidth || hoverPreviewNode.width,
                  height: hoverPreviewNode.metadata.naturalHeight || hoverPreviewNode.height,
              }
            : null;
    const showHoverPreview = Boolean(hoverPreviewMedia);
    const retainedPreviewRef = useRef<{ video: boolean; src: string; title: string; width: number; height: number } | null>(null);
    // Written during render on purpose: the overlay stays mounted while it fades out, so the last preview has to be
    // retained after the hovered node clears. Sizing reuses the measured container size instead of reading layout here.
    if (hoverPreviewMedia) {
        const previewSize = fitNodeSize(hoverPreviewMedia.width, hoverPreviewMedia.height, size.width * 0.9, size.height * 0.9);
        retainedPreviewRef.current = { video: hoverPreviewMedia.video, src: hoverPreviewMedia.src, title: hoverPreviewNode?.title || "", width: previewSize.width, height: previewSize.height };
    }
    const retainedPreview = retainedPreviewRef.current;

    async function prepareCreativeCanvas() {
        if (!isLoadedCanvasCurrent() || !authUserId) throw new Error("当前画布尚未准备好");
        const owner = authUserId, epoch = authSessionEpoch, id = projectId;
        const snapshot = { nodes: nodesRef.current, connections: connectionsRef.current, production: productionRef.current, directorScenes: directorScenesRef.current };
        updateProject(id, { ...snapshot, chatSessions, activeChatId, backgroundMode, showImageInfo });
        const remote = await prepareCanvasForTools(id);
        if (!isLoadedCanvasCurrent() || activeProjectIdRef.current !== id || !matchesCanvasSession(owner, epoch, useAuthStore.getState())) throw new Error("画布或账户已变化");
        if (snapshot.nodes !== nodesRef.current || snapshot.connections !== connectionsRef.current || snapshot.production !== productionRef.current || snapshot.directorScenes !== directorScenesRef.current) throw new Error("保存期间画布已有编辑，请保存后重新操作");
        const local = useCanvasStore.getState().projects.find(item => item.id === id)!;
        toolBaseRef.current = { projectId: id, owner, epoch, updatedAt: local.updatedAt, ...snapshot };
        return remote;
    }

    async function applyCreativeProject(remote: AgentProject) {
        const base = toolBaseRef.current;
        if (!isLoadedCanvasCurrent() || !base || remote.id !== projectId || activeProjectIdRef.current !== projectId || !matchesCanvasSession(base.owner, base.epoch, useAuthStore.getState())) throw new Error("操作所属画布或账户已变化");
        if (base.nodes !== nodesRef.current || base.connections !== connectionsRef.current || base.production !== productionRef.current || base.directorScenes !== directorScenesRef.current) throw new Error("执行期间已有编辑，结果保留在服务端，请先处理同步冲突");
        const local = await acceptCanvasToolProject(remote as ToolCloudProject, base.updatedAt);
        if (!isLoadedCanvasCurrent() || activeProjectIdRef.current !== projectId || !matchesCanvasSession(base.owner, base.epoch, useAuthStore.getState())) return;
        if (toolBaseRef.current !== base || base.nodes !== nodesRef.current || base.connections !== connectionsRef.current || base.production !== productionRef.current || base.directorScenes !== directorScenesRef.current) throw new Error("同步期间已有编辑，当前草稿已保留，请处理同步冲突后再采用");
        nodesRef.current = local.nodes; connectionsRef.current = local.connections; productionRef.current = local.production;
        directorScenesRef.current = local.directorScenes || [];
        setNodes(local.nodes); setConnections(local.connections); setProduction(local.production);
        setDirectorScenes(directorScenesRef.current);
        setChatSessions(local.chatSessions || []); setActiveChatId(local.activeChatId || null);
        setBackgroundMode(local.backgroundMode); setShowImageInfo(local.showImageInfo || false);
        toolBaseRef.current = { ...base, updatedAt: local.updatedAt, nodes: local.nodes, connections: local.connections, production: local.production, directorScenes: directorScenesRef.current };
    }

    function changeProduction(next: ProductionDocument) {
        if (!isLoadedCanvasCurrent()) return;
        const synced = syncProductionBindings(next, productionRef.current, nodesRef.current, nanoid);
        nodesRef.current = synced.nodes;
        productionRef.current = synced.production;
        setNodes(synced.nodes);
        setProduction(synced.production);
        updateProject(projectId, { nodes: synced.nodes, production: synced.production });
    }

    async function openUpscale(nodeId: string) {
        try {
            await prepareCreativeCanvas();
            if (isLoadedCanvasCurrent() && nodesRef.current.some(node => node.id === nodeId)) setSuperResolveNodeId(nodeId);
        } catch (error) { if (isLoadedCanvasCurrent()) message.error(friendlyErrorMessage(error instanceof Error ? error.message : String(error))); }
    }

    function openCreativeTool(handoff: NonNullable<typeof toolHandoff>) {
        if (!isLoadedCanvasCurrent() || handoff.projectId !== projectId || !nodesRef.current.some(node => node.id === handoff.nodeId)) { message.error("工具所属画布或素材已变化，请重新准备"); return; }
        setToolHandoff(handoff);
        setSelectedNodeIds(new Set([handoff.nodeId]));
        if (handoff.tool === 'upscale') { void openUpscale(handoff.nodeId); }
        else setCreativePanel('character');
    }

    function addCreativeMedia(runId: string, media: CharacterMedia[], sourceId?: string) {
        if (!isLoadedCanvasCurrent()) return;
        const source = sourceId ? nodesRef.current.find(node => node.id === sourceId) : undefined;
        const added: CanvasNodeData[] = [];
        for (const result of media) {
            if (!result.key || nodesRef.current.some(node => node.metadata?.creativeRunId === runId && node.metadata?.creativeSourceKey === result.key)) continue;
            const type = result.kind === "video" ? CanvasNodeType.Video : CanvasNodeType.Image;
            const size = fitNodeSize(result.width || 512, result.height || 512);
            added.push({ id: nanoid(), type, title: `${source?.title || "创作"} · 处理结果`, width: size.width, height: size.height,
                position: { x: (source?.position.x || 0) + (source?.width || 0) + 80, y: (source?.position.y || 0) + added.length * (size.height + 32) },
                metadata: { content: result.url || `/media/${result.key.split("/").map(encodeURIComponent).join("/")}`, status: "success", naturalWidth: result.width, naturalHeight: result.height, bytes: result.bytes, mimeType: result.mime, durationMs: result.duration === undefined ? undefined : result.duration * 1000, creativeRunId: runId, creativeSourceKey: result.key } });
        }
        if (!added.length) { message.info("结果已在当前画布中"); return; }
        nodesRef.current = [...nodesRef.current, ...added]; setNodes(nodesRef.current);
        if (source) { connectionsRef.current = [...connectionsRef.current, ...added.map(node => ({ id: nanoid(), fromNodeId: source.id, toNodeId: node.id }))]; setConnections(connectionsRef.current); }
        setSelectedNodeIds(new Set(added.map(node => node.id)));
        message.success(`已添加 ${added.length} 个处理结果到画布`);
    }

    function addUpscaleResult(run: UpscaleRun) {
        if (!run.resultUrl || !run.result) return;
        const resultUrl = new URL(run.resultUrl, window.location.origin);
        if (resultUrl.origin !== window.location.origin || !resultUrl.pathname.startsWith("/media/")) { message.error("结果尚未归档，请恢复原任务"); return; }
        addCreativeMedia(run.id, [{ key: decodeURIComponent(resultUrl.pathname.slice(7)), kind: run.purpose === "video_upscale" ? "video" : "image", url: run.resultUrl, ...run.result }], run.sourceNodeId);
    }

    async function upscaleProductionCandidate(runId: string, media: ProductionMedia) {
        if (!isLoadedCanvasCurrent() || !['image', 'video'].includes(media.kind)) return;
        const resultUrl = new URL(media.url || `/media/${media.storageKey}`, window.location.origin);
        if (resultUrl.origin !== window.location.origin || !resultUrl.pathname.startsWith('/media/private/')) throw new Error('候选尚未归档到当前账户');
        const key = decodeURIComponent(resultUrl.pathname.slice(7));
        let node = nodesRef.current.find(item => item.metadata?.creativeRunId === runId && item.metadata?.creativeSourceKey === key);
        if (!node) {
            addCreativeMedia(runId, [{ key, kind: media.kind as 'image' | 'video', url: resultUrl.pathname, ...(media.durationMs ? { duration: media.durationMs / 1000 } : {}) }]);
            node = nodesRef.current.find(item => item.metadata?.creativeRunId === runId && item.metadata?.creativeSourceKey === key);
        }
        if (!node) return;
        setToolHandoff(undefined);
        setSelectedNodeIds(new Set([node.id]));
        await openUpscale(node.id);
    }

    /* ---------------- 导演台（3D 场景搭建，迁移自 BeefTV） ---------------- */
    const activeDirectorScene = directorScenes[0] || null;

    const changeDirectorScenes = useCallback((next: DirectorScene[]) => {
        if (!isLoadedCanvasCurrent() || activeProjectIdRef.current !== projectId || !matchesCanvasSession(authUserId, authSessionEpoch, useAuthStore.getState())) throw new Error("导演台所属画布或账户已变化");
        directorScenesRef.current = next;
        setDirectorScenes(next);
        updateProject(projectId, { directorScenes: next });
    }, [projectId, authUserId, authSessionEpoch, updateProject]);

    const openDirector = useCallback(() => {
        // 首次进入自动建一条空场景，之后沿用项目里已存的那条。
        changeDirectorScenes(directorScenesRef.current.length ? directorScenesRef.current : [createDirectorSceneFromTemplate("empty", t("canvas.director.defaultScene"))]);
        setDirectorOpen(true);
    }, [changeDirectorScenes, t]);

    const saveDirectorScene = useCallback((scene: DirectorScene) => {
        const current = directorScenesRef.current;
        changeDirectorScenes(current.some((item) => item.id === scene.id) ? current.map((item) => (item.id === scene.id ? scene : item)) : [...current, scene]);
    }, [changeDirectorScenes]);

    /** 导演台上传的参考图：直接落成一张画布图片节点。 */
    const addDirectorCanvasImage = useCallback(
        async (image: Awaited<ReturnType<typeof uploadImage>>, title: string, signal: AbortSignal) => {
            if (signal.aborted || !isLoadedCanvasCurrent() || activeProjectIdRef.current !== projectId || !matchesCanvasSession(authUserId, authSessionEpoch, useAuthStore.getState())) throw new Error("导演台所属画布或账户已变化");
            const node = createCanvasNode(CanvasNodeType.Image, getCanvasCenter(), imageMetadata(image));
            node.title = title;
            nodesRef.current = [...nodesRef.current, node];
            setNodes(nodesRef.current);
            updateProject(projectId, { nodes: nodesRef.current });
            await prepareCanvasForTools(projectId);
            return { persisted: true };
        },
        [getCanvasCenter, projectId, authUserId, authSessionEpoch, updateProject],
    );

    const adoptDirectorRender = useCallback<AdoptDirectorRender>(async (task, output, target = 'canvas') => {
        const current = () => isLoadedCanvasCurrent() && activeProjectIdRef.current === projectId && matchesCanvasSession(authUserId, authSessionEpoch, useAuthStore.getState());
        if (!current()) throw new Error("导演台所属画布或账户已变化");
        if (task.status !== "completed" || !task.receipt?.outputs.some(item => item.objectKey === output.objectKey) || !task.receipt.fps) throw new Error("该任务尚无可采用的完整回执");
        if (target === 'production') {
            const project = await prepareCreativeCanvas();
            const api = canvasProductionApi(projectId);
            const preview = await api.directorMapping(task.id);
            if (!current()) throw new Error("导演台所属画布或账户已变化");
            const clientRequestId = crypto.randomUUID();
            await new Promise<void>(resolve => modal.confirm({
                title: '按切点采用到制作镜头',
                content: <div><p>采用来源版本 v{preview.sourceVersion} 的参考视频。已有对应镜头将更新素材和裁剪范围，保留名称及排序；其他镜头不变。</p><ul>{preview.mapping.map(cut => <li key={cut.shotId}>{cut.title}：{(cut.inMs / 1000).toFixed(3)}–{(cut.outMs / 1000).toFixed(3)} 秒</li>)}</ul></div>,
                okText: '确认采用', cancelText: '取消', onCancel: () => resolve(),
                onOk: async () => {
                    if (!current()) throw new Error("导演台所属画布或账户已变化");
                    const latest = await prepareCreativeCanvas();
                    if (latest.version !== project.version) throw new Error('画布已变化，请关闭后重新查看映射');
                    const result = await api.adoptDirector({ clientRequestId, expectedVersion: project.version, command: { type: 'director-adopt', renderRequestId: task.id } });
                    await applyCreativeProject(result.project);
                    message.success('已按切点采用到制作镜头'); resolve();
                },
            }));
            return;
        }
        await prepareCanvasForTools(projectId);
        if (!current()) throw new Error("导演台所属画布或账户已变化");
        const nodeId = `director-render-${task.id}-${output.frame ?? "video"}`;
        if (!nodesRef.current.some(node => node.id === nodeId)) {
            const video = task.parameters.kind === "video";
            const node = createCanvasNode(video ? CanvasNodeType.Video : CanvasNodeType.Image, getCanvasCenter(), {
                content: output.url, storageKey: output.objectKey, status: "success",
                naturalWidth: output.width, naturalHeight: output.height, mimeType: output.mime,
                bytes: Number(output.bytes), durationMs: output.duration === undefined ? undefined : output.duration * 1000,
                directorSceneId: task.sceneId, directorRenderRequestId: task.id, directorProjectVersion: task.projectVersion,
                directorOutputTarget: { kind: "sequence", sceneId: task.sceneId, sequenceId: task.parameters.sequenceId,
                    startFrame: output.frame ?? task.parameters.startFrame,
                    endFrame: output.frame === undefined ? task.parameters.endFrame : output.frame + 1,
                    fps: task.receipt.fps, fixedCameraId: task.parameters.fixedCameraId },
                workflowKind: video ? "reference_video" : "shot",
            });
            node.id = nodeId;
            node.title = uniqueNodeTitle(nodesRef.current, video ? "导演预演参考视频" : `导演参考 · 第 ${output.frame} 帧`);
            Object.assign(node, fitNodeSize(output.width, output.height));
            nodesRef.current = [...nodesRef.current, node];
            setNodes(nodesRef.current);
            updateProject(projectId, { nodes: nodesRef.current });
        }
        setSelectedNodeIds(new Set([nodeId]));
        setSelectedConnectionId(null);
        await prepareCanvasForTools(projectId);
        if (!current()) throw new Error("导演台所属画布或账户已变化");
        message.success("参考结果已加入画布");
    }, [projectId, authUserId, authSessionEpoch, getCanvasCenter, updateProject, message, modal]);

    /** 「应用到镜头」：把截图（以及可选的白膜视频）回写成画布节点。 */
    const applyDirectorOutput = useCallback(
        async (output: DirectorSceneOutput) => {
            const current = () => isLoadedCanvasCurrent() && activeProjectIdRef.current === projectId && matchesCanvasSession(authUserId, authSessionEpoch, useAuthStore.getState());
            if (!current()) throw new Error("导演台所属画布或账户已变化");
            // 同一个镜头可能多次回写，重名时把序号往后推，画布上能看出先后。
            const title = uniqueNodeTitle(nodesRef.current, output.shot?.name || output.scene.cameraSequence?.name || t("canvas.director.defaultScene"));
            const uploaded = await uploadImage(output.beauty);
            if (!current()) throw new Error("导演台所属画布或账户已变化");
            const center = getCanvasCenter();
            const imageNode = createCanvasNode(CanvasNodeType.Image, center, imageMetadata(uploaded));
            imageNode.title = title;
            imageNode.metadata = {
                ...imageNode.metadata,
                prompt: output.prompt,
                directorSceneId: output.scene.id,
                directorShotId: output.shot?.id,
                directorOutputTarget: output.target,
                workflowKind: "shot",
            };
            const additions = [imageNode];
            if (output.clayVideo) {
                const video = await uploadMediaFile(output.clayVideo, "director-clay");
                if (!current()) throw new Error("导演台所属画布或账户已变化");
                const videoNode = createCanvasNode(CanvasNodeType.Video, { x: center.x + imageNode.width + 80, y: center.y }, videoMetadata(video));
                videoNode.title = `${title} · 白膜`;
                videoNode.metadata = {
                    ...videoNode.metadata,
                    directorSceneId: output.scene.id,
                    directorShotId: output.shot?.id,
                    directorOutputTarget: output.target,
                    workflowKind: "reference_video",
                    assetTags: ["导演台白膜"],
                };
                additions.push(videoNode);
            }
            nodesRef.current = [...nodesRef.current, ...additions];
            setNodes(nodesRef.current);
            updateProject(projectId, { nodes: nodesRef.current });
            setSelectedNodeIds(new Set(additions.map((node) => node.id)));
            setSelectedConnectionId(null);
            await prepareCanvasForTools(projectId);
            if (!current()) throw new Error("导演台所属画布或账户已变化");
            message.success(t("canvas.director.applied"));
        },
        [getCanvasCenter, message, t, projectId, authUserId, authSessionEpoch, updateProject],
    );

    /** 一句话分镜：把脚本 + 每个镜头的提示词铺成画布节点，用户改完再逐个生成。 */
    const applyStoryboard = useCallback(
        (payload: StoryboardApplyPayload) => {
            if (!isLoadedCanvasCurrent() || activeProjectIdRef.current !== projectId || !matchesCanvasSession(authUserId, authSessionEpoch, useAuthStore.getState())) return;
            const center = getCanvasCenter();
            const scriptNode = createCanvasNode(CanvasNodeType.Text, center, { content: payload.scriptText, status: "success", fontSize: 13 });
            scriptNode.title = t("canvas.storyboard.scriptTitle", { title: payload.title });
            scriptNode.width = 380;
            scriptNode.height = 440;

            const imageSpec = getNodeSpec(CanvasNodeType.Image);
            const videoSpec = getNodeSpec(CanvasNodeType.Video);
            const columns = payload.shots.length > 4 ? 3 : 2;
            const rows = Math.ceil(payload.shots.length / columns);
            const gapX = 56;
            const gapY = 168;
            const scriptGap = 120;
            // 整块（脚本 + 分镜网格）居中落在当前视口中心，避免镜头铺到视野外。
            const gridWidth = columns * imageSpec.width + (columns - 1) * gapX;
            const blockWidth = scriptNode.width + scriptGap + gridWidth;
            const blockHeight = Math.max(scriptNode.height, rows * imageSpec.height + (rows - 1) * gapY);
            const startX = center.x - blockWidth / 2 + scriptNode.width + scriptGap;
            const startY = center.y - blockHeight / 2;
            scriptNode.position = { x: center.x - blockWidth / 2, y: startY };

            const created: CanvasNodeData[] = [scriptNode];
            const nextConnections: CanvasConnection[] = [];

            payload.shots.forEach((shot, index) => {
                const column = index % columns;
                const row = Math.floor(index / columns);
                const shotTitle = uniqueNodeTitle([...nodesRef.current, ...created], t("canvas.storyboard.shotTitle", { index: shot.index, duration: shot.duration }));

                const imageNode = createCanvasNode(CanvasNodeType.Image, center, { prompt: shot.prompt, status: "idle", workflowKind: "shot", shotIndex: shot.index });
                imageNode.title = shotTitle;
                imageNode.position = { x: startX + column * (imageSpec.width + gapX), y: startY + row * (imageSpec.height + gapY) };
                created.push(imageNode);
                nextConnections.push({ id: nanoid(), fromNodeId: scriptNode.id, toNodeId: imageNode.id });

                if (!payload.createVideoNodes) return;
                const videoNode = createCanvasNode(CanvasNodeType.Video, center, { prompt: shot.videoPrompt, status: "idle", workflowKind: "shot_video", shotIndex: shot.index });
                videoNode.title = `${shotTitle}${t("canvas.storyboard.videoSuffix")}`;
                videoNode.position = {
                    x: imageNode.position.x + (imageSpec.width - videoSpec.width) / 2,
                    y: imageNode.position.y + imageSpec.height + 44,
                };
                created.push(videoNode);
                nextConnections.push({ id: nanoid(), fromNodeId: imageNode.id, toNodeId: videoNode.id });
            });

            setNodes((current) => [...current, ...created]);
            setConnections((current) => [...current, ...nextConnections]);
            setSelectedNodeIds(new Set(created.map((node) => node.id)));
            setSelectedConnectionId(null);

            // 铺完把视口缩放到刚好容纳整块分镜，用户不用自己再缩放找镜头。
            const minX = Math.min(...created.map((node) => node.position.x));
            const minY = Math.min(...created.map((node) => node.position.y));
            const maxX = Math.max(...created.map((node) => node.position.x + node.width));
            const maxY = Math.max(...created.map((node) => node.position.y + node.height));
            const topInset = 88;
            const bottomInset = 104;
            const usableWidth = Math.max(160, size.width - 96);
            const usableHeight = Math.max(160, size.height - topInset - bottomInset);
            const k = Math.min(Math.max(Math.min(usableWidth / Math.max(1, maxX - minX), usableHeight / Math.max(1, maxY - minY)), 0.05), 1);
            setViewport({
                x: (size.width - (maxX - minX) * k) / 2 - minX * k,
                y: topInset + (usableHeight - (maxY - minY) * k) / 2 - minY * k,
                k,
            });

            message.success(t("canvas.storyboard.applied", { count: payload.shots.length }));
        },
        [getCanvasCenter, message, size.height, size.width, t, projectId, authUserId, authSessionEpoch],
    );

    if (!authReady || !projectLoaded || loadedProjectIdRef.current !== projectId || loadedAuthUserIdRef.current !== authUserId || !isCanvasAccountActive(authUserId)) return <CanvasRefreshShell />;

    return (
        <main className="flex h-full min-h-0 overflow-hidden" style={{ background: theme.canvas.background, color: theme.node.text }}>
            <CanvasSidePanel nodes={nodes} selectedNodeIds={selectedNodeIds} onFocusNode={focusNode} onPreviewNode={setPreviewNodeId} onHoverNode={setHoverPreviewNodeId} onInsertAsset={handleAssetInsert} />
            <section className="relative min-w-0 flex-1 overflow-hidden">
                <CanvasTopBar
                    title={currentProject?.title || t("canvas.projectPage.untitledCanvas")}
                    titleDraft={titleDraft}
                    isTitleEditing={titleEditing}
                    onTitleDraftChange={setTitleDraft}
                    onStartTitleEditing={startTitleEditing}
                    onFinishTitleEditing={finishTitleEditing}
                    onCancelTitleEditing={() => setTitleEditing(false)}
                    canUndo={historyState.canUndo}
                    canRedo={historyState.canRedo}
                    onHome={() => navigate("/")}
                    onBack={() => navigate("/canvas")}
                    onProjects={() => navigate("/canvas")}
                    onCreateProject={createAndOpenProject}
                    onDeleteProject={deleteCurrentProject}
                    onExportProject={exportCurrentProject}
                    onImportImage={() => handleUploadRequest()}
                    onUndo={undoCanvas}
                    onRedo={redoCanvas}
                    onOpenProduction={() => setCreativePanel("production")}
                    onOpenAgent={() => setCreativePanel("agent")}
                    onOpenCharacter={() => { setToolHandoff(undefined); setCreativePanel("character"); }}
                    onOpenUpscale={() => {
                        setToolHandoff(undefined);
                        const source = nodesRef.current.find(node => selectedNodeIdsRef.current.has(node.id) && (node.type === CanvasNodeType.Image || node.type === CanvasNodeType.Video) && node.metadata?.content);
                        if (source) void openUpscale(source.id);
                        else message.info("请先选择有素材的图片或视频节点");
                    }}
                />

                <InfiniteCanvas
                    containerRef={containerRef}
                    viewport={viewport}
                    tool={canvasTool}
                    backgroundMode={backgroundMode}
                    onViewportChange={(next) => {
                        setViewport(next);
                        setContextMenu(null);
                    }}
                    onCanvasMouseDown={(event) => {
                        if (!referencePickerNodeId) handleCanvasMouseDown(event);
                    }}
                    onCanvasDeselect={referencePickerNodeId ? undefined : deselectCanvas}
                    onCanvasDoubleClick={(event) => {
                        if (referencePickerNodeId) return;
                        setContextMenu(null);
                        setNodeCreateMenu({ world: screenToCanvas(event.clientX, event.clientY), anchor: { x: event.clientX, y: event.clientY } });
                    }}
                    onContextMenu={handleCanvasContextMenu}
                    onDrop={handleDrop}
                >
                    <svg className="absolute left-0 top-0 h-[10000px] w-[10000px] overflow-visible" style={{ pointerEvents: "none", transform: "translateZ(0)", zIndex: 0 }}>
                        {visibleConnections.map(({ connection, from, to }) => (
                            <ConnectionPath
                                key={connection.id}
                                connection={connection}
                                from={from}
                                to={to}
                                active={selectedConnectionId === connection.id || relatedHighlight.connectionIds.has(connection.id)}
                                onSelect={() => {
                                    setSelectedConnectionId(connection.id);
                                    setSelectedNodeIds(new Set());
                                    setContextMenu(null);
                                }}
                                onContextMenu={(event) => {
                                    setSelectedConnectionId(connection.id);
                                    setSelectedNodeIds(new Set());
                                    setContextMenu({ type: "connection", x: event.clientX, y: event.clientY, connectionId: connection.id });
                                }}
                            />
                        ))}
                        {connectingParams ? <ActiveConnectionPath node={nodeById.get(connectingParams.nodeId)} handle={connectingParams} mouseWorld={mouseWorld} target={connectionTargetNodeId ? nodeById.get(connectionTargetNodeId) : undefined} /> : null}
                    </svg>

                    {visibleNodes.map((node) => (
                        <CanvasNode
                            key={node.id}
                            data={node}
                            scale={viewport.k}
                            isSelected={selectedNodeIds.has(node.id)}
                            isRelated={relatedHighlight.nodeIds.has(node.id)}
                            isFocusRelated={activeNodeId === node.id}
                            isConnectionTarget={connectionTargetNodeId === node.id}
                            isConnecting={Boolean(connectingParams)}
                            referenceSelectionState={!referencePickerNodeId ? undefined : node.id === referencePickerNodeId ? "target" : referenceConnectedNodeIds.has(node.id) || !isCanvasReferenceNode(node, nodes) ? "disabled" : "available"}
                            showPanel={!isNodeResizing && dialogNodeId === node.id && !selectionBox && !getNodeDefinition(node.type)?.hidePanel}
                            groupChildCount={groupChildCountById.get(node.id) || 0}
                            isGroupDropTarget={dropTargetGroupId === node.id}
                            batchExpanded={expandedBatchNodeIds.has(node.id)}
                            showImageInfo={showImageInfo}
                            mentionReferences={mentionReferencesByNodeId.get(node.id) || EMPTY_REFERENCES}
                            registryVersion={nodeRegistryVersion}
                            renderPanel={renderNodePanel}
                            renderNodeContent={renderNodeContentPanel}
                            onMouseDown={handleNodeMouseDown}
                            onSelectCapture={handleNodeSelectCapture}
                            onHoverStart={handleNodeHoverStart}
                            onHoverEnd={handleNodeHoverEnd}
                            onConnectStart={handleConnectStart}
                            onResizeStart={handleNodeResizeStart}
                            onResize={handleNodeResize}
                            onResizeEnd={handleNodeResizeEnd}
                            onContentChange={handleNodeContentChange}
                            onTitleChange={handleNodeTitleChange}
                            onToggleBatch={toggleBatchExpanded}
                            onSetBatchPrimary={setBatchPrimary}
                            onDuplicateBatchImage={duplicateBatchImage}
                            onDownloadBatchImage={downloadBatchImage}
                            onRetryBatchImage={retryBatchImage}
                            onDeleteBatchImage={deleteBatchImage}
                            onRetry={handleNodeRetry}
                            onViewImage={handleNodeViewImage}
                            onSelectReference={selectNodeReference}
                            onContextMenu={handleNodeContextMenu}
                        />
                    ))}

                    {selectionBox ? (
                        <svg
                            className="pointer-events-none absolute z-[100] overflow-visible"
                            style={{
                                left: Math.min(selectionBox.startWorldX, selectionBox.currentWorldX),
                                top: Math.min(selectionBox.startWorldY, selectionBox.currentWorldY),
                                width: Math.abs(selectionBox.currentWorldX - selectionBox.startWorldX),
                                height: Math.abs(selectionBox.currentWorldY - selectionBox.startWorldY),
                            }}
                        >
                            <rect width="100%" height="100%" fill={theme.canvas.selectionFill} stroke={theme.canvas.selectionStroke} strokeOpacity={0.55} strokeWidth={1 / viewport.k} strokeDasharray={`${6 / viewport.k} ${4 / viewport.k}`} />
                        </svg>
                    ) : null}
                    {pendingConnectionCreate ? <ConnectionCreateMenu pending={pendingConnectionCreate} onCreate={(type) => createConnectedNode(type, pendingConnectionCreate)} onClose={cancelPendingConnectionCreate} /> : null}
                    {nodeCreateMenu ? (
                        <NodeCreateMenu
                            anchor={nodeCreateMenu.anchor}
                            onCreate={(type) => {
                                createNode(type, nodeCreateMenu.world);
                                setNodeCreateMenu(null);
                            }}
                            onClose={() => setNodeCreateMenu(null)}
                        />
                    ) : null}
                </InfiniteCanvas>

                {/* 迁移自 BeefTV：空画布给出「双击即添加」的入口提示，避免一进来只有一片点阵。 */}
                {!nodes.length ? (
                    <div className="pointer-events-none absolute inset-0 z-10 grid place-items-center pb-16">
                        <div className="flex flex-col items-center gap-1.5 text-center" style={{ color: theme.node.muted }}>
                            <MousePointerClick className="size-5 opacity-70" />
                            <p className="text-[12.5px] font-medium" style={{ color: theme.node.text, opacity: 0.86 }}>
                                {t("canvas.emptyHint.title")}
                            </p>
                            <p className="text-[11px] opacity-70">{t("canvas.emptyHint.description")}</p>
                        </div>
                    </div>
                ) : null}

                {referencePickerNodeId ? <button type="button" className="absolute left-1/2 top-4 z-[90] -translate-x-1/2 rounded-full border px-4 py-2 text-sm font-medium shadow-lg backdrop-blur" style={{ background: theme.toolbar.panel, borderColor: theme.toolbar.border }} onClick={exitNodeReferenceSelection}>{t("canvas.references.selectingHint")}</button> : null}

                <div
                    className="pointer-events-none absolute inset-0 z-[80] flex items-center justify-center transition-opacity duration-200 ease-out"
                    style={{ background: `color-mix(in srgb, ${theme.canvas.background} 76%, transparent)`, opacity: showHoverPreview ? 1 : 0 }}
                >
                    <div

"composition" : "script"} focusShotId={creativePanel === "production-export" ? undefined : production?.shots.find(shot => shot.nodeId === singleSelectedNodeId)?.shotId} prepareCanvas={prepareCreativeCanvas} applyProject={applyCreativeProject} onChangeProduction={changeProduction} onLocateNode={focusNode} onUpscaleCandidate={upscaleProductionCandidate} onClose={() => setCreativePanel(null)} />}

import type { AiTextMessage } from "@/services/api/image";
import type { CreationThread } from "./chat-store";
import type { CreationContextRecord } from "@/components/creation/creation-context";
type ContextImage = NonNullable<CreationContextRecord["images"]>[number];
export function latestThreadImage(thread?: CreationThread) {
    const record = [...(thread?.records ?? [])].reverse().find(item => item.images?.length || item.references?.length);
    return { record, image: record?.images?.at(-1) ?? record?.references?.at(-1) };
}
export async function buildCreationChatInput(thread: CreationThread, readImage: (image: ContextImage) => Promise<string>): Promise<AiTextMessage[]> {
    const input: AiTextMessage[] = [{ role: "system", content: "你是创作顾问。用中文与用户交流。只根据本次对话的内容回答。收到的图片是本次会话最近一张图片，可分析构图、光线、角色和细节并提出具体建议。历史文字描述不代表你看到了历史图片。你只提供建议，不执行生成。" }];
    for (const record of thread.records) input.push({ role: "user", content: `本次创作：${record.prompt}\n模型：${record.model}；状态：${record.status}\n生成参数：${JSON.stringify(record.config ?? {})}${record.video ? `\n视频链接：${record.video.url}（未读取视频画面）` : ""}` });
    const { record, image } = latestThreadImage(thread);
    if (image) input.push({ role: "user", content: [{ type: "text", text: `本次会话最近一张图片，对应描述：${record?.prompt ?? ""}` }, { type: "image_url", image_url: { url: await readImage(image) } }] });
    for (const item of thread.messages) if (item.text) input.push({ role: item.role, content: item.text });
    return input;
}

import { clearCreationDrafts } from "@/components/creation/creation-drafts";
import { create } from "zustand";
import { lazyStore } from "@/lib/localforage-store";
import type { CreationContextRecord } from "@/components/creation/creation-context";

export type ChatEntry = { id: string; role: "user" | "assistant"; text: string; error?: string; complete?: boolean };
export type CreationThread = { contextCleared?: boolean; id: string; title: string; createdAt: number; updatedAt: number; messages: ChatEntry[]; draft: string; records: CreationContextRecord[] };
type Saved = { threads: CreationThread[]; activeId: string };
const cache = lazyStore("creation_conversations");
export const useCreationChat = create<Saved & { owner: string; ready: boolean; error: string }>(() => ({ owner: "", ready: false, error: "", threads: [], activeId: "" }));
let loading: Promise<void> | undefined;
let writes = Promise.resolve();
function persist() {
    const { owner, threads, activeId } = useCreationChat.getState();
    if (!owner) return;
    const snapshot = structuredClone({ threads, activeId });
    writes = writes.then(() => cache.setItem(owner, snapshot)).then(() => undefined).catch(() => {
        if (useCreationChat.getState().owner === owner) useCreationChat.setState({ error: "浏览器保存失败，请检查可用存储空间；当前内容仍保留在页面中。" });
    });
}
export async function loadCreationChats(owner: string) {
    const state = useCreationChat.getState();
    if (state.owner === owner) { if (!state.ready) await loading; return; }
    useCreationChat.setState({ owner, ready: false, error: "", threads: [], activeId: "" });
    loading = (async () => {
        try {
            await writes;
            const saved = await cache.getItem<Saved>(owner);
            if (useCreationChat.getState().owner !== owner) return;
            const threads = (saved?.threads ?? []).map(thread => ({ ...thread, messages: thread.messages.map(item => item.role === "assistant" && !item.complete && !item.error ? { ...item, error: "上次回复已中断，可继续提问。" } : item) }));
            useCreationChat.setState({ threads, activeId: saved?.activeId ?? "", ready: true });
        } catch { if (useCreationChat.getState().owner === owner) useCreationChat.setState({ ready: true, error: "浏览器聊天记录读取失败，请刷新重试。" }); }
    })();
    await loading;
}
export function newCreationThread(owner: string, clearContext = true) {
    if (useCreationChat.getState().owner !== owner || !useCreationChat.getState().ready) return "";
    if (clearContext) clearCreationDrafts();
    const id = crypto.randomUUID(), now = Date.now();
    useCreationChat.setState(state => ({ activeId: id, threads: [...state.threads, { id, contextCleared: clearContext, title: "新对话", createdAt: now, updatedAt: now, messages: [], draft: "", records: [] }] }));
    persist(); return id;
}
export async function ensureCreationThread(owner: string) {
    await loadCreationChats(owner);
    const state = useCreationChat.getState();
    if (state.owner !== owner) throw new Error("账户已变化");
    return state.threads.some(t => t.id === state.activeId) ? state.activeId : newCreationThread(owner, false);
}
export function openCreationThread(owner: string, id: string) {
    const state = useCreationChat.getState();
    if (state.owner !== owner || !state.threads.some(t => t.id === id)) return false;
    useCreationChat.setState({ activeId: id }); persist(); return true;
}
export function patchCreationThread(owner: string, id: string, patch: Partial<CreationThread>, save = true) {
    if (useCreationChat.getState().owner !== owner) return;
    useCreationChat.setState(state => ({ threads: state.threads.map(t => t.id === id ? { ...t, ...patch, updatedAt: Date.now() } : t) }));
    if (save) persist();
}
export function saveCreationRecord(owner: string, record: CreationContextRecord, threadId?: string) {
    const state = useCreationChat.getState();
    if (state.owner !== owner) return;
    const thread = state.threads.find(t => t.records.some(r => r.id === record.id)) ?? state.threads.find(t => t.id === threadId);
    if (!thread) return;
    const imageRef = (image: NonNullable<CreationContextRecord["images"]>[number]) => image.storageKey ? { ...image, dataUrl: "", url: "" } : image;
    const storedRecord = { ...record, images: record.images?.map(imageRef), references: record.references?.map(imageRef) };
    const records = [...thread.records.filter(r => r.id !== record.id), storedRecord].sort((a,b) => a.createdAt-b.createdAt);
    patchCreationThread(owner, thread.id, { records, contextCleared: false, ...(thread.title === "新对话" ? { title: record.prompt.slice(0, 40) || "创作对话" } : {}) });
}

export async function handoffCreationToChat(owner: string, record?: CreationContextRecord) {
    await loadCreationChats(owner);
    const state = useCreationChat.getState();
    if (state.owner !== owner) throw new Error("账户已变化");
    const existing = record && state.threads.find(t => t.records.some(r => r.id === record.id));
    const id = existing?.id ?? await ensureCreationThread(owner);
    if (record) saveCreationRecord(owner, record, id);
    openCreationThread(owner, id);
    return id;
}

import { buildCreationChatInput, latestThreadImage } from "./chat-context";
import { useEffect, useRef, useState } from "react";
import { Input } from "antd";
import { MessageSquare, Plus, Send, Square } from "lucide-react";
import { ChatComposer } from "@astryxdesign/core/Chat";
import { Button } from "@astryxdesign/core/Button";
import { CreationStream } from "@/components/creation/creation-stream";

export default function ChatPage() {
    const user = useAuthStore(state => state.user);
    const epoch = useAuthStore(state => state.sessionEpoch);
    const session = `${user?.id}:${epoch}`;
    const [params, setParams] = useSearchParams();
    const config = useEffectiveConfig();
    const updateConfig = useConfigStore(state => state.updateConfig);
    const models = useConfigStore(state => state.serverModels);
    const state = useCreationChat();
    const thread = state.owner === user?.id ? state.threads.find(t => t.id === state.activeId) : undefined;
    const messages = thread?.messages ?? [];
    const draft = thread?.draft ?? "";
    const [vision, setVision] = useState<{ enabled: boolean; modelId: string }>();
    const [loadError, setLoadError] = useState("");
    const { image: latestImage } = latestThreadImage(thread);
    const [imagePreview, setImagePreview] = useState("");
    const [imagePreviewError, setImagePreviewError] = useState("");
    const [busy, setBusy] = useState(false);
    const controller = useRef<AbortController | null>(null);
    const end = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
    const model = latestImage ? (vision?.enabled && vision.modelId ? `server::${vision.modelId}` : "") : config.textModel;
    const modelReady = models.some(item => item.id === modelOptionName(model) && item.capability === "text");
    const quote = useCreditEstimate(modelReady ? modelOptionName(model) : "", "text", 1, "", session);
    const current = () => useAuthStore.getState().user?.id === user?.id && useAuthStore.getState().sessionEpoch === epoch;
    const patch = (value: Partial<NonNullable<typeof thread>>) => { if (current() && user && thread) patchCreationThread(user.id, thread.id, value); };

    useEffect(() => {
        let active = true;
        setLoadError("");
        if (!user) return;
        void loadCreationChats(user.id).then(async () => {
            if (!active) return;
            const id = params.get("thread");
            if (id && !openCreationThread(user.id, id)) { setLoadError("该对话不在此浏览器中，可能已清理或来自其他设备。"); return; }
            if (!id) await ensureCreationThread(user.id);
        });
        void apiRequest<{ enabled: boolean; modelId: string }>("/api/creation-chat/config").then(value => { if (active) setVision(value); }).catch(() => { if (active) setLoadError("看图模型配置读取失败，请刷新重试。"); });
        return () => { active = false; controller.current?.abort(); };
    }, [user?.id, epoch, params.get("thread")]);
    useEffect(() => {
        let active = true;
        setImagePreview(""); setImagePreviewError("");
        if (latestImage) void resolveImageUrl(latestImage.storageKey, latestImage.dataUrl || latestImage.url || "")
            .then(url => { if (active) { setImagePreview(url); if (!url) setImagePreviewError("图片暂时无法读取，原记录仍保留。"); } })
            .catch(() => { if (active) setImagePreviewError("图片暂时无法读取，原记录仍保留。"); });
        return () => { active = false; };
    }, [latestImage, user?.id, epoch]);
    useEffect(() => { end.current?.scrollIntoView({ block: "nearest" }); }, [messages.length, messages.at(-1)?.text]);
    function updateMessage(threadId: string, id: string, value: Partial<ChatEntry>) {
        if (!current() || !user) return;
        const target = useCreationChat.getState().threads.find(t => t.id === threadId);
        if (target) patchCreationThread(user.id, threadId, { messages: target.messages.map(item => item.id === id ? { ...item, ...value } : item) }, !!value.complete || !!value.error);
    }
    async function send() {
        if (!draft.trim() || !modelReady || controller.current || !user || !thread || loadError) return;
        const threadId = thread.id;
        const abort = new AbortController(); controller.current = abort; setBusy(true);
        const request: ChatEntry = { id: crypto.randomUUID(), role: "user", text: draft.trim() };
        const answer: ChatEntry = { id: crypto.randomUUID(), role: "assistant", text: "" };
        const history = [...messages, request];
        patch({ messages: [...history, answer], draft: "", ...(thread.title === "新对话" ? { title: request.text.slice(0, 40) } : {}) });
        try {
            const input = await buildCreationChatInput({ ...thread, messages: history }, image => imageToDataUrl(image, { expectedOwner: user.id, signal: abort.signal }));
            const text = await requestImageQuestion({ ...config, model }, input, text => updateMessage(threadId, answer.id, { text }), { signal: abort.signal, expectedUserId: user.id, surface: "workbench", creationChat: true });
            updateMessage(threadId, answer.id, { text, complete: true });
        } catch (error) {
            updateMessage(threadId, answer.id, { error: abort.signal.aborted ? "已停止回复，可继续提问。" : error instanceof Error ? error.message : String(error) });
        } finally { controller.current = null; if (current()) setBusy(false); }
    }
    const cost = quote.data ? `预计 ${quote.data.minCredits === quote.data.maxCredits ? quote.data.minCredits : `${quote.data.minCredits}–${quote.data.maxCredits}`} 积分 / 次` : modelReady ? "暂无法估算积分" : "请选择语言模型";
    return <div className="flex h-full min-h-0 flex-col">
        <div className="creation-top-actions flex items-center justify-between px-5 py-3">
            <button type="button" disabled={busy} className="flex items-center gap-2 text-sm disabled:opacity-40" onClick={() => { if (user) { const id = newCreationThread(user.id); setLoadError(""); setParams({ mode: "chat", thread: id }); } }}><Plus className="size-4" />新建对话</button>
            <span className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">创作交流 · 看图建议</span>
        </div>
        {(loadError || state.error) && <p role="alert" className="px-5 py-2 text-sm text-red-400">{loadError || state.error}</p>}
        <CreationStream composer={<div className="creation-composer mx-auto w-full max-w-[960px]">
            <ChatComposer value={draft} onSubmit={() => void send()} elevation="none"
                input={<div>
                    <Input.TextArea className="creation-chat-input" value={draft} onChange={e => patch({ draft: e.target.value })} autoSize={{ minRows: 2, maxRows: 5 }} placeholder="直接提问，自动结合当前创作内容和全部对话…" />
                </div>}
                footerActions={<div className="creation-actions flex w-full flex-wrap items-center gap-2"><CreationModeSwitch mode="chat" busy={busy} />{latestImage ? <span className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">看图模型：{models.find(m => m.id === vision?.modelId)?.name ?? "后台暂未配置"} · 自动附带最近一张图片</span> : <ModelPicker config={config} value={model} capability="text" placeholder="选择语言模型" onChange={value => updateConfig("textModel", value)} />}</div>}
                sendActions={<div className="creation-costs"><span className="text-xs text-muted-foreground" title="沿用文本模型计费，实际积分以服务端结算为准">{cost}</span></div>}
                sendButton={busy ? <Button label="停止" size="lg" variant="ghost" icon={<Square className="size-4" />} onClick={() => controller.current?.abort()} /> : <Button label="发送" size="lg" variant="primary" icon={<Send className="size-4" />} isDisabled={!draft.trim() || !modelReady || !thread || !!loadError} onClick={() => void send()} />}
            />
        </div>}>
            {latestImage && <div className="mx-auto mb-6 w-full max-w-[620px] rounded-2xl border border-border bg-card/30 p-4"><p className="mb-3 text-xs text-muted-foreground">当前图片 · 对话将自动分析这张图</p>{imagePreview ? <img src={imagePreview} alt="本次对话的最近一张图片" className="max-h-[40vh] w-full rounded-xl object-contain" onError={() => setImagePreviewError("图片暂时无法读取，原记录仍保留。")} /> : null}{imagePreviewError ? <p role="alert" className="text-xs text-red-400">{imagePreviewError}</p> : !imagePreview ? <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">正在读取图片…</p> : null}</div>}
            {!messages.length && !latestImage && <div className="creation-empty"><div className="creation-empty-icon"><MessageSquare className="size-7" /></div><h2>聊聊你的创作想法</h2><p>仅使用本次对话的内容和最近一张图片。<br />对话保存在当前浏览器，支持从最近作品继续。</p><button type="button" className="creation-tool-button mt-4" onClick={() => patch({ draft: "请分析刚刚生成的图片，并提出具体的改进建议。" })}>分析图片并给建议</button></div>}
            {messages.map(item => <div key={item.id} className={`mb-5 flex ${item.role === "user" ? "justify-end" : "justify-start"}`}><div className={`max-w-[90%] rounded-2xl px-4 py-3 text-sm leading-7 ${item.role === "user" ? "bg-muted rounded-br-sm" : "bg-muted/30 rounded-bl-sm"}`}>
                <p className="whitespace-pre-wrap break-words">{item.text || (!item.error && !item.complete ? "正在回复…" : "")}</p>{item.error && <p role="alert" className="mt-2 text-xs text-red-400">{item.error}</p>}
            </div></div>)}<div ref={end} />
        </CreationStream>
    </div>;
}

import { ChatComposer } from "@astryxdesign/core/Chat";
import { ImagePlus, Sparkles, Video } from "lucide-react";
import { useState } from "react";
import { useNavigate } from "react-router-dom";

import { useAuthDialogStore } from "@/stores/use-auth-dialog-store";

import { CreationStream } from "@/components/creation/creation-stream";
import { CreationModeTrack, type CreationModeOption } from "@/components/creation/creation-toolbar";
import { GUEST_DRAFT_KEY } from "@/lib/pending-prompt";

const GUEST_MODES: readonly CreationModeOption[] = [
    { value: "image", label: "图片", icon: ImagePlus },
    { value: "video", label: "视频", icon: Video },
];

export function GuestCreation() {
    const [mode, setMode] = useState<"image" | "video">("image");
    const [prompt, setPrompt] = useState("");
    const navigate = useNavigate();
    const openAuthDialog = useAuthDialogStore((state) => state.open);
    const login = () => {
        try { sessionStorage.setItem(GUEST_DRAFT_KEY, JSON.stringify({ mode, prompt })); } catch { /* login remains available if storage is blocked */ }
        openAuthDialog("login", { redirect: "/create" });
    };
    return <div className="creation-shell guest-creation flex h-full flex-col overflow-hidden bg-background text-foreground">
        <CreationStream composer={<div className="creation-composer mx-auto w-full"><ChatComposer
            value={prompt}
            onChange={setPrompt}
            onSubmit={login}
            elevation="none"
            placeholder="描述你的画面，开始创作…"
            footerActions={<div className="creation-actions flex min-w-0 flex-wrap items-center gap-1">
                <CreationModeTrack value={mode} options={GUEST_MODES} onChange={value => setMode(value as "image" | "video")} />
                <span className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">登录后选择模型与参考素材</span>
            </div>}
            sendButton={<button type="button" className="jm-btn jm-btn-primary h-9" onClick={login}>登录后继续</button>}
        /></div>}>
            <div className="creation-empty-wrap">
                <div className="creation-empty">
                    <span className="creation-empty-icon"><Sparkles /></span>
                    <h2>描述画面，登录后继续创作</h2>
                    <p>作品、素材与积分都归属同一个账号。<br />登录后即可选择模型、上传参考素材并开始生成。</p>
                </div>
            </div>
        </CreationStream>
    </div>;
}
