import { lazy, Suspense, useEffect } from "react";
import { createBrowserRouter, Navigate, Outlet, useLocation, useNavigate, useSearchParams } from "react-router-dom";

import { AuthDialogHost } from "@/components/layout/lazy-overlays";
import { AnalyticsTracker } from "@/components/layout/analytics-tracker";
import { RequireAuth } from "@/components/layout/require-auth";
import { RouteErrorPage } from "@/components/layout/route-error";
import { PageSkeleton } from "@/components/loading/page-skeleton";
import UserLayout from "@/layouts/user-layout";
import HomePage from "@/pages/home";
import { useAuthStore } from "@/stores/use-auth-store";
import { GUEST_DRAFT_KEY, storePendingPrompt } from "@/lib/pending-prompt";
import NotFound from "@/pages/not-found";

const AccountPage = lazy(() => import("@/pages/account"));
const AdminPage = lazy(() => import("@/pages/admin"));
const AssetsPage = lazy(() => import("@/pages/assets"));
const AuthGate = lazy(() => import("@/pages/auth").then((module) => ({ default: module.AuthGate })));
const CanvasPage = lazy(() => import("@/pages/canvas"));
const CanvasProjectPage = lazy(() => import("@/pages/canvas/project"));
const ChatPage = lazy(() => import("@/pages/chat"));
const ImagePage = lazy(() => import("@/pages/image"));
const PromptsPage = lazy(() => import("@/pages/prompts"));
const VideoPage = lazy(() => import("@/pages/video"));
const GuestCreation = lazy(() => import("@/pages/home/guest-creation").then((module) => ({ default: module.GuestCreation })));

function CreationHome() {
    const [params] = useSearchParams();
    const user = useAuthStore((state) => state.user);
    const ready = useAuthStore((state) => state.ready);
    const navigate = useNavigate();
    useEffect(() => {
        if (!user || !ready) return;
        try {
            const raw = sessionStorage.getItem(GUEST_DRAFT_KEY);
            if (!raw) return;
            const draft = JSON.parse(raw) as { mode?: string; prompt?: string };
            sessionStorage.removeItem(GUEST_DRAFT_KEY);
            if (typeof draft.prompt !== "string") return;
            const mode = draft.mode === "video" ? "video" : "image";
            storePendingPrompt(mode, draft.prompt, [], user.id);
            navigate(`/create?mode=${mode}`, { replace: true });
        } catch { /* a bad guest draft must not block the workspace */ }
    }, [user?.id, ready, navigate]);
    if (!ready) return <PageSkeleton embedded />;
    return user ? (params.get("mode") === "chat" ? <ChatPage key={`${user.id}:${useAuthStore.getState().sessionEpoch}`} /> : params.get("mode") === "video" ? <VideoPage /> : <ImagePage />) : <GuestCreation />;
}

function HomeEntry() {
    const location = useLocation();
    const params = new URLSearchParams(location.search);
    if (params.has("mode") || params.has("record")) return <Navigate to={{ pathname: "/create", search: location.search, hash: location.hash }} replace />;
    return <HomePage landing />;
}

function LegacyCreation({ mode }: { mode: "image" | "video" }) {
    const location = useLocation();
    const params = new URLSearchParams(location.search);
    params.set("mode", mode);
    return <Navigate to={{ pathname: "/create", search: `?${params}`, hash: location.hash }} replace />;
}

export const router = createBrowserRouter([
    {
        element: (
            <Suspense fallback={<PageSkeleton />}>
                <Outlet />
                <AuthDialogHost />
            </Suspense>
        ),
        errorElement: <RouteErrorPage />,
        children: [
            {
                element: (
                    <UserLayout>
                        <AnalyticsTracker />
                        <Outlet />
                    </UserLayout>
                ),
                children: [
                    { path: "/", element: <HomeEntry /> },
                    { path: "/create", element: <CreationHome /> },
                    { path: "/explore", element: <HomePage /> },
                    { path: "/image", element: <RequireAuth><LegacyCreation mode="image" /></RequireAuth> },
                    { path: "/video", element: <RequireAuth><LegacyCreation mode="video" /></RequireAuth> },
                    { path: "/assets", element: <RequireAuth><AssetsPage /></RequireAuth> },
                    { path: "/prompts", element: <RequireAuth><PromptsPage /></RequireAuth> },
                    { path: "/models", element: <Navigate to="/" replace /> },
                    { path: "/canvas", element: <RequireAuth><CanvasPage /></RequireAuth> },
                    { path: "/canvas/:id", element: <RequireAuth><CanvasProjectPage /></RequireAuth> },
                    { path: "/login", element: <AuthGate mode="login" /> },
                    { path: "/register", element: <AuthGate mode="register" /> },
                    { path: "/forgot-password", element: <AuthGate mode="reset" /> },
                    { path: "/account", element: <RequireAuth><AccountPage /></RequireAuth> },
                ],
            },
            { path: "/admin", element: <AdminPage /> },
            { path: "*", element: <NotFound /> },
        ],
    },
]);

export function expectedAccountHeaders(requestUrl: string, expectedUserId?: string): Record<string, string> {
    if (!expectedUserId || typeof window === "undefined") return {};
    try {
        const url = new URL(requestUrl, window.location.origin);
        if (url.origin === window.location.origin && /^\/api\/v1(?:\/|$)/.test(url.pathname)) {
            return { "X-Sundas-User": expectedUserId };
        }
    } catch { /* 无效地址会由请求处理报告 */ }
    return {};
}

import type { ApiRequestInit } from "../client";
type Request = <T = unknown>(path: string, init?: ApiRequestInit) => Promise<T>;
export type AdminRole = { id: string; code: string; name: string; description: string; isSystem: boolean; permissions: string[]; userCount: number };
export type Administrator = { id: string; email: string; displayName: string; status: string; roleIds: string[]; roleNames: string[] };
export const accessApi = (request: Request) => ({
    me: () => request<{ permissions: string[] }>("/api/admin/me"),
    roles: () => request<{ roles: AdminRole[]; permissions: string[] }>("/api/admin/roles"),
    administrators: () => request<{ administrators: Administrator[] }>("/api/admin/administrators"),
    saveRole: (id: string | undefined, body: unknown) => request(id ? `/api/admin/roles/${id}` : "/api/admin/roles", { method: id ? "PATCH" : "POST", json: body }),
    deleteRole: (id: string) => request(`/api/admin/roles/${id}`, { method: "DELETE" }),
    addAdmin: (userId: string, roles: string[]) => request("/api/admin/administrators", { method: "POST", json: { userId, roles } }),
    assign: (id: string, roles: string[]) => request(`/api/admin/administrators/${id}/roles`, { method: "PUT", json: { roles } }),
    remove: (id: string) => request(`/api/admin/administrators/${id}`, { method: "DELETE" }),
});

import type { ApiRequestInit } from "../client";

import { assertMediaOwner, currentMediaOwner } from "@/services/cloud-media";
import axios from "axios";

import i18n from "@/i18n";
import { audioMimeType, normalizeAudioFormatValue, normalizeAudioSpeedValue, normalizeAudioVoiceValue } from "@/lib/audio-generation";
import { uploadMediaFile, type UploadedFile } from "@/services/file-storage";
import { buildApiUrl, resolveModelRequestConfig, resolveModelScript, withLocalProxy, type AiConfig } from "@/stores/use-config-store";
import { runModelPlugin } from "./model-plugin";
import { expectedAccountHeaders } from "./account-headers";
import { refreshGenerationWallet } from "./generation-wallet";

type RequestOptions = { signal?: AbortSignal; expectedUserId?: string };
const apiText = (key: string, options?: Record<string, unknown>) => i18n.t(`apiErrors.${key}`, options);

function aiApiUrl(config: AiConfig, path: string) {
    return buildApiUrl(config.baseUrl, path);
}

function aiHeaders(config: AiConfig) {
    return {
        Authorization: `Bearer ${config.apiKey}`,
        "Content-Type": "application/json",
    };
}

type AudioReceipt = { taskId?: string; status: 'pending' | 'review' | 'failed' | 'completed'; error?: string; media?: UploadedFile & { mediaId: string; objectKey: string } };

export async function requestStoredAudio(config: AiConfig, prompt: string, options: RequestOptions & { requestId: string }): Promise<UploadedFile> {
    const owner = options.expectedUserId ?? currentMediaOwner();
    assertMediaOwner(owner, options.signal);
    const selected = config.model || config.audioModel;
    const requestConfig = resolveModelRequestConfig(config, selected);
    if (resolveModelScript(config, selected) || requestConfig.apiKey !== 'server') {
        return storeGeneratedAudio(await requestAudioGeneration(config, prompt, options), config.audioFormat, { signal: options.signal, expectedOwner: options.expectedUserId });
    }
    const url = aiApiUrl(requestConfig, '/audio/speech');
    const headers = { ...aiHeaders(requestConfig), ...expectedAccountHeaders(url, options.expectedUserId) };
    const resultUrl = aiApiUrl(requestConfig, `/audio/operations/${options.requestId}`);
    const readResult = async () => (await axios.get<AudioReceipt>(resultUrl, { headers, signal: options.signal })).data;
    try {
        let result: AudioReceipt;
        try {
            result = (await axios.post<AudioReceipt>(url, {
                model: requestConfig.model.trim(), input: prompt,
                voice: normalizeAudioVoiceValue(config.audioVoice), response_format: normalizeAudioFormatValue(config.audioFormat),
                speed: Number(normalizeAudioSpeedValue(config.audioSpeed)),
                ...(config.audioInstructions.trim() ? { instructions: config.audioInstructions.trim() } : {}),
            }, { headers: { ...headers, 'X-Sundas-Audio-Result': 'json', 'Idempotency-Key': options.requestId }, signal: options.signal })).data;
        } catch (error) {
            if (options.signal?.aborted || (axios.isAxiosError(error) && error.response?.status && error.response.status < 500)) throw error;
            result = await readResult();
        }
        if (result.status !== 'completed' || !result.media) throw new Error(result.error || '原音频任务处理中，请稍后重试以查询原结果');
        assertMediaOwner(owner, options.signal);
        window.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('sundas:generation-updated', { detail: { owner: options.expectedUserId } }));
        return { ...result.media, taskId: result.taskId };
    } catch (error) { throw new Error(readAxiosError(error, apiText('audioGenerationFailed'))); }
    finally { refreshGenerationWallet(options.expectedUserId); }
}

export async function requestAudioGeneration(config: AiConfig, prompt: string, options?: RequestOptions): Promise<Blob> {
    try { return await requestAudioGenerationInner(config, prompt, options); }
    finally { refreshGenerationWallet(options?.expectedUserId); }
}

async function requestAudioGenerationInner(config: AiConfig, prompt: string, options?: RequestOptions): Promise<Blob> {
    const requestConfig = resolveModelRequestConfig(config, config.model || config.audioModel);
    const model = requestConfig.model.trim();
    const format = normalizeAudioFormatValue(config.audioFormat);
    const script = resolveModelScript(config, config.model || config.audioModel);
    if (script) {
        if (!model) throw new Error(apiText("audioModelRequired"));
        if (!requestConfig.baseUrl.trim()) throw new Error(apiText("baseUrlRequired"));
        if (!requestConfig.apiKey.trim()) throw new Error(apiText("apiKeyRequired"));
        try {
            const result = await runModelPlugin({
                capability: "audio",
                script,
                config: requestConfig,
                prompt,
                params: { voice: normalizeAudioVoiceValue(config.audioVoice), format, speed: normalizeAudioSpeedValue(config.audioSpeed), instructions: config.audioInstructions.trim() },
                signal: options?.signal,
            });
            return await audioPluginBlob(result, format);
        } catch (error) {
            throw new Error(readAxiosError(error, apiText("audioGenerationFailed")));
        }
    }
    assertAudioConfig(requestConfig, model);
    const instructions = config.audioInstructions.trim();

    try {
        const response = await axios.post<Blob>(
            aiApiUrl(requestConfig, "/audio/speech"),
            {
                model,
                input: prompt,
                voice: normalizeAudioVoiceValue(config.audioVoice),
                response_format: format,
                speed: Number(normalizeAudioSpeedValue(config.audioSpeed)),
                ...(instructions ? { instructions } : {}),
            },
            { headers: { ...aiHeaders(requestConfig), ...expectedAccountHeaders(aiApiUrl(requestConfig, "/audio/speech"), options?.expectedUserId) }, responseType: "blob", signal: options?.signal },
        );
        await assertAudioBlob(response.data);
        return response.data.type.startsWith("audio/") ? response.data : new Blob([response.data], { type: audioMimeType(format) });
    } catch (error) {
        throw new Error(readAxiosError(error, apiText("audioGenerationFailed")));
    }
}

async function audioPluginBlob(result: unknown, format: string): Promise<Blob> {
    if (result instanceof Blob) return result.type.startsWith("audio/") ? result : new Blob([result], { type: audioMimeType(format) });
    let source = "";
    if (typeof result === "string") source = result;
    else if (result && typeof result === "object") {
        const record = result as Record<string, unknown>;
        source = typeof record.b64_json === "string" ? record.b64_json : typeof record.data === "string" ? record.data : typeof record.url === "string" ? record.url : "";
    }
    if (!source) throw new Error(apiText("scriptNoAudio"));
    const url = source.startsWith("data:") || /^https?:/i.test(source) ? source : `data:${audioMimeType(format)};base64,${source}`;
    const blob = await (await fetch(withLocalProxy(url))).blob();
    return blob.type.startsWith("audio/") ? blob : new Blob([blob], { type: audioMimeType(format) });
}

export async function storeGeneratedAudio(blob: Blob, format = "mp3", options?: { expectedOwner?: string | null; signal?: AbortSignal }): Promise<UploadedFile> {
    const audio = blob.type.startsWith("audio/") ? blob : new Blob([blob], { type: audioMimeType(format) });
    return uploadMediaFile(audio, "audio", options);
}

function assertAudioConfig(config: AiConfig, model: string) {
    if (!model) throw new Error(apiText("audioModelRequired"));
    if (!config.baseUrl.trim()) throw new Error(apiText("baseUrlRequired"));
    if (!config.apiKey.trim()) throw new Error(apiText("apiKeyRequired"));
    if (config.apiFormat === "gemini") throw new Error(apiText("geminiAudioUnsupported"));
}

async function assertAudioBlob(blob: Blob) {
    if (!blob.type.includes("json")) return;
    let payload: { code?: number; msg?: string; error?: { message?: string } };
    try {
        payload = JSON.parse(await blob.text()) as { code?: number; msg?: string; error?: { message?: string } };
    } catch {
        return;
    }
    if (typeof payload.code === "number" && payload.code !== 0) throw new Error(payload.msg || apiText("audioGenerationFailed"));
    if (payload.error?.message) throw new Error(payload.error.message);
}

function readApiErrorMessage(value: unknown): string {
    if (!value) return "";
    if (typeof value === "string") {
        try {
            const parsed = JSON.parse(value);
            const inner = readApiErrorMessage(parsed) || value;
            if (inner === value && typeof parsed === "object" && Object.keys(parsed).length === 0) return "";
            return inner;
        } catch {
            if (/<[a-z][\s\S]*>/i.test(value)) return apiText("htmlError", { preview: `${value.slice(0, 80)}...` });
            return value;
        }
    }
    if (typeof value !== "object") return "";
    const payload = value as { msg?: unknown; message?: unknown; error?: unknown; detail?: unknown };
    const errorMsg =
        typeof payload.error === "string"
            ? payload.error
            : (payload.error as { message?: unknown })?.message;
    return (
        readApiErrorMessage(payload.msg) ||
        readApiErrorMessage(payload.message) ||
        readApiErrorMessage(errorMsg) ||
        readApiErrorMessage(payload.detail) ||
        ""
    );
}

function readAxiosError(error: unknown, fallback: string) {
    if (axios.isCancel(error)) return apiText("requestCanceled");
    if (axios.isAxiosError(error)) {
        if (!error.response && error.code === "ERR_NETWORK") return apiText("requestFailed");
        const responseData = error.response?.data;
        const apiMsg = readApiErrorMessage(responseData);
        if (apiMsg) return apiMsg;
        const statusMsg = statusMessage(error.response?.status, fallback);
        if (statusMsg) return statusMsg;
        return error.message || fallback;
    }
    if (error instanceof DOMException && error.name === "AbortError") return apiText("requestCanceled");
    return error instanceof Error ? readApiErrorMessage(error.message) || error.message : fallback;
}

function statusMessage(status: number | undefined, fallback: string) {
    if (status === 401 || status === 403) return apiText("authenticationFailed");
    if (status === 429) return apiText("rateLimited");
    if (status === 404) return apiText("notFound");
    if (status === 502) return apiText("badGateway");
    if (status === 503) return apiText("serviceBusy");
    return status ? apiText("httpFailed", { status }) : fallback;
}

import { apiRequest } from './client';
import type { DirectorScene } from '@/types/director';

export type DirectorRenderParameters = { sequenceId: string; kind: 'frames' | 'video'; startFrame: number; endFrame: number; frames?: number[]; fixedCameraId?: string };
export type DirectorRenderOutput = { url: string; objectKey: string; frame?: number; width: number; height: number; duration?: number; mime: string; bytes: string };
export type DirectorRenderRequest = { id: string; sceneId: string; projectVersion: number; parameters: DirectorRenderParameters; status: 'waiting' | 'claimed' | 'completed' | 'failed' | 'cancelled'; snapshot?: DirectorScene; claimToken?: string; error?: string; receipt?: { fps: number; outputs: DirectorRenderOutput[] } };
export type AdoptDirectorRender = (task: DirectorRenderRequest, output: DirectorRenderOutput, target?: 'canvas' | 'production') => Promise<void>;
export function directorClient(projectId: string, userId: string, signal: AbortSignal) {
    const root = `/api/canvas/projects/${encodeURIComponent(projectId)}/director/render-requests`;
    const options = { signal, headers: { 'X-Sundas-User': userId } };
    const action = <T>(id: string, action: string, json: unknown = {}) => apiRequest<T>(`${root}/${encodeURIComponent(id)}/${action}`, { ...options, method: 'POST', json });
    return {
        list: () => apiRequest<{ requests: DirectorRenderRequest[] }>(root, options),
        create: (input: { id: string; expectedVersion: number; sceneId: string; parameters: DirectorRenderParameters }) => apiRequest<{ request: DirectorRenderRequest }>(root, { ...options, method: 'POST', json: input }),
        claim: (id: string, browserSession: string) => action<{ request: DirectorRenderRequest }>(id, 'claim', { browserSession }),
        complete: (id: string, claimToken: string, outputs: Array<{ objectKey: string; frame?: number }>) => action<{ receipt: DirectorRenderRequest['receipt'] }>(id, 'complete', { claimToken, outputs }),
        fail: (id: string, claimToken: string, error: string) => action(id, 'fail', { claimToken, error }),
        cancel: (id: string) => action(id, 'cancel'),
        resume: (id: string) => action(id, 'resume'),
    };
}

import { apiRequest } from './client';
import { useAuthStore } from '@/stores/use-auth-store';
import type { AgentProject } from './creative-agent';
import type { ProductionMedia } from '../../../../shared/production';
import type { DirectorCutMapping } from '../../../../shared/director-production';

export type ProductionRequest = { kind: 'script' | 'images' | 'narration' | 'audition' | 'render' | 'preview'; expectedVersion: number; modelId?: string; shotIds?: string[]; narrationIds?: string[]; assetIds?: string[]; prompt?: string; voice?: string; format?: string; speed?: number; instructions?: string; size?: string; resolution?: string; skills?: Array<{ id: string; version: number }>; options?: Record<string, unknown> };
export type ProductionQuote = { digest: string; minCredits: number; maxCredits: number; message: string; steps: Array<{ targetId: string; targetKind: string; inputHash: string; minCredits: number; maxCredits: number; prompt?: string }> };
export type ProductionSubmission = ProductionRequest & { clientRequestId: string; confirmed: true; quoteDigest: string; acceptedCredits: number };
export type ProductionRun = { id: string; projectId: string; kind: ProductionRequest['kind']; status: string; createdAt: string; updatedAt?: string; clientRequestId?: string; error?: string; errorMessage?: string; [key: string]: unknown };
export type ProductionStep = { id: string; runId: string; targetId: string; targetKind?: string; status: string; taskIds?: string[]; error?: string; errorMessage?: string; input?: Record<string, unknown>; output?: Record<string, unknown>; stale?: boolean; result?: { media?: ProductionMedia[]; text?: string; draft?: Record<string, unknown>; creditsCharged?: number; [key: string]: unknown }; [key: string]: unknown };
export type ProductionRunDetail = { run: ProductionRun; steps: ProductionStep[] };
export type ProductionModel = { id: string; name: string; capability: 'text' | 'image' | 'audio' | 'video'; voices: string[]; minCredits: number; maxCredits: number; unit?: string };
export type ProductionCommandRecord = { clientRequestId: string; beforeVersion: number; projectVersion: number; type: 'adopt' | 'director-adopt' | 'restore'; createdAt: string };

export function canvasProductionApi(projectId: string, signal?: AbortSignal) {
    const account = useAuthStore.getState();
    const owner = account.user?.id, epoch = account.sessionEpoch;
    const current = () => owner && useAuthStore.getState().user?.id === owner && useAuthStore.getState().sessionEpoch === epoch && !signal?.aborted;
    const base = `/api/canvas/projects/${encodeURIComponent(projectId)}/production`;
    async function request<T>(path: string, method = 'GET', json?: unknown): Promise<T> {
        if (!current()) throw new Error('登录会话已变化，请重新打开制作面板');
        const result = await apiRequest<T>(path.startsWith('/api/') ? path : `${base}${path}`, { method, json, signal, headers: { 'X-Sundas-User': owner! } });
        if (!current()) throw new Error('账户已变化，本次制作结果未回填');
        if (result && typeof result === 'object') {
            const scoped = result as { run?: ProductionRun; project?: AgentProject; runs?: ProductionRun[] };
            if ((scoped.run && scoped.run.projectId !== projectId) || (scoped.project && scoped.project.id !== projectId) || scoped.runs?.some(run => run.projectId !== projectId)) throw new Error('制作回执项目归属不一致，已停止回填');
        }
        return result;
    }
    return {
        models: () => request<{ models: ProductionModel[]; audioTimestamps: boolean; message?: string }>('/api/canvas/production/models'),
        directorMapping: (renderId: string) => request<{ mapping: DirectorCutMapping[]; sourceVersion: number }>(`/director-mapping/${encodeURIComponent(renderId)}`),
        adoptDirector: (input: { clientRequestId: string; expectedVersion: number; command: { type: 'director-adopt'; renderRequestId: string } }) => request<{ project: AgentProject; receipt: Record<string, unknown> }>('/commands', 'POST', input),
        commands: () => request<{ commands: ProductionCommandRecord[] }>('/commands'),
        quote: (input: ProductionRequest) => request<{ quote: ProductionQuote }>('/quotes', 'POST', input),
        create: (input: ProductionSubmission) => request<ProductionRunDetail>('/runs', 'POST', input),
        list: () => request<{ runs: ProductionRun[] }>('/runs'),
        detail: (id: string) => request<ProductionRunDetail>(`/runs/${encodeURIComponent(id)}`),
        resume: (id: string) => request<ProductionRunDetail>(`/runs/${encodeURIComponent(id)}/resume`, 'POST', {}),
        cancel: (id: string) => request<ProductionRunDetail>(`/runs/${encodeURIComponent(id)}/cancel`, 'POST', {}),
        pause: (id: string) => request<ProductionRunDetail>(`/runs/${encodeURIComponent(id)}/pause`, 'POST', {}),
        adopt: (input: { clientRequestId: string; expectedVersion: number; command: { type: 'adopt'; runId: string; stepId: string; resultIndex?: number; allowStale?: boolean } }) => request<{ project: AgentProject; receipt: Record<string, unknown> }>('/commands', 'POST', input),
        restore: (input: { clientRequestId: string; expectedVersion: number; command: { type: 'restore'; requestId: string } }) => request<{ project: AgentProject; receipt: Record<string, unknown> }>('/commands', 'POST', input),
    };
}

import { apiRequest } from './client';

export type UpscaleTarget = { id: string; label: string; scale?: number; width?: number; height?: number };
export type UpscaleModel = {
    id: string; name: string; mediaKind: 'image' | 'video'; inputMimeTypes: string[];
    targets: UpscaleTarget[]; available: boolean; reason: string | null;
};
export type UpscaleCapabilities = { models: UpscaleModel[]; available: boolean; reason: string };
export type UpscaleRun = {

export type CharacterInput = {
    sourceKey: string; characterKey: string; target: string; instructions: string;
    imageModel: string; videoModel: string; imageSize?: string; resolution: string; ratio: string;
    start: number; end: number | null; keepAudio: boolean;
};
export type CharacterMedia = { key: string; kind: "image" | "video"; url?: string; mime?: string; bytes?: number; width?: number; height?: number; duration?: number };
export type CharacterStepName = "prepare" | "image" | "video" | "assemble";
export type CharacterStep = {
    id: string; name: CharacterStepName; attempt: number; status: "queued" | "running" | "succeeded" | "failed" | "review";
    taskIds: string[]; error?: string; output: { media?: CharacterMedia[]; range?: { start: number; end: number; duration: number }; frame?: CharacterMedia; clip?: CharacterMedia };
};
export type CharacterRun = { id: string; projectId: string; input: CharacterInput; selectedKey?: string; paused: boolean; createdAt: string; steps?: CharacterStep[] };

export function characterRequest<T>(path: string, init: ApiRequestInit = {}) {
    const auth = useAuthStore.getState();
    if (!auth.user) return Promise.reject(new Error("请先登录"));
    const owner = auth.user.id, epoch = auth.sessionEpoch;
    return apiRequest<T>(`/api/canvas/character-runs${path}`, { ...init, headers: { ...init.headers, "X-Sundas-User": owner } }).then(result => {
        const current = useAuthStore.getState();
        if (current.user?.id !== owner || current.sessionEpoch !== epoch) throw new DOMException("登录账户已变化", "AbortError");
        return result;
    });
}

/** Captures account and epoch once; both request and response must belong to this session. */
export function creativeAgentApi(signal?: AbortSignal) {
    const session = useAuthStore.getState();
    const owner = session.user?.id;
    const epoch = session.sessionEpoch;
    const current = () => owner && useAuthStore.getState().user?.id === owner && useAuthStore.getState().sessionEpoch === epoch;
    async function request<T>(path: string, method = 'GET', json?: unknown): Promise<T> {
        if (!current()) throw new Error('登录账户已变化，请重新打开创作助手');
        const result = await apiRequest<T>(path, { method, json, signal, headers: { 'X-Sundas-User': owner!, [AGENT_CAPABILITIES_HEADER]: DIRECTOR_AGENT_CAPABILITY } });
        if (!current() || signal?.aborted) throw new Error('画布会话已变化，本次结果未回填');
        return result;
    }
    async function state(path: string, method = 'GET', json?: unknown) {
        const value = await request<AgentState>(path, method, json);
        if (value.protocolVersion !== 1 || value.storageVersion !== 1) throw new Error('助手数据版本不受支持，请更新应用；原记录已保留');
        if (value.items.some(item => item.threadId !== value.thread.id || !value.turns.some(turn => turn.id === item.turnId && turn.threadId === item.threadId))) throw new Error('助手消息归属不一致，请重新加载');
        return value;
    }
    return {
        undoDirector: (projectId: string, commandId: string, expectedVersion: number) => request<{ project: AgentProject }>(`/api/canvas/projects/${encodeURIComponent(projectId)}/director/commands/${encodeURIComponent(commandId)}/undo`, 'POST', { expectedVersion }),
        catalog: () => request<AgentCatalog>('/api/canvas-agent/models'),
        threads: (projectId: string) => request<{ threads: AgentThread[] }>(`/api/canvas-agent/threads?projectId=${encodeURIComponent(projectId)}`),
        createThread: (projectId: string, title: string) => state('/api/canvas-agent/threads', 'POST', { projectId, title }),
        thread: (id: string) => state(`/api/canvas-agent/threads/${encodeURIComponent(id)}`),
        plan: (id: string, input: AgentTurnInput) => state(`/api/canvas-agent/threads/${encodeURIComponent(id)}/turns`, 'POST', input),
        confirm: (id: string, expectedVersion: number) => state(`/api/canvas-agent/turns/${encodeURIComponent(id)}/confirm`, 'POST', { confirmed: true, expectedVersion }),
        step: (id: string, itemId: string, expectedVersion: number) => state(`/api/canvas-agent/turns/${encodeURIComponent(id)}/steps/${encodeURIComponent(itemId)}`, 'POST', { expectedVersion }),
        pause: (id: string) => state(`/api/canvas-agent/turns/${encodeURIComponent(id)}/pause`, 'POST', {}),
        refresh: (id: string) => state(`/api/canvas-agent/turns/${encodeURIComponent(id)}/refresh`, 'POST', {}),
        skills: () => request<{ skills: CreativeSkill[] }>('/api/creative-skills'),
        versions: (id: string) => request<{ versions: SkillVersion[] }>(`/api/creative-skills/${id}/versions`),
        createSkill: (value: SkillDraft) => request<{ id: string; version: number }>('/api/creative-skills', 'POST', value),
        editSkill: (id: string, value: SkillDraft, expectedVersion: number) => request(`/api/creative-skills/${id}`, 'PUT', { ...value, expectedVersion }),
        enableSkill: (id: string, enabled: boolean) => request(`/api/creative-skills/${id}`, 'PATCH', { enabled }),

    };
}

import { apiRequest } from './client';

type HistoryMedia = { id:string;kind:string;url:string;mime:string;bytes:number };
type HistoryTask = { id:string;type:string;modelId:string|null;modelName:string;routeId?:string|null;params:Record<string,unknown>;status:string;error:string|null;createdAt:string;finishedAt:string|null;creditsCharged?:number;reconciliationRequired?:boolean;media:HistoryMedia[] };

export async function fetchGenerationHistory(owner:string,type:'image'|'video',page=1, filter: { id?: string; active?: boolean } = {}) {
    const params = new URLSearchParams({ type, page: String(page), ...(filter.id ? { id: filter.id } : {}), ...(filter.active ? { active: 'true' } : {}) });
    const data=await apiRequest<{items:HistoryTask[];hasMore:boolean;hiddenTaskIds:string[]}>(`/api/generations/history?${params}`,{headers:{'X-Sundas-User':owner}});
    const logs:RestoredLog[]=data.items.map(row=>{
        const modelId=row.modelId??'';
        const createdAt=new Date(row.createdAt).getTime();
        const durationMs=row.finishedAt?Math.max(0,new Date(row.finishedAt).getTime()-createdAt):0;
        const prompt=String(row.params.prompt??'').replace(/^参考图片编号：[^\n]*\n+/, '').replace(/^Reference image labels:[^\n]*\n+/i, '').trim();
        const images=row.media.filter(m=>m.kind==='image').map(m=>({id:m.id,dataUrl:m.url,width:0,height:0,bytes:Number(m.bytes),mimeType:m.mime,durationMs}));
        const media=row.media.find(m=>m.kind==='video');
        const status=row.status==='succeeded'?(row.media.length?'success':'unavailable'):row.status==='failed'?'failed':'pending';
        return {id:row.id,serverTaskIds:[row.id],createdAt,title:prompt.slice(0,80)||row.modelName,prompt,time:new Date(createdAt).toLocaleString(),model:row.modelName,
            config:{model:modelId,imageModel:modelId,videoModel:modelId,videoRouteId:row.routeId??'',size:String(row.params.size??''),vquality:String(row.params.resolution??''),videoSeconds:String(row.params.seconds??''),videoMode:String(row.params.mode??''),videoGenerateAudio:String(row.params.generateAudio??row.params.generate_audio??''),videoWatermark:String(row.params.watermark??''),count:String(images.length||1),quality:String(row.params.quality??''),background:String(row.params.background??'')},
            references:[],durationMs,size:String(row.params.size??''),resolution:String(row.params.resolution??''),seconds:String(row.params.seconds??''),status,
            error:row.error??(status==='unavailable'?'生成结果文件暂不可用':undefined),task:type==='video'?{id:row.id,provider:'openai',model:modelId}:undefined,
            images,video:media?{id:media.id,url:media.url,storageKey:'',width:0,height:0,bytes:Number(media.bytes),mimeType:media.mime,durationMs}:undefined,
            successCount:images.length,failCount:status==='failed'?1:0,imageCount:images.length,
            creditsCharged:!row.reconciliationRequired && ['succeeded','failed'].includes(row.status) && row.creditsCharged != null ? Number(row.creditsCharged) : undefined,
            reconciliationRequired:row.reconciliationRequired,referenceCount:Array.isArray(row.params.referenceInputs)?row.params.referenceInputs.length:undefined,
            referenceHistoryUnknown:type==='image' && (!Array.isArray(row.params.referenceInputs) || row.params.referenceInputs.length>0)};
    });
    return {logs,hiddenTaskIds:data.hiddenTaskIds,hasMore:data.hasMore};
}

// Keep previously opened pages while refreshing the newest page after a task
// update. Requests are serialized so a refresh and an older-page load cannot
// overwrite one another.
export class GenerationHistoryPager {
    private records = new Map<string, RestoredLog>();
    private activeIds = new Set<string>();
    private hidden: string[] = [];
    private nextPage = 1;
    private more = true;
    private queue: Promise<unknown> = Promise.resolve();

    constructor(private owner: string, private type: 'image' | 'video') {}

    private enqueue<T>(run: () => Promise<T>): Promise<T> {
        const result = this.queue.then(run, run);
        this.queue = result.catch(() => undefined);
        return result;
    }

    private async fetch(page: number) {
        const data = await fetchGenerationHistory(this.owner, this.type, page);
        this.hidden = data.hiddenTaskIds;
        for (const id of this.hidden) this.records.delete(id);
        for (const log of data.logs) this.records.set(log.id, log);
        if (page >= this.nextPage) {
            this.nextPage = page + 1;
            this.more = data.hasMore;
        }
        return this.snapshot();
    }

    refresh() { return this.enqueue(async () => {
        await this.fetch(1);
        const active = new Set<string>();
        for (let page = 1; ; page++) {
            const result = await fetchGenerationHistory(this.owner, this.type, page, { active: true });
            for (const log of result.logs) { active.add(log.id); this.records.set(log.id, log); }
            if (!result.hasMore) break;
        }
        for (const id of this.activeIds) {
            if (!active.has(id)) await this.readRecord(id);
        }
        this.activeIds = active;
        return this.snapshot();
    }); }
    private async readRecord(id: string) {
        const result = await fetchGenerationHistory(this.owner, this.type, 1, { id });
        this.hidden = result.hiddenTaskIds;
        for (const hidden of this.hidden) this.records.delete(hidden);
        if (!result.logs.length) this.records.delete(id);
        for (const log of result.logs) this.records.set(log.id, log);
        return this.snapshot();
    }
    loadRecord(id: string) { return this.enqueue(() => this.readRecord(id)); }
    loadMore() { return this.enqueue(() => this.more ? this.fetch(this.nextPage) : Promise.resolve(this.snapshot())); }
    snapshot() { return { logs: [...this.records.values()], hiddenTaskIds: this.hidden, hasMore: this.more }; }
}
type MergeLog = {id:string;createdAt:number;serverTaskIds?:string[];task?:{id:string};images?:{dataUrl:string}[];video?:unknown;references?:unknown[];config?:unknown;prompt?:string;model?:string;status?:string;creditsCharged?:number;reconciliationRequired?:boolean;referenceHistoryUnknown?:boolean};
function plainPrompt(log: MergeLog) {
    return (log.prompt ?? '').replace(/^参考图片编号：[^\n]*\n+/, '').replace(/^Reference image labels:[^\n]*\n+/i, '').trim();
}
function mergeVideoConfig(local: unknown, remote: unknown) {
    if (!local || typeof local !== 'object') return remote;
    if (!remote || typeof remote !== 'object') return local;
    const remoteConfig = remote as Record<string, unknown>;
    const localValues = Object.fromEntries(Object.entries(local).filter(([, value]) => value !== '' && value != null));
    return { ...remoteConfig, ...localValues, ...(remoteConfig.videoRouteId ? { videoRouteId: remoteConfig.videoRouteId } : {}) };
}
export function generationTaskIds(log:MergeLog) { return log.serverTaskIds??(log.task?[log.task.id]:[]); }
export function mergeGenerationHistory<T extends MergeLog>(local:T[],remote:T[],hidden:string[]) {
    const remaining=new Map(remote.map(log=>[log.id,log]));
    const merged:T[]=[];
    for(const log of local) {
        const ids=generationTaskIds(log);
        if(ids.some(id=>hidden.includes(id)))continue;
        const matches=remote.filter(item=>ids.includes(item.id)||log.images?.some(image=>item.images?.some(remoteImage=>image.dataUrl===remoteImage.dataUrl))||(!ids.length&&!log.images?.length&&item.status==='failed'&&log.status==='failed'&&log.model===item.model&&plainPrompt(log)&&plainPrompt(log)===plainPrompt(item)&&Math.abs(item.createdAt-log.createdAt)<=15_000));
        const match=matches[0];
        if(match) {
            matches.forEach(item=>remaining.delete(item.id));
            const value=log.task?{...log,...match,id:log.id,references:log.references??match.references,config:mergeVideoConfig(log.config,match.config),video:match.video??log.video,status:match.status==='pending' && log.status && log.status!=='pending'?log.status:match.status}:{...match,...log};
            const completeMatch=ids.length ? ids.every(id=>matches.some(item=>item.id===id)) : (log.images?.length??0)<=1 && matches.length===1;
            merged.push({...value,...(!log.task && Array.isArray(log.references)?{referenceHistoryUnknown:false}:{}),serverTaskIds:[...new Set([...ids,...matches.map(item=>item.id)])],reconciliationRequired:matches.some(item=>item.reconciliationRequired),creditsCharged:completeMatch && matches.every(item=>item.creditsCharged != null)?matches.reduce((sum,item)=>sum+(item.creditsCharged??0),0):undefined});
        } else merged.push(log);
    }
    return [...merged,...remaining.values()].sort((a,b)=>b.createdAt-a.createdAt);
}
export async function hideGenerationHistory(owner:string,ids:string[]) {
    await Promise.all([...new Set(ids)].map(id=>apiRequest(`/api/generations/history/${encodeURIComponent(id)}`,{method:'DELETE',headers:{'X-Sundas-User':owner}})));
}

        strict?: boolean;
    };
};

type ToolResponseResult = {
    content: string;
    toolCalls: ResponseToolCall[];
};

type ToolChoice = "auto" | "required" | { type: "function"; name: string };
type ResponseMessageContent = AiTextMessage["content"] | string;
type ResponseInputContent = { type: "input_text"; text: string } | { type: "input_image"; image_url: string };
type ResponseInputItem =
    | { role: "system" | "user" | "assistant"; content: string | ResponseInputContent[] }
    | { type: "function_call"; call_id: string; name: string; arguments: string }
    | { type: "function_call_output"; call_id: string; output: string };
type ResponseApiToolDefinition = {
    type: "function";
    name: string;
    description?: string;
    parameters: Record<string, unknown>;
    strict?: boolean;
};
type ResponseApiOutputItem =
    | { type?: "message"; content?: Array<{ type?: string; text?: string }> }
    | { type?: "function_call"; id?: string; call_id?: string; name?: string; arguments?: string };
type ResponseApiPayload = {
    id?: string;
    output?: ResponseApiOutputItem[];
    output_text?: string;
    error?: { message?: string };
    code?: number;
    msg?: string;
};
type ResponseStreamState = { buffer: string; text: string; completed: boolean; payload?: ResponseApiPayload; error?: string };

type ImageApiResponse = {
    data?: Array<Record<string, unknown>>;
    status?: string;
    taskId?: string;
    error?: { message?: string };
    code?: number;
    msg?: string;
};
type GeminiPart = {
    text?: string;
    inlineData?: { mimeType?: string; data?: string };
    inline_data?: { mime_type?: string; mimeType?: string; data?: string };
    fileData?: { mimeType?: string; fileUri?: string };
    functionCall?: { id?: string; name?: string; args?: Record<string, unknown> };
    functionResponse?: { id?: string; name?: string; response?: Record<string, unknown> };
    thoughtSignature?: string;
    thought_signature?: string;
};
type GeminiContent = { role?: "user" | "model"; parts: GeminiPart[] };
type GeminiPayload = {
    candidates?: Array<{ content?: { parts?: GeminiPart[] }; finishReason?: string }>;
    models?: Array<{ name?: string }>;
    error?: { message?: string };
    promptFeedback?: { blockReason?: string };
};
type GeminiStreamState = { buffer: string; text: string; toolCalls: ResponseToolCall[]; error?: string };
type RequestOptions = { creationChat?: boolean; signal?: AbortSignal; expectedUserId?: string; surface?: "canvas" | "workbench" };

const IMAGE_QUALITY_VALUES = ["low", "medium", "high", "xhigh", "max"];
const DEFAULT_IMAGE_SHORT_SIDE = 1024;
const IMAGE_SIZE_STEP = 16;
const IMAGE_MIN_PIXELS = 655360;
const IMAGE_MAX_PIXELS = 8294400;
const IMAGE_MAX_EDGE = 3840;
const IMAGE_MAX_RATIO = 3;
const IMAGE_OUTPUT_FORMAT = "png";
// 与 image-storage 的下载超时保持一致，避免接口挂起时节点一直停在生成中。
const IMAGE_REQUEST_TIMEOUT_MS = 10 * 60_000;

function imageCapabilityParams(config: AiConfig) {
    const modelId = modelOptionName(config.model || config.imageModel);
    const model = useConfigStore.getState().serverModels.find(item => item.id === modelId);
    const limits = model?.metadata?.imageCapabilities as { resolutions?: string[]; aspectRatios?: string[]; maxImages?: number; maxImagesByResolution?: Record<string, number> } | undefined;
    if (!limits) return undefined;
    const scales = limits.resolutions ?? [];
    const ratios = limits.aspectRatios ?? [];
    const currentScale = inferMediaScale(config.size);
    const currentRatio = inferMediaRatio(config.size);
    const scale = currentScale === 'auto' ? scales[0] : currentScale.toUpperCase();
    const ratio = currentRatio === 'auto' ? (ratios.includes('1:1') ? '1:1' : ratios[0]) : currentRatio;
    if (!scale || !scales.includes(scale)) throw new Error(`该模型支持的清晰度为 ${scales.join('、')}，请调整图片设置`);
    if (ratios.length && (!ratio || !ratios.includes(ratio))) throw new Error(`该模型支持的比例为 ${ratios.join('、')}，请调整图片设置`);
    return { resolution: scale, aspect_ratio: ratio, maxImages: limits.maxImagesByResolution?.[scale.toLowerCase()] ?? limits.maxImages };
}

export function imageTaskIdFromError(error: unknown) {
    const taskId = error && typeof error === 'object' && 'taskId' in error ? (error as { taskId?: unknown }).taskId : undefined;
    return typeof taskId === 'string' ? taskId : undefined;
}

async function resolvePendingImage(payload: ImageApiResponse, config: AiConfig, options?: RequestOptions): Promise<ImageApiResponse> {
    if (payload.status === 'review') throw Object.assign(new Error(readApiErrorMessage(payload.error) || '原图片任务待核对，请勿重复生成'), { taskId: payload.taskId });
    if (payload.status !== 'pending' || !payload.taskId) return payload;
    const url = aiApiUrl(config, `/images/${encodeURIComponent(payload.taskId)}`);
    for (;;) {
        if (options?.signal?.aborted) throw new DOMException('Aborted', 'AbortError');
        let state: ImageApiResponse | undefined;
        try {
            state = (await axios.get<ImageApiResponse>(url, { headers: { ...aiHeaders(config), ...expectedAccountHeaders(url, options?.expectedUserId) }, signal: options?.signal })).data;
        } catch (error) {
            if (options?.signal?.aborted) throw new DOMException('Aborted', 'AbortError');
            if (axios.isAxiosError(error) && [401, 403, 404].includes(error.response?.status ?? 0)) throw error;
        }
        if (state?.status === 'completed') return state;
        if (state?.status === 'failed' || state?.status === 'review') throw Object.assign(new Error(readApiErrorMessage(state.error) || '图片生成失败'), { taskId: payload.taskId });
        await new Promise<void>((resolve, reject) => {
            if (options?.signal?.aborted) return reject(new DOMException('Aborted', 'AbortError'));
            const abort = () => { clearTimeout(timer); reject(new DOMException('Aborted', 'AbortError')); };
            const timer = setTimeout(() => { options?.signal?.removeEventListener('abort', abort); resolve(); }, 5000);
            options?.signal?.addEventListener('abort', abort, { once: true });
        });
    }
}

const GEMINI_SUPPORTED_RATIOS = ["1:1", "1:4", "1:8", "2:3", "3:2", "3:4", "4:1", "4:3", "4:5", "5:4", "8:1", "9:16", "16:9", "21:9"];

function normalizeQuality(quality: string) {
    const value = quality.trim().toLowerCase();
    return IMAGE_QUALITY_VALUES.includes(value) ? value : undefined;
}

/** Only "transparent" is forwarded; any other value (incl. empty) means keep the default opaque background. */
function normalizeBackground(background: string | undefined) {
    return background?.trim().toLowerCase() === "transparent" ? "transparent" : undefined;
}

/** Map a bare ratio such as "1:1" to an explicit pixel dimension like "1024x1024". */
function resolveSize(ratio: string): string {
    const parsedRatio = parseImageRatio(ratio);
    const preset = imageSizePresets["1k"][ratio];
    if (preset) return preset;
    const isLandscape = parsedRatio.width >= parsedRatio.height;
    const longRatio = isLandscape ? parsedRatio.width / parsedRatio.height : parsedRatio.height / parsedRatio.width;
    const shortSide = DEFAULT_IMAGE_SHORT_SIDE;
    const longSide = Math.round((shortSide * longRatio) / IMAGE_SIZE_STEP) * IMAGE_SIZE_STEP;
    const width = isLandscape ? longSide : shortSide;
    const height = isLandscape ? shortSide : longSide;
    validateImageSize(width, height);
    return `${width}x${height}`;
}

function parseRatioValue(value: string) {
    const parts = value.split(":");
    if (parts.length !== 2) throw new Error(apiText("invalidImageSizeFormat"));
    const w = Number(parts[0]);
    const h = Number(parts[1]);
    if (!Number.isFinite(w) || !Number.isFinite(h) || w <= 0 || h <= 0) throw new Error(apiText("positiveImageRatio"));
    return { width: w, height: h };
}

function parseImageRatio(value: string) {
    const ratio = parseRatioValue(value);
    if (Math.max(ratio.width, ratio.height) / Math.min(ratio.width, ratio.height) > IMAGE_MAX_RATIO) throw new Error(apiText("imageRatioLimit"));
    return ratio;
}

function parseImageDimensions(value: string) {
    const match = value.match(/^(\d+)x(\d+)$/i);
    if (!match) return null;
    return { width: Number(match[1]), height: Number(match[2]) };
}

function validateImageSize(width: number, height: number) {
    if (!Number.isInteger(width) || !Number.isInteger(height) || width <= 0 || height <= 0) throw new Error(apiText("positiveImageDimensions"));
    if (width % IMAGE_SIZE_STEP !== 0 || height % IMAGE_SIZE_STEP !== 0) throw new Error(apiText("imageDimensionStep"));
    if (Math.max(width, height) > IMAGE_MAX_EDGE) throw new Error(apiText("imageEdgeLimit"));
    if (Math.max(width, height) / Math.min(width, height) > IMAGE_MAX_RATIO) throw new Error(apiText("imageRatioLimit"));
    const pixels = width * height;
    if (pixels < IMAGE_MIN_PIXELS || pixels > IMAGE_MAX_PIXELS) throw new Error(apiText("imagePixelLimit"));
}

function resolveRequestSize(size: string) {
    const value = size.trim();
    if (!value || value.toLowerCase() === "auto") return undefined;
    const dimensions = parseImageDimensions(value);
    if (dimensions) {
        validateImageSize(dimensions.width, dimensions.height);
        return `${dimensions.width}x${dimensions.height}`;
    }
    if (value.includes(":")) return resolveSize(value);
    throw new Error(apiText("invalidImageSizeFormat"));
}

function resolveGeminiImageConfig(config: AiConfig) {
    const value = config.size.trim();
    const dimensions = parseImageDimensions(value);
    const ratio = dimensions ? `${dimensions.width}:${dimensions.height}` : value;
    const aspectRatio = value && value.toLowerCase() !== "auto" ? closestGeminiAspectRatio(ratio) : undefined;
    const imageSize = resolveGeminiImageSize(dimensions);
    const image = { ...(aspectRatio ? { aspectRatio } : {}), ...(imageSize ? { imageSize } : {}) };
    return Object.keys(image).length ? { imageConfig: image } : {};
}

function closestGeminiAspectRatio(value: string) {
    const ratio = parseImageRatio(value);
    const target = ratio.width / ratio.height;
    return GEMINI_SUPPORTED_RATIOS.reduce((best, item) => {
        const current = parseRatioValue(item);
        const bestRatio = parseRatioValue(best);
        return Math.abs(current.width / current.height - target) < Math.abs(bestRatio.width / bestRatio.height - target) ? item : best;
    });
}

/** Gemini takes the resolution tier and the ratio separately; the tier comes from the size presets. */
function resolveGeminiImageSize(dimensions: { width: number; height: number } | null) {
    if (!dimensions) return undefined;
    const size = `${dimensions.width}x${dimensions.height}`;
    const scale = Object.keys(imageSizePresets).find((key) => Object.values(imageSizePresets[key]).includes(size));
    if (scale) return scale.toUpperCase();
    const edge = Math.max(dimensions.width, dimensions.height);
    if (edge <= 768) return "512";
    if (edge <= 1536) return "1K";
    if (edge <= 3072) return "2K";
    return "4K";
}

function resolveImageSource(item: Record<string, unknown>) {
    if (typeof item.b64_json === "string" && item.b64_json) {
        return `data:image/png;base64,${item.b64_json}`;
    }
    if (typeof item.url === "string" && item.url) {
        return item.url;
    }
    return null;
}

function parseImagePayload(payload: ImageApiResponse) {
    if (typeof payload.code === "number" && payload.code !== 0) {
        throw new Error(payload.msg || apiText("requestFailed"));
    }
    // Support data, images, and results response fields used by different APIs.
    const imageList = payload.data
        || (payload as Record<string, unknown>).images as Array<Record<string, unknown>> | undefined
        || (payload as Record<string, unknown>).results as Array<Record<string, unknown>> | undefined
        || [];
    const images = imageList
        .map(resolveImageSource)
        .filter((value): value is string => Boolean(value))
        .map((dataUrl) => ({ id: nanoid(), dataUrl, taskId: typeof (payload as Record<string, unknown>).taskId === 'string' ? (payload as Record<string, unknown>).taskId as string : undefined }));

    if (images.length === 0) {
        // Check whether the response contains data in an unrecognized format.
        const rawKeys = Object.keys(payload).filter((k) => k !== "code" && k !== "msg" && k !== "error");
        throw new Error(rawKeys.length > 0
            ? apiText("unknownImageResponse", { fields: rawKeys.join(", ") })
            : apiText("noImageReturned"));
    }

    return images;
}

function readApiErrorMessage(value: unknown): string {
    if (!value) return "";
    if (typeof value === "string") {
        // The value may be serialized JSON, such as error.message, or a plain-text error.
        try {
            const parsed = JSON.parse(value);
            const inner = readApiErrorMessage(parsed) || value;
            // Treat an empty parsed object such as "{}" as having no useful message.
            if (inner === value && typeof parsed === "object" && Object.keys(parsed).length === 0) return "";
            return friendlyErrorMessage(inner);
        } catch {
            // Detect HTML error pages.
            if (/<[a-z][\s\S]*>/i.test(value)) return apiText("htmlError", { preview: `${value.slice(0, 80)}...` });
            return friendlyErrorMessage(value);
        }
    }
    if (typeof value !== "object") return "";
    const payload = value as { msg?: unknown; message?: unknown; error?: unknown; detail?: unknown };
    // error may be a string or an object containing a message.
    const errorMsg =
        typeof payload.error === "string"
            ? payload.error
            : (payload.error as { message?: unknown })?.message;
    return friendlyErrorMessage(
        readApiErrorMessage(payload.msg) ||
        readApiErrorMessage(payload.message) ||
        readApiErrorMessage(errorMsg) ||
        readApiErrorMessage(payload.detail) ||
        ""
    );
}

function readAxiosError(error: unknown, fallback: string) {
    if (axios.isCancel(error)) return apiText("requestCanceled");
    if (axios.isAxiosError(error)) {
        if (error.code === "ECONNABORTED" || error.code === "ETIMEDOUT") return apiText("imageTimeout");
        if (!error.response && error.code === "ERR_NETWORK") return apiText("requestFailed");
        const responseData = error.response?.data;
        // Prefer the API error from the response body.
        const apiMsg = readApiErrorMessage(responseData);
        if (apiMsg) return apiMsg;
        // Infer the error from the HTTP status when the response body has no usable message.
        const statusMsg = readStatusError(error.response?.status, fallback);
        if (statusMsg) return statusMsg;
        // Fall back to Axios's own error message.
        return error.message || fallback;
    }
    if (error instanceof DOMException && error.name === "AbortError") return apiText("requestCanceled");
    return error instanceof Error ? readApiErrorMessage(error.message) || error.message : fallback;
}

function readStatusError(status: number | undefined, fallback: string) {
    if (status === 401 || status === 403) return apiText("authenticationFailed");
    if (status === 429) return apiText("rateLimited");
    if (status === 404) return apiText("notFound");
    if (status === 502) return apiText("badGateway");
    if (status === 503) return apiText("serviceBusy");
    return status ? apiText("httpFailed", { status }) : fallback;
}

function withSystemPrompt(config: AiConfig, prompt: string) {
    const systemPrompt = config.systemPrompt.trim();
    return systemPrompt ? `${systemPrompt}\n\n${prompt}` : prompt;
}

function aiApiUrl(config: AiConfig, path: string) {
    return buildApiUrl(config.baseUrl, path);
}

function aiHeaders(config: AiConfig, contentType?: string) {
    return {
        Authorization: `Bearer ${config.apiKey}`,
        ...(contentType ? { "Content-Type": contentType } : {}),
    };
}

function geminiBaseUrl(config: Pick<AiConfig, "baseUrl">) {
    const normalizedBaseUrl = config.baseUrl.trim().replace(/\/+$/, "");
    const lowerBaseUrl = normalizedBaseUrl.toLowerCase();
    return lowerBaseUrl.endsWith("/v1") || lowerBaseUrl.endsWith("/v1beta") ? normalizedBaseUrl : `${normalizedBaseUrl}/v1beta`;
}

function geminiModelName(model: string) {
    return model.trim().replace(/^models\//, "");
}

function geminiApiUrl(config: Pick<AiConfig, "baseUrl" | "model">, action?: "generateContent" | "streamGenerateContent") {
    const baseUrl = geminiBaseUrl(config);
    if (!action) return withLocalProxy(`${baseUrl}/models`);
    return withLocalProxy(`${baseUrl}/models/${encodeURIComponent(geminiModelName(config.model))}:${action}`);
}

function geminiHeaders(config: Pick<AiConfig, "apiKey">) {
    return {
        "x-goog-api-key": config.apiKey,
        "Content-Type": "application/json",
    };
}

function withSystemMessage<T extends ResponseInputMessage>(config: AiConfig, messages: T[]): ResponseInputMessage[] {
    const systemPrompt = config.systemPrompt.trim();
    return systemPrompt ? [{ role: "system" as const, content: systemPrompt }, ...messages] : messages;
}

function toResponseInput(messages: ResponseInputMessage[]): ResponseInputItem[] {
    return messages.flatMap((message): ResponseInputItem[] => {
        if ("type" in message) return [message];
        if (message.role === "tool") return [{ type: "function_call_output", call_id: message.tool_call_id, output: message.content }];
        return [{ role: message.role, content: toResponseContent(message.content || "") }];
    });
}

function toResponseContent(content: ResponseMessageContent): string | ResponseInputContent[] {
    if (!Array.isArray(content)) return String(content || "");
    return content.map((item) => (item.type === "text" ? { type: "input_text" as const, text: item.text } : { type: "input_image" as const, image_url: item.image_url.url }));
}

function toResponseTool(tool: ResponseFunctionTool): ResponseApiToolDefinition {
    return {
        type: "function",
        name: tool.function.name,
        description: tool.function.description,
        parameters: tool.function.parameters,
        strict: tool.function.strict,
    };
}

function parseToolResponse(payload: ResponseApiPayload): ToolResponseResult {
    const output = payload.output || [];
    const content =
        payload.output_text ||
        output
            .flatMap((item) => (item.type === "message" ? item.content || [] : []))
            .map((item) => item.text || "")
            .join("");
    const toolCalls = output
        .filter((item): item is Extract<ResponseApiOutputItem, { type?: "function_call" }> => item.type === "function_call")
        .map((item) => ({
            id: item.call_id || item.id || "",
            type: "function" as const,
            function: { name: item.name || "", arguments: item.arguments || "{}" },
        }))
        .filter((item) => item.id && item.function.name);
    return { content, toolCalls };
}

function isRecord(value: unknown): value is Record<string, unknown> {
    return Boolean(value && typeof value === "object" && !Array.isArray(value));
}

function responseErrorMessage(value: unknown) {
    if (!isRecord(value)) return "";
    const error = isRecord(value.error) ? value.error : undefined;
    const response = isRecord(value.response) ? value.response : undefined;
    const responseError = response && isRecord(response.error) ? response.error : undefined;
    return stringValue(value.msg) || stringValue(error?.message) || stringValue(responseError?.message);
}

function stringValue(value: unknown) {
    return typeof value === "string" ? value : "";
}

function validateResponsePayload(payload: ResponseApiPayload) {
    if (typeof payload.code === "number" && payload.code !== 0) throw new Error(payload.msg || apiText("requestFailed"));
    if (payload.error?.message) throw new Error(payload.error.message);
}

function validateGeminiPayload(payload: GeminiPayload) {
    if (payload.error?.message) throw new Error(payload.error.message);
    if (payload.promptFeedback?.blockReason) throw new Error(apiText("geminiRejected", { reason: payload.promptFeedback.blockReason }));
}

async function readFetchError(response: Response, fallback: string) {
    const text = await response.text();
    if (!text) return readStatusError(response.status, fallback);
    try {
        return responseErrorMessage(JSON.parse(text)) || readStatusError(response.status, fallback);
    } catch {
        return text.slice(0, 300) || readStatusError(response.status, fallback);
    }
}

function consumeResponseStreamBlock(block: string, state: ResponseStreamState, onDelta?: (text: string) => void) {
    const data = block
        .split(/\r?\n/)
        .filter((line) => line.startsWith("data:"))
        .map((line) => line.slice(5).replace(/^ /, ""))
        .join("\n")
        .trim();
    if (!data) return;
    if (data === "[DONE]") { state.completed = true; return; }
    const event = JSON.parse(data) as Record<string, unknown>;
    const type = stringValue(event.type);
    if (type === "response.completed") state.completed = true;
    const errorMessage = responseErrorMessage(event);
    if (errorMessage) state.error = errorMessage;
    if (type === "response.output_text.delta" && typeof event.delta === "string") {
        state.text += event.delta;
        onDelta?.(state.text);
    }
    if (type === "response.output_text.done" && !state.text && typeof event.text === "string") {
        state.text = event.text;
        onDelta?.(state.text);
    }
    if (type === "response.completed" && isRecord(event.response)) {
        state.payload = event.response as ResponseApiPayload;
    } else if (Array.isArray(event.output)) {
        state.payload = event as ResponseApiPayload;
    }
}

function consumeResponseStreamText(state: ResponseStreamState, text: string, onDelta?: (text: string) => void, flush = false) {
    state.buffer += text;
    for (;;) {
        const match = state.buffer.match(/\r?\n\r?\n/);
        if (!match) break;
        const index = match.index ?? 0;
        consumeResponseStreamBlock(state.buffer.slice(0, index), state, onDelta);
        state.buffer = state.buffer.slice(index + match[0].length);
    }
    if (flush && state.buffer.trim()) {
        consumeResponseStreamBlock(state.buffer, state, onDelta);
        state.buffer = "";
    }
}

async function requestStreamingResponse(config: AiConfig, body: Record<string, unknown>, onDelta?: (text: string) => void, options?: RequestOptions): Promise<ToolResponseResult> {
    const response = await fetch(aiApiUrl(config, "/responses"), {
        method: "POST",
        headers: { ...aiHeaders(config, "application/json"), Accept: "text/event-stream", ...expectedAccountHeaders(aiApiUrl(config, "/responses"), options?.expectedUserId), ...(options?.surface ? { "X-Sundas-Surface": options.surface } : {}) },
        body: JSON.stringify({ ...body, stream: true }),
        signal: options?.signal,
    });
    if (!response.ok) throw new Error(await readFetchError(response, apiText("requestFailed")));
    if (!response.body) {
        const payload = (await response.json()) as ResponseApiPayload;
        validateResponsePayload(payload);
        return parseToolResponse(payload);
    }

    const reader = response.body.getReader();
    const decoder = new TextDecoder();
    const state: ResponseStreamState = { buffer: "", text: "", completed: false };
    try {
        for (;;) {
            const { done, value } = await reader.read();
            if (done) break;
            consumeResponseStreamText(state, decoder.decode(value, { stream: true }), onDelta);
            if (state.error) throw new Error(state.error);
        }
        consumeResponseStreamText(state, decoder.decode(), onDelta, true);
        if (state.error) throw new Error(state.error);
        if (!state.completed) throw new Error(apiText("streamIncomplete"));
        if (!state.payload) return { content: state.text, toolCalls: [] };
        validateResponsePayload(state.payload);
        const result = parseToolResponse(state.payload);
        return { ...result, content: state.text || result.content };
    } catch (error) {
        void reader.cancel().catch(() => undefined);
        throw error;
    } finally {
        reader.releaseLock();
    }
}

function toGeminiBody(config: AiConfig, messages: ResponseInputMessage[], extra?: Record<string, unknown>) {
    const systemText = [
        config.systemPrompt.trim(),
        ...messages.flatMap((message) => (!("type" in message) && message.role === "system" ? [geminiTextContent(message.content)] : [])),
    ]
        .filter(Boolean)
        .join("\n\n");
    const contents = toGeminiContents(messages.filter((message) => ("type" in message ? true : message.role !== "system")));
    return {
        contents,
        ...(systemText ? { systemInstruction: { parts: [{ text: systemText }] } } : {}),
        ...extra,
    };
}

function toGeminiContents(messages: ResponseInputMessage[]): GeminiContent[] {
    const callNameById = new Map<string, string>();
    return messages.flatMap((message): GeminiContent[] => {
        if ("type" in message) {
            callNameById.set(message.call_id, message.name);
            return [{ role: "model", parts: [{ functionCall: { id: message.call_id, name: message.name, args: jsonObject(message.arguments) }, ...(message.thoughtSignature ? { thoughtSignature: message.thoughtSignature } : {}) }] }];
        }
        if (message.role === "tool") {
            const name = callNameById.get(message.tool_call_id) || "tool_result";
            return [{ role: "user", parts: [{ functionResponse: { id: message.tool_call_id, name, response: { result: jsonValue(message.content) } } }] }];
        }
        return [{ role: message.role === "assistant" ? "model" : "user", parts: toGeminiParts(message.content) }];
    });
}

function toGeminiParts(content: ResponseMessageContent): GeminiPart[] {
    if (!Array.isArray(content)) return [{ text: String(content || "") }];
    return content.map((item) => (item.type === "text" ? { text: item.text } : toGeminiImagePart(item.image_url.url)));
}

function toGeminiImagePart(url: string): GeminiPart {
    const match = url.match(/^data:([^;,]+);base64,(.+)$/);
    if (match) return { inlineData: { mimeType: match[1], data: match[2] } };
    return { fileData: { fileUri: url, mimeType: "image/png" } };
}

function geminiTextContent(content: ResponseMessageContent) {
    if (!Array.isArray(content)) return String(content || "");
    return content.map((item) => (item.type === "text" ? item.text : item.image_url.url)).join("\n");
}

function jsonObject(value: string): Record<string, unknown> {
    const parsed = jsonValue(value);
    return isRecord(parsed) ? parsed : {};
}

function jsonValue(value: string): unknown {
    try {
        return JSON.parse(value);
    } catch {
        return value;
    }
}

function toGeminiToolOptions(tools: ResponseFunctionTool[], toolChoice: ToolChoice) {
    if (!tools.length) return {};
    const functionDeclarations = tools.map((tool) => ({
        name: tool.function.name,
        description: tool.function.description,
        parameters: tool.function.parameters,
    }));
    const functionCallingConfig =
        typeof toolChoice === "object"
            ? { mode: "ANY", allowedFunctionNames: [toolChoice.name] }
            : { mode: toolChoice === "required" ? "ANY" : "AUTO" };
    return {
        tools: [{ functionDeclarations }],
        toolConfig: { functionCallingConfig },
    };
}

async function requestGeminiStreamingResponse(config: AiConfig, body: Record<string, unknown>, onDelta?: (text: string) => void, options?: RequestOptions): Promise<ToolResponseResult> {
    const response = await fetch(`${geminiApiUrl(config, "streamGenerateContent")}?alt=sse`, {
        method: "POST",
        headers: geminiHeaders(config),
        body: JSON.stringify(body),
        signal: options?.signal,
    });
    if (!response.ok) throw new Error(await readFetchError(response, apiText("requestFailed")));
    if (!response.body) {
        const payload = (await response.json()) as GeminiPayload;
        return parseGeminiToolResponse(payload);
    }

    const reader = response.body.getReader();
    const decoder = new TextDecoder();
    const state: GeminiStreamState = { buffer: "", text: "", toolCalls: [] };
    for (;;) {
        const { done, value } = await reader.read();
        if (done) break;
        consumeGeminiStreamText(state, decoder.decode(value, { stream: true }), onDelta);
        if (state.error) throw new Error(state.error);
    }
    consumeGeminiStreamText(state, decoder.decode(), onDelta, true);
    if (state.error) throw new Error(state.error);
    return { content: state.text, toolCalls: state.toolCalls };
}

function consumeGeminiStreamText(state: GeminiStreamState, text: string, onDelta?: (text: string) => void, flush = false) {
    state.buffer += text;
    for (;;) {
        const match = state.buffer.match(/\r?\n\r?\n/);
        if (!match) break;
        const index = match.index ?? 0;
        consumeGeminiStreamBlock(state.buffer.slice(0, index), state, onDelta);
        state.buffer = state.buffer.slice(index + match[0].length);
    }
    if (flush && state.buffer.trim()) {
        consumeGeminiStreamBlock(state.buffer, state, onDelta);
        state.buffer = "";
    }
}

function consumeGeminiStreamBlock(block: string, state: GeminiStreamState, onDelta?: (text: string) => void) {
    const data = block
        .split(/\r?\n/)
        .filter((line) => line.startsWith("data:"))
        .map((line) => line.slice(5).replace(/^ /, ""))
        .join("\n")
        .trim();
    if (!data || data === "[DONE]") return;
    const result = parseGeminiToolResponse(JSON.parse(data) as GeminiPayload);
    if (result.content) {
        state.text += result.content;
        onDelta?.(state.text);
    }
    state.toolCalls.push(...result.toolCalls);
}

function parseGeminiToolResponse(payload: GeminiPayload): ToolResponseResult {
    validateGeminiPayload(payload);
    const parts = payload.candidates?.flatMap((candidate) => candidate.content?.parts || []) || [];
    const content = parts.map((part) => part.text || "").join("");
    const toolCalls = parts
        .map((part) => part.functionCall)
        .filter((call): call is NonNullable<GeminiPart["functionCall"]> => Boolean(call?.name))
        .map((call) => {
            const part = parts.find((item) => item.functionCall === call);
            const thoughtSignature = part?.thoughtSignature || part?.thought_signature;
            return {
                id: call.id || nanoid(),
                type: "function" as const,
                function: { name: call.name || "", arguments: JSON.stringify(call.args || {}) },
                ...(thoughtSignature ? { thoughtSignature } : {}),
            };
        });
    return { content, toolCalls };
}

async function requestGeminiImages(config: AiConfig, prompt: string, references: ReferenceImage[], count: number, options?: RequestOptions) {
    const requests = Array.from({ length: count }, () => requestGeminiImagesOnce(config, prompt, references, options));
    return (await Promise.all(requests)).flat();
}

async function requestGeminiImagesOnce(config: AiConfig, prompt: string, references: ReferenceImage[], options?: RequestOptions) {
    const parts: GeminiPart[] = [{ text: prompt }];
    for (const image of references) {
        parts.push(toGeminiImagePart(await imageToDataUrl(image)));
    }
    const response = await axios.post<GeminiPayload>(
        geminiApiUrl(config, "generateContent"),
        {
            ...toGeminiBody(config, [{ role: "user", content: prompt }], { generationConfig: { responseModalities: ["TEXT", "IMAGE"], ...resolveGeminiImageConfig(config) } }),
            contents: [{ role: "user", parts }],
        },
        { headers: geminiHeaders(config), signal: options?.signal, timeout: IMAGE_REQUEST_TIMEOUT_MS },
    );
    return parseGeminiImagePayload(response.data);
}

function parseGeminiImagePayload(payload: GeminiPayload) {
    validateGeminiPayload(payload);
    const images =
        payload.candidates
            ?.flatMap((candidate) => candidate.content?.parts || [])
            .map((part) => {
                const inlineData = part.inlineData || (part.inline_data ? { mimeType: part.inline_data.mimeType || part.inline_data.mime_type, data: part.inline_data.data } : undefined);
                if (inlineData?.data) return `data:${inlineData.mimeType || "image/png"};base64,${inlineData.data}`;
                return part.fileData?.fileUri || null;
            })
            .filter((value): value is string => Boolean(value))
            .map((dataUrl) => ({ id: nanoid(), dataUrl })) || [];
    if (!images.length) throw new Error(apiText("geminiNoImage"));
    return images;
}

async function requestGenerationInner(config: AiConfig, prompt: string, options?: RequestOptions) {
    const requestConfig = resolveModelRequestConfig(config, config.model || config.imageModel);
    const n = Math.max(1, Math.min(15, Math.floor(Math.abs(Number(config.count)) || 1)));
    const script = resolveModelScript(config, config.model || config.imageModel);
    if (script) {
        const quality = normalizeQuality(config.quality);
        const requestSize = resolveRequestSize(config.size);
        const background = normalizeBackground(config.background);
        try {
            const result = await runModelPlugin({
                capability: "image",
                script,
                config: requestConfig,
                prompt: withSystemPrompt(requestConfig, prompt),
                images: [],
                params: { size: requestSize, resolution: inferMediaScale(config.size), quality, count: n, ...(background ? { background } : {}) },
                signal: options?.signal,
            });
            return normalizePluginImages(result).map((dataUrl) => ({ id: nanoid(), dataUrl }));
        } catch (error) {
            throw new Error(readAxiosError(error, apiText("requestFailed")));
        }
    }
    const quality = normalizeQuality(config.quality);
    const requestSize = resolveRequestSize(config.size);
    const background = normalizeBackground(config.background);
    const capabilities = imageCapabilityParams(config);
    try {
        const response = await axios.post<ImageApiResponse>(
            aiApiUrl(requestConfig, "/images/generations"),
            {
                model: requestConfig.model,
                prompt: withSystemPrompt(requestConfig, prompt),
                n,
                ...(quality ? { quality } : {}),
                ...(requestSize ? { size: requestSize } : {}),
                ...(capabilities ? { resolution: capabilities.resolution, aspect_ratio: capabilities.aspect_ratio } : {}),
                ...(background ? { background } : {}),
                // gpt-image models reject response_format; they always return b64.
                ...(/gpt-image/.test(requestConfig.model) ? {} : { response_format: "b64_json" }),
                output_format: IMAGE_OUTPUT_FORMAT,
            },
            {
                headers: { ...aiHeaders(requestConfig, "application/json"), ...expectedAccountHeaders(aiApiUrl(requestConfig, "/images/generations"), options?.expectedUserId), ...(options?.surface ? { "X-Sundas-Surface": options.surface } : {}) },
                signal: options?.signal,
                timeout: IMAGE_REQUEST_TIMEOUT_MS,
            },
        );
        const images = parseImagePayload(await resolvePendingImage(response.data, requestConfig, options));
        return images;
    } catch (error) {
        if (imageTaskIdFromError(error)) throw error;
        throw new Error(readAxiosError(error, apiText("requestFailed")));
    }
}

async function requestEditInner(config: AiConfig, prompt: string, references: ReferenceImage[], options?: RequestOptions) {
    const requestConfig = resolveModelRequestConfig(config, config.model || config.imageModel);
    const n = Math.max(1, Math.min(15, Math.floor(Math.abs(Number(config.count)) || 1)));
    const requestPrompt = buildImageReferencePromptText(prompt, references);
    const script = resolveModelScript(config, config.model || config.imageModel);
    if (script) {
        const quality = normalizeQuality(config.quality);
        const requestSize = resolveRequestSize(config.size);
        const background = normalizeBackground(config.background);
        const refs = await Promise.all(references.map((image) => imageToDataUrl(image)));
        try {
            const result = await runModelPlugin({
                capability: "image",
                script,
                config: requestConfig,
                prompt: withSystemPrompt(requestConfig, requestPrompt),
                images: refs,
                params: { size: requestSize, resolution: inferMediaScale(config.size), quality, count: n, ...(background ? { background } : {}) },
                signal: options?.signal,
            });
            return normalizePluginImages(result).map((dataUrl) => ({ id: nanoid(), dataUrl }));
        } catch (error) {
            throw new Error(readAxiosError(error, apiText("requestFailed")));
        }
    }

    const quality = normalizeQuality(config.quality);
    const requestSize = resolveRequestSize(config.size);
    const background = normalizeBackground(config.background);
    const capabilities = imageCapabilityParams(config);
    if (capabilities?.maxImages !== undefined && references.length > capabilities.maxImages) throw new Error(`该模型最多支持 ${capabilities.maxImages} 张参考图`);
    const formData = new FormData();
    formData.set("model", requestConfig.model);
    formData.set("prompt", withSystemPrompt(requestConfig, requestPrompt));
    formData.set("n", String(n));
    if (capabilities) { formData.set('resolution', capabilities.resolution); if (capabilities.aspect_ratio) formData.set('aspect_ratio', capabilities.aspect_ratio); }
    // gpt-image models reject response_format; they always return b64.
    if (!/gpt-image/.test(requestConfig.model)) {
        formData.set("response_format", "b64_json");
    }
    formData.set("output_format", IMAGE_OUTPUT_FORMAT);
    if (quality) {
        formData.set("quality", quality);
    }
    if (requestSize) {
        formData.set("size", requestSize);
    }
    if (background) {
        formData.set("background", background);
    }
    const files = await Promise.all(references.map(async (image) => dataUrlToFile({ ...image, dataUrl: await imageToDataUrl(image) })));
    const imageField = files.length > 1 ? "image[]" : "image";
    files.forEach((file) => formData.append(imageField, file));

    try {
        const response = await axios.post<ImageApiResponse>(aiApiUrl(requestConfig, "/images/edits"), formData, { headers: { ...aiHeaders(requestConfig), ...expectedAccountHeaders(aiApiUrl(requestConfig, "/images/edits"), options?.expectedUserId), ...(options?.surface ? { "X-Sundas-Surface": options.surface } : {}) }, signal: options?.signal, timeout: IMAGE_REQUEST_TIMEOUT_MS });
        const images = parseImagePayload(await resolvePendingImage(response.data, requestConfig, options));
        return images;
    } catch (error) {
        if (imageTaskIdFromError(error)) throw error;
        throw new Error(readAxiosError(error, apiText("requestFailed")));
    }
}
