import { nanoid } from "nanoid";

import { assertLocalMediaOwner, assertMediaOwner, currentMediaOwner, isOwnMediaUrl, localMediaKey, notifyLocalMediaOnly, StorageQuotaError, uploadBlobToServer } from "@/services/cloud-media";
import { lazyStore } from "@/lib/localforage-store";
import { withLocalProxy } from "@/stores/use-config-store";
import { MediaObjectUrls, registerSessionMediaCache } from "@/lib/media-object-urls";

export type UploadedFile = { mediaId?: string; taskId?: string; objectKey?: string; url: string; storageKey: string; bytes: number; mimeType: string; width?: number; height?: number; durationMs?: number };

const store = lazyStore("media_files");
const objectUrls = registerSessionMediaCache(new MediaObjectUrls());

export class InvalidMediaResponseError extends Error {
    constructor() { super("媒体地址返回了错误或无效内容，请检查来源后重试"); this.name = "InvalidMediaResponseError"; }
}

export async function uploadMediaFile(input: string | Blob, prefix = "file", options?: { expectedOwner?: string | null; signal?: AbortSignal }): Promise<UploadedFile> {
    const owner = options?.expectedOwner === undefined ? currentMediaOwner() : options.expectedOwner;
    assertMediaOwner(owner, options?.signal);
    if (typeof input === "string" && isOwnMediaUrl(input)) {
        const meta = await readMediaMetaByUrl(input);
        assertMediaOwner(owner, options?.signal);
        return { url: input, storageKey: "", bytes: 0, mimeType: "", ...meta };
    }

    let blob: Blob;
    if (typeof input === "string") {
        const response = await fetch(withLocalProxy(input), { signal: options?.signal });
        const contentType = response.headers.get("content-type")?.split(";")[0].trim().toLowerCase() ?? "";
        if (!response.ok || contentType.startsWith("text/") || contentType === "application/json" || contentType.endsWith("+json")) throw new InvalidMediaResponseError();
        blob = await response.blob();
        if (!blob.size) throw new InvalidMediaResponseError();
    } else blob = input;
    assertMediaOwner(owner, options?.signal);
    const uploaded = await uploadBlobToServer(blob, prefix, owner, options?.signal).catch((error) => { if (error instanceof StorageQuotaError) throw error; return null; });
    assertMediaOwner(owner, options?.signal);
    const probeUrl = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
    const meta = blob.type.startsWith("video/") ? await readVideoMeta(probeUrl) : blob.type.startsWith("audio/") ? await readAudioMeta(probeUrl) : {};
    URL.revokeObjectURL(probeUrl);
    assertMediaOwner(owner, options?.signal);

    if (uploaded) {
        return { url: uploaded.url, storageKey: "", bytes: blob.size, mimeType: blob.type || "application/octet-stream", ...meta };
    }

    const storageKey = localMediaKey(prefix, owner, nanoid());
    await store.setItem(storageKey, blob);
    try { assertMediaOwner(owner, options?.signal); } catch (error) { await store.removeItem(storageKey); throw error; }
    notifyLocalMediaOnly(owner);
    const url = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
    objectUrls.set(storageKey, url);
    return { url, storageKey, bytes: blob.size, mimeType: blob.type || "application/octet-stream", ...meta };
}

function readMediaMetaByUrl(url: string) {
    if (/\.(mp4|webm|mov|m4v)(\?|$)/i.test(url)) return readVideoMeta(url);
    if (/\.(mp3|wav|ogg|m4a|aac|flac)(\?|$)/i.test(url)) return readAudioMeta(url);
    return Promise.resolve({});
}

export async function resolveMediaUrl(storageKey?: string, fallback = "", hydration?: { owner: string; isActive: () => boolean }) {
    if (!storageKey) return fallback;
    const owner = hydration?.owner ?? currentMediaOwner();
    assertLocalMediaOwner(storageKey, owner);
    if (hydration && !hydration.isActive()) throw new DOMException("账户数据加载已中断", "AbortError");
    const url = await objectUrls.resolve(storageKey, async () => {
        const blob = await store.getItem<Blob>(storageKey);
        if (hydration) { if (!hydration.isActive()) throw new DOMException("账户数据加载已中断", "AbortError"); }
        else assertMediaOwner(owner);
        return blob;
    });
    if (hydration) { if (!hydration.isActive()) throw new DOMException("账户数据加载已中断", "AbortError"); }
    else assertMediaOwner(owner);
    return url || fallback;
}

export async function getMediaBlob(storageKey: string) {
    const owner = currentMediaOwner();
    assertLocalMediaOwner(storageKey, owner);
    const blob = await store.getItem<Blob>(storageKey);
    assertMediaOwner(owner);
    return blob;
}

export async function setMediaBlob(storageKey: string, blob: Blob) {
    await store.setItem(storageKey, blob);
    const url = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
    objectUrls.set(storageKey, url);
    return url;
}

export async function deleteStoredMedia(keys: Iterable<string>) {
    await Promise.all(
        Array.from(new Set(keys)).map(async (key) => {
            objectUrls.delete(key);
            await store.removeItem(key);
        }),
    );
}

export async function cleanupUnusedMedia(usedData: unknown) {
    const usedKeys = collectMediaStorageKeys(usedData);
    const unused: string[] = [];
    await store.iterate((_value, key) => {
        if (!usedKeys.has(key)) unused.push(key);
    });
    await deleteStoredMedia(unused);
}

export function collectMediaStorageKeys(value: unknown, keys = new Set<string>()) {
    if (!value || typeof value !== "object") return keys;
    if ("storageKey" in value && typeof value.storageKey === "string" && value.storageKey.includes(":")) keys.add(value.storageKey);
    Object.values(value).forEach((item) => (Array.isArray(item) ? item.forEach((child) => collectMediaStorageKeys(child, keys)) : collectMediaStorageKeys(item, keys)));
    return keys;
}

function readVideoMeta(url: string) {
    return new Promise<{ width: number; height: number; durationMs?: number }>((resolve) => {
        const video = document.createElement("video");
        const done = () => {
            const meta = { width: video.videoWidth || 1280, height: video.videoHeight || 720, durationMs: Number.isFinite(video.duration) ? Math.round(video.duration * 1000) : undefined };
            video.onloadedmetadata = null;
            video.onerror = null;
            video.removeAttribute("src");
            video.load();
            resolve(meta);
        };
        video.onloadedmetadata = done;
        video.onerror = done;
        video.preload = "metadata";
        video.src = url;
    });
}

function readAudioMeta(url: string) {
    return new Promise<{ durationMs?: number }>((resolve) => {
        const audio = document.createElement("audio");
        const done = () => {
            const meta = { durationMs: Number.isFinite(audio.duration) ? Math.round(audio.duration * 1000) : undefined };
            audio.onloadedmetadata = null;
            audio.onerror = null;
            audio.removeAttribute("src");
            audio.load();
            resolve(meta);
        };
        audio.onloadedmetadata = done;
        audio.onerror = done;
        audio.preload = "metadata";
        audio.src = url;
    });
}

import { nanoid } from "nanoid";
import i18n from "@/i18n";
import { assertLocalMediaOwner, assertMediaOwner, currentMediaOwner, isOwnMediaUrl, localMediaKey, notifyLocalMediaOnly, StorageQuotaError, uploadBlobToServer } from "@/services/cloud-media";
import { lazyStore } from "@/lib/localforage-store";
import { withLocalProxy } from "@/stores/use-config-store";
import { createImageThumbnail } from "@/lib/image-thumbnail";
import { MediaObjectUrls, registerSessionMediaCache } from "@/lib/media-object-urls";

export type UploadedImage = {
    url: string;
    storageKey?: string;
    width: number;
    height: number;
    bytes: number;
    mimeType: string;
    /** 仅为兼容从 BeefTV 平移过来的调用方：sundas 没有远端待上传态，恒为 false。 */
    pendingRemoteUpload?: boolean;
};

const store = lazyStore("image_files");
const previewStore = lazyStore("image_previews");
const imageLogStore = lazyStore("image_generation_logs");
const videoLogStore = lazyStore("video_generation_logs");
const objectUrls = registerSessionMediaCache(new MediaObjectUrls());
const previewUrls = registerSessionMediaCache(new MediaObjectUrls(() => {
    previewRevision += 1;
    previewListeners.forEach((listener) => listener());
}));
const previewListeners = new Set<() => void>();
let previewRevision = 0;
let previewQueue: Promise<unknown> = Promise.resolve();
const IMAGE_PREVIEW_VERSION = 1;
const IMAGE_DOWNLOAD_TIMEOUT_MS = 10 * 60_000;
const IMAGE_REMOTE_LOAD_TIMEOUT_MS = 10 * 60_000;
const IMAGE_DECODE_TIMEOUT_MS = 10_000;
const IMAGE_RESPONSE_ERROR = "ImageResponseError";
const IMAGE_TIMEOUT_ERROR = "ImageTimeoutError";

type StoredImagePreview = { version: number; blob?: Blob };

type ImageReadOptions = { signal?: AbortSignal; expectedOwner?: string | null; onProgress?: (progress: number) => void };

export async function uploadImage(input: string | Blob, options?: ImageReadOptions): Promise<UploadedImage> {
    const owner = options?.expectedOwner === undefined ? currentMediaOwner() : options.expectedOwner;
    assertMediaOwner(owner, options?.signal);
    options = { ...options, expectedOwner: owner };
    if (typeof input !== "string") {
        try {
            return await storeImage(input, options);
        } catch (error) {
            if (error instanceof StorageQuotaError) throw error;
            const uploaded = await uploadBlobToServer(input, "image", owner, options?.signal, true, false, options?.onProgress).catch(() => null);
            if (!uploaded) throw error;
            const meta = await loadImageMeta(uploaded.url, options).catch(() => null);
            return { url: uploaded.url, width: meta?.width ?? 0, height: meta?.height ?? 0, bytes: uploaded.bytes, mimeType: uploaded.mime };
        }
    }
    if (isOwnMediaUrl(input)) {
        const meta = await loadImageMeta(input, options);
        assertMediaOwner(owner, options?.signal);
        if (!meta) throw new Error(i18n.t("common.imageReadFailed"));
        return { url: input, width: meta.width, height: meta.height, bytes: 0, mimeType: "" };
    }

    let blob: Blob;
    try {
        blob = await fetchImageBlob(input, options);
    } catch (error) {
        if (options?.signal?.aborted || isNamedError(error, IMAGE_RESPONSE_ERROR) || isNamedError(error, IMAGE_TIMEOUT_ERROR) || !/^https?:\/\//i.test(input)) throw error;
        const meta = await loadImageMeta(input, options, IMAGE_REMOTE_LOAD_TIMEOUT_MS);
        if (!meta) throw error;
        assertMediaOwner(owner, options?.signal);
        return { url: input, width: meta.width, height: meta.height, bytes: 0, mimeType: "" };
    }
    return storeImage(blob, options);
}

async function storeImage(blob: Blob, options?: ImageReadOptions): Promise<UploadedImage> {
    const owner = options?.expectedOwner === undefined ? currentMediaOwner() : options.expectedOwner;
    assertMediaOwner(owner, options?.signal);
    const storageKey = localMediaKey("image", owner, nanoid());
    const url = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
    try {
        const meta = await loadImageMeta(url, options);
        if (!meta) throw new Error(i18n.t("common.imageReadFailed"));
        throwIfAborted(options?.signal);

        const uploaded = await uploadBlobToServer(blob, "image", owner, options?.signal, false, false, options?.onProgress).catch((error) => { if (error instanceof StorageQuotaError) throw error; return null; });
        assertMediaOwner(owner, options?.signal);
        if (uploaded) {
            URL.revokeObjectURL(url);
            return { url: uploaded.url, width: meta.width, height: meta.height, bytes: blob.size, mimeType: blob.type.startsWith("image/") ? blob.type : "" };
        }

        await store.setItem(storageKey, blob);
        assertMediaOwner(owner, options?.signal);
        throwIfAborted(options?.signal);
        objectUrls.set(storageKey, url);
        await storeImagePreview(storageKey, blob);
        assertMediaOwner(owner, options?.signal);
        notifyLocalMediaOnly(owner);
        return { url, storageKey, width: meta.width, height: meta.height, bytes: blob.size, mimeType: blob.type.startsWith("image/") ? blob.type : "" };
    } catch (error) {
        objectUrls.delete(storageKey);
        URL.revokeObjectURL(url);
        await deleteImagePreview(storageKey);
        await store.removeItem(storageKey).catch(() => undefined);
        throw error;
    }
}

async function fetchImageBlob(url: string, options?: ImageReadOptions) {
    const controller = new AbortController();
    let timedOut = false;
    const abort = () => controller.abort();
    if (options?.signal?.aborted) abort();
    else options?.signal?.addEventListener("abort", abort, { once: true });
    const timer = window.setTimeout(() => {
        timedOut = true;
        controller.abort();
    }, IMAGE_DOWNLOAD_TIMEOUT_MS);
    try {
        const response = await fetch(withLocalProxy(url), { signal: controller.signal });
        if (!response.ok) throw namedError(IMAGE_RESPONSE_ERROR);
        return await response.blob();
    } catch (error) {
        if (timedOut) throw namedError(IMAGE_TIMEOUT_ERROR);
        if (options?.signal?.aborted) throw abortReason(options.signal);
        throw error;
    } finally {
        window.clearTimeout(timer);
        options?.signal?.removeEventListener("abort", abort);
    }
}

function loadImageMeta(url: string, options?: ImageReadOptions, timeoutMs = IMAGE_DECODE_TIMEOUT_MS) {
    return new Promise<{ width: number; height: number } | null>((resolve, reject) => {
        if (options?.signal?.aborted) return reject(abortReason(options.signal));
        const image = new Image();
        let settled = false;
        const finish = (value: { width: number; height: number } | null) => {
            if (settled) return;
            settled = true;
            window.clearTimeout(timer);
            options?.signal?.removeEventListener("abort", abort);
            image.onload = null;
            image.onerror = null;
            resolve(value);
        };
        const abort = () => {
            if (settled) return;
            settled = true;
            window.clearTimeout(timer);
            image.onload = null;
            image.onerror = null;
            reject(abortReason(options!.signal!));
        };
        const timer = window.setTimeout(() => finish(null), timeoutMs);
        options?.signal?.addEventListener("abort", abort, { once: true });
        image.onload = () => finish(image.naturalWidth && image.naturalHeight ? { width: image.naturalWidth, height: image.naturalHeight } : null);
        image.onerror = () => finish(null);
        image.src = url;
    });
}

function namedError(name: string) {
    const error = new Error(i18n.t("common.imageReadFailed"));
    error.name = name;
    return error;
}

function isNamedError(error: unknown, name: string) {
    return error instanceof Error && error.name === name;
}

function abortReason(signal: AbortSignal) {
    return signal.reason instanceof Error ? signal.reason : new DOMException("Aborted", "AbortError");
}

function throwIfAborted(signal?: AbortSignal) {
    if (signal?.aborted) throw abortReason(signal);
}

type ImageHydration = { owner?: string; isActive?: () => boolean; cacheMiss?: boolean };

export async function resolveImageUrl(storageKey?: string, fallback = "", hydration?: ImageHydration) {
    if (!storageKey) return fallback;
    const owner = hydration?.owner ?? currentMediaOwner();
    assertLocalMediaOwner(storageKey, owner);
    const assertActive = () => {
        if (hydration?.isActive) {
            if (!hydration.isActive()) throw new DOMException("账户数据加载已中断", "AbortError");
        } else assertMediaOwner(owner);
    };
    assertActive();
    // Refresh a stale cover URL while concurrent refreshes still share one read.
    if (hydration?.cacheMiss && objectUrls.get(storageKey)) objectUrls.delete(storageKey);
    const url = await objectUrls.resolve(storageKey, async () => {
        const blob = await store.getItem<Blob>(storageKey);
        assertActive();
        return blob;
    });
    assertActive();
    return url || fallback;
}

/** 优先返回本地缩略图，没有则回落到原图 URL —— 对齐 BeefTV 的封面解析语义。 */
export async function resolvePreviewImageUrl(storageKey?: string, fallback = "", hydration?: ImageHydration) {
    if (!storageKey) return fallback;
    const owner = hydration?.owner ?? currentMediaOwner();
    assertLocalMediaOwner(storageKey, owner);
    if (hydration?.isActive) {
        if (!hydration.isActive()) throw new DOMException("账户数据加载已中断", "AbortError");
    } else assertMediaOwner(owner);
    const preview = hydration?.cacheMiss ? undefined : previewUrlFor(storageKey);
    if (preview) return preview;
    return resolveImageUrl(storageKey, fallback, hydration);
}

export async function getImageBlob(storageKey: string) {
    const owner = currentMediaOwner();
    assertLocalMediaOwner(storageKey, owner);
    const blob = await store.getItem<Blob>(storageKey);
    assertMediaOwner(owner);
    return blob;
}

// 缩略图按图片的 storageKey 另存一份 WebP，只放在本地 IndexedDB 里，不写进节点数据，也不参与导出。
export function previewUrlFor(storageKey?: string) {
    if (!storageKey) return undefined;
    try { assertLocalMediaOwner(storageKey); } catch { return undefined; }
    return previewUrls.get(storageKey);
}

// 缩略图在后台补，生成完成后再让用到它的界面重渲染一次。
export function subscribeImagePreviews(listener: () => void) {
    previewListeners.add(listener);
    return () => {
        previewListeners.delete(listener);
    };
}

export function getImagePreviewRevision() {
    return previewRevision;
}

export async function ensureImagePreview(storageKey?: string) {
    if (!storageKey) return undefined;
    const owner = currentMediaOwner();
    try { assertLocalMediaOwner(storageKey, owner); } catch { return undefined; }
    return previewUrls.resolve(storageKey, async (isCurrent) => {
        const stored = await previewStore.getItem<StoredImagePreview>(storageKey).catch(() => null);
        if (currentMediaOwner() !== owner || !isCurrent()) return undefined;
        if (stored?.version === IMAGE_PREVIEW_VERSION) return stored.blob;
        // Keep the existing serial decoder queue; duplicate requests share this complete operation.
        const result = previewQueue.then(async () => {
            if (currentMediaOwner() !== owner || !isCurrent()) return undefined;
            const original = await getImageBlob(storageKey);
            return original ? createStoredImagePreview(storageKey, original, () => currentMediaOwner() === owner && isCurrent()) : undefined;
        });
        previewQueue = result.catch(() => undefined);
        return result;
    }).catch(() => undefined);
}

async function storeImagePreview(storageKey: string, original: Blob) {
    const owner = currentMediaOwner();
    return previewUrls.resolve(storageKey, (isCurrent) => createStoredImagePreview(storageKey, original, () => currentMediaOwner() === owner && isCurrent())).catch(() => undefined);
}

async function createStoredImagePreview(storageKey: string, original: Blob, isCurrent: () => boolean) {
    // Decode errors must remain retryable rather than being persisted as a successful empty preview.
    const preview = await createImageThumbnail(original);
    if (!isCurrent()) return undefined;
    await previewStore.setItem<StoredImagePreview>(storageKey, { version: IMAGE_PREVIEW_VERSION, blob: preview }).catch(() => undefined);
    return isCurrent() ? preview : undefined;
}

async function deleteImagePreview(storageKey: string) {
    previewUrls.delete(storageKey);
    await previewStore.removeItem(storageKey).catch(() => undefined);
}

export async function setImageBlob(storageKey: string, blob: Blob) {
    await store.setItem(storageKey, blob);
    await deleteImagePreview(storageKey);
    await storeImagePreview(storageKey, blob);
    const url = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
    objectUrls.set(storageKey, url);
    return url;
}

export async function retryLocalImage(storageKey: string, options?: ImageReadOptions): Promise<UploadedImage> {
    const owner = options?.expectedOwner === undefined ? currentMediaOwner() : options.expectedOwner;
    assertMediaOwner(owner, options?.signal);
    const blob = await getImageBlob(storageKey);
    if (!blob?.size) throw new Error(i18n.t("common.imageReadFailed"));
    const uploaded = await uploadBlobToServer(blob, "image", owner, options?.signal, true, false, options?.onProgress);
    if (!uploaded) throw new Error(i18n.t("common.imageReadFailed"));
    const meta = await loadImageMeta(uploaded.url, options).catch(() => null);
    return { url: uploaded.url, width: meta?.width ?? 0, height: meta?.height ?? 0, bytes: uploaded.bytes, mimeType: uploaded.mime };
}

export async function imageToDataUrl(image: { url?: string; dataUrl?: string; storageKey?: string }, options?: ImageReadOptions) {
    const owner = options?.expectedOwner === undefined ? currentMediaOwner() : options.expectedOwner;
    assertMediaOwner(owner, options?.signal);
    if (image.storageKey) assertLocalMediaOwner(image.storageKey, owner);
    const url = image.dataUrl || (await resolveImageUrl(image.storageKey, image.url || ""));
    if (!url || url.startsWith("data:")) { assertMediaOwner(owner, options?.signal); return url; }
    const result = await blobToDataUrl(await fetchImageBlob(url, options));
    assertMediaOwner(owner, options?.signal);
    return result;
}

export async function deleteStoredImages(keys: Iterable<string>) {
    await Promise.all(
        Array.from(new Set(keys)).map(async (key) => {
            objectUrls.delete(key);
            await deleteImagePreview(key);
            await store.removeItem(key);
        }),
    );
}

export async function cleanupUnusedImages(usedData: unknown) {
    const usedKeys = collectImageStorageKeys(usedData);
    await Promise.all([
        imageLogStore.iterate((value) => {
            collectImageStorageKeys(value, usedKeys);
        }),
        videoLogStore.iterate((value) => {
            collectImageStorageKeys(value, usedKeys);
        }),
    ]);
    const unused: string[] = [];
    await store.iterate((_value, key) => {
        if (!usedKeys.has(key)) unused.push(key);
    });
    const orphanPreviews: string[] = [];
    await previewStore.iterate((_value, key) => {
        if (!usedKeys.has(key)) orphanPreviews.push(key);
    });
    await Promise.all([deleteStoredImages(unused), ...orphanPreviews.map(deleteImagePreview)]);
}

export function collectImageStorageKeys(value: unknown, keys = new Set<string>()) {
    if (!value || typeof value !== "object") return keys;
    if ("storageKey" in value && typeof value.storageKey === "string" && value.storageKey.startsWith("image:")) keys.add(value.storageKey);
    Object.values(value).forEach((item) => (Array.isArray(item) ? item.forEach((child) => collectImageStorageKeys(child, keys)) : collectImageStorageKeys(item, keys)));
    return keys;
}

function blobToDataUrl(blob: Blob) {
    return new Promise<string>((resolve, reject) => {
        const reader = new FileReader();
        reader.onload = () => resolve(String(reader.result || ""));
        reader.onerror = () => reject(new Error(i18n.t("common.imageReadFailed")));
        reader.readAsDataURL(blob);
    });
}

export type IndexedDbStoreUsage = { name: string; records: number; bytes: number };
export type IndexedDbDatabaseUsage = { name: string; version: number; bytes: number; stores: IndexedDbStoreUsage[] };
export type LocalStorageUsage = { usage: number; quota: number | null; contentBytes: number; databases: IndexedDbDatabaseUsage[] };

export async function readLocalStorageUsage(): Promise<LocalStorageUsage> {
    const [estimate, database] = await Promise.all([readStorageEstimate(), readDatabaseUsage("sundas")]);
    return { usage: estimate?.usage ?? database.bytes, quota: estimate?.quota ?? null, contentBytes: database.bytes, databases: [database] };
}

async function readStorageEstimate() {
    if (typeof navigator === "undefined" || !navigator.storage?.estimate) return null;
    try {
        return await navigator.storage.estimate();
    } catch {
        return null;
    }
}

function readDatabaseUsage(name: string) {
    return new Promise<IndexedDbDatabaseUsage>((resolve, reject) => {
        const request = indexedDB.open(name);
        request.onerror = () => reject(request.error);
        request.onsuccess = () => {
            const database = request.result;
            const names = Array.from(database.objectStoreNames);
            if (!names.length) {
                database.close();
                resolve({ name, version: database.version, bytes: 0, stores: [] });
                return;
            }
            const transaction = database.transaction(names, "readonly");
            Promise.all(names.map((storeName) => readStoreUsage(transaction.objectStore(storeName))))
                .then((stores) => resolve({ name, version: database.version, bytes: stores.reduce((total, store) => total + store.bytes, 0), stores: stores.sort((a, b) => b.bytes - a.bytes) }))
                .catch(reject)
                .finally(() => database.close());
        };
    });
}

function readStoreUsage(store: IDBObjectStore) {
    return new Promise<IndexedDbStoreUsage>((resolve, reject) => {
        let records = 0;
        let bytes = 0;
        const request = store.openCursor();
        request.onerror = () => reject(request.error);
        request.onsuccess = () => {
            const cursor = request.result;
            if (!cursor) {
                resolve({ name: store.name, records, bytes });
                return;
            }
            records += 1;
            bytes += valueBytes(cursor.value);
            cursor.continue();
        };
    });
}

function valueBytes(value: unknown) {
    if (value instanceof Blob) return value.size;
    if (value instanceof ArrayBuffer) return value.byteLength;
    if (ArrayBuffer.isView(value)) return value.byteLength;
    return new TextEncoder().encode(typeof value === "string" ? value : JSON.stringify(value)).byteLength;
}

/** 返回 true 表示已使用同源授权下载；其他 URL 继续原有下载行为。 */
export function downloadCloudMedia(value: string, filename: string) {
    const url = new URL(value, window.location.origin);
    if (url.origin !== window.location.origin || !url.pathname.startsWith('/media/private/')) return false;
    url.searchParams.set('download', filename);
    const anchor = document.createElement('a');
    anchor.href = url.toString();
    anchor.download = filename;
    anchor.rel = 'noreferrer';
    document.body.appendChild(anchor);
    anchor.click();
    anchor.remove();
    return true;
}

const pendingMediaRefresh = new WeakMap<HTMLMediaElement | HTMLImageElement, string>();

/** 只重取本站私有媒体；同一次失败不循环重试，读取成功后允许之后再次过期恢复。 */
export function refreshExpiredMedia(event: { currentTarget: HTMLMediaElement | HTMLImageElement }) {
    const video = event.currentTarget;
    const src = new URL(video.getAttribute('src') || '', window.location.origin);
    if (src.origin !== window.location.origin || !src.pathname.startsWith('/media/private/') || (video instanceof HTMLMediaElement && video.error && [1, 3].includes(video.error.code))) return;
    src.searchParams.delete('_refresh');
    const source = src.toString();
    if (pendingMediaRefresh.get(video) === source) return;
    pendingMediaRefresh.set(video, source);
    const position = video instanceof HTMLMediaElement ? video.currentTime : 0;
    src.searchParams.set('_refresh', String(Date.now()));
    const refreshedUrl = src.toString();
    if (video instanceof HTMLMediaElement) video.addEventListener('loadedmetadata', () => { if (video.src === refreshedUrl && position > 0) video.currentTime = position; }, { once: true });
    video.addEventListener(video instanceof HTMLMediaElement ? 'loadeddata' : 'load', () => { if (pendingMediaRefresh.get(video) === source) pendingMediaRefresh.delete(video); }, { once: true });
    video.src = refreshedUrl;
    if (video instanceof HTMLMediaElement) video.load();
}

import { create } from "zustand";
import { persist, type PersistStorage, type StorageValue } from "zustand/middleware";

import i18n from "@/i18n";
import { localForageStorage } from "@/lib/localforage-storage";
import { nextUpdatedAt } from "@/lib/next-updated-at";
import { createSerializedWriter } from "@/lib/serialized-writer";
import type { DirectorScene } from "@/types/director";
import type { CanvasBackgroundMode } from "@/lib/canvas-theme";
import type { CanvasAssistantSession, CanvasConnection, CanvasNodeData, ViewportTransform } from "@/types/canvas";
import type { ProductionDocument } from "../../../../shared/production";

export type CanvasProject = {
    id: string;
    title: string;
    createdAt: string;
    updatedAt: string;
    nodes: CanvasNodeData[];
    connections: CanvasConnection[];
    chatSessions: CanvasAssistantSession[];
    activeChatId: string | null;
    backgroundMode: CanvasBackgroundMode;
    showImageInfo: boolean;
    viewport: ViewportTransform;
    production?: ProductionDocument;
    /** 导演台场景：跟随画布项目一起持久化，一个项目可存多条镜头场景。 */
    directorScenes?: DirectorScene[];
};

export type CanvasDeletedProject = {
    id: string;
    deletedAt: string;
};

type CanvasStore = {
    hydrated: boolean;
    projects: CanvasProject[];
    deletedProjects: CanvasDeletedProject[];
    createProject: (title?: string) => string;
    importProject: (project: Partial<CanvasProject>) => string;
    openProject: (id: string) => CanvasProject | null;
    renameProject: (id: string, title: string) => void;
    deleteProjects: (ids: string[]) => void;
    clearDeletedProjects: (ids: string[]) => void;
    replaceProjects: (projects: CanvasProject[], deletedProjects?: CanvasDeletedProject[]) => void;
    updateProject: (id: string, patch: Partial<Pick<CanvasProject, "nodes" | "connections" | "chatSessions" | "activeChatId" | "backgroundMode" | "showImageInfo" | "viewport" | "production" | "directorScenes">>) => void;
};

const initialViewport: ViewportTransform = { x: 0, y: 0, k: 1 };
const CANVAS_STORE_KEY = "sundas:canvas_store";
export function isCanvasAccountActive(userId: string | null) {
    return useCanvasStore.persist.getOptions().name === (userId ? `${CANVAS_STORE_KEY}:${userId}` : CANVAS_STORE_KEY);
}
type PersistedCanvasState = Pick<CanvasStore, "projects" | "deletedProjects">;
let saveTimer: ReturnType<typeof setTimeout> | null = null;
let queuedPersistState: PersistedCanvasState | null = null;
let switchingCanvas = false;
let canvasHydrationError: unknown;
const canvasWrites = createSerializedWriter();

function writeCanvas(name: string, value: string) {
    return canvasWrites.write(() => localForageStorage.setItem(name, value));
}

const canvasStorage: PersistStorage<CanvasStore> = {
    getItem: async (name) => {
        const value = await localForageStorage.getItem(name);
        if (!value) return null;
        const parsed = JSON.parse(value) as StorageValue<CanvasStore>;
        queuedPersistState = parsed.state as PersistedCanvasState;
        return parsed;
    },
    setItem: (name, value) => {
        if (switchingCanvas) return;
        const nextState = value.state as PersistedCanvasState;
        if (queuedPersistState && queuedPersistState.projects === nextState.projects && queuedPersistState.deletedProjects === nextState.deletedProjects) return;
        const deletedChanged = Boolean(queuedPersistState && queuedPersistState.deletedProjects !== nextState.deletedProjects);
        queuedPersistState = nextState;
        if (saveTimer) clearTimeout(saveTimer);
        if (deletedChanged) {
            saveTimer = null;
            void writeCanvas(name, JSON.stringify(value)).catch((error) => console.error("画布本地保存失败", error));
            return;
        }
        saveTimer = setTimeout(() => {
            saveTimer = null;
            void writeCanvas(name, JSON.stringify(value)).catch((error) => console.error("画布本地保存失败", error));
        }, 400);
    },
    removeItem: (name) => localForageStorage.removeItem(name),
};

function nextProjectTitle(projects: CanvasProject[]) {
    let highest = 0;
    for (const project of projects) {
        const match = project.title.match(/(\d+)\s*$/);
        if (match) highest = Math.max(highest, Number(match[1]));
    }
    return i18n.t("canvas.defaultTitle", { count: Math.max(projects.length + 1, highest + 1) });
}

export const useCanvasStore = create<CanvasStore>()(
    persist(
        (set, get) => ({
            hydrated: false,
            projects: [],
            deletedProjects: [],
            createProject: (title) => {
                const now = new Date().toISOString();
                const id = crypto.randomUUID();
                const project: CanvasProject = {
                    id,
                    title: title?.trim() || nextProjectTitle(get().projects),
                    createdAt: now,
                    updatedAt: now,
                    nodes: [],
                    connections: [],
                    chatSessions: [],
                    activeChatId: null,
                    backgroundMode: "dots",
                    showImageInfo: false,
                    viewport: initialViewport,
                };
                set((state) => ({ projects: [project, ...state.projects] }));
                return id;
            },
            importProject: (source) => {
                const now = new Date().toISOString();
                const project: CanvasProject = {
                    id: crypto.randomUUID(),
                    title: source.title || i18n.t("canvas.project.imported"),
                    createdAt: source.createdAt || now,
                    updatedAt: now,
                    nodes: source.nodes || [],
                    connections: source.connections || [],
                    chatSessions: source.chatSessions || [],
                    activeChatId: source.activeChatId || null,
                    backgroundMode: source.backgroundMode || "dots",
                    showImageInfo: source.showImageInfo || false,
                    viewport: source.viewport || initialViewport,
                    ...(source.production ? { production: source.production } : {}),
                    ...(source.directorScenes ? { directorScenes: source.directorScenes } : {}),
                };
                set((state) => ({ projects: [project, ...state.projects] }));
                return project.id;
            },
            openProject: (id) => {
                return get().projects.find((item) => item.id === id) || null;
            },
            renameProject: (id, title) =>
                set((state) => ({
                    projects: state.projects.map((project) => (project.id === id ? { ...project, title: title.trim() || project.title, updatedAt: nextUpdatedAt(project.updatedAt) } : project)),
                })),
            deleteProjects: (ids) =>
                set((state) => {
                    const now = new Date().toISOString();
                    const removing = new Set(ids);
                    const projects = state.projects.filter((project) => !removing.has(project.id));
                    const deletedProjects = [...state.deletedProjects.filter((item) => !removing.has(item.id)), ...ids.map((id) => ({ id, deletedAt: now }))];
                    return { projects, deletedProjects };
                }),
            clearDeletedProjects: (ids) =>
                set((state) => {
                    const removing = new Set(ids);
                    return { deletedProjects: state.deletedProjects.filter((item) => !removing.has(item.id)) };
                }),
            replaceProjects: (projects, deletedProjects = []) => set({ projects, deletedProjects }),
            updateProject: (id, patch) =>
                set((state) => {
                    const current = state.projects.find(project => project.id === id);
                    if (!current || Object.entries(patch).every(([key, value]) => current[key as keyof CanvasProject] === value)) return state;
                    return { projects: state.projects.map((project) => (project.id === id ? { ...project, ...patch, updatedAt: nextUpdatedAt(project.updatedAt) } : project)) };
                }),
        }),
        {
            name: CANVAS_STORE_KEY,
            skipHydration: true,
            storage: canvasStorage,
            partialize: (state) =>
                ({
                    projects: state.projects,
                    deletedProjects: state.deletedProjects,
                }) as StorageValue<CanvasStore>["state"],
            onRehydrateStorage: () => (_state, error) => {
                canvasHydrationError = error;
                if (!error) useCanvasStore.setState({ hydrated: true });
            },
        },
    ),
);

export async function flushCanvasAccount() {
    const previous = useCanvasStore.persist.getOptions().name;
    if (!previous?.trim()) throw new Error("画布缓存标识缺失，已停止保存和切换账户");
    if (saveTimer) clearTimeout(saveTimer);
    saveTimer = null;
    await canvasWrites.flush();
    if (previous !== CANVAS_STORE_KEY && queuedPersistState) {
        await writeCanvas(previous, JSON.stringify({ state: queuedPersistState, version: 0 }));
    }
}

export async function switchCanvasAccount(userId: string | null, alreadyFlushed = false) {
    if (!alreadyFlushed) await flushCanvasAccount();
    switchingCanvas = true;
    try {
        queuedPersistState = null;
        useCanvasStore.setState({ projects: [], deletedProjects: [], hydrated: false });
        useCanvasStore.persist.setOptions({ name: userId ? `${CANVAS_STORE_KEY}:${userId}` : CANVAS_STORE_KEY });
        if (userId) {
            canvasHydrationError = undefined;
            await useCanvasStore.persist.rehydrate();
            if (canvasHydrationError) throw canvasHydrationError;
        }
    } finally {
        switchingCanvas = false;
    }
}

import { create } from "zustand";
import { useLayoutEffect } from "react";

import { useThemeStore, type ThemeName } from "@/stores/use-theme-store";

type CanvasThemeStore = {
    theme: ThemeName;
    active: boolean;
    followGlobal: boolean;
    setTheme: (theme?: string) => void;
};

/**
 * 画布主题作用域（sundas 版）。
 *
 * BeefTV 这套 store 承载「画布可独立选外观」，sundas 的外观已锁定暗色，
 * 所以这里只保留导演台等调用方需要的契约：useActiveTheme() 返回当前主题、
 * useCanvasThemeScope() 标记画布处于激活态。
 */
export const useCanvasThemeStore = create<CanvasThemeStore>()((set) => ({
    theme: useThemeStore.getState().theme,
    active: false,
    followGlobal: true,
    setTheme: (theme) => set({ theme: theme === "light" ? "light" : "dark", followGlobal: false }),
}));

useThemeStore.subscribe((state, previous) => {
    if (state.theme !== previous.theme && useCanvasThemeStore.getState().followGlobal) {
        useCanvasThemeStore.setState({ theme: state.theme });
    }
});

export function useCanvasThemeScope() {
    useLayoutEffect(() => {
        useCanvasThemeStore.setState({ active: true });
        return () => {
            useCanvasThemeStore.setState({ active: false });
        };
    }, []);
}

export function useActiveTheme() {
    const workspaceTheme = useThemeStore((state) => state.theme);
    const canvasTheme = useCanvasThemeStore((state) => state.theme);
    const active = useCanvasThemeStore((state) => state.active);
    return active ? canvasTheme : workspaceTheme;
}

    // 夹在 store 层而不是只在 UI 层过滤：dock 与顶栏是两条路径，

import { create } from 'zustand';

import type { ProductionModel, ProductionRun, ProductionRunDetail, ProductionSubmission } from '@/services/api/canvas-production';

export type ProductionTab = 'script' | 'library' | 'shots' | 'audio' | 'composition' | 'runs';
type State = { scope: string; tab: ProductionTab; focusShotId: string | null; busy: boolean; error: string; models: ProductionModel[]; runs: ProductionRun[]; detail: ProductionRunDetail | null; pending: ProductionSubmission | null; patch: (value: Partial<Omit<State, 'patch'>>) => void };
const initial = { scope: '', tab: 'script' as const, focusShotId: null, busy: false, error: '', models: [], runs: [], detail: null, pending: null };
export const useProductionStore = create<State>(set => ({ ...initial, patch: value => set(value) }));
useAuthStore.subscribe((state, previous) => {
    if (state.sessionEpoch !== previous.sessionEpoch || state.user?.id !== previous.user?.id) useProductionStore.getState().patch(initial);
});

/** Persist the authorized idempotency key before submission, including a lost HTTP response. */
export async function saveProductionSubmission(owner: string, projectId: string, value: ProductionSubmission | null) {
    const key = `sundas:production-pending:${owner}:${projectId}`;
    if (value) await localForageStorage.setItem(key, JSON.stringify(value));
    else await localForageStorage.removeItem(key);
}
export async function readProductionSubmission(owner: string, projectId: string): Promise<ProductionSubmission | null> {
    const value = await localForageStorage.getItem(`sundas:production-pending:${owner}:${projectId}`);
    if (!value) return null;
    const parsed = JSON.parse(value) as ProductionSubmission;
    if (!parsed.clientRequestId || parsed.confirmed !== true || !parsed.quoteDigest) throw new Error('原提交记录损坏，请先在生产记录核对任务');
    return parsed;
}

        try {
            const parsed = new URL(endpoint);
            if (!["http:", "https:"].includes(parsed.protocol)) throw new Error();
        } catch {
            return set({ connectError: silent ? "" : i18n.t("agent.state.invalidUrl") });

}));

useAuthStore.subscribe((state, previous) => {

import { create } from "zustand";
import { persist, type PersistStorage, type StorageValue } from "zustand/middleware";

import { localForageStorage } from "@/lib/localforage-storage";
import { nextUpdatedAt } from "@/lib/next-updated-at";
import { createSerializedWriter } from "@/lib/serialized-writer";
import { ensureImagePreview, previewUrlFor, resolveImageUrl, uploadImage } from "@/services/image-storage";
import { resolveMediaUrl } from "@/services/file-storage";

export type AssetKind = "text" | "image" | "video" | "audio" | "model";
export type TextAsset = AssetBase<"text"> & { data: { content: string } };
export type ImageAsset = AssetBase<"image"> & { data: { dataUrl: string; storageKey?: string; width: number; height: number; bytes: number; mimeType: string } };
export type VideoAsset = AssetBase<"video"> & { data: { url: string; storageKey?: string; width: number; height: number; bytes: number; mimeType: string } };
/** 3D 模型（.glb/.gltf）：给导演台把上传的自定义演员/道具存进素材库。 */
export type ModelAsset = AssetBase<"model"> & { data: { url: string; storageKey?: string; bytes: number; mimeType: string; fileName?: string } };
export type AudioAsset = AssetBase<"audio"> & { data: { url: string; storageKey?: string; width: number; height: number; bytes: number; mimeType: string; durationMs?: number } };
export type Asset = AudioAsset | TextAsset | ImageAsset | VideoAsset | ModelAsset;

type AssetBase<T extends AssetKind> = {
    id: string;
    kind: T;
    title: string;
    coverUrl: string;
    tags: string[];
    source?: string;
    note?: string;
    createdAt: string;
    updatedAt: string;
    metadata?: Record<string, unknown>;
};

type AssetStore = {
    hydrated: boolean;
    assets: Asset[];
    deletedAssets: string[];
    addAsset: (asset: Omit<Asset, "id" | "createdAt" | "updatedAt">) => string;
    updateAsset: (id: string, patch: Partial<Omit<Asset, "id" | "createdAt">>) => void;
    removeAsset: (id: string) => void;
    clearDeletedAssets: (ids: string[]) => void;
    replaceAssets: (assets: Asset[]) => void;
    cleanupImages: (extra?: unknown) => void;
};

// 卡片用缩略图渲染，自定义封面（远程地址或单独上传的封面）保持原样。
export function assetCoverUrl(asset: Asset) {
    const own = asset.kind === "image" ? asset.data.dataUrl : "";
    const cover = asset.coverUrl || own;
    return asset.kind === "image" && cover === own ? previewUrlFor(asset.data.storageKey) || cover : cover;
}

const ASSET_STORE_KEY = "sundas:asset_store";
export function isAssetAccountActive(userId: string | null) {
    return useAssetStore.persist.getOptions().name === (userId ? `${ASSET_STORE_KEY}:${userId}` : ASSET_STORE_KEY);
}
let switchingAssets = false;
let assetHydrationError: unknown;
const assetWrites = createSerializedWriter();

const assetStorage: PersistStorage<AssetStore> = {
    getItem: async (name) => {
        const value = await localForageStorage.getItem(name);
        if (!value) return null;
        const owner = name.startsWith(`${ASSET_STORE_KEY}:`) ? name.slice(ASSET_STORE_KEY.length + 1) : "";
        const hydration = { owner, isActive: () => switchingAssets && useAssetStore.persist.getOptions().name === name };
        const parsed = JSON.parse(value) as StorageValue<AssetStore>;
        parsed.state.assets = await Promise.all(
            parsed.state.assets.map(async (asset) => {
                if ((asset.kind === "video" || asset.kind === "audio") && asset.data.storageKey) return { ...asset, data: { ...asset.data, url: await resolveMediaUrl(asset.data.storageKey, asset.data.url, hydration) } };
                if (asset.kind !== "image") return asset;
                if (asset.data.storageKey) {
                    void ensureImagePreview(asset.data.storageKey);
                    return {
                        ...asset,
                        coverUrl: asset.coverUrl?.startsWith("blob:") ? await resolveImageUrl(asset.data.storageKey, asset.coverUrl, hydration) : asset.coverUrl,
                        data: { ...asset.data, dataUrl: await resolveImageUrl(asset.data.storageKey, asset.data.dataUrl, hydration) },
                    };
                }
                if (!asset.data.dataUrl?.startsWith("data:image/")) return asset;
                const image = await uploadImage(asset.data.dataUrl);
                return { ...asset, coverUrl: asset.coverUrl?.startsWith("data:image/") ? image.url : asset.coverUrl, data: { ...asset.data, dataUrl: image.url, storageKey: image.storageKey, bytes: image.bytes, mimeType: image.mimeType } };
            }),
        );
        return parsed;
    },
    setItem: (name, value) => {
        if (switchingAssets) return;
        const encoded = JSON.stringify(value);
        const write = assetWrites.write(() => localForageStorage.setItem(name, encoded));
        void write.catch((error) => console.error("素材本地保存失败", error));
        return write;
    },
    removeItem: (name) => localForageStorage.removeItem(name),
};

export const useAssetStore = create<AssetStore>()(
    persist(
        (set, get) => ({
            hydrated: false,
            assets: [],
            deletedAssets: [],
            addAsset: (asset) => {
                const now = new Date().toISOString();
                const id = crypto.randomUUID();
                set((state) => ({ assets: [{ ...asset, id, createdAt: now, updatedAt: now } as Asset, ...state.assets] }));
                return id;
            },
            updateAsset: (id, patch) =>
                set((state) => ({
                    assets: state.assets.map((asset) => (asset.id === id ? ({ ...asset, ...patch, updatedAt: nextUpdatedAt(asset.updatedAt) } as Asset) : asset)),
                })),
            removeAsset: (id) =>
                set((state) => {
                    const assets = state.assets.filter((asset) => asset.id !== id);
                    get().cleanupImages({ assets });
                    return { assets, deletedAssets: [...new Set([...state.deletedAssets, id])] };
                }),
            clearDeletedAssets: (ids) => set((state) => ({ deletedAssets: state.deletedAssets.filter((id) => !ids.includes(id)) })),
            replaceAssets: (assets) => set({ assets }),
            // 媒体文件存储仍被所有账户共享，不能按当前账户引用删除其他账户的离线文件。
            cleanupImages: () => {},
        }),
        {
            name: ASSET_STORE_KEY,
            skipHydration: true,
            storage: assetStorage,
            partialize: (state) => ({ assets: state.assets, deletedAssets: state.deletedAssets }) as StorageValue<AssetStore>["state"],
            onRehydrateStorage: () => (_state, error) => {
                assetHydrationError = error;
                if (!error) useAssetStore.setState({ hydrated: true });
            },
        },
    ),
);

export async function flushAssetAccount() {
    await assetWrites.flush();
    const previous = useAssetStore.persist.getOptions().name;
    if (!previous?.trim()) throw new Error("资产缓存标识缺失，已停止保存和切换账户");
    if (previous !== ASSET_STORE_KEY && useAssetStore.getState().hydrated) {
        const { assets, deletedAssets } = useAssetStore.getState();
        await assetWrites.write(() => localForageStorage.setItem(previous, JSON.stringify({ state: { assets, deletedAssets }, version: 0 })));
    }
}

export async function switchAssetAccount(userId: string | null, alreadyFlushed = false) {
    if (!alreadyFlushed) await flushAssetAccount();
    switchingAssets = true;
    try {
        useAssetStore.setState({ assets: [], deletedAssets: [], hydrated: false });
        useAssetStore.persist.setOptions({ name: userId ? `${ASSET_STORE_KEY}:${userId}` : ASSET_STORE_KEY });
        if (userId) {
            assetHydrationError = undefined;
            await useAssetStore.persist.rehydrate();
            if (assetHydrationError) throw assetHydrationError;
        }
    } finally {
        switchingAssets = false;
    }
}

import { create } from "zustand";

import { apiRequest } from "@/services/api/client";
import { createSerializedWriter } from "@/lib/serialized-writer";
import { useCanvasUiStore } from "@/stores/canvas/use-canvas-ui-store";
import { useWorkbenchAgentStore } from "@/stores/use-workbench-agent-store";
import { broadcastSessionChange } from "@/lib/session-broadcast";
import { clearSessionMediaCaches } from "@/lib/media-object-urls";

const authTransitions = createSerializedWriter();
let authEpoch = 0;
let walletRequest = 0;

async function switchCachedAccount(userId: string | null) {
    const [{ switchCanvasAccount, flushCanvasAccount }, { switchAssetAccount, flushAssetAccount }] = await Promise.all([
        import("@/stores/canvas/use-canvas-store"), import("@/stores/use-asset-store"),
    ]);
    const flushes = await Promise.allSettled([flushCanvasAccount(), flushAssetAccount()]);
    const flushError = flushes.find((item): item is PromiseRejectedResult => item.status === "rejected");
    if (flushError) throw flushError.reason;
    const switches = await Promise.allSettled([switchCanvasAccount(userId, true), switchAssetAccount(userId, true)]);
    const switchError = switches.find((item): item is PromiseRejectedResult => item.status === "rejected");
    if (switchError) throw switchError.reason;
}

export type AuthUser = {
    id: string;
    email: string;
    displayName: string;
    role: "user" | "admin";
    status: "active" | "banned";
};

export type WalletState = {
    balance: number;
    availableCredits?: number;
    held: number;
    member: boolean;
    memberUntil: string | null;
    planName?: string | null;
    planId?: string | null;
    tierName?: string | null;
    tierLevel?: number | null;
    generationDiscount?: number;
    monthlyCredits?: number;
    storage?: { usedBytes: number; limitBytes: number };
};

type AuthState = {
    user: AuthUser | null;
    wallet: WalletState | null;
    ready: boolean;
    sessionEpoch: number;
    hydrate: () => Promise<void>;
    externalSessionChanged: () => Promise<void>;
    refreshWallet: () => Promise<void>;
    login: (email: string, password: string) => Promise<AuthUser>;
    register: (email: string, code: string, password: string, inviteCode?: string) => Promise<AuthUser>;
    logout: () => Promise<void>;
    sendCode: (email: string, purpose: "register" | "reset") => Promise<void>;
    resetPassword: (email: string, code: string, password: string) => Promise<void>;
    changePassword: (oldPassword: string, newPassword: string, expectedUserId?: string) => Promise<void>;
};

async function hydrateNow(set: (state: Partial<AuthState>) => void) {
    const epoch = authEpoch;
    const safeSet = (state: Partial<AuthState>) => { if (authEpoch === epoch) set(state); };
    safeSet({ ready: false, user: null, wallet: null });
    try {
        let data: { user: AuthUser | null; wallet?: WalletState };
        try { data = await apiRequest<{ user: AuthUser | null; wallet?: WalletState }>("/api/auth/me"); }
        catch { throw new Error("无法确认登录状态，请检查网络后刷新页面"); }
        if (authEpoch !== epoch) return;
        try { await switchCachedAccount(data.user?.id ?? null); }
        catch (error) {
            if (error instanceof Error && error.name === "LocalMediaOwnershipError") throw new Error(error.message);
            throw new Error("本地账户数据加载失败，请检查浏览器存储后刷新页面");
        }
        safeSet({ user: data.user, wallet: data.user ? (data.wallet ?? null) : null });
    } finally { safeSet({ ready: true }); }
}

export const useAuthStore = create<AuthState>((set, get) => ({
    user: null,
    wallet: null,
    ready: false,
    sessionEpoch: 0,

    hydrate: () => authTransitions.write(async () => { authEpoch += 1; set({ sessionEpoch: authEpoch }); await hydrateNow(set); }),

    externalSessionChanged: () => {
        const epoch = ++authEpoch;
        set({ ready: false, user: null, wallet: null, sessionEpoch: epoch });
        return authTransitions.write(async () => { if (authEpoch === epoch) await hydrateNow(set); });
    },

    refreshWallet: async () => {
        const owner = get().user?.id;
        const epoch = authEpoch;
        if (!owner || !get().ready) return;
        const request = ++walletRequest;
        const wallet = await apiRequest<WalletState>("/api/wallet", { headers: { "X-Sundas-User": owner } });
        if (get().ready && get().user?.id === owner && authEpoch === epoch && request === walletRequest) set({ wallet });
    },

    login: (email, password) => authTransitions.write(async () => {
        authEpoch += 1;
        const epoch = authEpoch;
        set({ ready: false, sessionEpoch: authEpoch });
        try {
            try { await switchCachedAccount(null); }
            catch { throw new Error("本地数据保存失败，请检查浏览器存储空间后重试"); }
            if (authEpoch === epoch) set({ user: null, wallet: null });
        } finally { if (authEpoch === epoch) set({ ready: true }); }
        const data = await apiRequest<{ user: AuthUser }>("/api/auth/login", { method: "POST", json: { email, password } });
        broadcastSessionChange();
        try { await hydrateNow(set); }
        catch (error) { throw new Error(`登录已提交，但会话确认失败：${error instanceof Error ? error.message : "请刷新页面"}`); }
        if (get().user?.id !== data.user.id) throw new Error("登录已提交，但会话未能确认，请刷新页面后重试");
        return data.user;
    }),

    register: (email, code, password, inviteCode) => authTransitions.write(async () => {
        authEpoch += 1;
        const epoch = authEpoch;
        set({ ready: false, sessionEpoch: authEpoch });
        try {
            try { await switchCachedAccount(null); }
            catch { throw new Error("本地数据保存失败，请检查浏览器存储空间后重试"); }
            if (authEpoch === epoch) set({ user: null, wallet: null });
        } finally { if (authEpoch === epoch) set({ ready: true }); }
        const data = await apiRequest<{ user: AuthUser }>("/api/auth/register", { method: "POST", json: { email, code, password, inviteCode: inviteCode || undefined } });
        broadcastSessionChange();
        try { await hydrateNow(set); }
        catch (error) { throw new Error(`注册已提交，请勿重复注册；会话确认失败：${error instanceof Error ? error.message : "请刷新页面后登录"}`); }
        if (get().user?.id !== data.user.id) throw new Error("注册已提交，但会话未能确认，请刷新页面后登录");
        return data.user;
    }),

    logout: () => authTransitions.write(async () => {
        const owner = get().user?.id;
        authEpoch += 1;
        const epoch = authEpoch;
        set({ ready: false, sessionEpoch: authEpoch });
        try {
            try { await switchCachedAccount(null); }
            catch { throw new Error("本地数据保存失败，尚未退出，请检查浏览器存储空间后重试"); }
            if (authEpoch !== epoch) return;
            if (authEpoch === epoch) set({ user: null, wallet: null });
            await apiRequest("/api/auth/logout", { method: "POST", headers: owner ? { "X-Sundas-User": owner } : undefined });
            broadcastSessionChange();
        } finally {
            if (authEpoch === epoch) set({ ready: true });
        }
    }),

    sendCode: async (email, purpose) => {
        await apiRequest("/api/auth/send-code", { method: "POST", json: { email, purpose } });
    },

    resetPassword: async (email, code, password) => {
        await apiRequest("/api/auth/reset-password", { method: "POST", json: { email, code, password } });
    },

    changePassword: async (oldPassword, newPassword, expectedUserId) => {
        await apiRequest("/api/auth/change-password", { method: "POST", headers: expectedUserId ? { "X-Sundas-User": expectedUserId } : undefined, json: { oldPassword, newPassword } });
    },
}));

useAuthStore.subscribe((state, previous) => {
    if (state.sessionEpoch !== previous.sessionEpoch || state.user?.id !== previous.user?.id) {
        clearSessionMediaCaches();
        useCanvasUiStore.getState().reset();
        useWorkbenchAgentStore.getState().reset();
    }
});

import { create } from "zustand";

export const CANVAS_SIDE_PANEL_MOTION_MS = 500;
export const CANVAS_SIDE_PANEL_MIN_WIDTH = 220;
export const CANVAS_SIDE_PANEL_MAX_WIDTH = 480;
export const CANVAS_SIDE_PANEL_DEFAULT_WIDTH = 280;

const WIDTH_KEY = "canvas-side-panel-width";
const OPEN_KEY = "canvas-side-panel-open";
const NODE_VIEW_KEY = "canvas-side-panel-node-view";

export type CanvasNodeViewMode = "list" | "grid";

function initialWidth() {
    if (typeof window === "undefined") return CANVAS_SIDE_PANEL_DEFAULT_WIDTH;
    const stored = Number(localStorage.getItem(WIDTH_KEY));
    if (!stored) return CANVAS_SIDE_PANEL_DEFAULT_WIDTH;
    return Math.min(CANVAS_SIDE_PANEL_MAX_WIDTH, Math.max(CANVAS_SIDE_PANEL_MIN_WIDTH, stored));
}

function initialOpen() {
    if (typeof window === "undefined") return true;
    const stored = localStorage.getItem(OPEN_KEY);
    if (stored === "1") return true;
    if (stored === "0") return false;
    // 首次访问时小屏默认收起，避免移动端面板遮挡画布；桌面端保持展开。
    return !window.matchMedia("(max-width: 767px)").matches;
}

function initialNodeView(): CanvasNodeViewMode {
    if (typeof window === "undefined") return "list";
    return localStorage.getItem(NODE_VIEW_KEY) === "grid" ? "grid" : "list";
}

type CanvasSidePanelStore = {
    width: number;
    panelOpen: boolean;
    panelMounted: boolean;
    panelClosing: boolean;
    nodeViewMode: CanvasNodeViewMode;
    setWidth: (width: number) => void;
    setNodeViewMode: (mode: CanvasNodeViewMode) => void;
    openPanel: () => void;
    closePanel: () => void;
    togglePanel: () => void;
};

export const useCanvasSidePanelStore = create<CanvasSidePanelStore>((set, get) => ({
    width: initialWidth(),
    panelOpen: initialOpen(),
    panelMounted: initialOpen(),
    panelClosing: false,
    nodeViewMode: initialNodeView(),
    setWidth: (width) => set({ width }),
    setNodeViewMode: (mode) => {
        if (typeof window !== "undefined") localStorage.setItem(NODE_VIEW_KEY, mode);
        set({ nodeViewMode: mode });
    },
    openPanel: () => {
        if (typeof window !== "undefined") localStorage.setItem(OPEN_KEY, "1");
        set({ panelOpen: true, panelMounted: true, panelClosing: false });
    },
    closePanel: () => {
        if (!get().panelMounted || get().panelClosing) return;
        if (typeof window !== "undefined") localStorage.setItem(OPEN_KEY, "0");
        set({ panelOpen: false, panelClosing: true });
        setTimeout(() => {
            if (get().panelClosing) set({ panelMounted: false, panelClosing: false });
        }, CANVAS_SIDE_PANEL_MOTION_MS);
    },
    togglePanel: () => (get().panelOpen ? get().closePanel() : get().openPanel()),
}));

type ConfigStore = {

    serverModels: ServerModelInfo[];

const VIDEO_KEYWORDS = ["video", "seedance", "sora", "veo", "kling", "wan", "hailuo"];

export function boolConfig(value: string, fallback: boolean) {
    return value ? value === "true" : fallback;
}
const AUDIO_KEYWORDS = ["audio", "tts", "speech", "voice", "music", "sound"];
const IMAGE_KEYWORDS = ["seedream", "gpt-image", "image", "dall-e", "dalle", "imagen", "flux", "sdxl", "stable-diffusion", "midjourney"];

/** Best-effort default capability for a freshly fetched model name; user can override in the channel editor. */
export function guessCapability(name: string): ModelCapability {
    const value = name.toLowerCase();
    if (VIDEO_KEYWORDS.some((keyword) => value.includes(keyword))) return "video";
    if (AUDIO_KEYWORDS.some((keyword) => value.includes(keyword))) return "audio";
    if (IMAGE_KEYWORDS.some((keyword) => value.includes(keyword))) return "image";
    return "text";
}

function findChannelModel(config: AiConfig, value: string): { channel: ModelChannel; model: ChannelModel } | null {
    const decoded = decodeChannelModel(value);
    const name = decoded?.model || value;
    const channel = decoded ? config.channels.find((item) => item.id === decoded.channelId) : config.channels.find((item) => item.models.some((model) => model.name === name));
    const model = channel?.models.find((item) => item.name === name);
    return channel && model ? { channel, model } : null;
}

export function modelCapabilityOf(config: AiConfig, value: string): ModelCapability | undefined {
    return findChannelModel(config, value)?.model.capability;
}

export function modelMatchesCapability(config: AiConfig, value: string, capability?: ModelCapability) {
    if (!capability) return true;
    return modelCapabilityOf(config, value) === capability;
}

export function resolveModelForCapability(config: AiConfig, currentModel: string | undefined, capability: ModelCapability) {
    const defaultModel = capability === "image" ? config.imageModel : capability === "video" ? config.videoModel : capability === "audio" ? config.audioModel : config.textModel;
    const fallbackModel = capability === "image" ? defaultConfig.imageModel : capability === "video" ? defaultConfig.videoModel : capability === "audio" ? defaultConfig.audioModel : defaultConfig.textModel;
    for (const model of [currentModel, defaultModel]) {
        if (!model) continue;
        const configuredCapability = modelCapabilityOf(config, model);
        // Keep unavailable selections visible so the readiness check blocks the
        // request. Only a known capability switch may choose another model.
        if (!configuredCapability || configuredCapability === capability) return model;
    }
    return fallbackModel;
}

export function selectableModelsByCapability(config: AiConfig, capability?: ModelCapability) {
    if (!capability) return config.models;
    return config.channels.flatMap((channel) => channel.models.filter((model) => model.capability === capability).map((model) => encodeChannelModel(channel.id, model.name)));
}

/** Generation requests always use the site's gateway. */
export function resolveModelScript(_config: AiConfig, _value: string) {
    return "";
}

function isAiConfigReady(config: AiConfig, model: string) {
    const match = findChannelModel(config, model);
    return Boolean(match && match.channel.baseUrl.trim() && match.channel.apiKey.trim());
}

export const useConfigStore = create<ConfigStore>()(
    persist(
        (set, get) => ({
            config: defaultConfig,
            serverModels: [],
            isConfigOpen: false,
            shouldPromptContinue: false,
            updateConfig: (key, value) =>
                set((state) => ({
                    config: {
                        ...state.config,
                        [key]: value,
                    },
                })),
            importChannelCredentials: (input) => {
                const currentConfig = get().config;
                const result = upsertChannelCredentials(currentConfig, input);
                if (result.config !== currentConfig) set({ config: result.config });
                return { status: result.status, channelName: result.channelName };
            },
            isAiConfigReady: (config, model) => isAiConfigReady(config, model),
            openConfigDialog: (shouldPromptContinue = false) => set({ isConfigOpen: true, shouldPromptContinue }),
            setConfigDialogOpen: (isConfigOpen) => set({ isConfigOpen }),
            clearPromptContinue: () => set({ shouldPromptContinue: false }),
        }),
        {
            name: CONFIG_STORE_KEY,
            partialize: (state) => ({ config: state.config }),
            merge: (persisted, current) => {
                const persistedState = (persisted || {}) as Partial<ConfigStore>;
                const persistedConfig = (persistedState.config || {}) as Partial<AiConfig>;
                const config = { ...defaultConfig, ...persistedConfig };
                if (!Array.isArray(persistedConfig.channels)) config.channels = [];
                const channels = normalizeChannels(config);
                const models = modelOptionsFromChannels(channels);
                return {
                    ...current,
                    config: {
                        ...config,
                        channelMode: "local",
                        apiFormat: normalizeApiFormat(config.apiFormat),
                        channels,
                        models,
                        imageModel: normalizeModelOptionValue(config.imageModel || config.model, channels),
                        videoModel: normalizeModelOptionValue(config.videoModel, channels),
                        textModel: normalizeModelOptionValue(config.textModel || config.model, channels),
                        audioModel: normalizeModelOptionValue(config.audioModel || defaultConfig.audioModel, channels),
                        audioVoice: config.audioVoice || defaultConfig.audioVoice,
                        audioFormat: config.audioFormat || defaultConfig.audioFormat,
                        audioSpeed: config.audioSpeed || defaultConfig.audioSpeed,
                        audioInstructions: config.audioInstructions || "",
                        reasoningEffort: config.reasoningEffort || "auto",
                        videoSeconds: config.videoSeconds || "6",
                        vquality: config.vquality || "720",
                        videoGenerateAudio: config.videoGenerateAudio || "true",
                        videoWatermark: config.videoWatermark || "false",
                        videoMode: config.videoMode === "reference" ? "reference" : "frames",
                        canvasImageCount: config.canvasImageCount || "3",
                        proxyEnabled: Boolean(config.proxyEnabled),
                        proxyUrl: config.proxyUrl || DEFAULT_LOCAL_PROXY_URL,
                        nodeRegenerateBehavior: config.nodeRegenerateBehavior === "overwrite" ? "overwrite" : "new-node",
                        autoFocusOnSelect: Boolean(config.autoFocusOnSelect),
                    },
                };
            },
        },
    ),
);

export function useEffectiveConfig() {
    const config = useConfigStore((state) => state.config);
    return useMemo(() => ({ ...config, channelMode: "local" as const }), [config]);
}

/** Normalize a mixed list of raw model names or model objects into deduped ChannelModel entries. */
export function normalizeChannelModels(models: Array<string | ChannelModel> | undefined): ChannelModel[] {
    const seen = new Set<string>();
    const result: ChannelModel[] = [];
    for (const item of models || []) {
        const name = (typeof item === "string" ? item : item?.name || "").trim();
        if (!name || seen.has(name)) continue;
        seen.add(name);
        const capability = typeof item === "string" ? guessCapability(name) : item.capability || guessCapability(name);
        const script = typeof item === "string" ? undefined : item.script?.trim() || undefined;
        result.push({ name, capability, script });
    }
    return result;
}

export function createModelChannel(channel?: Partial<ModelChannel>): ModelChannel {
    const apiFormat = normalizeApiFormat(channel?.apiFormat);
    return {
        id: channel?.id?.trim() || nanoid(),
        name: channel?.name?.trim() || i18n.t("config.channels.newName"),
        baseUrl: channel?.baseUrl?.trim() || defaultBaseUrlForApiFormat(apiFormat),
        apiKey: channel?.apiKey || "",
        apiFormat,
        models: normalizeChannelModels(channel?.models),
    };
}

export function upsertChannelCredentials(
    config: AiConfig,
    input: { baseUrl?: string | null; apiKey?: string | null },
): ChannelCredentialsImportResult & { config: AiConfig } {
    const rawBaseUrl = input.baseUrl?.trim() || "";
    if (!rawBaseUrl) return { status: "missing-base-url", config };
    if (!isHttpBaseUrl(rawBaseUrl)) return { status: "invalid-base-url", config };

    const baseUrl = normalizeImportedBaseUrl(rawBaseUrl);
    const apiKey = input.apiKey?.trim() || "";
    const matchingIndex = config.channels.findIndex((channel) => normalizedBaseUrlKey(channel.baseUrl) === normalizedBaseUrlKey(baseUrl));

    if (matchingIndex >= 0) {
        const existing = config.channels[matchingIndex];
        if (existing.baseUrl === baseUrl && (!apiKey || existing.apiKey === apiKey)) {
            return { status: "updated", channelName: existing.name, config };
        }
        const updated = { ...existing, baseUrl, ...(apiKey ? { apiKey } : {}) };
        const channels = config.channels.map((channel, index) => (index === matchingIndex ? updated : channel));
        return { status: "updated", channelName: existing.name, config: { ...config, channels } };
    }

    const channel = createModelChannel({
        name: importedChannelName(baseUrl),
        baseUrl,
        apiKey,
        apiFormat: "openai",
        models: [],
    });
    return { status: "created", channelName: channel.name, config: { ...config, channels: [...config.channels, channel] } };
}

function isHttpBaseUrl(baseUrl: string) {
    try {
        const url = new URL(baseUrl);
        return (url.protocol === "http:" || url.protocol === "https:") && Boolean(url.hostname);
    } catch {
        return false;
    }
}

function normalizedBaseUrlKey(baseUrl: string) {
    try {
        return stripTrailingApiVersion(normalizeImportedBaseUrl(baseUrl));
    } catch {
        return stripTrailingApiVersion(baseUrl.trim().replace(/\/+$/, ""));
    }
}

function normalizeImportedBaseUrl(baseUrl: string) {
    const url = new URL(baseUrl.trim());
    url.hash = "";
    return url.toString().replace(/\/+$/, "");
}

function stripTrailingApiVersion(baseUrl: string) {
    return baseUrl.replace(/\/v1$/i, "");
}

function importedChannelName(baseUrl: string) {
    const hostname = new URL(baseUrl).hostname;
    return hostname.replace(/^(?:www|api)\./i, "") || i18n.t("config.channels.newName");
}

export function encodeChannelModel(channelId: string, model: string) {
    return `${channelId}${CHANNEL_MODEL_SEPARATOR}${model.trim()}`;
}

export function isChannelModelValue(value: string) {
    return value.includes(CHANNEL_MODEL_SEPARATOR);
}

export function decodeChannelModel(value: string) {
    const index = value.indexOf(CHANNEL_MODEL_SEPARATOR);
    if (index < 0) return null;
    return { channelId: value.slice(0, index), model: value.slice(index + CHANNEL_MODEL_SEPARATOR.length) };
}

export function modelOptionName(value: string) {
    return decodeChannelModel(value)?.model || value;
}

export function modelOptionLabel(config: AiConfig, value: string) {
    const decoded = decodeChannelModel(value);
    if (!decoded) return value;
    const serverModel = useConfigStore.getState().serverModels.find((model) => model.id === decoded.model);
    if (serverModel) return serverModel.name;
    const channel = config.channels.find((item) => item.id === decoded.channelId);
    return channel ? `${decoded.model}（${channel.name}）` : decoded.model;
}

export function modelOptionsFromChannels(channels: ModelChannel[]) {
    return uniqueModelOptions(channels.flatMap((channel) => channel.models.map((model) => encodeChannelModel(channel.id, model.name))));
}

export function normalizeModelOptionValue(value: string | undefined, channels: ModelChannel[]) {
    const model = (value || "").trim();
    if (!model) return "";
    const decoded = decodeChannelModel(model);
    if (decoded) {
        const channel = channels.find((item) => item.id === decoded.channelId);
        return channel && channel.models.some((item) => item.name === decoded.model) ? model : "";
    }
    const channel = channels.find((item) => item.models.some((entry) => entry.name === model)) || channels[0];
    return channel && channel.models.some((item) => item.name === model) ? encodeChannelModel(channel.id, model) : model;
}

export function resolveModelChannel(config: AiConfig, value: string) {
    const decoded = decodeChannelModel(value);
    const model = decoded?.model || value;
    const matched = decoded ? config.channels.find((channel) => channel.id === decoded.channelId) : config.channels.find((channel) => channel.models.some((item) => item.name === model));
    return matched || config.channels[0] || createModelChannel({ id: "default", name: i18n.t("config.channels.defaultName"), baseUrl: config.baseUrl, apiKey: config.apiKey, apiFormat: config.apiFormat, models: config.models.map(modelOptionName).map((name) => ({ name, capability: guessCapability(name) })) });
}

export function resolveModelRequestConfig(config: AiConfig, value: string) {
    return {
        ...config,
        model: modelOptionName(value || config.model),
        baseUrl: `${window.location.origin}/api`,
        apiKey: "server",
        apiFormat: "openai" as const,
    };
}

function normalizeChannels(config: AiConfig) {
    const persistedChannels = Array.isArray(config.channels) ? config.channels : [];
    const channels = persistedChannels.map((channel, index) =>
        createModelChannel({
            ...channel,
            id: channel.id || (index === 0 ? "default" : `channel-${index + 1}`),
            name: channel.name || (index === 0 ? i18n.t("config.channels.defaultName") : i18n.t("config.channels.indexedName", { index: index + 1 })),
            models: normalizeChannelModels(channel.models),
        }),
    );
    if (!channels.length) {
        channels.push(
            createModelChannel({
                id: "default",
                name: i18n.t("config.channels.defaultName"),
                baseUrl: config.baseUrl || defaultConfig.baseUrl,
                apiKey: config.apiKey || "",
                apiFormat: config.apiFormat || defaultConfig.apiFormat,
                models: normalizeChannelModels([config.model, config.imageModel, config.videoModel, config.textModel, config.audioModel].map(modelOptionName)),
            }),
        );
    }
    return channels;
}

export function defaultBaseUrlForApiFormat(apiFormat: ApiCallFormat) {
    if (apiFormat === "gemini") return GEMINI_BASE_URL;
    return OPENAI_BASE_URL;
}

function normalizeApiFormat(apiFormat: unknown): ApiCallFormat {
    return apiFormat === "gemini" ? apiFormat : "openai";
}

function uniqueModelOptions(models: string[]) {
    return Array.from(new Set((models || []).map((model) => model.trim()).filter(Boolean)));
}

export function buildApiUrl(baseUrl: string, path: string) {
    const normalizedBaseUrl = baseUrl.trim().replace(/\/+$/, "");
    const lowerBaseUrl = normalizedBaseUrl.toLowerCase();
    const apiBaseUrl = lowerBaseUrl.endsWith("/v1") ? normalizedBaseUrl : `${normalizedBaseUrl}/v1`;
    return withLocalProxy(`${apiBaseUrl}${path}`);
}

export function normalizeLocalProxyUrl(value: string) {
    const trimmed = value.trim().replace(/\/+$/, "");
    if (!trimmed) return "";
    return /^https?:\/\//i.test(trimmed) ? trimmed : `http://${trimmed}`;
}

/** Prefix an outgoing request with the local forwarding proxy so the browser is not blocked by CORS. */
export function withLocalProxy(url: string) {
    // Requests to our gateway must retain the browser session and never use a legacy forwarding proxy.
    if (typeof window !== "undefined" && /^https?:\/\//i.test(url) && new URL(url).origin === window.location.origin) return url;
    const { proxyEnabled, proxyUrl } = useConfigStore.getState().config;
    if (!proxyEnabled || !/^https?:\/\//i.test(url)) return url;
    const base = normalizeLocalProxyUrl(proxyUrl);
    if (!base || url.startsWith(`${base}/`)) return url;
    return `${base}/${url}`;
}

FILE: web/src/stores/use-operation-progress.ts

import { create } from "zustand";
import { nanoid } from "nanoid";

export type OperationPhase = "preparing" | "transferring" | "processing" | "done" | "error";

export type OperationProgress = {
    id: string;
    title: string;
    detail: string;
    phase: OperationPhase;
    totalBytes?: number;
    loadedBytes?: number;
    totalFiles?: number;
    doneFiles?: number;
    startedAt: number;
    updatedAt: number;
};

type ProgressStore = { entries: Record<string, OperationProgress>; remove: (id: string) => void };

/**
 * 操作进度（sundas 精简版）。
 *
 * BeefTV 这套 store 还带「画布节点任务」聚合与速率采样；sundas 目前只有导演台
 * 导出白膜视频会用到它，所以只保留 startOperation 的进度契约，
 * 供调用方上报进度/完成/失败，UI 侧按需读取 entries。
 */
export const useOperationProgress = create<ProgressStore>((set) => ({
    entries: {},
    remove: (id) =>
        set((state) => {
            const entries = { ...state.entries };
            delete entries[id];
            return { entries };
        }),
}));

export function startOperation(title: string, options: { detail?: string; totalBytes?: number; totalFiles?: number } = {}) {
    const id = nanoid();
    const startedAt = Date.now();
    let finished = false;

    const patch = (next: Partial<OperationProgress>) => {
        if (finished) return;
        useOperationProgress.setState((state) => {
            const previous = state.entries[id];
            if (!previous) return state;
            return { entries: { ...state.entries, [id]: { ...previous, ...next, updatedAt: Date.now() } } };
        });
    };

    useOperationProgress.setState((state) => ({
        entries: {
            ...state.entries,
            [id]: {
                id,
                title,
                detail: options.detail || "正在准备文件",
                phase: "preparing",
                totalBytes: options.totalBytes,
                totalFiles: options.totalFiles,
                startedAt,
                updatedAt: startedAt,
            },
        },
    }));

    const settle = (phase: "done" | "error", detail: string) => {
        patch({ phase, detail });
        finished = true;
        if (phase === "done") window.setTimeout(() => useOperationProgress.getState().remove(id), 4500);
    };

    return {
        update: patch,
        progress: (loaded: number, total?: number) =>
            patch({ loadedBytes: loaded, totalBytes: total, phase: total && loaded >= total ? "processing" : "transferring", detail: total && loaded >= total ? "文件已传输，正在确认与保存" : "正在传输文件" }),
        done: (detail = "处理完成") => settle("done", detail),
        fail: (detail = "处理没有完成，请重试") => settle("error", detail),
        dismiss: () => {
            finished = true;
            useOperationProgress.getState().remove(id);
        },
    };
}

FILE: web/src/stores/use-workbench-agent-store.ts
